# Scientific Visualization 2026 – Course Exercises

## Course Exercises Overview

This repository contains C++ and shader implementations for the Scientific Visualization course exercises[cite: 1]:

* **Exercise 1: Point Rendering**
  * Implements 3D point cloud visualization using point splatting, expanding particles into screen-facing billboards, and calculating ray–sphere intersections, depth buffer writing, and transfer function color mapping in the fragment shader[cite: 1].
* **Exercise 2: Direct Volume Rendering**
  * Implements GPU-based direct volume rendering on 3D CT scalar fields via proxy geometry ray marching, Beer–Lambert transfer function lookup, front-to-back compositing, and single-scattering shadow rays[cite: 2].
* **Exercise 3: Isosurface Ray Casting**
  * Directly computes volume isosurfaces by detecting sign changes along camera rays, refining surface intersections using bisection, calculating central difference normals, and rendering Lambertian shading with dynamic shadows[cite: 3].
* **Exercise 4: Critical Point Extraction**
  * Locates and classifies vector field critical points ($v(x) = 0$) using a recursive voxel subdivision algorithm with early-out sign tests, Jacobian matrix evaluation, and eigenvalue analysis (sinks, sources, saddles)[cite: 4].
* **Exercise 5: Line-based Flow Visualization**
  * Traces 3D streamlines using Euler, RK2, and RK4 numerical integration schemes, visualized using the Zöckler et al. illuminated streamline shading model and periodic brightness animation[cite: 5].
* **Exercise 6: Texture-based Flow Visualization (LIC)**
  * Implements Line Integral Convolution (LIC) in a GPU compute shader, generating dense 2D flow representations by convolving noise textures along forward and backward RK4 streamlines[cite: 6].
* **Exercise 7: Unsteady Flow Visualization (FTLE)**
  * Computes Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponents (FTLE) on time-dependent double gyre flows using RK4 trajectory integration, Cauchy–Green deformation tensors, and comparing finite difference gradients against localized linearization methods[cite: 7].
* **Exercise 8: Stream Surface Extraction**
  * Extracts 2D stream surfaces in 3D vector fields using the Hultquist advancing front algorithm, incorporating recursive diagonal edge evaluation and adaptive front refinement[cite: 8].
* **Exercise 9: Feature-based Flow Visualization**
  * Extracts flow structures around 3D geometry using finite-difference spatial derivatives to evaluate four classical vortex criteria: Vorticity Magnitude, Helicity, Q-Criterion, and the $\lambda_2$ Criterion[cite: 9].

---

## Installation

### Git and CMake

Before we begin, you must have Git running, a distributed revision control system which you need to keep track of your code changes. We refer you to the online [Pro Git book](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2) for more information. On Windows, we suggest using [git for windows](https://git-for-windows.github.io/).

CMake is the system this framework uses for cross-platform builds. If you are using Linux or macOS, we recommend installing it with a package manager instead of the CMake download page. E.g. on Debian/Ubuntu:
```
sudo apt-get install cmake
```
or with MacPorts on macOS:
```
sudo port install cmake.
```
On Windows, you can download it from:
[https://cmake.org/download/](https://cmake.org/download/)

---

### Note for Linux users

Many linux distributions do not include `gcc` and the basic development tools in their default installation. On Ubuntu, you need to install the following packages:

```
sudo apt-get install build-essential libx11-dev mesa-common-dev libgl1-mesa-dev libglu1-mesa-dev libxrandr-dev libxi-dev libxmu-dev libblas-dev libxinerama-dev libxcursor-dev libwayland-dev libxkbcommon-dev
```

If you are using linux with a virtual machine on Windows, it is *recommended* to use **Visual Studio** instead.

---

### Note for Windows users

You can download *Visual Studio Community* for free from [here](https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/vs/).
Install Visual Studio with the **Desktop development with C++** workload enabled. This provides the compiler and tools required to build the exercises. If you would like to use the Direct3D backend, also enabled the **Game development with C++** workload.

---

## Enabling Your RRZE GitLab Account

If you cannot access the course repository, your RRZE GitLab account must be activated.

1. Go to the IdM portal:  
   https://www.idm.fau.de/grow/?lang=de
2. Enable the RRZE GitLab service.
3. As the reason, enter:  
   **"Need access for programming exercises of the course Scientific Visualization."**
4. After activation, it may take a few minutes until access is available.

---

## Download the Dataset

Before building the exercises, [download the datasets from FAUbox](https://faubox.rrze.uni-erlangen.de/getlink/fiHoRC8uAANYi3PyNx34VV/SciVis).

Place the files somewhere on your system, for example:

```
C:/scivis-datasets/
```

You will pass this dataset path to the example applications as a command‑line argument, e.g.:

```
./scivis/0_empty/scivis_0_empty C:/scivis-datasets/
```

The applications will look for files such as `tornado.am` or `boeing747.am` inside this directory.

---

## Cloning Your Exercise Repository

Before you are able to clone your private exercise repository, you need to have an active [gitlab@FAU](https://gitlab.rrze.fau.de/) account. Then you can [fork](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/repository/forking_workflow.html) this project to create your own private online repository.

In the next step, you need to clone it to your local hard drive:

```
git clone git@gitlab.rrze.fau.de:'Your_Git_Username'/scivis-ss26.git
```

'Your_Git_Username' needs to be replaced accordingly. This can take a moment.

Next, cd into the newly created folder, and run the following commands inside the relevant subfolder to setup the build folder:

```
cd scivis-ss26
mkdir build
cd build
cmake ..
```

On Windows, use the CMAKE gui with the buttons Configure and Generate.

Compile and run the executable, e.g. Ubuntu with single-target build system:
```
make && ./bin/scivis_0_empty /path/to/datasets/
```
Or for Ubuntu with multi-target build system you can choose:
```
make && ./bin/Debug/scivis_0_empty /path/to/datasets/
make && ./bin/Release/scivis_0_empty /path/to/datasets/
```

Or use your favorite IDE. In case of Visual Studio, you need to open ```build/vislab.sln(x)``` file.

---

## Updating Your Fork

To update your forked repository, check this page: [how-do-i-update-a-github-forked-repository](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/7244321/how-do-i-update-a-github-forked-repository)

Basically, you are required to add our repository as a remote to your own one:

```
git remote add upstream git@gitlab.rrze.fau.de:vc/teaching/ss26/scivis-ss26.git
```

Then, fetch updates from it:

```
git fetch upstream
```

Lastly, move to your `main` branch and merge updates into yours:

```
git checkout main
git merge upstream/main
```

Note that you need to run the first line *only once* for adding, and the following steps (cmake as well!) should be done again for new updates.

---

## Support

If you encounter issues with compilation, CMake, or dataset paths, please ask during the exercise sessions.

Happy coding!

### scivis/0_empty/main.cpp
```
#include <init_vislab.hpp>

#include <vislab/app/trackball_interactor.hpp>
#include <vislab/field/regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_perspective_camera.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/render_context.hpp>
#include <vislab/scene/perspective_camera.hpp>

#include "application.hpp"

#include <memory>

using namespace vislab;

class EmptyDemo : public scivis::Application
{
public:
    void init([[maybe_unused]] const SwapchainContext& stx) override
    {
        // camera
        mCamera = std::make_shared<PerspectiveCamera>();
        mCamera->setLookAt(Eigen::Vector3d(0.5, 0.5, 0.5));
        mCamera->setPosition(Eigen::Vector3d(1.7, 2.3, 1.7));
        mCamera->setUp(Eigen::Vector3d(0, 0, 1));
        mCamera->setNear(0.01);
        mCamera->setFar(100.0);
        mGpuCamera = std::make_unique<GpuPerspectiveCamera>(device.get(), mCamera.get());

        // interactor
        auto trackball = std::make_shared<TrackballInteractor>();
        trackball->setCamera(mCamera);
        setInteractor(trackball);

        // cube geometry
        createCubeGeometry();

        // load shaders
        ShaderBinary vsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "basic", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Vertex);
        ShaderBinary fsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "basic", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Fragment);

        // pipeline
        RenderPipelineDesc rp{};
        rp.vertexShader   = vsBin;
        rp.fragmentShader = fsBin;
        rp.vertexLayout   = mGpuMesh->getVertexLayout();
        mPipeline         = device->createRenderPipeline(rp);
    }

    void update([[maybe_unused]] double dt, [[maybe_unused]] double total) override {}

    void gui() override
    {
        ImGui::Begin("SciVis", 0, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);

        // close button
        if (ImGui::Button("Close Window"))
            exit(0);

        ImGui::End();
    }

    void render(ICommandList* cmd, const RenderContext& ctx) override
    {
        // -------- Updates ---------

        // update camera
        mCamera->setWidth(ctx.width);
        mCamera->setHeight(ctx.height);
        mGpuCamera->update(cmd);

        // -------- Rendering ---------

        // set viewport
        cmd->setViewport(0, 0, float(ctx.width), float(ctx.height));

        // clear
        const float clearColor[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 1 };
        cmd->clearRenderTarget(ctx.renderTarget, clearColor);
        cmd->clearDepthStencil(ctx.depthTarget, 1.0f);

        // set render pipeline
        cmd->setRenderPipeline(mPipeline.get());

        // bind constant buffers
        mGpuCamera->bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);

        // bind and draw mesh
        mGpuMesh->bind(cmd, EVertexStream::Position);
        mGpuMesh->draw(cmd);
    }

private:
    void createCubeGeometry()
    {
        mMesh.setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology::TriangleList);
        mMesh.getPositions().setValues({ { 0.f, 0.f, 0.f },
                                         { 1.f, 0.f, 0.f },
                                         { 1.f, 1.f, 0.f },
                                         { 0.f, 1.f, 0.f },
                                         { 0.f, 0.f, 1.f },
                                         { 1.f, 0.f, 1.f },
                                         { 1.f, 1.f, 1.f },
                                         { 0.f, 1.f, 1.f } });
        mMesh.getIndexCollection().setValues({ 0u, 1u, 2u, 0u, 2u, 3u,
                                               4u, 6u, 5u, 4u, 7u, 6u,
                                               0u, 4u, 5u, 0u, 5u, 1u,
                                               3u, 2u, 6u, 3u, 6u, 7u,
                                               0u, 3u, 7u, 0u, 7u, 4u,
                                               1u, 5u, 6u, 1u, 6u, 2u });
        mGpuMesh = std::make_unique<GpuMesh>(device.get(), &mMesh);
    }

    // Camera data
    std::shared_ptr<PerspectiveCamera> mCamera;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuPerspectiveCamera> mGpuCamera;

    // cube mesh
    Mesh3f mMesh;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> mGpuMesh;

    // Render pipeline
    std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> mPipeline;
};

int main(int argc, char* argv[])
{
    EmptyDemo app;
    return app.run(argc, argv,
                   scivis::EGraphicsDevice::OpenGL,
                   1280, 720,
                   4);
}
```

### scivis/1_point/main.cpp
```
#include <init_vislab.hpp>

#include <vislab/app/trackball_interactor.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_constant_buffer.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_perspective_camera.hpp>
#include <vislab/scene/perspective_camera.hpp>

#include "application.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <imgui.h>

using namespace vislab;

class PointDemo : public scivis::Application
{
public:
    void init([[maybe_unused]] const SwapchainContext& stx) override
    {
        // camera
        mCamera = std::make_shared<PerspectiveCamera>();
        mCamera->setLookAt(Eigen::Vector3d(0.5, 0.5, 0.5));
        mCamera->setPosition(Eigen::Vector3d(-1.3, 1.3, 0.5));
        mCamera->setUp(Eigen::Vector3d(0, 0, 1));
        mCamera->setNear(0.01);
        mCamera->setFar(100.0);
        mGpuCamera = std::make_unique<GpuPerspectiveCamera>(device.get(), mCamera.get());

        // interactor
        auto trackball = std::make_shared<TrackballInteractor>();
        trackball->setCamera(mCamera);
        setInteractor(trackball);

        // load first mesh
        mMesh.setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology::PointList);
        mMesh.getAttributes().create<Array1f>("potential");
        mTimeStep = 2;
        readFile(mTimeStep, mMesh);
        mDataDirty = false;
        mGpuMesh   = std::make_unique<GpuMesh>(device.get(), &mMesh);

        // load shaders
        ShaderBinary vsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "spheres", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Vertex);
        ShaderBinary gsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "spheres", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Geometry);
        ShaderBinary fsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "spheres", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Fragment);

        // render pipeline
        RenderPipelineDesc rp{};
        rp.vertexShader   = vsBin;
        rp.geometryShader = gsBin;
        rp.fragmentShader = fsBin;
        rp.vertexLayout   = mGpuMesh->getVertexLayout();
        rp.multisample.multisampleEnable = true;
        rp.multisample.sampleShading     = true;
        mPipeline = device->createRenderPipeline(rp);

        // constant buffer
        mGpuConstants = GpuConstantBuffer<Constants>(device.get(), "Constants");
    }

    void update([[maybe_unused]] double dt, [[maybe_unused]] double total) override
    {
        static int lastTimeStep = -1;
        if (lastTimeStep != mTimeStep)
        {
            readFile(mTimeStep, mMesh);
            mDataDirty   = true;
            lastTimeStep = mTimeStep;
        }
    }

    void gui() override
    {
        ImGui::Begin("SciVis", 0, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);

        ImGui::SliderInt("Time Step", &mTimeStep, 1, 4);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("Radius Scale", &mGpuConstants.getData().radiusScale, 0.0f, 0.01f);
        
        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        // TODO 7: Adding Sliders
        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        ImGui::SliderFloat("Data Min", &mGpuConstants.getData().dataMin, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("Data Max", &mGpuConstants.getData().dataMax, 0.0f, 1.0f);

        ImGui::Separator();

        // close button
        if (ImGui::Button("Close Window"))
            exit(0);

        ImGui::End();
    }

    void render(ICommandList* cmd, const RenderContext& ctx) override
    {
        // -------- Updates ---------

        // update camera
        mCamera->setWidth(ctx.width);
        mCamera->setHeight(ctx.height);
        mGpuCamera->update(cmd);

        // update constant buffer
        mGpuConstants.update(cmd);

        // upload vertex data (if changed)
        if (mDataDirty)
        {
            mGpuMesh->update(cmd);
            mDataDirty = false;
        }

        // -------- Rendering ---------

        // set viewport
        cmd->setViewport(0, 0, float(ctx.width), float(ctx.height));

        // clear
        const float clearColor[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 1 };
        cmd->clearRenderTarget(ctx.renderTarget, clearColor);
        cmd->clearDepthStencil(ctx.depthTarget, 1.0f);

        // set render pipeline
        cmd->setRenderPipeline(mPipeline.get());

        // bind constant buffers
        mGpuCamera->bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Geometry | EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);
        mGpuConstants.bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Geometry | EShaderStage::Fragment, 1);

        // bind and draw mesh
        mGpuMesh->bind(cmd, EVertexStream::Position | EVertexStream::Attribute0);
        mGpuMesh->draw(cmd);
    }

private:
    void readFile(int ifile, Mesh3f& mesh)
    {
        // get arrays to read into.
        Array3f& positions = mesh.getPositions();
        Array1f potential(mesh.getAttributes().getByNameShared("potential"));

        // open file
        char buf[64];
        std::sprintf(buf, "cosmo%i.bin", ifile);
        std::filesystem::path filepath = datasetPath / buf;
        std::ifstream file(filepath, std::ios::binary);
        if (!file.is_open())
        {
            std::cout << "Data file not found! Place the files cosmo1.bin, cosmo2.bin, cosmo3.bin, and cosmo4.bin in your dataset folder and check that the command line argument points correctly to the dataset folder." << std::endl;
            exit(1);
        }

        // read number of particles
        int64_t numParticles;
        file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&numParticles), sizeof(int64_t));

        // read positions
        positions.setSize(numParticles);
        file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(positions.getPtr()), positions.getSizeInBytes());

        // read potential
        potential.setSize(numParticles);
        file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(potential.getPtr()), potential.getSizeInBytes());
        file.close();
    }

    // Mesh data
    Mesh3f mMesh;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> mGpuMesh;
    int mTimeStep   = 0;
    bool mDataDirty = false;

    // Camera data
    std::shared_ptr<PerspectiveCamera> mCamera;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuPerspectiveCamera> mGpuCamera;

    // Constant data
    struct Constants
    {
        float radiusScale = 0.001f;
        float dataMin     = 0.0f;
        float dataMax     = 1.0f;
    };
    GpuConstantBuffer<Constants> mGpuConstants;

    // Render pipeline
    std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> mPipeline;
};

int main(int argc, char* argv[])
{
    PointDemo app;
    return app.run(argc, argv,
                   scivis::EGraphicsDevice::OpenGL,
                   1280, 720,
                   1); // Change from 4x MSAA to 1x MSAA (Intel UHD on my laptop)
}
```

### scivis/2_volren/main.cpp
```
#include <init_vislab.hpp>

#include <vislab/app/trackball_interactor.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/transfer_function.hpp>
#include <vislab/field/regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_perspective_camera.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_transfer_function.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/render_context.hpp>
#include <vislab/scene/perspective_camera.hpp>

#include "amira_reader.hpp"
#include "application.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <iostream>
#include <memory>

using namespace vislab;

class VolrenDemo : public scivis::Application
{
public:
    void init([[maybe_unused]] const SwapchainContext& stx) override
    {
        // camera
        mCamera = std::make_shared<PerspectiveCamera>();
        mCamera->setLookAt(Eigen::Vector3d(0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
        mCamera->setPosition(Eigen::Vector3d(0.7, 1.6, -0.1));
        mCamera->setUp(Eigen::Vector3d(0, 0, -1));
        mCamera->setNear(0.01);
        mCamera->setFar(100.0);
        mGpuCamera = std::make_unique<GpuPerspectiveCamera>(device.get(), mCamera.get());

        // interactor
        auto trackball = std::make_shared<TrackballInteractor>();
        trackball->setCamera(mCamera);
        setInteractor(trackball);

        // load field
        readFile();

        // GPU volume wrapper
        mGpuField = std::make_unique<GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f>(
            device.get(),
            mField.get(),
            ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource,
            EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
            "VolumeField");

        // transfer function (CPU)
        mTF = std::make_unique<TransferFunction4d>();
        mTF->getValues().insert({ 0.00, Eigen::Vector4d(103.0 / 255.0, 169.0 / 255.0, 207.0 / 255.0, 0.00) });
        mTF->getValues().insert({ 0.25, Eigen::Vector4d(209.0 / 255.0, 229.0 / 255.0, 240.0 / 255.0, 0.25) });
        mTF->getValues().insert({ 0.50, Eigen::Vector4d(247.0 / 255.0, 247.0 / 255.0, 247.0 / 255.0, 0.50) });
        mTF->getValues().insert({ 0.75, Eigen::Vector4d(253.0 / 255.0, 219.0 / 255.0, 199.0 / 255.0, 0.75) });
        mTF->getValues().insert({ 1.00, Eigen::Vector4d(239.0 / 255.0, 138.0 / 255.0, 98.0 / 255.0, 1.00) });

        // GPU transfer function wrapper
        mGpuTF = std::make_unique<GpuTransferFunction>(
            device.get(),
            mTF.get(),
            32,
            "TransferFunction");

        // cube geometry
        createCubeGeometry();

        // load shaders
        ShaderBinary vsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "volren", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Vertex);
        ShaderBinary fsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "volren", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Fragment);

        // pipeline
        RenderPipelineDesc rp{};
        rp.vertexShader            = vsBin;
        rp.fragmentShader          = fsBin;
        rp.vertexLayout            = mGpuCube->getVertexLayout();
        rp.depth.depthWrite        = false;
        rp.blend.targets[0].enable = true;
        mPipeline                  = device->createRenderPipeline(rp);

        // constant buffer
        Constants constants;
        constants.domainMin       = mField->getDomain().min().cast<float>();
        constants.domainMax       = mField->getDomain().max().cast<float>();
        constants.stepSize        = float(mField->getGrid().getSpacing().minCoeff());
        constants.tfMin           = 0.26f;
        constants.tfMax           = 1.0f;
        constants.enableShadows   = 1;
        constants.extinctionScale = 300.0f;
        mGpuConstants             = GpuConstantBuffer<Constants>(device.get(), constants, "Constants");
    }

    void update([[maybe_unused]] double dt, [[maybe_unused]] double total) override {}

    void gui() override
    {
        ImGui::Begin("SciVis", 0, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);

        ImGui::SliderFloat("stepSize", &mGpuConstants.getData().stepSize, 0.001f, 0.01f);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("tfMin", &mGpuConstants.getData().tfMin, 0, 1);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("tfMax", &mGpuConstants.getData().tfMax, 0, 1);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("extinction", &mGpuConstants.getData().extinctionScale, 0, 1000);
        ImGui::Checkbox("shadows", (bool*)&mGpuConstants.getData().enableShadows);

        ImGui::Separator();

        // close button
        if (ImGui::Button("Close Window"))
            exit(0);

        ImGui::End();
    }

    void render(ICommandList* cmd, const RenderContext& ctx) override
    {
        // -------- Updates ---------

        // update camera
        mCamera->setWidth(ctx.width);
        mCamera->setHeight(ctx.height);
        mGpuCamera->update(cmd);

        // update constant buffer
        mGpuConstants.update(cmd);

        // -------- Rendering ---------

        // set viewport
        cmd->setViewport(0, 0, float(ctx.width), float(ctx.height));

        // clear
        const float clearColor[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 1 };
        cmd->clearRenderTarget(ctx.renderTarget, clearColor);
        cmd->clearDepthStencil(ctx.depthTarget, 1.0f);

        // set render pipeline
        cmd->setRenderPipeline(mPipeline.get());

        // bind constant buffers
        mGpuCamera->bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);
        mGpuConstants.bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Fragment, 1);

        // bind volume (SRV + sampler)
        mGpuField->bindSampler(cmd, EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);
        mGpuField->bindSRV(cmd, EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);

        // bind transfer function (SRV + sampler)
        mGpuTF->bind(EShaderStage::Fragment, 1, cmd);

        // bind and draw mesh
        mGpuCube->bind(cmd, EVertexStream::Position);
        mGpuCube->draw(cmd);
    }

private:
    void readFile()
    {
        // read file
        mField = scivis::AmiraReader::readAs<RegularSteadyScalarField3f>((datasetPath / "head.am").string());
        if (!mField)
        {
            std::cout << "Data file not found! Place the head.am in your dataset folder and check that the command line argument points correctly to the dataset folder." << std::endl;
            exit(1);
        }

        // rescale and recenter domain
        Eigen::AlignedBox3d domain = mField->getDomain();
        double scale               = (domain.max() - domain.min()).maxCoeff();
        mField->setDomain(Eigen::AlignedBox3d((domain.min() / scale) - domain.center() / scale,
                                              (domain.max() / scale) - domain.center() / scale));
    }

    void createCubeGeometry()
    {
        mCube.setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology::TriangleList);
        mCube.getPositions().setValues({ { 0.f, 0.f, 0.f },
                                         { 1.f, 0.f, 0.f },
                                         { 1.f, 1.f, 0.f },
                                         { 0.f, 1.f, 0.f },
                                         { 0.f, 0.f, 1.f },
                                         { 1.f, 0.f, 1.f },
                                         { 1.f, 1.f, 1.f },
                                         { 0.f, 1.f, 1.f } });
        mCube.getIndexCollection().setValues({ 0u, 1u, 2u, 0u, 2u, 3u,
                                               4u, 6u, 5u, 4u, 7u, 6u,
                                               0u, 4u, 5u, 0u, 5u, 1u,
                                               3u, 2u, 6u, 3u, 6u, 7u,
                                               0u, 3u, 7u, 0u, 7u, 4u,
                                               1u, 5u, 6u, 1u, 6u, 2u });
        mGpuCube = std::make_unique<GpuMesh>(device.get(), &mCube);
    }

    // Volume data
    std::shared_ptr<RegularSteadyScalarField3f> mField;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f> mGpuField;

    // Transfer function
    std::unique_ptr<TransferFunction4d> mTF;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuTransferFunction> mGpuTF;

    // Camera data
    std::shared_ptr<PerspectiveCamera> mCamera;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuPerspectiveCamera> mGpuCamera;

    // Constant data
    struct Constants
    {
        Eigen::Vector3f domainMin;
        float stepSize;

        Eigen::Vector3f domainMax;
        float tfMin;

        float tfMax;
        int enableShadows;
        float extinctionScale;
    };
    GpuConstantBuffer<Constants> mGpuConstants;

    // cube mesh
    Mesh3f mCube;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> mGpuCube;

    // Render pipeline
    std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> mPipeline;
};

int main(int argc, char* argv[])
{
    VolrenDemo app;
    return app.run(argc, argv,
                   scivis::EGraphicsDevice::OpenGL,
                   1280, 720);
}

### scivis/3_isocontour/main.cpp
```
#include <init_vislab.hpp>

#include <vislab/app/trackball_interactor.hpp>
#include <vislab/field/regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_perspective_camera.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/render_context.hpp>
#include <vislab/scene/perspective_camera.hpp>

#include "amira_reader.hpp"
#include "application.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <iostream>
#include <memory>

using namespace vislab;

class IsocontourDemo : public scivis::Application
{
public:
    void init([[maybe_unused]] const vislab::SwapchainContext& stx) override
    {
        // camera
        mCamera = std::make_shared<PerspectiveCamera>();
        mCamera->setLookAt(Eigen::Vector3d(0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
        mCamera->setPosition(Eigen::Vector3d(0.5, 1.3, -0.1));
        mCamera->setUp(Eigen::Vector3d(0, 0, -1));
        mCamera->setNear(0.01);
        mCamera->setFar(100.0);
        mGpuCamera = std::make_unique<GpuPerspectiveCamera>(device.get(), mCamera.get());

        // interactor
        auto trackball = std::make_shared<TrackballInteractor>();
        trackball->setCamera(mCamera);
        setInteractor(trackball);

        // load field
        readFile();

        // GPU volume wrapper
        mGpuField = std::make_unique<GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f>(
            device.get(),
            mField.get(),
            ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource,
            EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
            "VolumeField");

        // cube geometry
        createCubeGeometry();

        // load shaders
        ShaderBinary vsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "isocontour", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Vertex);
        ShaderBinary fsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "isocontour", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Fragment);

        // pipeline
        RenderPipelineDesc rp{};
        rp.vertexShader   = vsBin;
        rp.fragmentShader = fsBin;
        rp.vertexLayout   = mGpuCube->getVertexLayout();
        mPipeline         = device->createRenderPipeline(rp);

        // constant buffer
        Constants constants;
        constants.domainMin            = mField->getDomain().min().cast<float>();
        constants.domainMax            = mField->getDomain().max().cast<float>();
        constants.stepSize             = 1.f * float(mField->getGrid().getSpacing().minCoeff());
        constants.isovalue             = 0.333f;
        constants.lightAngle           = 0.1f;
        constants.enableShadows        = 1;
        constants.refinementIterations = 5;
        mGpuConstants                  = GpuConstantBuffer<Constants>(device.get(), constants, "Constants");
    }

    void update([[maybe_unused]] double dt, [[maybe_unused]] double total) override
    {
    }

    void gui() override
    {
        ImGui::Begin("SciVis", 0, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);

        ImGui::SliderFloat("stepSize", &mGpuConstants.getData().stepSize, 0.001f, 0.01f);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("isovalue", &mGpuConstants.getData().isovalue, 0, 1);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("lightAngle", &mGpuConstants.getData().lightAngle, 0, 1);
        ImGui::SliderInt("refine iter.", &mGpuConstants.getData().refinementIterations, 0, 10);
        ImGui::Checkbox("shadows", (bool*)&mGpuConstants.getData().enableShadows);

        ImGui::Separator();

        // close button
        if (ImGui::Button("Close Window"))
            exit(0);

        ImGui::End();
    }

    void render(ICommandList* cmd, const RenderContext& ctx) override
    {
        // -------- Updates ---------

        // update camera
        mCamera->setWidth(ctx.width);
        mCamera->setHeight(ctx.height);
        mGpuCamera->update(cmd);

        // update constant buffer
        mGpuConstants.update(cmd);

        // -------- Rendering ---------

        // set viewport
        cmd->setViewport(0, 0, float(ctx.width), float(ctx.height));

        // clear
        const float clearColor[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 1 };
        cmd->clearRenderTarget(ctx.renderTarget, clearColor);
        cmd->clearDepthStencil(ctx.depthTarget, 1.0f);

        // set render pipeline
        cmd->setRenderPipeline(mPipeline.get());

        // bind constant buffers
        mGpuCamera->bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);
        mGpuConstants.bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Fragment, 1);

        // bind volume (SRV + sampler)
        mGpuField->bindSampler(cmd, EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);
        mGpuField->bindSRV(cmd, EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);

        // bind and draw mesh
        mGpuCube->bind(cmd, EVertexStream::Position);
        mGpuCube->draw(cmd);
    }

private:
    void readFile()
    {
        // read file
        mField = scivis::AmiraReader::readAs<RegularSteadyScalarField3f>((datasetPath / "head.am").string());
        if (!mField)
        {
            std::cout << "Data file not found! Place the head.am in your dataset folder and check that the command line argument points correctly to the dataset folder." << std::endl;
            exit(1);
        }

        // rescale and recenter domain
        Eigen::AlignedBox3d domain = mField->getDomain();
        double scale               = (domain.max() - domain.min()).maxCoeff();
        mField->setDomain(Eigen::AlignedBox3d((domain.min() / scale) - domain.center() / scale,
                                              (domain.max() / scale) - domain.center() / scale));
    }

    void createCubeGeometry()
    {
        mCube.setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology::TriangleList);
        mCube.getPositions().setValues({ { 0.f, 0.f, 0.f },
                                         { 1.f, 0.f, 0.f },
                                         { 1.f, 1.f, 0.f },
                                         { 0.f, 1.f, 0.f },
                                         { 0.f, 0.f, 1.f },
                                         { 1.f, 0.f, 1.f },
                                         { 1.f, 1.f, 1.f },
                                         { 0.f, 1.f, 1.f } });
        mCube.getIndexCollection().setValues({ 0u, 1u, 2u, 0u, 2u, 3u,
                                               4u, 6u, 5u, 4u, 7u, 6u,
                                               0u, 4u, 5u, 0u, 5u, 1u,
                                               3u, 2u, 6u, 3u, 6u, 7u,
                                               0u, 3u, 7u, 0u, 7u, 4u,
                                               1u, 5u, 6u, 1u, 6u, 2u });
        mGpuCube = std::make_unique<GpuMesh>(device.get(), &mCube);
    }

    // Volume data
    std::shared_ptr<RegularSteadyScalarField3f> mField;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f> mGpuField;

    // Camera data
    std::shared_ptr<PerspectiveCamera> mCamera;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuPerspectiveCamera> mGpuCamera;

    // Constant data
    struct Constants
    {
        Eigen::Vector3f domainMin;
        float stepSize;

        Eigen::Vector3f domainMax;
        float isovalue;

        float lightAngle;
        int enableShadows;
        int refinementIterations;
    };
    GpuConstantBuffer<Constants> mGpuConstants;

    // cube mesh
    Mesh3f mCube;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> mGpuCube;

    // Render pipeline
    std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> mPipeline;
};

int main(int argc, char* argv[])
{
    IsocontourDemo app;
    return app.run(argc, argv,
                   scivis::EGraphicsDevice::OpenGL,
                   1280, 720);
}

### scivis/4_critical/main.cpp
```
#include <init_vislab.hpp>

#ifdef _MSC_VER
#pragma warning(push)
#pragma warning(disable : 4305)
#include <Eigen/Eigenvalues>
#pragma warning(pop)
#endif

#include <vislab/app/trackball_interactor.hpp>
#include <vislab/field/regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_perspective_camera.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_transform.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/render_context.hpp>
#include <vislab/scene/perspective_camera.hpp>
#include <vislab/scene/transform.hpp>

#include "amira_reader.hpp"
#include "application.hpp"

using namespace vislab;

class CriticalPointsDemo : public scivis::Application
{
public:
    struct CriticalPoint
    {
        Eigen::Vector3f position;
        Eigen::Matrix3f eigenvectors; // columns = eigenvectors
        Eigen::Vector3f eigenvalues;
        enum Type
        {
            Sink,
            Source,
            Saddle
        } type;
    };

    void init([[maybe_unused]] const SwapchainContext& stx) override
    {
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Camera
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        mCamera = std::make_shared<PerspectiveCamera>();
        mCamera->setLookAt({ 50, 50, 50 });
        mCamera->setPosition({ 60, 110, 70 });
        mCamera->setUp({ 0, 0, 1 });
        mCamera->setNear(0.1);
        mCamera->setFar(1000.0);
        mGpuCamera = std::make_unique<GpuPerspectiveCamera>(device.get(), mCamera.get());

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Interactor
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        auto trackball = std::make_shared<TrackballInteractor>();
        trackball->setCamera(mCamera);
        setInteractor(trackball);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Extract critical points
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        extractCriticalPoints();

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Create glyph meshes
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        createSphereMesh(); // sinks + sources
        createSaddleMesh(); // saddles

        mGpuSphereMesh = std::make_unique<GpuMesh>(device.get(), &mSphereMesh);
        mGpuSaddleMesh = std::make_unique<GpuMesh>(device.get(), &mSaddleMesh);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Create transforms for each critical point
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        createTransforms();

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Create constant buffer for color
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        ColorUBO colorSink   = { Eigen::Vector3f(0.5f, 0.5f, 1.0f) };
        ColorUBO colorSource = { Eigen::Vector3f(1.0f, 0.5f, 0.5f) };
        ColorUBO colorSaddle = { Eigen::Vector3f(1.0f, 1.0f, 0.5f) };
        mColorSink           = std::make_unique<GpuConstantBuffer<ColorUBO>>(device.get(), colorSink);
        mColorSource         = std::make_unique<GpuConstantBuffer<ColorUBO>>(device.get(), colorSource);
        mColorSaddle         = std::make_unique<GpuConstantBuffer<ColorUBO>>(device.get(), colorSaddle);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Load shaders
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        ShaderBinary vsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "critical", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Vertex);
        ShaderBinary fsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "critical", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Fragment);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Render pipeline
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        RenderPipelineDesc rp{};
        rp.vertexShader    = vsBin;
        rp.fragmentShader  = fsBin;
        rp.vertexLayout    = mGpuSphereMesh->getVertexLayout();
        rp.raster.cullMode = ECullMode::None;
        mPipeline          = device->createRenderPipeline(rp);
    }

    void update(double, double) override {}

    void gui() override
    {
        ImGui::Begin("SciVis", nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);

        ImGui::Text("Critical points: %zu", mCriticalPoints.size());

        ImGui::Separator();

        // close button
        if (ImGui::Button("Close Window"))
            exit(0);

        ImGui::End();
    }

    void render(ICommandList* cmd, const RenderContext& ctx) override
    {
        // update camera
        mCamera->setWidth(ctx.width);
        mCamera->setHeight(ctx.height);
        mGpuCamera->update(cmd);

        // clear
        cmd->setViewport(0, 0, float(ctx.width), float(ctx.height));
        const float clearColor[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 1 };
        cmd->clearRenderTarget(ctx.renderTarget, clearColor);
        cmd->clearDepthStencil(ctx.depthTarget, 1.0f);

        // pipeline
        cmd->setRenderPipeline(mPipeline.get());
        mGpuCamera->bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);

        // draw glyphs
        for (size_t i = 0; i < mCriticalPoints.size(); ++i)
        {
            const auto& cp = mCriticalPoints[i];
            auto* gpuT     = mGpuTransforms[i].get();

            // ------------------------------------------------------------
            // Bind color constant buffer
            // ------------------------------------------------------------
            GpuConstantBuffer<ColorUBO>* gpuColor = nullptr;
            switch (cp.type)
            {
            case CriticalPoint::Sink:
                gpuColor = mColorSink.get();
                break;
            case CriticalPoint::Source:
                gpuColor = mColorSource.get();
                break;
            case CriticalPoint::Saddle:
                gpuColor = mColorSaddle.get();
                break;
            }
            if (gpuColor)
                gpuColor->bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Fragment, 2);

            // ------------------------------------------------------------
            // Bind transform
            // ------------------------------------------------------------
            gpuT->update(cmd);
            gpuT->bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex, 1);

            // ------------------------------------------------------------
            // Bind mesh + draw
            // ------------------------------------------------------------
            if (cp.type == CriticalPoint::Saddle)
            {
                mGpuSaddleMesh->bind(cmd, EVertexStream::Position | EVertexStream::Normal);
                mGpuSaddleMesh->draw(cmd);
            }
            else
            {
                mGpuSphereMesh->bind(cmd, EVertexStream::Position | EVertexStream::Normal);
                mGpuSphereMesh->draw(cmd);
            }
        }
    }

private:
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Extract critical points
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    void extractCriticalPoints()
    {
        mCriticalPoints.clear();

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Load vector field
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        auto vfield = scivis::AmiraReader::readAs<RegularSteadyVectorField3f>((datasetPath / "benzene.am").string());
        if (!vfield)
        {
            std::cout << "Data file not found! Place the benzene.am in your dataset folder and check that the command line argument points correctly to the dataset folder." << std::endl;
            exit(1);
        }

        Eigen::Vector3i res = vfield->getGrid().getResolution();

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Parameters for recursion
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const double epsDiagonal  = 1e-5;
        const double epsDuplicate = 10.0 * epsDiagonal;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Loop over all voxels (skip boundary)
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        for (int ix = 1; ix < res.x() - 2; ++ix)
            for (int iy = 1; iy < res.y() - 2; ++iy)
                for (int iz = 1; iz < res.z() - 2; ++iz)
                {
                    // --------------------------------------------------------
                    // Read velocity at 8 corners
                    // --------------------------------------------------------
                    Eigen::Vector3d v000 = vfield->getVertexDataAt({ ix + 0, iy + 0, iz + 0 }).cast<double>();
                    Eigen::Vector3d v001 = vfield->getVertexDataAt({ ix + 0, iy + 0, iz + 1 }).cast<double>();
                    Eigen::Vector3d v010 = vfield->getVertexDataAt({ ix + 0, iy + 1, iz + 0 }).cast<double>();
                    Eigen::Vector3d v011 = vfield->getVertexDataAt({ ix + 0, iy + 1, iz + 1 }).cast<double>();
                    Eigen::Vector3d v100 = vfield->getVertexDataAt({ ix + 1, iy + 0, iz + 0 }).cast<double>();
                    Eigen::Vector3d v101 = vfield->getVertexDataAt({ ix + 1, iy + 0, iz + 1 }).cast<double>();
                    Eigen::Vector3d v110 = vfield->getVertexDataAt({ ix + 1, iy + 1, iz + 0 }).cast<double>();
                    Eigen::Vector3d v111 = vfield->getVertexDataAt({ ix + 1, iy + 1, iz + 1 }).cast<double>();

                    // --------------------------------------------------------
                    // Read positions of 8 corners
                    // --------------------------------------------------------
                    Eigen::Vector3d p000 = vfield->getGrid().getCoordAt({ ix + 0, iy + 0, iz + 0 });
                    Eigen::Vector3d p001 = vfield->getGrid().getCoordAt({ ix + 0, iy + 0, iz + 1 });
                    Eigen::Vector3d p010 = vfield->getGrid().getCoordAt({ ix + 0, iy + 1, iz + 0 });
                    Eigen::Vector3d p011 = vfield->getGrid().getCoordAt({ ix + 0, iy + 1, iz + 1 });
                    Eigen::Vector3d p100 = vfield->getGrid().getCoordAt({ ix + 1, iy + 0, iz + 0 });
                    Eigen::Vector3d p101 = vfield->getGrid().getCoordAt({ ix + 1, iy + 0, iz + 1 });
                    Eigen::Vector3d p110 = vfield->getGrid().getCoordAt({ ix + 1, iy + 1, iz + 0 });
                    Eigen::Vector3d p111 = vfield->getGrid().getCoordAt({ ix + 1, iy + 1, iz + 1 });

                    // --------------------------------------------------------
                    // Recursively search for critical points in this voxel
                    // --------------------------------------------------------
                    recursiveCriticalPoints(
                        *vfield,
                        v000, v001, v010, v011, v100, v101, v110, v111,
                        p000, p001, p010, p011, p100, p101, p110, p111,
                        epsDiagonal, epsDuplicate);
                }
    }

    void recursiveCriticalPoints(
        const RegularSteadyVectorField3f& vfield,
        const Eigen::Vector3d& v000, const Eigen::Vector3d& v001, const Eigen::Vector3d& v010, const Eigen::Vector3d& v011, const Eigen::Vector3d& v100, const Eigen::Vector3d& v101, const Eigen::Vector3d& v110, const Eigen::Vector3d& v111,
        const Eigen::Vector3d& p000, const Eigen::Vector3d& p001, const Eigen::Vector3d& p010, const Eigen::Vector3d& p011, const Eigen::Vector3d& p100, const Eigen::Vector3d& p101, const Eigen::Vector3d& p110, const Eigen::Vector3d& p111,
        double epsDiagonal, double epsDuplicate)
    {
        // --------------------------------------------------------------------
        // TODO 1: Early-out test
        // Check whether all 8 velocity vectors have the same sign in any
        // component (x, y, or z). If so, return immediately.
        // --------------------------------------------------------------------
        double uMin = std::min({v000.x(), v001.x(), v010.x(), v011.x(), v100.x(), v101.x(), v110.x(), v111.x()});
        double uMax = std::max({v000.x(), v001.x(), v010.x(), v011.x(), v100.x(), v101.x(), v110.x(), v111.x()});
        double vMin = std::min({v000.y(), v001.y(), v010.y(), v011.y(), v100.y(), v101.y(), v110.y(), v111.y()});
        double vMax = std::max({v000.y(), v001.y(), v010.y(), v011.y(), v100.y(), v101.y(), v110.y(), v111.y()});
        double wMin = std::min({v000.z(), v001.z(), v010.z(), v011.z(), v100.z(), v101.z(), v110.z(), v111.z()});
        double wMax = std::max({v000.z(), v001.z(), v010.z(), v011.z(), v100.z(), v101.z(), v110.z(), v111.z()});
        if (uMin > 0 || uMax < 0 || vMin > 0 || vMax < 0 || wMin > 0 || wMax < 0)
            return;

        // --------------------------------------------------------------------
        // TODO 2: Convergence test
        // If the voxel diagonal is smaller than epsDiagonal:
        //   - take the voxel center as the critical point position
        //   - avoid duplicates (compare squared distances to all points in the set mCriticalPoints)
        //   - classify the critical point (call classifyCriticalPoint)
        //   - store the result in a CriticalPoint variable and append it to mCriticalPoints
        //   - return
        // --------------------------------------------------------------------
        if ((p111 - p000).norm() < epsDiagonal)
        {
            Eigen::Vector3d centerP = 0.5 * (p000 + p111);

            bool duplicate = false;
            for (const auto& cp : mCriticalPoints)
            {
                if ((cp.position.cast<double>() - centerP).squaredNorm() < (epsDuplicate * epsDuplicate))
                {
                    duplicate = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (!duplicate)
            {
                CriticalPoint cp;
                cp.position = centerP.cast<float>();
                classifyCriticalPoint(centerP, vfield, cp.type, cp.eigenvectors, cp.eigenvalues);
                mCriticalPoints.push_back(cp);
            }
            return;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------------------
        // TODO 3: Subdivision
        // Compute all midpoint velocities and positions needed to form the
        // 8 child voxels. Then recursively call this function on each child.
        // --------------------------------------------------------------------
        //
        //      011-----x11-----111
        //      /:     /       / |
        //    0x1-----xx1-----1x1|
        //    /  :   /       /   |
        //  001-----x01-----101  |
        //  |    :          |    |
        //  |    :          |    |
        //  |   01x.....x1x.|...11x
        //  |   /:     /    |   /|
        //  | 0xx.....xxx...|.1xx|
        //  | /  :   /      | /  |
        //  00x-----x0x-----10x  |
        //  |    :          |    |
        //  |    :          |    |
        //  |   010.....x10.|...110
        //  |   /       /   |   /
        //  | 0x0.....xx0...|.1x0
        //  | /       /     | /
        //  000-----x00-----100
        auto mid = [](const Eigen::Vector3d& a, const Eigen::Vector3d& b)
        { return 0.5 * (a + b); };

        // Edges varying x (i)
        Eigen::Vector3d px00 = mid(p000, p100);
        Eigen::Vector3d vx00 = mid(v000, v100);
        Eigen::Vector3d px01 = mid(p001, p101);
        Eigen::Vector3d vx01 = mid(v001, v101);
        Eigen::Vector3d px10 = mid(p010, p110);
        Eigen::Vector3d vx10 = mid(v010, v110);
        Eigen::Vector3d px11 = mid(p011, p111);
        Eigen::Vector3d vx11 = mid(v011, v111);

        // Edges varying y (j)
        Eigen::Vector3d p0x0 = mid(p000, p010);
        Eigen::Vector3d v0x0 = mid(v000, v010);
        Eigen::Vector3d p0x1 = mid(p001, p011);
        Eigen::Vector3d v0x1 = mid(v001, v011);
        Eigen::Vector3d p1x0 = mid(p100, p110);
        Eigen::Vector3d v1x0 = mid(v100, v110);
        Eigen::Vector3d p1x1 = mid(p101, p111);
        Eigen::Vector3d v1x1 = mid(v101, v111);

        // Edges varying z (k)
        Eigen::Vector3d p00x = mid(p000, p001);
        Eigen::Vector3d v00x = mid(v000, v001);
        Eigen::Vector3d p01x = mid(p010, p011);
        Eigen::Vector3d v01x = mid(v010, v011);
        Eigen::Vector3d p10x = mid(p100, p101);
        Eigen::Vector3d v10x = mid(v100, v101);
        Eigen::Vector3d p11x = mid(p110, p111);
        Eigen::Vector3d v11x = mid(v110, v111);

        // Face centers varying x, y
        Eigen::Vector3d pxx0 = mid(p0x0, p1x0);
        Eigen::Vector3d vxx0 = mid(v0x0, v1x0);
        Eigen::Vector3d pxx1 = mid(p0x1, p1x1);
        Eigen::Vector3d vxx1 = mid(v0x1, v1x1);

        // Face centers varying x, z
        Eigen::Vector3d px0x = mid(p00x, p10x);
        Eigen::Vector3d vx0x = mid(v00x, v10x);
        Eigen::Vector3d px1x = mid(p01x, p11x);
        Eigen::Vector3d vx1x = mid(v01x, v11x);

        // Face centers varying y, z
        Eigen::Vector3d p0xx = mid(p00x, p01x);
        Eigen::Vector3d v0xx = mid(v00x, v01x);
        Eigen::Vector3d p1xx = mid(p10x, p11x);
        Eigen::Vector3d v1xx = mid(v10x, v11x);

        // Voxel center
        Eigen::Vector3d pxxx = mid(pxx0, pxx1);
        Eigen::Vector3d vxxx = mid(vxx0, vxx1);

        // Recursive calls for the 8 child voxels
        recursiveCriticalPoints(vfield,
                                v000, v00x, v0x0, v0xx, vx00, vx0x, vxx0, vxxx,
                                p000, p00x, p0x0, p0xx, px00, px0x, pxx0, pxxx, epsDiagonal, epsDuplicate);

        recursiveCriticalPoints(vfield,
                                v00x, v001, v0xx, v0x1, vx0x, vx01, vxxx, vxx1,
                                p00x, p001, p0xx, p0x1, px0x, px01, pxxx, pxx1, epsDiagonal, epsDuplicate);

        recursiveCriticalPoints(vfield,
                                v0x0, v0xx, v010, v01x, vxx0, vxxx, vx10, vx1x,
                                p0x0, p0xx, p010, p01x, pxx0, pxxx, px10, px1x, epsDiagonal, epsDuplicate);

        recursiveCriticalPoints(vfield,
                                v0xx, v0x1, v01x, v011, vxxx, vxx1, vx1x, vx11,
                                p0xx, p0x1, p01x, p011, pxxx, pxx1, px1x, px11, epsDiagonal, epsDuplicate);

        recursiveCriticalPoints(vfield,
                                vx00, vx0x, vxx0, vxxx, v100, v10x, v1x0, v1xx,
                                px00, px0x, pxx0, pxxx, p100, p10x, p1x0, p1xx, epsDiagonal, epsDuplicate);

        recursiveCriticalPoints(vfield,
                                vx0x, vx01, vxxx, vxx1, v10x, v101, v1xx, v1x1,
                                px0x, px01, pxxx, pxx1, p10x, p101, p1xx, p1x1, epsDiagonal, epsDuplicate);

        recursiveCriticalPoints(vfield,
                                vxx0, vxxx, vx10, vx1x, v1x0, v1xx, v110, v11x,
                                pxx0, pxxx, px10, px1x, p1x0, p1xx, p110, p11x, epsDiagonal, epsDuplicate);

        recursiveCriticalPoints(vfield,
                                vxxx, vxx1, vx1x, vx11, v1xx, v1x1, v11x, v111,
                                pxxx, pxx1, px1x, px11, p1xx, p1x1, p11x, p111, epsDiagonal, epsDuplicate);
    }

    void classifyCriticalPoint(const Eigen::Vector3d& position,
                               const RegularSteadyVectorField3f& vfield,
                               CriticalPoint::Type& outType,
                               Eigen::Matrix3f& outEigenvectors,
                               Eigen::Vector3f& outEigenvalues)
    {
        // --------------------------------------------------------------------
        // TODO 4: Jacobian evaluation
        // Use vfield.samplePartial(position, PartialSteady3d::dx/dy/dz) to compute the three partial derivative vectors.
        // Assemble the 3×3 Jacobian matrix J py placing the partials column-wise.
        // --------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Use 'auto' to safely catch the returned vector, then cast to float for the Matrix3f
        auto vx = vfield.samplePartial(position, PartialSteady3d::dx);
        auto vy = vfield.samplePartial(position, PartialSteady3d::dy);
        auto vz = vfield.samplePartial(position, PartialSteady3d::dz);

        Eigen::Matrix3f J;
        J.col(0) = vx.cast<float>();
        J.col(1) = vy.cast<float>();
        J.col(2) = vz.cast<float>();

        // --------------------------------------------------------------------
        // TODO 5: Eigenanalysis and classification
        // Use Eigen::EigenSolver to compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
        // Store their real parts in outEigenvalues and outEigenvectors.
        // Classify the critical point by its eigenvalues and store the result in outType.
        // --------------------------------------------------------------------
        Eigen::EigenSolver<Eigen::Matrix3f> solver(J);
        outEigenvalues  = solver.eigenvalues().real();
        outEigenvectors = solver.eigenvectors().real();

        if (outEigenvalues[0] < 0.0f && outEigenvalues[1] < 0.0f && outEigenvalues[2] < 0.0f)
        {
            outType = CriticalPoint::Sink;
        }
        else if (outEigenvalues[0] > 0.0f && outEigenvalues[1] > 0.0f && outEigenvalues[2] > 0.0f)
        {
            outType = CriticalPoint::Source;
        }
        else
        {
            outType = CriticalPoint::Saddle;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Create sphere mesh
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    void createSphereMesh()
    {
        mSphereMesh.setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology::TriangleList);

        const int stacks = 16;
        const int slices = 32;

        auto& P = mSphereMesh.getPositions();
        auto& N = mSphereMesh.getNormals();
        auto& I = mSphereMesh.getIndexCollection();

        P.clear();
        N.clear();
        I.clear();

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Generate vertices
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        for (int i = 0; i <= stacks; ++i)
        {
            double v   = double(i) / stacks;
            double phi = v * double(EIGEN_PI); // 0..pi

            for (int j = 0; j <= slices; ++j)
            {
                double u     = double(j) / slices;
                double theta = u * 2.0 * double(EIGEN_PI); // 0..2pi

                Eigen::Vector3f p(
                    float(std::sin(phi) * std::cos(theta)),
                    float(std::sin(phi) * std::sin(theta)),
                    float(std::cos(phi)));

                P.push_back(p);
                N.push_back(p.normalized());
            }
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Generate indices
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        for (int i = 0; i < stacks; ++i)
        {
            for (int j = 0; j < slices; ++j)
            {
                int row1 = i * (slices + 1);
                int row2 = (i + 1) * (slices + 1);

                uint32_t a = row1 + j;
                uint32_t b = row1 + j + 1;
                uint32_t c = row2 + j;
                uint32_t d = row2 + j + 1;

                // two triangles per quad
                I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(a));
                I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(c));
                I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(b));
                I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(b));
                I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(c));
                I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(d));
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Create saddle mesh
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    void createSaddleMesh()
    {
        mSaddleMesh.setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology::TriangleList);

        auto& P = mSaddleMesh.getPositions();
        auto& N = mSaddleMesh.getNormals();
        auto& I = mSaddleMesh.getIndexCollection();

        P.clear();
        N.clear();
        I.clear();

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Disk
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const int diskSlices   = 32;
        const float diskRadius = 1;

        int baseDisk = 0;

        // center vertex
        P.push_back(Eigen::Vector3f(0, 0, 0));
        N.push_back(Eigen::Vector3f(0, 0, 1));

        // rim vertices
        for (int i = 0; i <= diskSlices; ++i)
        {
            float a = float(i) / diskSlices * 2.0f * float(EIGEN_PI);
            float x = diskRadius * std::cos(a);
            float y = diskRadius * std::sin(a);

            P.push_back(Eigen::Vector3f(x, y, 0));
            N.push_back(Eigen::Vector3f(0, 0, 1));
        }

        // disk indices
        for (int i = 1; i <= diskSlices; ++i)
        {
            I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(baseDisk + 0));
            I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(baseDisk + i));
            I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(baseDisk + i + 1));
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Stick
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const int stickSlices   = 16;
        const float stickRadius = 0.1f;
        const float stickHeight = 1;

        int baseStick = (int)P.getSize();

        // bottom ring
        for (int i = 0; i <= stickSlices; ++i)
        {
            float a = float(i) / stickSlices * 2.0f * float(EIGEN_PI);
            float x = stickRadius * std::cos(a);
            float y = stickRadius * std::sin(a);

            Eigen::Vector3f n = Eigen::Vector3f(x, y, 0).normalized();

            P.push_back(Eigen::Vector3f(x, y, -stickHeight));
            N.push_back(n);
        }

        // top ring
        for (int i = 0; i <= stickSlices; ++i)
        {
            float a = float(i) / stickSlices * 2.0f * float(EIGEN_PI);
            float x = stickRadius * std::cos(a);
            float y = stickRadius * std::sin(a);

            Eigen::Vector3f n = Eigen::Vector3f(x, y, 0).normalized();

            P.push_back(Eigen::Vector3f(x, y, stickHeight));
            N.push_back(n);
        }

        // cylinder indices
        for (int i = 0; i < stickSlices; ++i)
        {
            int b0 = baseStick + i;
            int b1 = baseStick + i + 1;
            int t0 = baseStick + (stickSlices + 1) + i;
            int t1 = baseStick + (stickSlices + 1) + i + 1;

            I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(b0));
            I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(t0));
            I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(b1));
            I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(b1));
            I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(t0));
            I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(t1));
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Create transforms for each critical point
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    void createTransforms()
    {
        mTransforms.clear();
        mGpuTransforms.clear();

        for (const auto& cp : mCriticalPoints)
        {
            auto T = std::make_shared<Transform>();

            Eigen::Matrix4d M = Eigen::Matrix4d::Identity();

            // ------------------------------------------------------------
            // Relative scaling based on eigenvalue ratios
            // ------------------------------------------------------------
            Eigen::Vector3d evalsAbs = cp.eigenvalues.cwiseAbs().cast<double>();

            double maxEval = evalsAbs.maxCoeff();
            if (maxEval < 1e-12)
                maxEval = 1e-12;

            Eigen::Vector3d rel = evalsAbs / maxEval;

            // Global glyph size
            double glyphScale     = 1.0;
            Eigen::Vector3d scale = rel * glyphScale;

            // ------------------------------------------------------------
            // Orientation + scale
            // ------------------------------------------------------------
            if (cp.type == CriticalPoint::Saddle)
            {
                // --------------------------------------------------------
                // 1. Identify eigenvalue with unique sign
                // --------------------------------------------------------
                Eigen::Vector3f evals = cp.eigenvalues;
                int odd               = -1;

                if ((evals[0] > 0 && evals[1] > 0 && evals[2] < 0) ||
                    (evals[0] < 0 && evals[1] < 0 && evals[2] > 0))
                    odd = 2;
                else if ((evals[0] > 0 && evals[2] > 0 && evals[1] < 0) ||
                         (evals[0] < 0 && evals[2] < 0 && evals[1] > 0))
                    odd = 1;
                else
                    odd = 0;

                // --------------------------------------------------------
                // 2. Reorder eigenvectors so that:
                //    - odd eigenvector -> Z axis (stick direction)
                //    - the other two   -> X/Y plane (disk)
                // --------------------------------------------------------
                int i1 = (odd + 1) % 3;
                int i2 = (odd + 2) % 3;

                Eigen::Matrix3d R;
                R.col(0) = cp.eigenvectors.col(i1).cast<double>().normalized();
                R.col(1) = cp.eigenvectors.col(i2).cast<double>().normalized();
                R.col(2) = cp.eigenvectors.col(odd).cast<double>().normalized();

                // --------------------------------------------------------
                // 3. Apply relative scaling (same as sinks/sources)
                // --------------------------------------------------------
                M.block<3, 3>(0, 0) = R * scale.asDiagonal();
            }
            else
            {
                // sinks + sources: standard relative scaling
                M.block<3, 3>(0, 0) = cp.eigenvectors.cast<double>() * scale.asDiagonal();
            }

            // ------------------------------------------------------------
            // Translation
            // ------------------------------------------------------------
            M.block<3, 1>(0, 3) = cp.position.cast<double>();

            T->setMatrix(M);

            mTransforms.push_back(T);
            mGpuTransforms.push_back(std::make_unique<GpuTransform>(device.get(), T.get()));
        }
    }

private:
    // Camera
    std::shared_ptr<PerspectiveCamera> mCamera;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuPerspectiveCamera> mGpuCamera;

    // Critical points
    std::vector<CriticalPoint> mCriticalPoints;

    // Meshes
    Mesh3f mSphereMesh;
    Mesh3f mSaddleMesh;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> mGpuSphereMesh;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> mGpuSaddleMesh;

    struct ColorUBO
    {
        Eigen::Vector3f color;
    };
    std::unique_ptr<GpuConstantBuffer<ColorUBO>> mColorSink;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuConstantBuffer<ColorUBO>> mColorSource;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuConstantBuffer<ColorUBO>> mColorSaddle;

    // Transforms
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<Transform>> mTransforms;
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<GpuTransform>> mGpuTransforms;

    // Pipeline
    std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> mPipeline;
};

int main(int argc, char* argv[])
{
    CriticalPointsDemo app;
    return app.run(argc, argv,
                   scivis::EGraphicsDevice::OpenGL,
                   1280, 720);
}

### scivis/5_lines/main.cpp
```
#include <init_vislab.hpp>

#include <vislab/app/trackball_interactor.hpp>
#include <vislab/field/regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_perspective_camera.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/render_context.hpp>
#include <vislab/scene/perspective_camera.hpp>

#include "amira_reader.hpp"
#include "application.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <iostream>
#include <memory>
#include <random>
#include <vector>

using namespace vislab;

class LinesDemo : public scivis::Application
{
public:
    /**
     * @brief Enumeration of integration methods.
     */
    enum EMethod
    {
        Euler,
        RungeKutta2,
        RungeKutta4
    };

    void init([[maybe_unused]] const SwapchainContext& stx) override
    {
        // camera
        mCamera = std::make_shared<PerspectiveCamera>();
        mCamera->setLookAt(Eigen::Vector3d(0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
        mCamera->setPosition(Eigen::Vector3d(-16, 20, 16));
        mCamera->setUp(Eigen::Vector3d(0, 0, 1));
        mCamera->setNear(0.01);
        mCamera->setFar(100.0);
        mGpuCamera = std::make_unique<GpuPerspectiveCamera>(device.get(), mCamera.get());

        // interactor
        auto trackball = std::make_shared<TrackballInteractor>();
        trackball->setCamera(mCamera);
        setInteractor(trackball);

        // load field
        readFile();

        // trace streamlines
        mStreamlines.setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology::LineStrip);
        mStreamlines.getAttributes().create<Array3f>("tangent");
        mStreamlines.getAttributes().create<Array1f>("time");
        computeStreamlines();
        mGpuStreamlines = std::make_unique<GpuMesh>(device.get(), &mStreamlines);

        // load shaders
        ShaderBinary vsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "lines", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Vertex);
        ShaderBinary fsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "lines", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Fragment);

        // pipeline
        RenderPipelineDesc rp{};
        rp.vertexShader   = vsBin;
        rp.fragmentShader = fsBin;
        rp.vertexLayout   = mGpuStreamlines->getVertexLayout();
        mPipeline         = device->createRenderPipeline(rp);

        // constant buffer
        Constants constants{};
        constants.color      = Eigen::Vector4f(0.4f, 0.7f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
        constants.timeOffset = 0;
        constants.length     = 1.f;
        mGpuConstants        = GpuConstantBuffer<Constants>(device.get(), constants, "Constants");
    }

    void update([[maybe_unused]] double dt, [[maybe_unused]] double total) override
    {
        mGpuConstants.getData().timeOffset += static_cast<float>(dt * mAnimationSpeed);

        static int lastNumStreamlines = -1;
        static int lastNumSteps       = -1;
        static float lastStepSize     = -1;
        static EMethod lastMethod     = EMethod::Euler;
        if (lastNumStreamlines != mNumStreamlines || lastNumSteps != mNumSteps || lastStepSize != mStepSize || lastMethod != mMethod)
        {
            computeStreamlines();
            lastNumSteps       = mNumSteps;
            lastNumStreamlines = mNumStreamlines;
            lastStepSize       = mStepSize;
            lastMethod         = mMethod;
        }
    }

    void gui() override
    {
        ImGui::Begin("SciVis", 0, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);

        int method = (int)mMethod;
        ImGui::RadioButton("Euler", &method, 0);
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::RadioButton("RK2", &method, 1);
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::RadioButton("RK4", &method, 2);
        mMethod = (EMethod)method;

        ImGui::SliderInt("numLines", &mNumStreamlines, 1, 2000);
        ImGui::SliderInt("numSteps", &mNumSteps, 2, 1000);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("stepSize", &mStepSize, 0, 2);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("speed", &mAnimationSpeed, 0, 10);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("length", &mGpuConstants.getData().length, 0, 3);
        ImGui::ColorEdit3("color", mGpuConstants.getData().color.ptr());
        ImGui::Separator();

        // close button
        if (ImGui::Button("Close Window"))
            exit(0);

        ImGui::End();
    }

    void render(ICommandList* cmd, const RenderContext& ctx) override
    {
        // -------- Updates ---------

        // update camera
        mCamera->setWidth(ctx.width);
        mCamera->setHeight(ctx.height);
        mGpuCamera->update(cmd);

        // update constant buffer
        mGpuConstants.update(cmd);

        // upload vertex data (if changed)
        if (mStreamlinesDirty)
        {
            mGpuStreamlines->update(cmd);
            mStreamlinesDirty = false;
        }

        // -------- Rendering ---------

        // set viewport
        cmd->setViewport(0, 0, float(ctx.width), float(ctx.height));

        // clear
        const float clearColor[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 1 };
        cmd->clearRenderTarget(ctx.renderTarget, clearColor);
        cmd->clearDepthStencil(ctx.depthTarget, 1.0f);

        // set render pipeline
        cmd->setRenderPipeline(mPipeline.get());

        // bind constant buffers
        mGpuCamera->bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);
        mGpuConstants.bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Fragment, 1);

        // bind and draw mesh
        mGpuStreamlines->bind(cmd, EVertexStream::Position | EVertexStream::Attribute0 | EVertexStream::Attribute1);
        mGpuStreamlines->draw(cmd);
    }

private:
    void readFile()
    {
        // read file
        mField = scivis::AmiraReader::readAs<RegularSteadyVectorField3f>((datasetPath / "tornado.am").string());
        if (!mField)
        {
            std::cout << "Data file not found! Place the tornado.am in your dataset folder and check that the command line argument points correctly to the dataset folder." << std::endl;
            exit(1);
        }
    }

    Eigen::Vector3d sample(const Eigen::Vector3d& pos, bool& indomain) const
    {
        indomain &= mField->getDomain().contains(pos);
        if (indomain)
        {
            Eigen::Vector3d vel = mField->sample(pos);
            double length       = vel.norm();
            if (length > 1E-8)
                return -vel.normalized(); // we trace backwards in this vector field
        }
        return Eigen::Vector3d(0, 0, 0);
    }

    Eigen::Vector3d stepEuler(const Eigen::Vector3d& pos, double stepSize, bool& indomain) const
    {
        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        // TODO 1: implement Euler
        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        Eigen::Vector3d k1 = sample(pos, indomain);
        return pos + stepSize * k1;
    }

    Eigen::Vector3d stepRK2(const Eigen::Vector3d& pos, double stepSize, bool& indomain) const
    {
        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        // TODO 2: implement RK2
        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        Eigen::Vector3d k1 = sample(pos, indomain);
        Eigen::Vector3d k2 = sample(pos + 0.5 * stepSize * k1, indomain);
        return pos + stepSize * k2;
    }

    Eigen::Vector3d stepRK4(const Eigen::Vector3d& pos, double stepSize, bool& indomain) const
    {
        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        // TODO 3: implement RK4
        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        Eigen::Vector3d k1 = sample(pos, indomain);
        Eigen::Vector3d k2 = sample(pos + 0.5 * stepSize * k1, indomain);
        Eigen::Vector3d k3 = sample(pos + 0.5 * stepSize * k2, indomain);
        Eigen::Vector3d k4 = sample(pos + stepSize * k3, indomain);
        return pos + (stepSize / 6.0) * (k1 + 2.0 * k2 + 2.0 * k3 + k4);
    }

    void computeStreamlines()
    {
        // get buffer and clear
        Array3f& vbPosition = mStreamlines.getPositions();
        Array3f vbTangent(mStreamlines.getAttributes().getByNameShared("tangent"));
        Array1f vbTime(mStreamlines.getAttributes().getByNameShared("time"));
        auto& submeshes = mStreamlines.getSubmeshCollection();
        vbPosition.clear();
        vbTangent.clear();
        vbTime.clear();
        submeshes.clear();

        // random number generate for seed points
        std::mt19937 rng;
        std::uniform_real_distribution<double> rnd(0, 1);
        const Eigen::AlignedBox3d& domain = mField->getDomain();

        // for each line
        int indexOffset = 0;
        for (int iline = 0; iline < mNumStreamlines; ++iline)
        {
            // randomly pick seed point
            Eigen::Vector3d x = domain.min() + (domain.max() - domain.min()).cwiseProduct(Eigen::Vector3d(rnd(rng), rnd(rng), rnd(rng)));
            float t           = static_cast<float>(rnd(rng) * 2 * EIGEN_PI);

            // trace the streamline
            int indexCount = 0;
            bool indomain  = true;
            for (int istep = 0; istep < mNumSteps && indomain; ++istep)
            {
                // sample tangent
                Eigen::Vector3d tangent = mField->sample(x).normalized();

                // store point
                vbPosition.push_back(x.cast<float>());
                vbTangent.push_back(tangent.cast<float>());
                vbTime.push_back(Eigen::Vector1f(t));
                indexCount++;

                // integration step
                switch (mMethod)
                {
                case EMethod::Euler:
                    x = stepEuler(x, mStepSize, indomain);
                    break;
                case EMethod::RungeKutta2:
                    x = stepRK2(x, mStepSize, indomain);
                    break;
                case EMethod::RungeKutta4:
                    x = stepRK4(x, mStepSize, indomain);
                    break;
                }
                t += mStepSize;
            }

            // add submesh to define start and length of line
            submeshes.push_back(Submesh(indexOffset, indexCount));
            indexOffset += indexCount;
        }
        mStreamlinesDirty = true;
    }

    // Volume data
    std::shared_ptr<RegularSteadyVectorField3f> mField;

    // Camera data
    std::shared_ptr<PerspectiveCamera> mCamera;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuPerspectiveCamera> mGpuCamera;

    // Constant data
    struct Constants
    {
        Eigen::Vector4f color; // base color
        float timeOffset;      // controls animation speed
        float length;          // controls length of streamlet
    };
    GpuConstantBuffer<Constants> mGpuConstants;
    EMethod mMethod       = EMethod::Euler;
    float mAnimationSpeed = 1.f;
    int mNumStreamlines   = 100;
    float mStepSize       = 0.1f;
    int mNumSteps         = 1000;

    // cube mesh
    Mesh3f mStreamlines;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> mGpuStreamlines;
    bool mStreamlinesDirty = false;

    // Render pipeline
    std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> mPipeline;
};

int main(int argc, char* argv[])
{
    LinesDemo app;
    return app.run(argc, argv,
                   scivis::EGraphicsDevice::OpenGL,
                   1280, 720);
}
