### scivis/6_lic/main.cpp
```
#include <init_vislab.hpp>

#include <vislab/app/trackball_interactor.hpp>
#include <vislab/field/regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>
#include <vislab/image/image.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_image.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_perspective_camera.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/render_context.hpp>

#include "amira_reader.hpp"
#include "application.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <iostream>
#include <memory>
#include <random>

using namespace vislab;

class LICDemo : public scivis::Application
{
public:
    void init(const vislab::SwapchainContext& stx) override
    {
        readFile();

        // GPU volume wrapper
        mGpuField = std::make_unique<GpuRegularUnsteadyVectorField2f>(
            device.get(),
            mField.get(),
            ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource,
            EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
            "VolumeField");

        // viewport quad
        mViewportQuad.setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology::TriangleStrip);
        mViewportQuad.getPositions().setValues({ { -1.f, -1.f, 0.f },
                                                 { 1.f, -1.f, 0.f },
                                                 { -1.f, 1.f, 0.f },
                                                 { 1.f, 1.f, 0.f } });
        mGpuViewportQuad = std::make_unique<GpuMesh>(device.get(), &mViewportQuad);

        // load shaders
        ShaderBinary vsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "lic", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Vertex);
        ShaderBinary fsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "lic", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Fragment);
        ShaderBinary csBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "lic", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Compute);

        // render pipeline
        RenderPipelineDesc rp{};
        rp.vertexShader     = vsBin;
        rp.fragmentShader   = fsBin;
        rp.depth.depthTest  = false;
        rp.depth.depthWrite = false;
        rp.vertexLayout     = mGpuViewportQuad->getVertexLayout();
        mRenderPipeline     = device->createRenderPipeline(rp);

        // compute pipeline
        ComputePipelineDesc cp{};
        cp.computeShader = csBin;
        mComputePipeline = device->createComputePipeline(cp);

        // constant buffer
        Constants constants{};
        constants.domainMin      = mField->getDomain().min().cast<float>();
        constants.domainMax      = mField->getDomain().max().cast<float>();
        constants.time           = 0.0f;
        constants.stepSize       = 2;
        constants.numSteps       = 100;
        constants.contrast       = 5.f;
        constants.gridResolution = Eigen::Vector2i(stx.width, stx.height);
        mGpuConstants            = GpuConstantBuffer<Constants>(device.get(), constants, "Constants");

        // LIC image
        mLicImage    = std::make_unique<Image1f>(stx.width, stx.height);
        mGpuLicImage = std::make_unique<GpuImage>(device.get(), &mLicImage->getRaw(), ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource | ETextureBindFlags::UnorderedAccess);

        // noise image
        mNoiseImage = std::make_unique<Image1f>(stx.width / 2, stx.height / 2);
        std::mt19937 rng;
        std::uniform_real_distribution<float> rnd;
        for (int ix = 0; ix < mNoiseImage->getResolution().x(); ++ix)
            for (int iy = 0; iy < mNoiseImage->getResolution().y(); ++iy)
                mNoiseImage->setValue({ ix, iy }, Eigen::Vector1f(rnd(rng)));
        mGpuNoiseImage = std::make_unique<GpuImage>(device.get(), &mNoiseImage->getRaw(), ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource);
    }

    void resize(const vislab::SwapchainContext& stx) override
    {
        mLicImage->setResolution(stx.width, stx.height);
        mGpuLicImage->resize();

        mNoiseImage->setResolution(stx.width / 2, stx.height / 2);
        std::mt19937 rng;
        std::uniform_real_distribution<float> rnd;
        for (int ix = 0; ix < mNoiseImage->getResolution().x(); ++ix)
            for (int iy = 0; iy < mNoiseImage->getResolution().y(); ++iy)
                mNoiseImage->setValue({ ix, iy }, Eigen::Vector1f(rnd(rng)));
        mGpuNoiseImage->resize();

        mGpuConstants.getData().gridResolution = Eigen::Vector2i(stx.width, stx.height);
    }

    void update([[maybe_unused]] double dt, [[maybe_unused]] double total) override
    {
    }

    void gui() override
    {
        ImGui::Begin("SciVis", 0, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);

        ImGui::SliderFloat("time", &mGpuConstants.getData().time, 0, 0.99f);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("stepSize", &mGpuConstants.getData().stepSize, 0, 10);
        ImGui::SliderInt("numSteps", &mGpuConstants.getData().numSteps, 1, 200);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("contrast", &mGpuConstants.getData().contrast, 0, 10);
        ImGui::Separator();

        // close button
        if (ImGui::Button("Close Window"))
            exit(0);

        ImGui::End();
    }

    void render(ICommandList* cmd, const RenderContext& ctx) override
    {
        // -------- Updates ---------

        // update constant buffer
        mGpuConstants.update(cmd);

        // -------- Compute ---------
        // bind volume (SRV + sampler)
        mGpuField->bindSampler(cmd, EShaderStage::Compute, 0);
        mGpuField->bindSRV(cmd, EShaderStage::Compute, 0);
        mGpuNoiseImage->bindSampler(cmd, EShaderStage::Compute, 1);
        mGpuNoiseImage->bindSRV(cmd, EShaderStage::Compute, 1);
        mGpuLicImage->bindUAV(cmd, EShaderStage::Compute, 0);
        mGpuConstants.bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Compute, 1);
        cmd->setComputePipeline(mComputePipeline.get());
        const int THREADS_X = 16;
        const int THREADS_Y = 16;
        int groupsX         = (mLicImage->getResolution().x() + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X;
        int groupsY         = (mLicImage->getResolution().y() + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y;
        cmd->dispatch(groupsX, groupsY, 1);
        mGpuLicImage->unbindUAV(cmd, EShaderStage::Compute, 0);

        // -------- Rendering ---------

        // set viewport
        cmd->setViewport(0, 0, float(ctx.width), float(ctx.height));

        // clear
        const float clearColor[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 1 };
        cmd->clearRenderTarget(ctx.renderTarget, clearColor);

        // set render pipeline
        cmd->setRenderPipeline(mRenderPipeline.get());

        // bind shader resource view
        mGpuLicImage->bindSRV(cmd, EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);

        // bind and draw mesh
        mGpuViewportQuad->bind(cmd, EVertexStream::Position);
        mGpuViewportQuad->draw(cmd);

        // unbind shader resource view
        mGpuLicImage->unbindSRV(cmd, EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);
    }

private:
    void readFile()
    {
        // read file
        mField = scivis::AmiraReader::readAs<RegularUnsteadyVectorField2f>((datasetPath / "cylinder.am").string());
        if (!mField)
        {
            std::cout << "Data file not found! Place the cylinder.am in your dataset folder and check that the command line argument points correctly to the dataset folder." << std::endl;
            exit(1);
        }
    }

    // Constant data
    struct Constants
    {
        Eigen::Vector3f domainMin;
        float time; // time slice

        Eigen::Vector3f domainMax;
        float stepSize; // RK4 step size

        int numSteps;                   // number of RK4 steps
        float contrast;                 // scaling for contrast enhancement
        Eigen::Vector2i gridResolution; // LIC image resolution
    };
    GpuConstantBuffer<Constants> mGpuConstants;

    std::shared_ptr<RegularUnsteadyVectorField2f> mField;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuRegularUnsteadyVectorField2f> mGpuField;

    std::unique_ptr<Image1f> mNoiseImage;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuImage> mGpuNoiseImage;

    std::unique_ptr<Image1f> mLicImage;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuImage> mGpuLicImage;

    // cube mesh
    Mesh3f mViewportQuad;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> mGpuViewportQuad;

    // Pipelines
    std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> mRenderPipeline;
    std::unique_ptr<IComputePipeline> mComputePipeline;
};

int main(int argc, char* argv[])
{
    LICDemo app;
    return app.run(argc, argv,
                   scivis::EGraphicsDevice::OpenGL,
                   1024, 512);
}
```

### scivis/7_ftle/main.cpp
```
#include <init_vislab.hpp>

#include <vislab/app/trackball_interactor.hpp>
#include <vislab/field/regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>
#include <vislab/image/image.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_image.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_perspective_camera.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/render_context.hpp>

#include "application.hpp"

#include <memory>

using namespace vislab;

class FTLEDemo : public scivis::Application
{
public:
    /**
     * @brief Enumeration of integration methods.
     */
    enum EMethod
    {
        FiniteDifference,
        LocalizedEuler,
        LocalizedRK4,
    };

    void init(const SwapchainContext& stx) override
    {
        // viewport quad
        mViewportQuad.setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology::TriangleStrip);
        mViewportQuad.getPositions().setValues({ { -1.f, -1.f, 0.f },
                                                 { 1.f, -1.f, 0.f },
                                                 { -1.f, 1.f, 0.f },
                                                 { 1.f, 1.f, 0.f } });
        mGpuViewportQuad = std::make_unique<GpuMesh>(device.get(), &mViewportQuad);

        // load shaders
        ShaderBinary vsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "ftle", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Vertex);
        ShaderBinary fsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "ftle", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Fragment);
        ShaderBinary csBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "ftle", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Compute);

        // render pipeline
        RenderPipelineDesc rp{};
        rp.vertexShader     = vsBin;
        rp.fragmentShader   = fsBin;
        rp.depth.depthTest  = false;
        rp.depth.depthWrite = false;
        rp.vertexLayout     = mGpuViewportQuad->getVertexLayout();
        mRenderPipeline     = device->createRenderPipeline(rp);

        // compute pipeline
        ComputePipelineDesc cp{};
        cp.computeShader = csBin;
        mComputePipeline = device->createComputePipeline(cp);

        // constant buffer
        Constants constants{};
        constants.startTime          = 0.0f;
        constants.stepSize           = 0.5f;
        constants.numSteps           = 30;
        constants.tfMax              = 1.;
        float dx                     = 2.0f / float(stx.width);
        float dy                     = 1.0f / float(stx.height);
        constants.separationDistance = std::min(dx, dy);
        constants.gridResolution     = Eigen::Vector2i(stx.width, stx.height);
        mGpuConstants                = GpuConstantBuffer<Constants>(device.get(), constants, "Constants");

        // image
        mFtleImage    = std::make_unique<Image1f>(stx.width, stx.height);
        mGpuFtleImage = std::make_unique<GpuImage>(device.get(), &mFtleImage->getRaw(), ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource | ETextureBindFlags::UnorderedAccess);
    }

    void resize(const vislab::SwapchainContext& stx) override
    {
        mFtleImage->setResolution(stx.width, stx.height);
        mGpuFtleImage->resize();

        mGpuConstants.getData().gridResolution     = Eigen::Vector2i(stx.width, stx.height);
        float dx                                   = 2.0f / float(stx.width);
        float dy                                   = 1.0f / float(stx.height);
        mGpuConstants.getData().separationDistance = std::min(dx, dy);
    }

    void update([[maybe_unused]] double dt, [[maybe_unused]] double total) override
    {
    }

    void gui() override
    {
        ImGui::Begin("SciVis", 0, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);

        ImGui::RadioButton("Finite Diff", &mGpuConstants.getData().method, 0);
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::RadioButton("Localized Euler", &mGpuConstants.getData().method, 1);
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::RadioButton("Localized RK4", &mGpuConstants.getData().method, 2);

        ImGui::SliderFloat("startTime", &mGpuConstants.getData().startTime, 0, 10);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("stepSize", &mGpuConstants.getData().stepSize, 0, 1);
        ImGui::SliderInt("numSteps", &mGpuConstants.getData().numSteps, 1, 100);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("tfMax", &mGpuConstants.getData().tfMax, 0, 2);
        ImGui::Separator();

        // close button
        if (ImGui::Button("Close Window"))
            exit(0);

        ImGui::End();
    }

    void render(ICommandList* cmd, const RenderContext& ctx) override
    {
        // -------- Updates ---------

        // update constant buffer
        mGpuConstants.update(cmd);

        // -------- Compute ---------
        mGpuFtleImage->bindUAV(cmd, EShaderStage::Compute, 0);
        mGpuConstants.bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Compute, 1);
        cmd->setComputePipeline(mComputePipeline.get());
        const int THREADS_X = 16;
        const int THREADS_Y = 16;
        int groupsX         = (mFtleImage->getResolution().x() + THREADS_X - 1) / THREADS_X;
        int groupsY         = (mFtleImage->getResolution().y() + THREADS_Y - 1) / THREADS_Y;
        cmd->dispatch(groupsX, groupsY, 1);
        mGpuFtleImage->unbindUAV(cmd, EShaderStage::Compute, 0);

        // -------- Rendering ---------

        // set viewport
        cmd->setViewport(0, 0, float(ctx.width), float(ctx.height));

        // clear
        const float clearColor[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 1 };
        cmd->clearRenderTarget(ctx.renderTarget, clearColor);

        // set render pipeline
        cmd->setRenderPipeline(mRenderPipeline.get());

        // bind constant buffers
        mGpuConstants.bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Fragment, 1);

        // bind shader resource view
        mGpuFtleImage->bindSRV(cmd, EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);

        // bind and draw mesh
        mGpuViewportQuad->bind(cmd, EVertexStream::Position);
        mGpuViewportQuad->draw(cmd);

        // unbind shader resource view
        mGpuFtleImage->unbindSRV(cmd, EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);
    }

private:
    // Constant data
    struct Constants
    {
        int method;                     // 0 = finite diff, 1 = localized linear, 2 = exponential
        float startTime;                // integration start time
        float stepSize;                 // RK4 step size
        int numSteps;                   // number of RK4 steps
        float tfMax;                    // visualization normalization
        float separationDistance;       // finite-difference epsilon (domain-space)
        Eigen::Vector2i gridResolution; // FTLE image resolution
    };
    GpuConstantBuffer<Constants> mGpuConstants;

    std::unique_ptr<Image1f> mFtleImage;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuImage> mGpuFtleImage;

    // cube mesh
    Mesh3f mViewportQuad;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> mGpuViewportQuad;

    // Pipelines
    std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> mRenderPipeline;
    std::unique_ptr<IComputePipeline> mComputePipeline;
};

int main(int argc, char* argv[])
{
    FTLEDemo app;
    return app.run(argc, argv,
                   scivis::EGraphicsDevice::OpenGL,
                   1024, 512);
}
```

### scivis/8_surface/main.cpp
```
#include <init_vislab.hpp>

#include <vislab/app/trackball_interactor.hpp>
#include <vislab/field/regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/vertex_normals.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_perspective_camera.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/render_context.hpp>
#include <vislab/scene/perspective_camera.hpp>

#include "amira_reader.hpp"
#include "application.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <iostream>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

using namespace vislab;

class SurfaceDemo : public scivis::Application
{
public:
    void init([[maybe_unused]] const SwapchainContext& stx) override
    {
        // camera
        mCamera = std::make_shared<PerspectiveCamera>();
        mCamera->setLookAt(Eigen::Vector3d(0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
        mCamera->setPosition(Eigen::Vector3d(-16, 20, 16));
        mCamera->setUp(Eigen::Vector3d(0, 0, 1));
        mCamera->setNear(0.01);
        mCamera->setFar(100.0);
        mGpuCamera = std::make_unique<GpuPerspectiveCamera>(device.get(), mCamera.get());

        // interactor
        auto trackball = std::make_shared<TrackballInteractor>();
        trackball->setCamera(mCamera);
        setInteractor(trackball);

        // load field
        readFile();

        // compute surface
        mSurface.setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology::TriangleList);
        computeSurface();
        mGpuSurface = std::make_unique<GpuMesh>(device.get(), &mSurface);

        // load shaders
        ShaderBinary vsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "surface", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Vertex);
        ShaderBinary fsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "surface", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Fragment);

        // pipeline
        {
            RenderPipelineDesc rp{};
            rp.vertexShader     = vsBin;
            rp.fragmentShader   = fsBin;
            rp.raster.cullMode  = ECullMode::None;
            rp.vertexLayout     = mGpuSurface->getVertexLayout();
            rp.raster.wireframe = false;
            mPipelineSolid      = device->createRenderPipeline(rp);
        }
        {
            RenderPipelineDesc rp{};
            rp.vertexShader     = vsBin;
            rp.fragmentShader   = fsBin;
            rp.raster.cullMode  = ECullMode::None;
            rp.vertexLayout     = mGpuSurface->getVertexLayout();
            rp.raster.wireframe = true;
            mPipelineWire       = device->createRenderPipeline(rp);
        }

        // constant buffer
        Constants constants{};
        constants.color = Eigen::Vector4f(0.7f, 0.9f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
        mGpuConstants   = GpuConstantBuffer<Constants>(device.get(), constants, "Constants");
    }

    void update([[maybe_unused]] double dt, [[maybe_unused]] double total) override
    {
        static Eigen::Vector3f lastSeedA    = mSeedA;
        static Eigen::Vector3f lastSeedB    = mSeedB;
        static int lastNumSteps             = mNumSteps;
        static float lastStepSize           = mStepSize;
        static int lastNumInitialPoints     = mNumInitialPoints;
        static float lastSeparationDistance = mSeparationDistance;
        if (lastSeedA != mSeedA || lastSeedB != mSeedB || lastNumSteps != mNumSteps || lastStepSize != mStepSize || lastNumInitialPoints != mNumInitialPoints || lastSeparationDistance != mSeparationDistance)
        {
            computeSurface();
            lastSeedA              = mSeedA;
            lastSeedB              = mSeedB;
            lastNumSteps           = mNumSteps;
            lastStepSize           = mStepSize;
            lastNumInitialPoints   = mNumInitialPoints;
            lastSeparationDistance = mSeparationDistance;
        }
    }

    void gui() override
    {
        ImGui::Begin("SciVis", 0, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);

        int mode = mSolid ? 0 : 1;
        ImGui::RadioButton("Solid", &mode, 0);
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::RadioButton("Wireframe", &mode, 1);
        mSolid = (mode == 0);

        ImGui::SliderFloat("seedA.x", &mSeedA[0], -10, 10);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("seedA.y", &mSeedA[1], -10, 10);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("seedA.z", &mSeedA[2], -10, 10);

        ImGui::SliderFloat("seedB.x", &mSeedB[0], -10, 10);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("seedB.y", &mSeedB[1], -10, 10);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("seedB.z", &mSeedB[2], -10, 10);

        ImGui::SliderInt("numInitPoints", &mNumInitialPoints, 2, 100);
        ImGui::SliderInt("numSteps", &mNumSteps, 2, 1000);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("stepSize", &mStepSize, 0, 2);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("sepDist", &mSeparationDistance, 0, 1);

        ImGui::ColorEdit3("color", mGpuConstants.getData().color.ptr());
        ImGui::Separator();

        // close button
        if (ImGui::Button("Close Window"))
            exit(0);

        ImGui::End();
    }

    void render(ICommandList* cmd, const RenderContext& ctx) override
    {
        // -------- Updates ---------

        // update camera
        mCamera->setWidth(ctx.width);
        mCamera->setHeight(ctx.height);
        mGpuCamera->update(cmd);

        // update constant buffer
        mGpuConstants.update(cmd);

        // upload vertex data (if changed)
        if (mSurfaceDirty)
        {
            mGpuSurface->update(cmd);
            mSurfaceDirty = false;
        }

        // -------- Rendering ---------

        // set viewport
        cmd->setViewport(0, 0, float(ctx.width), float(ctx.height));

        // clear
        const float clearColor[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 1 };
        cmd->clearRenderTarget(ctx.renderTarget, clearColor);
        cmd->clearDepthStencil(ctx.depthTarget, 1.0f);

        // set render pipeline
        cmd->setRenderPipeline(mSolid ? mPipelineSolid.get() : mPipelineWire.get());

        // bind constant buffers
        mGpuCamera->bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);
        mGpuConstants.bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Fragment, 1);

        // bind and draw mesh
        mGpuSurface->bind(cmd, EVertexStream::Position | EVertexStream::Normal);
        mGpuSurface->draw(cmd);
    }

private:
    void readFile()
    {
        // read file
        mField = scivis::AmiraReader::readAs<RegularSteadyVectorField3f>((datasetPath / "tornado.am").string());
        if (!mField)
        {
            std::cout << "Data file not found! Place the tornado.am in your dataset folder and check that the command line argument points correctly to the dataset folder." << std::endl;
            exit(1);
        }
    }

    Eigen::Vector3d sample(const Eigen::Vector3d& pos, bool& indomain) const
    {
        indomain &= mField->getDomain().contains(pos);
        if (indomain)
        {
            Eigen::Vector3d vel = mField->sample(pos);
            double length       = vel.norm();
            if (length > 1E-8)
                return -vel.normalized();
        }
        return Eigen::Vector3d(0, 0, 0);
    }

    Eigen::Vector3d stepRK4(const Eigen::Vector3d& pos, double stepSize, bool& indomain) const
    {
        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        // TODO 1: implement RK4 (copy from scivis_5_lines)
        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        Eigen::Vector3d k1 = sample(pos, indomain);
        Eigen::Vector3d k2 = sample(pos + 0.5 * stepSize * k1, indomain);
        Eigen::Vector3d k3 = sample(pos + 0.5 * stepSize * k2, indomain);
        Eigen::Vector3d k4 = sample(pos + stepSize * k3, indomain);
        return pos + (stepSize / 6.0) * (k1 + 2.0 * k2 + 2.0 * k3 + k4);
    }

    // FrontPoint structure
    struct FrontPoint
    {
        Eigen::Vector3d pos0; // current position at time t_i
        Eigen::Vector3d pos1; // advected position at time t_{i+1}

        double time0 = 0.0; // current time
        double time1 = 0.0; // next time

        unsigned int vertexIndex0 = 0; // index of pos0 in mesh
        unsigned int vertexIndex1 = 0; // index of pos1 in mesh
    };

    using FrontLine     = std::list<FrontPoint>;
    using FrontIterator = FrontLine::iterator;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TODO 3: Recursive Hultquist Step
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    void recursiveHultquist(FrontLine& front, FrontIterator current)
    {
        if (mStopSurface)
            return;

        auto& P = mSurface.getPositions();
        auto& I = mSurface.getIndexCollection();

        bool caughtUp   = false;
        double prev_dg2 = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();

        // Local lambda for "advanceLeft(current)"
        auto advanceLeftPoint = [&]() -> bool
        {
            bool indomain = true;

            current->pos0         = current->pos1;
            current->time0        = current->time1;
            current->vertexIndex0 = current->vertexIndex1;

            current->pos1  = stepRK4(current->pos0, mStepSize, indomain);
            current->time1 = current->time0 + mStepSize;

            if (!indomain)
            {
                mStopSurface = true;
                return false;
            }

            P.push_back(current->pos1.cast<float>());
            current->vertexIndex1 = (unsigned int)P.getSize() - 1;

            return true;
        };

        while (!mStopSurface)
        {
            // TODO 3.1: Extract left quad edge
            Eigen::Vector3d L0 = current->pos0;
            Eigen::Vector3d L1 = current->pos1;

            // TODO 3.2: Identify right neighbor
            FrontIterator next = current;
            ++next;
            if (next == front.end())
            {
                advanceLeftPoint();
                return;
            }

            // TODO 3.3: Extract right quad edge
            Eigen::Vector3d R0 = next->pos0;
            Eigen::Vector3d R1 = next->pos1;

            // TODO 3.4: Compute diagonal lengths
            double d_L2    = (L1 - R0).squaredNorm();
            double d_R2    = (L0 - R1).squaredNorm();
            double min_dg2 = std::min(d_L2, d_R2);
            bool advanceLeft = (d_L2 == min_dg2);

            // TODO 3.5: Termination condition
            if (caughtUp && (advanceLeft || (d_R2 > prev_dg2)))
                return;

            if (advanceLeft)
            {
                // TODO 3.6: Advance left
                I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(current->vertexIndex0));
                I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(current->vertexIndex1));
                I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(next->vertexIndex0));

                if (!advanceLeftPoint())
                    return;

                caughtUp = true;
            }
            else
            {
                // TODO 3.7: Advance right (recursive)
                I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(current->vertexIndex0));
                I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(next->vertexIndex1));
                I.push_back(Eigen::Vector1u(next->vertexIndex0));

                recursiveHultquist(front, next);
            }

            // TODO 3.8: Update previous diagonal length
            prev_dg2 = min_dg2;
        }
    }

    // Top-level Hultquist integration
    void integrateSurfaceHultquist(
        const std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d>& seedLine,
        float neighborSeparationDist)
    {
        mStopSurface = false;

        auto& P = mSurface.getPositions();

        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        // TODO 2: Initialize front from seed line
        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        FrontLine front(seedLine.size());
        std::size_t idx = 0;

        for (auto it = front.begin(); it != front.end(); ++it, ++idx)
        {
            FrontPoint& fp = *it;

            // TODO 2.1: Set initial state at time t0
            fp.pos0  = seedLine[idx];
            fp.time0 = 0.0;

            // TODO 2.2: Store pos0 in the mesh and record vertexIndex0
            P.push_back(fp.pos0.cast<float>());
            fp.vertexIndex0 = (unsigned int)P.getSize() - 1;

            // TODO 2.3: Compute pos1 using RK4 starting from pos0
            bool indomain = true;
            fp.pos1  = stepRK4(fp.pos0, mStepSize, indomain);
            fp.time1 = fp.time0 + mStepSize;

            // TODO 2.4: If the point leaves the domain, stop the surface
            if (!indomain)
            {
                mStopSurface = true;
                break;
            }

            // TODO 2.5: Store pos1 in the mesh and record vertexIndex1
            P.push_back(fp.pos1.cast<float>());
            fp.vertexIndex1 = (unsigned int)P.getSize() - 1;
        }

        if (mStopSurface)
            return;

        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Main propagation loop
        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        for (int iter = 0; iter < mNumSteps; ++iter)
        {
            if (mStopSurface)
                break;

            // Call recursive Hultquist on first front element
            auto it = front.begin();
            if (it != front.end())
                recursiveHultquist(front, it);

            if (mStopSurface)
                break;

            // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
            // TODO 4: Refinement step
            // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
            for (auto L = front.begin(); L != front.end(); ++L)
            {
                auto R = std::next(L);
                if (R == front.end())
                    break;

                // TODO 4.1: Compute squared distance d^2 = ||L.pos0 - R.pos0||^2
                double d2 = (L->pos0 - R->pos0).squaredNorm();

                // TODO 4.2: Compare with threshold^2 = neighborSeparationDist^2
                double threshold2 = double(neighborSeparationDist) * double(neighborSeparationDist);
                if (d2 > threshold2)
                {
                    FrontPoint fp;

                    // TODO 4.3: Compute midpoint values by linear interpolation: pos0_mid, pos1_mid, time0_mid, time1_mid
                    fp.pos0  = 0.5 * (L->pos0 + R->pos0);
                    fp.pos1  = 0.5 * (L->pos1 + R->pos1);
                    fp.time0 = 0.5 * (L->time0 + R->time0);
                    fp.time1 = 0.5 * (L->time1 + R->time1);

                    // TODO 4.4: Insert midpoint positions into the mesh and store vertexIndex0 and vertexIndex1 in fp
                    P.push_back(fp.pos0.cast<float>());
                    fp.vertexIndex0 = (unsigned int)P.getSize() - 1;
                    P.push_back(fp.pos1.cast<float>());
                    fp.vertexIndex1 = (unsigned int)P.getSize() - 1;

                    // TODO 4.5: Insert midpoint into the front before R
                    front.insert(R, fp);
                }
            }
        }

        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Finalize mesh
        // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        mSurface.recomputeBoundingBox();
    }

    std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> makeSeedLine(const Eigen::Vector3f& A,
                                              const Eigen::Vector3f& B,
                                              int samples)
    {
        std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> line;
        line.reserve(samples);

        if (samples < 2)
            samples = 2;

        for (int i = 0; i < samples; ++i)
        {
            double t          = double(i) / double(samples - 1);
            Eigen::Vector3d p = (1.0 - t) * A.cast<double>() + t * B.cast<double>();
            line.push_back(p);
        }

        return line;
    }

    void computeSurface()
    {
        // clear CPU mesh buffers
        auto& P = mSurface.getPositions();
        auto& N = mSurface.getNormals();
        auto& I = mSurface.getIndexCollection();

        P.clear();
        N.clear();
        I.clear();

        // compute seeding curve.
        auto seedline = makeSeedLine(mSeedA, mSeedB, mNumInitialPoints);

        // recompute the surface
        integrateSurfaceHultquist(seedline, mSeparationDistance);

        // compute vertex normals
        VertexNormals::computeNormals(mSurface.getRaw());

        // mark dirty so GPU updates
        mSurfaceDirty = true;
    }

    // Volume data
    std::shared_ptr<RegularSteadyVectorField3f> mField;

    // Camera data
    std::shared_ptr<PerspectiveCamera> mCamera;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuPerspectiveCamera> mGpuCamera;

    // Constant data
    struct Constants
    {
        Eigen::Vector4f color; // base color
    };
    GpuConstantBuffer<Constants> mGpuConstants;

    // stream surface
    Eigen::Vector3f mSeedA    = Eigen::Vector3f(-6, -6, -2);
    Eigen::Vector3f mSeedB    = Eigen::Vector3f(-6, -6, 9);
    float mStepSize           = 0.1f;
    int mNumSteps             = 200;
    int mNumInitialPoints     = 20;
    float mSeparationDistance = 0.1f;
    bool mStopSurface         = false;
    Mesh3f mSurface;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> mGpuSurface;
    bool mSurfaceDirty = false;
    bool mSolid        = false;

    // Render pipelines
    std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> mPipelineSolid;
    std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> mPipelineWire;
};

int main(int argc, char* argv[])
{
    SurfaceDemo app;
    return app.run(argc, argv,
                   scivis::EGraphicsDevice::OpenGL,
                   1280, 720);
}
```

```
#include <init_vislab.hpp>

#include <vislab/app/trackball_interactor.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/transfer_function.hpp>
#include <vislab/field/regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_perspective_camera.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_transfer_function.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/render_context.hpp>
#include <vislab/scene/perspective_camera.hpp>

#include "amira_reader.hpp"
#include "application.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <iostream>
#include <memory>

using namespace vislab;

class FeatureDemo : public scivis::Application
{
public:
    enum class EMethod
    {
        Vorticity,
        Helicity,
        QHunt,
        Lambda2
    };

    void init([[maybe_unused]] const SwapchainContext& stx) override
    {
        // camera
        mCamera = std::make_shared<PerspectiveCamera>();
        mCamera->setLookAt(Eigen::Vector3d(0.0, -0.15, 0.1));
        mCamera->setPosition(Eigen::Vector3d(0.3, -0.7, -0.4));
        mCamera->setUp(Eigen::Vector3d(0, 0, -1));
        mCamera->setNear(0.01);
        mCamera->setFar(100.0);
        mGpuCamera = std::make_unique<GpuPerspectiveCamera>(device.get(), mCamera.get());

        // interactor
        auto trackball = std::make_shared<TrackballInteractor>();
        trackball->setCamera(mCamera);
        setInteractor(trackball);

        // load field
        readFile();
        mFeature = std::make_shared<RegularSteadyScalarField3f>(mField->getDomain(), mField->getGrid().getResolution());
        computeFeature();

        // GPU volume wrapper
        mGpuFeature = std::make_unique<GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f>(
            device.get(),
            mFeature.get(),
            ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource,
            EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
            "VolumeField");

        // transfer function (CPU)
        mTF = std::make_unique<TransferFunction4d>();
        mTF->getValues().insert({ 0.00, Eigen::Vector4d(103.0 / 255.0, 169.0 / 255.0, 207.0 / 255.0, 0.00) });
        mTF->getValues().insert({ 0.25, Eigen::Vector4d(209.0 / 255.0, 229.0 / 255.0, 240.0 / 255.0, 0.25) });
        mTF->getValues().insert({ 0.50, Eigen::Vector4d(247.0 / 255.0, 247.0 / 255.0, 247.0 / 255.0, 0.50) });
        mTF->getValues().insert({ 0.75, Eigen::Vector4d(253.0 / 255.0, 219.0 / 255.0, 199.0 / 255.0, 0.75) });
        mTF->getValues().insert({ 1.00, Eigen::Vector4d(239.0 / 255.0, 138.0 / 255.0, 98.0 / 255.0, 1.00) });

        // GPU transfer function wrapper
        mGpuTF = std::make_unique<GpuTransferFunction>(
            device.get(),
            mTF.get(),
            32,
            "TransferFunction");

        // cube geometry
        createCubeGeometry();

        // load shaders (reuse from scivis_2_volren)
        ShaderBinary vsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "volren", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Vertex);
        ShaderBinary fsBin = scivis::Backend::getShader(device.get(), "volren", SHADER_DIR, EShaderStage::Fragment);

        // pipeline
        RenderPipelineDesc rp{};
        rp.vertexShader            = vsBin;
        rp.fragmentShader          = fsBin;
        rp.vertexLayout            = mGpuCube->getVertexLayout();
        rp.depth.depthWrite        = false;
        rp.blend.targets[0].enable = true;
        mPipeline                  = device->createRenderPipeline(rp);

        // constant buffer
        Constants constants{};
        constants.domainMin       = mField->getDomain().min().cast<float>();
        constants.domainMax       = mField->getDomain().max().cast<float>();
        constants.stepSize        = float(mField->getGrid().getSpacing().minCoeff());
        constants.tfMin           = 0.1f;
        constants.tfMax           = 0.7f;
        constants.enableShadows   = 1;
        constants.extinctionScale = 500.0f;
        mGpuConstants             = GpuConstantBuffer<Constants>(device.get(), constants, "Constants");
    }

    void update([[maybe_unused]] double dt, [[maybe_unused]] double total) override
    {
        static EMethod lastMethod = EMethod::Vorticity;
        if (lastMethod != mMethod)
        {
            computeFeature();
            mDataDirty = true;
            lastMethod = mMethod;
        }
    }

    void gui() override
    {
        ImGui::Begin("SciVis", 0, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);

        int method = (int)mMethod;
        ImGui::RadioButton("Vorticity", &method, 0);
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::RadioButton("Helicity", &method, 1);
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::RadioButton("QHunt", &method, 2);
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::RadioButton("Lambda2", &method, 3);
        mMethod = (EMethod)method;

        ImGui::SliderFloat("stepSize", &mGpuConstants.getData().stepSize, 0.001f, 0.01f);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("tfMin", &mGpuConstants.getData().tfMin, 0, 1);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("tfMax", &mGpuConstants.getData().tfMax, 0, 1);
        ImGui::SliderFloat("extinction", &mGpuConstants.getData().extinctionScale, 0, 1000);
        ImGui::Checkbox("shadows", (bool*)&mGpuConstants.getData().enableShadows);

        ImGui::Separator();

        // close button
        if (ImGui::Button("Close Window"))
            exit(0);

        ImGui::End();
    }

    void render(ICommandList* cmd, const RenderContext& ctx) override
    {
        // -------- Updates ---------

        // update camera
        mCamera->setWidth(ctx.width);
        mCamera->setHeight(ctx.height);
        mGpuCamera->update(cmd);

        // update constant buffer
        mGpuConstants.update(cmd);

        // upload vertex data (if changed)
        if (mDataDirty)
        {
            mGpuFeature->update(cmd);
            mDataDirty = false;
        }

        // -------- Rendering ---------

        // set viewport
        cmd->setViewport(0, 0, float(ctx.width), float(ctx.height));

        // clear
        const float clearColor[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 1 };
        cmd->clearRenderTarget(ctx.renderTarget, clearColor);
        cmd->clearDepthStencil(ctx.depthTarget, 1.0f);

        // set render pipeline
        cmd->setRenderPipeline(mPipeline.get());

        // bind constant buffers
        mGpuCamera->bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);
        mGpuConstants.bind(cmd, EShaderStage::Vertex | EShaderStage::Fragment, 1);

        // bind volume (SRV + sampler)
        mGpuFeature->bindSampler(cmd, EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);
        mGpuFeature->bindSRV(cmd, EShaderStage::Fragment, 0);

        // bind transfer function (SRV + sampler)
        mGpuTF->bind(EShaderStage::Fragment, 1, cmd);

        // bind and draw mesh
        mGpuCube->bind(cmd, EVertexStream::Position);
        mGpuCube->draw(cmd);
    }

private:
    void readFile()
    {
        // read file
        mField = scivis::AmiraReader::readAs<RegularSteadyVectorField3f>((datasetPath / "boeing747.am").string());
        if (!mField)
        {
            std::cout << "Data file not found! Place the boeing747.am in your dataset folder and check that the command line argument points correctly to the dataset folder." << std::endl;
            exit(1);
        }

        // rescale and recenter domain
        Eigen::AlignedBox3d domain = mField->getDomain();
        double scale               = (domain.max() - domain.min()).maxCoeff();
        mField->setDomain(Eigen::AlignedBox3d((domain.min() / scale) - domain.center() / scale,
                                              (domain.max() / scale) - domain.center() / scale));
    }

    void computeFeature()
    {
        auto& grid             = mFeature->getGrid();
        Eigen::Index numPoints = grid.getNumGridPoints();

        // for each grid point
#ifdef _NDEBUG
#pragma omp parallel for
#endif
        for (Eigen::Index linearIndex = 0; linearIndex < numPoints; ++linearIndex)
        {
            // --- Load grid coordinate and velocity ---
            Eigen::Vector3i gridCoord = grid.getGridCoord(linearIndex);
            Eigen::Vector3f v         = mField->getVertexDataAt(gridCoord);

            // --- TODO: Compute partial derivatives using estimatePartial ---
            // Eigen::Vector3f vx = ...
            // Eigen::Vector3f vy = ...
            // Eigen::Vector3f vz = ...

            float value = 0.0f;

            switch (mMethod)
            {
            case EMethod::Vorticity:
            {
                // TODO 1: Compute vorticity vector w = curl(v)
                // TODO 1: Set value = ||w||

                break;
            }

            case EMethod::Helicity:
            {
                // TODO 2: Compute vorticity vector w = curl(v)
                // TODO 2: Set value = | v · w |

                break;
            }

            case EMethod::QHunt:
            {
                // TODO 3: Assemble Jacobian J from vx, vy, vz
                // TODO 3: Compute S = 0.5 * (J + J^T)
                // TODO 3: Compute O = 0.5 * (J - J^T)
                // TODO 3: Compute Q = 0.5 * (||O||^2 - ||S||^2)
                // TODO 3: Set value = Q

                break;
            }

            case EMethod::Lambda2:
            {
                // TODO 4: Assemble Jacobian J from vx, vy, vz
                // TODO 4: Compute S = 0.5 * (J + J^T)
                // TODO 4: Compute O = 0.5 * (J - J^T)
                // TODO 4: Compute M = S*S + O*O
                // TODO 4: Compute eigenvalues of M
                // TODO 4: Set value = -lambda2 (middle eigenvalue)

                break;
            }
            }

            // --- Store result ---
            mFeature->setVertexDataAt(gridCoord, value);
        }

        // --- Normalize to [0,1] for visualization ---
        float maxValue = getMax<Eigen::Vector1f>(mFeature->getArray().getRaw()).x();

#ifdef _NDEBUG
#pragma omp parallel for
#endif
        for (Eigen::Index linearIndex = 0; linearIndex < numPoints; ++linearIndex)
        {
            Eigen::Vector3i gridCoord = grid.getGridCoord(linearIndex);
            float value               = mFeature->getVertexDataAt(gridCoord).x();
            float scaled              = value / maxValue;
            mFeature->setVertexDataAt(gridCoord, scaled);
        }
    }

    void createCubeGeometry()
    {
        mCube.setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology::TriangleList);
        mCube.getPositions().setValues({ { 0.f, 0.f, 0.f },
                                         { 1.f, 0.f, 0.f },
                                         { 1.f, 1.f, 0.f },
                                         { 0.f, 1.f, 0.f },
                                         { 0.f, 0.f, 1.f },
                                         { 1.f, 0.f, 1.f },
                                         { 1.f, 1.f, 1.f },
                                         { 0.f, 1.f, 1.f } });
        mCube.getIndexCollection().setValues({ 0u, 1u, 2u, 0u, 2u, 3u,
                                               4u, 6u, 5u, 4u, 7u, 6u,
                                               0u, 4u, 5u, 0u, 5u, 1u,
                                               3u, 2u, 6u, 3u, 6u, 7u,
                                               0u, 3u, 7u, 0u, 7u, 4u,
                                               1u, 5u, 6u, 1u, 6u, 2u });
        mGpuCube = std::make_unique<GpuMesh>(device.get(), &mCube);
    }

    // Volume data
    std::shared_ptr<RegularSteadyVectorField3f> mField;

    std::shared_ptr<RegularSteadyScalarField3f> mFeature;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f> mGpuFeature;

    // Transfer function
    std::unique_ptr<TransferFunction4d> mTF;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuTransferFunction> mGpuTF;

    // Camera data
    std::shared_ptr<PerspectiveCamera> mCamera;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuPerspectiveCamera> mGpuCamera;

    // Constant data
    struct Constants
    {
        Eigen::Vector3f domainMin;
        float stepSize;

        Eigen::Vector3f domainMax;
        float tfMin;

        float tfMax;
        int enableShadows;
        float extinctionScale;
    };
    GpuConstantBuffer<Constants> mGpuConstants;

    // cube mesh
    Mesh3f mCube;
    std::unique_ptr<GpuMesh> mGpuCube;

    // Render pipeline
    std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> mPipeline;

    EMethod mMethod = EMethod::Vorticity;
    bool mDataDirty = false;
};
```

### scivis/common/include/amira.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#include <Eigen/Eigen>

namespace amira
{

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // File encoding
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    enum class FileEncoding
    {
        ASCII,
        BinaryLittleEndian,
        BinaryBigEndian
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Scalar types (Amira + your extended types)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    enum class ScalarType
    {
        Float32,
        Float64,
        Int16,
        Int32,
        Int64,
        UInt8,
        UInt16,
        UInt32,
        UInt64,
        Unknown
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Primitive topology (self-contained Amira version)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    enum class PrimitiveTopology
    {
        Undefined,
        PointList,
        LineList,
        LineStrip,
        TriangleList,
        TriangleStrip
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Parameter (generic key-value from header)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    struct Parameter
    {
        std::string name;
        std::string value;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Raw data block referenced by @<index>
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    struct DataBlock
    {
        int index = -1;

        // Using aligned allocator for zero-copy into your RawArray
        std::vector<std::byte, Eigen::aligned_allocator<std::byte>> data;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Attribute declaration from header
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    struct Attribute
    {
        std::string objectType; // "Vertices", "Triangles", "Lattice", etc.
        std::string name;       // "Coordinates", "Normals", "Data", etc.

        ScalarType scalarType = ScalarType::Unknown;
        int components        = 1;

        int dataBlockIndex = -1; // @<index>
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Full AmiraMesh container
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    struct AmiraMesh
    {
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // File header
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        std::string magicLine;
        FileEncoding encoding = FileEncoding::ASCII;

        // Parameters { ... } block
        std::unordered_map<std::string, Parameter> parameters;

        // Attribute declarations (Vertices, Lines, Triangles, etc.)
        std::vector<Attribute> attributes;

        // Raw data blocks referenced by @<index>
        std::unordered_map<int, DataBlock> dataBlocks;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Topology inferred from first attribute
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        PrimitiveTopology topology = PrimitiveTopology::Undefined;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Optional: scalar/vector field domain
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        std::array<int, 3> latticeDims    = { 0, 0, 0 }; // define Lattice nx ny nz
        std::array<double, 6> boundingBox = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 };
        std::string coordType; // "uniform", "rectilinear", "irregular"

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // NEW: entity counts from header (define or nVertices etc.)
        // These DO NOT affect your conversion pipeline unless you use them.
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        int vertexCount   = 0; // from define Vertices
        int pointCount    = 0; // from define PointList
        int lineCount     = 0; // from define LineList or LineStrip
        int triangleCount = 0; // from define TriangleList or TriangleStrip
    };


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Amira interface with read and write.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    class Amira
    {
    public:
        [[nodiscard]] static AmiraMesh read(const std::string& filename);
        static void write(const AmiraMesh& mesh, const std::string& filename);
    };

} // namespace amira
```

### scivis/common/include/amira_reader.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <vislab/core/algorithm.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/path_parameter.hpp>

namespace scivis
{
    class AmiraReader : public vislab::ConcreteAlgorithm<AmiraReader>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         * @param outData Data to write to.
         * @param path Path to read from.
         */
        AmiraReader(const std::shared_ptr<vislab::Data>& outData = nullptr, const std::string& path = "");

        /**
         * @brief Data that was read from file.
         */
        vislab::OutputPort<vislab::Data> outputData;

        /**
         * @brief Path to read from.
         */
        vislab::PathParameter paramPath;

        /**
         * @brief Helper function for reading an Amira file into a generic Data type.
         * @param path Path to the .am file.
         * @return Shared pointer to read data or nullptr if failed.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] static std::shared_ptr<vislab::Data> read(const std::string& path)
        {
            AmiraReader reader;
            reader.paramPath.setValue(path);
            auto info = reader.update();
            if (!info.success())
                return nullptr;
            return reader.outputData.getData();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Helper function for reading an Amira file into a certain type.
         * @tparam TData Type to read. Note that this must match exactly to the file content.
         * @param path Path to the .am file.
         * @return Shared pointer to read data or nullptr if failed.
         */
        template <typename TData>
        [[nodiscard]] static std::shared_ptr<TData> readAs(const std::string& path)
        {
            return std::dynamic_pointer_cast<TData>(read(path));
        }

    protected:
        /**
         * @brief Internal computation function
         * @param progress Optional progress info.
         * @return Information about the completion of the computation, including a potential error message.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] vislab::UpdateInfo internalUpdate(vislab::ProgressInfo& progress) override;
    };
}
```

```
#pragma once

#include <vislab/core/algorithm.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/path_parameter.hpp>

namespace scivis
{
    /**
     * @brief Amira writer that supports binary format and little-endian.
     */
    class AmiraWriter : public vislab::ConcreteAlgorithm<AmiraWriter>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         * @param path Path to write to.
         */
        AmiraWriter(const std::string& path = "");

        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         * @param inData Data to write.
         * @param path Path to write to.
         */
        AmiraWriter(const std::shared_ptr<vislab::Data>& inData, const std::string& path = "");

        /**
         * @brief RawMesh that is written to file.
         */
        vislab::OutputPort<vislab::Data> inputData;

        /**
         * @brief Path to write to.
         */
        vislab::PathParameter paramPath;

        /**
         * @brief Helper function for writing an Amira file. The data must be a mesh or a regular field.
         * @param path Path to the .am file.
         * @param data Data to write to file.
         * @return True if writing was successful.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] static bool write(const std::string& path, std::shared_ptr<vislab::Data> data)
        {
            AmiraWriter writer;
            writer.paramPath.setValue(path);
            writer.inputData.setData(data);
            auto info = writer.update();
            return info.success();
        }

    protected:
        /**
         * @brief Internal computation function
         * @param progress Optional progress info.
         * @return Information about the completion of the computation, including a potential error message.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] vislab::UpdateInfo internalUpdate(vislab::ProgressInfo& progress) override;
    };
}
```

### scivis/common/include/application.hpp
```
#pragma once
#include <filesystem>
#include <memory>

#include "backend.hpp"
#include <vislab/app/application.hpp>
#include <vislab/app/input_dispatcher.hpp>
#include <vislab/app/windowed_app.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/render_context.hpp>

#include <imgui.h>
#include <iostream>

namespace scivis
{
    class Application : public vislab::Application
    {
    public:
        virtual ~Application() = default;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // SciVis lifecycle (implemented by exercises)
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        virtual void init(const vislab::SwapchainContext& stx) = 0;
        virtual void update([[maybe_unused]] double elapsedSeconds, [[maybe_unused]] double totalSeconds) {}
        virtual void gui() {}
        virtual void resize([[maybe_unused]] const vislab::SwapchainContext& stx) {}
        virtual void render(vislab::ICommandList* cmd, const vislab::RenderContext& ctx) = 0;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // vislab::Application overrides
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        bool onInit(vislab::IGraphicsDevice* dev,
                    const vislab::SwapchainContext& stx,
                    vislab::InputDispatcher* input) final
        {
            mInput = input;

            Backend::initImGui(dev);
            subscribeInput(input);

            init(stx);
            return true;
        }

        void onUpdate(double dtSeconds) final
        {
            totalTimeSeconds += dtSeconds;
            update(dtSeconds, totalTimeSeconds);
        }

        void onRender(vislab::ICommandList* cmd,
                      const vislab::RenderContext& ctx) final
        {
            render(cmd, ctx);
        }

        void onGui(vislab::ICommandList* cmd,
                   const vislab::FrameContext& ftx) final
        {
            Backend::newImGuiFrame(device.get(), ftx);

            if (auto* inter = getInteractor())
            {
                ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
                inter->setActive(
                    !io.WantCaptureMouse &&
                    !io.WantCaptureKeyboard);
            }

            gui();

            Backend::renderImGui(device.get(), cmd);
        }

        void onResize(const vislab::SwapchainContext& stx) final
        {
            resize(stx);
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // SciVis host function
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        int run(int argc, char* argv[], EGraphicsDevice graphicsDevice = EGraphicsDevice::OpenGL, uint32_t width = 1280, uint32_t height = 720, uint32_t sampleCount = 1)
        {
            vislab::Init();

            if (argc <= 1)
            {
                std::cerr << "ERROR: Pass the path to the SciVis data folder.\n";
                return 1;
            }

            datasetPath = argv[1];
            if (!std::filesystem::exists(datasetPath))
            {
                std::cerr << "ERROR: Dataset path does not exist: "
                          << datasetPath << "\n";
                return 1;
            }

            device = Backend::createDevice(graphicsDevice);

            vislab::SwapchainDesc scDesc;
            scDesc.width       = width;
            scDesc.height      = height;
            scDesc.sampleCount = sampleCount;
            scDesc.vsync       = true;

            vislab::TextureDesc* colorDescPtr = nullptr;

            vislab::TextureDesc colorDesc;
            if (sampleCount > 1)
            {
                colorDesc.format    = vislab::ETextureFormat::RGBA8;
                colorDesc.bindFlags = vislab::ETextureBindFlags::RenderTarget |
                                      vislab::ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource;
                colorDesc.sampleCount = sampleCount;

                colorDescPtr = &colorDesc;
            }

            vislab::TextureDesc depthDesc;
            depthDesc.format      = vislab::ETextureFormat::D32F;
            depthDesc.bindFlags   = vislab::ETextureBindFlags::DepthStencil;
            depthDesc.sampleCount = sampleCount;

            vislab::WindowedApp host(device.get(),
                                     this,
                                     "SciVis Exercise",
                                     scDesc,
                                     colorDescPtr, // null when sampleCount == 1
                                     &depthDesc);

            host.run();
            return 0;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Provided to exercises
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        std::filesystem::path datasetPath;
        std::unique_ptr<vislab::IGraphicsDevice> device = nullptr;

    private:
        void subscribeInput(vislab::InputDispatcher* input)
        {
            ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();

            mImGuiConnections.push_back(
                input->mouseMoved.subscribe([&](double x, double y)
                                            { io.AddMousePosEvent((float)x, (float)y); }));

            mImGuiConnections.push_back(
                input->mousePressed.subscribe([&](int button)
                                              { io.AddMouseButtonEvent(button, true); }));

            mImGuiConnections.push_back(
                input->mouseReleased.subscribe([&](int button)
                                               { io.AddMouseButtonEvent(button, false); }));

            mImGuiConnections.push_back(
                input->scrolled.subscribe([&](double dx, double dy)
                                          { io.AddMouseWheelEvent((float)dx, (float)dy); }));

            mImGuiConnections.push_back(
                input->keyPressed.subscribe([&](int key)
                                            { io.AddKeyEvent(Backend::mapKeyFromGLFW(key), true); }));

            mImGuiConnections.push_back(
                input->keyReleased.subscribe([&](int key)
                                             { io.AddKeyEvent(Backend::mapKeyFromGLFW(key), false); }));

            mImGuiConnections.push_back(
                input->charEntered.subscribe([&](unsigned int c)
                                             { io.AddInputCharacter(c); }));
        }

        double totalTimeSeconds         = 0.0;
        vislab::InputDispatcher* mInput = nullptr;
        std::vector<vislab::EventConnection> mImGuiConnections;
    };

}
```
