### scivis/common/src/amira.cpp
```
#include "amira.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <stdexcept>

namespace amira
{
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helper utilities
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    static inline std::string trim(const std::string& s)
    {
        const char* ws = " \t\r\n";
        size_t a       = s.find_first_not_of(ws);
        if (a == std::string::npos)
            return "";
        size_t b = s.find_last_not_of(ws);
        return s.substr(a, b - a + 1);
    }

    static inline bool startsWith(const std::string& s, const std::string& prefix)
    {
        return s.rfind(prefix, 0) == 0;
    }

    static inline std::vector<std::string> split(const std::string& s)
    {
        std::istringstream iss(s);
        std::vector<std::string> out;
        std::string tok;
        while (iss >> tok)
            out.push_back(tok);
        return out;
    }

    std::vector<std::string> splitTopLevel(const std::string& s)
    {
        std::vector<std::string> out;
        std::string current;
        bool inQuotes = false;

        for (char c : s)
        {
            if (c == '"')
                inQuotes = !inQuotes;

            if (c == ',' && !inQuotes)
            {
                out.push_back(trim(current));
                current.clear();
            }
            else
            {
                current.push_back(c);
            }
        }

        if (!current.empty())
            out.push_back(trim(current));

        return out;
    }

    void parseParametersBlock(const std::string& inside, AmiraMesh& mesh)
    {
        auto entries = splitTopLevel(inside);

        for (const std::string& entry : entries)
        {
            auto tokens = split(entry);
            if (tokens.empty())
                continue;

            Parameter p;
            p.name  = tokens[0];
            p.value = trim(entry.substr(p.name.size()));

            mesh.parameters[p.name] = p;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Scalar type parser
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    static ScalarType parseScalarType(const std::string& type)
    {
        // Floating point
        if (type == "float")
            return ScalarType::Float32;
        if (type == "double")
            return ScalarType::Float64;

        // Signed integers
        if (type == "int" || type == "int32" || type == "int32_t")
            return ScalarType::Int32;
        if (type == "short" || type == "int16" || type == "int16_t")
            return ScalarType::Int16;
        if (type == "int64" || type == "int64_t")
            return ScalarType::Int64;

        // Unsigned integers
        if (type == "byte" || type == "uint8")
            return ScalarType::UInt8;
        if (type == "uint16" || type == "uint16_t")
            return ScalarType::UInt16;
        if (type == "uint32" || type == "uint32_t")
            return ScalarType::UInt32;
        if (type == "uint64" || type == "uint64_t")
            return ScalarType::UInt64;

        return ScalarType::Unknown;
    }

    static const char* scalarTypeToString(ScalarType t)
    {
        switch (t)
        {
        case ScalarType::Float32:
            return "float";
        case ScalarType::Float64:
            return "double";
        case ScalarType::Int16:
            return "int16";
        case ScalarType::Int32:
            return "int32";
        case ScalarType::Int64:
            return "int64";
        case ScalarType::UInt8:
            return "uint8";
        case ScalarType::UInt16:
            return "uint16";
        case ScalarType::UInt32:
            return "uint32";
        case ScalarType::UInt64:
            return "uint64";
        default:
            return "unknown";
        }
    }

    static std::size_t scalarTypeSize(ScalarType t)
    {
        switch (t)
        {
        case ScalarType::Float32:
            return 4;
        case ScalarType::Float64:
            return 8;
        case ScalarType::Int16:
            return 2;
        case ScalarType::Int32:
            return 4;
        case ScalarType::Int64:
            return 8;
        case ScalarType::UInt8:
            return 1;
        case ScalarType::UInt16:
            return 2;
        case ScalarType::UInt32:
            return 4;
        case ScalarType::UInt64:
            return 8;
        default:
            return 0;
        }
    }

    static std::string readFullAttributeLine(std::istream& file, std::string firstLine)
    {
        std::string combined = trim(firstLine);

        if (combined.find('}') != std::string::npos)
            return combined;

        std::string line;
        while (std::getline(file, line))
        {
            std::string t = trim(line);
            if (t.empty() || t[0] == '#')
                continue;

            combined += " " + t;

            if (t.find('}') != std::string::npos)
                break;
        }

        return combined;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Parse attribute declaration line
    // Example:  Vertices { float[3] Coordinates } @1
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    static Attribute parseAttributeLine(const std::string& line)
    {
        Attribute attr;

        // Extract object type
        size_t brace1 = line.find('{');
        if (brace1 == std::string::npos)
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid attribute line: missing '{'");

        attr.objectType = trim(line.substr(0, brace1));

        // Extract inside braces
        size_t brace2 = line.find('}', brace1);
        if (brace2 == std::string::npos)
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid attribute line: missing '}'");

        std::string inside = trim(line.substr(brace1 + 1, brace2 - brace1 - 1));

        // inside = "float[3] Coordinates"
        auto tokens = split(inside);
        if (tokens.size() < 2)
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid attribute declaration inside braces");

        // Parse type and component count
        std::string typeToken = tokens[0]; // e.g. float[3]
        size_t lb             = typeToken.find('[');
        size_t rb             = typeToken.find(']');

        if (lb != std::string::npos && rb != std::string::npos)
        {
            attr.scalarType = parseScalarType(typeToken.substr(0, lb));
            attr.components = std::stoi(typeToken.substr(lb + 1, rb - lb - 1));
        }
        else
        {
            attr.scalarType = parseScalarType(typeToken);
            attr.components = 1;
        }

        // Parse attribute name
        attr.name = tokens[1];

        // Parse @index
        size_t at = line.find('@', brace2);
        if (at == std::string::npos)
            throw std::runtime_error("Attribute missing @<index>");

        attr.dataBlockIndex = std::stoi(line.substr(at + 1));

        return attr;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Reader::read()
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    AmiraMesh Amira::read(const std::string& filename)
    {
        std::ifstream file(filename, std::ios::binary);
        if (!file)
            throw std::runtime_error("Cannot open file: " + filename);

        AmiraMesh mesh;

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // 1. Read magic line
        // --------------------------------------------------------
        std::string line;
        if (!std::getline(file, line))
            throw std::runtime_error("Empty file");

        mesh.magicLine = trim(line);

        if (mesh.magicLine.find("ASCII") != std::string::npos)
            mesh.encoding = FileEncoding::ASCII;
        else if (mesh.magicLine.find("BINARY-LITTLE-ENDIAN") != std::string::npos)
            mesh.encoding = FileEncoding::BinaryLittleEndian;
        else if (mesh.magicLine.find("BINARY-BIG-ENDIAN") != std::string::npos)
            mesh.encoding = FileEncoding::BinaryBigEndian;

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // 2. Parse header until first @ (start of data blocks)
        // --------------------------------------------------------
        while (true)
        {
            std::streampos pos = file.tellg();
            if (!std::getline(file, line))
                break;

            line = trim(line);
            if (line.empty())
                continue;

            if (line[0] == '#')
                continue;

            if (line[0] == '@')
            {
                file.seekg(pos);
                break;
            }

            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // define statements
            // ----------------------------------------------------
            if (startsWith(line, "define "))
            {
                auto tokens = split(line);
                if (tokens.size() >= 3)
                {
                    const std::string& what = tokens[1];

                    if (what == "Vertices")
                    {
                        mesh.vertexCount = std::stoi(tokens[2]);
                    }
                    else if (what == "Points")
                    {
                        mesh.pointCount = std::stoi(tokens[2]);
                    }
                    else if (what == "Lines")
                    {
                        mesh.lineCount = std::stoi(tokens[2]);
                    }
                    else if (what == "Triangles")
                    {
                        mesh.triangleCount = std::stoi(tokens[2]);
                    }
                    else if (what == "Lattice" && tokens.size() >= 5)
                    {
                        mesh.latticeDims[0] = std::stoi(tokens[2]);
                        mesh.latticeDims[1] = std::stoi(tokens[3]);
                        mesh.latticeDims[2] = std::stoi(tokens[4]);
                    }

                    continue;
                }
            }

            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // Legacy nVertices / nPoints / nLines / nTriangles
            // ----------------------------------------------------
            if (startsWith(line, "nVertices"))
            {
                mesh.vertexCount = std::stoi(split(line)[1]);
                continue;
            }
            if (startsWith(line, "nPoints"))
            {
                mesh.pointCount = std::stoi(split(line)[1]);
                continue;
            }
            if (startsWith(line, "nLines"))
            {
                mesh.lineCount = std::stoi(split(line)[1]);
                continue;
            }
            if (startsWith(line, "nTriangles"))
            {
                mesh.triangleCount = std::stoi(split(line)[1]);
                continue;
            }

            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // BoundingBox
            // ----------------------------------------------------
            if (startsWith(line, "BoundingBox"))
            {
                auto tokens = split(line);
                if (tokens.size() == 7)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
                        mesh.boundingBox[i] = std::stod(tokens[i + 1]);
                }
                continue;
            }

            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // CoordType
            // ----------------------------------------------------
            if (startsWith(line, "CoordType"))
            {
                mesh.coordType = split(line)[1];
                continue;
            }

            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // Parameters { ... }
            // ----------------------------------------------------
            if (startsWith(line, "Parameters"))
            {
                std::string combined = line;

                if (combined.find('}') == std::string::npos)
                {
                    std::string pline;
                    while (std::getline(file, pline))
                    {
                        std::string t = trim(pline);
                        if (t.empty() || t[0] == '#')
                            continue;

                        combined += " " + t;
                        if (t.find('}') != std::string::npos)
                            break;
                    }
                }

                auto open  = combined.find('{');
                auto close = combined.rfind('}');
                if (open != std::string::npos && close != std::string::npos)
                {
                    std::string inside = trim(combined.substr(open + 1, close - open - 1));
                    parseParametersBlock(inside, mesh);
                }

                continue;
            }

            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // Attribute declaration
            // ----------------------------------------------------
            if (line.find('{') != std::string::npos)
            {
                std::string full = readFullAttributeLine(file, line);
                mesh.attributes.push_back(parseAttributeLine(full));
                continue;
            }

            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // Generic parameter fallback
            // ----------------------------------------------------
            {
                auto tokens = split(line);
                if (tokens.size() >= 2)
                {
                    Parameter p;
                    p.name                  = tokens[0];
                    p.value                 = line.substr(p.name.size());
                    mesh.parameters[p.name] = p;
                }
            }
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // 3. Interpret ContentType (new + legacy)
        // --------------------------------------------------------
        {
            auto it = mesh.parameters.find("ContentType");
            if (it != mesh.parameters.end())
            {
                auto stripQuotes = [&](std::string s)
                {
                    s = trim(s);

                    // Remove trailing comma first
                    if (!s.empty() && s.back() == ',')
                        s.pop_back();

                    s = trim(s);

                    // Remove leading quote
                    if (!s.empty() && (s.front() == '"' || s.front() == '\''))
                        s.erase(s.begin());

                    // Remove trailing quote
                    if (!s.empty() && (s.back() == '"' || s.back() == '\''))
                        s.pop_back();

                    return trim(s);
                };

                std::string ct = stripQuotes(it->second.value);

                if (ct == "HxPointList")
                    mesh.topology = PrimitiveTopology::PointList;
                else if (ct == "HxLineList")
                    mesh.topology = PrimitiveTopology::LineList;
                else if (ct == "HxLineStrip")
                    mesh.topology = PrimitiveTopology::LineStrip;
                else if (ct == "HxTriangleList")
                    mesh.topology = PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList;
                else if (ct == "HxTriangleStrip")
                    mesh.topology = PrimitiveTopology::TriangleStrip;

                // Legacy
                else if (ct == "HxLineSet")
                    mesh.topology = PrimitiveTopology::LineStrip;
                else if (ct == "HxSurface")
                    mesh.topology = PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList;
                else if (ct == "HxPointSet")
                    mesh.topology = PrimitiveTopology::PointList;
            }
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // 4. Precompute expected data block sizes
        // --------------------------------------------------------
        std::unordered_map<int, std::size_t> blockSizes;

        auto getElementCount = [&](const Attribute& a)
        {
            if (a.objectType == "Vertices")
                return std::size_t(mesh.vertexCount);
            if (a.objectType == "Points")
                return std::size_t(mesh.pointCount);
            if (a.objectType == "Lines")
                return std::size_t(mesh.lineCount);
            if (a.objectType == "Triangles")
                return std::size_t(mesh.triangleCount);
            if (a.objectType == "Lattice")
                return std::size_t(mesh.latticeDims[0]) *
                       std::size_t(mesh.latticeDims[1]) *
                       std::size_t(mesh.latticeDims[2]);
            return std::size_t(0);
        };

        for (const auto& a : mesh.attributes)
        {
            std::size_t elemCount = getElementCount(a);
            if (elemCount == 0)
                continue;

            std::size_t bytesPerScalar = scalarTypeSize(a.scalarType);
            std::size_t totalBytes     = elemCount *
                                     std::size_t(a.components) *
                                     bytesPerScalar;

            blockSizes[a.dataBlockIndex] = totalBytes;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // 5. Parse data blocks
        // --------------------------------------------------------
        while (std::getline(file, line))
        {
            line = trim(line);
            if (line.empty() || line[0] == '#')
                continue;

            if (line[0] == '@')
            {
                int index = std::stoi(line.substr(1));
                DataBlock block;
                block.index = index;

                auto itSize = blockSizes.find(index);
                if (itSize == blockSizes.end())
                    throw std::runtime_error("No size information for data block @" + std::to_string(index));

                std::size_t totalBytes = itSize->second;
                block.data.resize(totalBytes);

                file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(block.data.data()),
                          static_cast<std::streamsize>(totalBytes));

                if (!file)
                    throw std::runtime_error("Failed to read binary data block @" + std::to_string(index));

                mesh.dataBlocks[index] = std::move(block);
            }
        }

        return mesh;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Writer::write()
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    void Amira::write(const AmiraMesh& mesh, const std::string& filename)
    {
        std::ofstream file(filename, std::ios::binary);
        if (!file)
            throw std::runtime_error("Cannot open file for writing: " + filename);

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // 1. Magic line
        // --------------------------------------------------------
        file << "# AmiraMesh BINARY-LITTLE-ENDIAN 2.1\n\n";

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // 2. define statements
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        // Vertices always required for meshes
        if (mesh.vertexCount > 0)
            file << "define Vertices " << mesh.vertexCount << "\n";

        // Explicit index buffers
        if (mesh.pointCount > 0)
            file << "define Points " << mesh.pointCount << "\n";

        if (mesh.lineCount > 0)
            file << "define Lines " << mesh.lineCount << "\n";

        if (mesh.triangleCount > 0)
            file << "define Triangles " << mesh.triangleCount << "\n";

        // Lattice for fields
        if (mesh.latticeDims[0] > 0 &&
            mesh.latticeDims[1] > 0 &&
            mesh.latticeDims[2] > 0)
        {
            file << "define Lattice "
                 << mesh.latticeDims[0] << " "
                 << mesh.latticeDims[1] << " "
                 << mesh.latticeDims[2] << "\n";
        }

        file << "\n";

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // 3. Parameters block
        // --------------------------------------------------------
        file << "Parameters {\n";
        for (const auto& kv : mesh.parameters)
        {
            file << "    " << kv.first << " " << kv.second.value << ",\n";
        }
        file << "}\n\n";

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // 4. Attribute declarations
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        // Vertices
        for (const auto& a : mesh.attributes)
        {
            file << a.objectType << " { "
                 << scalarTypeToString(a.scalarType) << "[" << a.components << "] "
                 << a.name << " } @" << a.dataBlockIndex << "\n";
        }

        file << "\n";

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // 5. Data blocks
        // --------------------------------------------------------
        for (const auto& kv : mesh.dataBlocks)
        {
            const DataBlock& block = kv.second;

            file << "@" << block.index << "\n";

            if (mesh.encoding == FileEncoding::ASCII)
            {
                // ASCII: write bytes as characters
                for (std::byte b : block.data)
                    file << char(b);
            }
            else
            {
                // Binary: write raw bytes
                file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(block.data.data()),
                           static_cast<std::streamsize>(block.data.size()));
            }

            file << "\n";
        }
    }

} // namespace amira
```

### scivis/common/src/amira_reader.cpp
```
#include "amira_reader.hpp"

#include "amira.hpp"

#include <vislab/core/array.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/format.hpp>

#include <vislab/field/regular_field.hpp>

#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/mesh_topology.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/raw_mesh.hpp>

#include <memory>

namespace scivis
{
    using namespace vislab;

    using vislab::EFormat;
    using vislab::EMeshTopology;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helpers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    static EFormat convertFormat(amira::ScalarType t)
    {
        using S = amira::ScalarType;

        switch (t)
        {
        case S::Float32:
            return EFormat::Float32;
        case S::Float64:
            return EFormat::Float64;
        case S::Int16:
            return EFormat::Int16;
        case S::Int32:
            return EFormat::Int32;
        case S::Int64:
            return EFormat::Int64;
        default:
            return EFormat::Undefined; // UInt* not supported in engine
        }
    }

    static EMeshTopology convertTopology(amira::PrimitiveTopology topo)
    {
        switch (topo)
        {
        case amira::PrimitiveTopology::PointList:
            return EMeshTopology::PointList;
        case amira::PrimitiveTopology::LineList:
            return EMeshTopology::LineList;
        case amira::PrimitiveTopology::LineStrip:
            return EMeshTopology::LineStrip;
        case amira::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList:
            return EMeshTopology::TriangleList;
        case amira::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleStrip:
            return EMeshTopology::TriangleStrip;
        default:
            return EMeshTopology::TriangleList; // or whatever default you prefer
        }
    }

    static std::size_t formatSize(EFormat f)
    {
        switch (f)
        {
        case EFormat::Float32:
            return 4;
        case EFormat::Float64:
            return 8;
        case EFormat::Int16:
            return 2;
        case EFormat::Int32:
            return 4;
        case EFormat::Int64:
            return 8;
        default:
            return 0;
        }
    }

    static void transferRawArrayData(
        RawArray& dst,
        const amira::Attribute& attr,
        amira::DataBlock& block)
    {
        EFormat fmt = convertFormat(attr.scalarType);
        dst.setFormat(fmt);
        dst.setNumComponents(attr.components);

        std::size_t elemSize = formatSize(fmt);
        if (elemSize == 0)
        {
            // Unsupported format in engine
            dst.setSize(0);
            dst.getData() = std::move(block.data); // still transfer raw bytes
            return;
        }

        std::size_t totalBytes = block.data.size();
        std::size_t stride     = elemSize * static_cast<std::size_t>(attr.components);

        if (stride == 0 || totalBytes % stride != 0)
        {
            dst.setSize(0);
            return;
        }

        std::size_t count = totalBytes / stride;
        dst.setSize(count);

        // *** TRUE ZERO-COPY ***
        dst.getData() = std::move(block.data);
    }

    void convertIndices(const amira::Attribute& attr,
                        amira::DataBlock& block,
                        RawMesh& dst)
    {
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 1. Determine Amira index format
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        EFormat fmt = convertFormat(attr.scalarType);
        if (fmt != EFormat::Int32 && fmt != EFormat::Int16)
            throw std::runtime_error("Index buffer must be Int16 or Int32");

        const std::size_t elemSize = formatSize(fmt);
        const std::size_t count    = elemSize == 0 ? 0 : block.data.size() / elemSize;

        // Typed pointer into Amira data
        const int32_t* ptr32 = nullptr;
        const int16_t* ptr16 = nullptr;

        if (fmt == EFormat::Int32)
            ptr32 = reinterpret_cast<const int32_t*>(block.data.data());
        else
            ptr16 = reinterpret_cast<const int16_t*>(block.data.data());

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 2. First pass: detect trivial indexing and count cleaned size
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        bool isTrivial           = true;
        std::size_t cleanedCount = 0;

        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        {
            int idx = (fmt == EFormat::Int32) ? ptr32[i] : ptr16[i];

            if (idx != static_cast<int>(i))
                isTrivial = false;

            if (idx != -1)
                cleanedCount++;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 3. Trivial indexing → no index buffer, no submeshes
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        if (isTrivial)
        {
            dst.getIndexCollection().setSize(0);
            dst.getSubmeshCollection().clear();
            return;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 4. Allocate final RawArray buffer (aligned)
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        RawArray& dstIdx = dst.getIndexCollection();
        dstIdx.setFormat(EFormat::UInt32);
        dstIdx.setNumComponents(1);
        dstIdx.setSize(cleanedCount);

        auto& data = dstIdx.getData();
        data.resize(cleanedCount * sizeof(uint32_t));

        uint32_t* out = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(data.data());

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 5. Second pass: write cleaned indices + build submeshes
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        auto& submeshes = dst.getSubmeshCollection();
        submeshes.clear();

        int indexOffset = 0;
        int indexCount  = 0;

        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        {
            int idx = (fmt == EFormat::Int32) ? ptr32[i] : ptr16[i];

            if (idx == -1)
            {
                if (indexCount > 0)
                {
                    submeshes.emplace_back(indexOffset, indexCount);
                    indexOffset += indexCount;
                    indexCount = 0;
                }
                continue;
            }

            *out++ = static_cast<uint32_t>(idx);
            indexCount++;
        }

        if (indexCount > 0)
            submeshes.emplace_back(indexOffset, indexCount);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 6. Make the submesh implicit if possible
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        if (submeshes.size() == 1)
        {
            const auto& sm = submeshes[0];
            if (sm.indexOffset == 0 && sm.indexCount == cleanedCount)
            {
                // No separators were present → implicit
                submeshes.clear();
            }
        }
    }

    std::shared_ptr<RawMesh> convertAmiraMeshToRawMesh(amira::AmiraMesh& src)
    {
        auto dst = std::make_shared<RawMesh>();

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 1. Set mesh topology (from ContentType via Amira::read)
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        dst->setMeshTopology(convertTopology(src.topology));

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 2. Process attributes
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        for (const auto& attr : src.attributes)
        {
            auto it = src.dataBlocks.find(attr.dataBlockIndex);
            if (it == src.dataBlocks.end())
                continue;

            amira::DataBlock& block = it->second;

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // Special case: Indices
            // --------------------------------------------------------
            if (attr.objectType == "Points" ||
                attr.objectType == "Lines" ||
                attr.objectType == "Triangles")
            {
                convertIndices(attr, block, *dst);
                continue;
            }

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // Built-in vertex attributes
            // --------------------------------------------------------
            RawArray* target = nullptr;

            if (attr.objectType == "Vertices" && attr.name == "Coordinates")
                target = &dst->getPositions();
            else if (attr.objectType == "Vertices" && attr.name == "Normals")
                target = &dst->getNormals();
            else if (attr.objectType == "Vertices" && attr.name == "TexCoords")
                target = &dst->getTexCoords();

            if (target)
            {
                transferRawArrayData(*target, attr, block);
                continue;
            }

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // Custom vertex attributes (Attribute_ prefix)
            // --------------------------------------------------------
            static constexpr const char* PREFIX = "Attribute_";
            static constexpr size_t PREFIX_LEN  = 10; // strlen("Attribute_")

            if (attr.objectType == "Vertices" &&
                attr.name.size() > PREFIX_LEN &&
                attr.name.rfind(PREFIX, 0) == 0) // starts with prefix
            {
                auto arr = std::make_shared<RawArray>();

                // Strip prefix for RawMesh attribute name
                std::string cleanName = attr.name.substr(PREFIX_LEN);
                arr->setName(cleanName);

                transferRawArrayData(*arr, attr, block);
                dst->getAttributes().add(arr);
                continue;
            }

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // Fallback: unknown attribute → store as-is
            // --------------------------------------------------------
            {
                auto arr = std::make_shared<RawArray>();
                arr->setName(attr.name);
                transferRawArrayData(*arr, attr, block);
                dst->getAttributes().add(arr);
            }
        }

        dst->recomputeBoundingBox();
        return dst;
    }

    static bool isMesh(const amira::AmiraMesh& am)
    {
        for (auto& a : am.attributes)
        {
            if (a.objectType == "Vertices" ||
                a.objectType == "Points" ||
                a.objectType == "Lines" ||
                a.objectType == "Triangles")
            {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static bool isField(const amira::AmiraMesh& am)
    {
        // Lattice dimensions must be valid
        if (am.latticeDims[0] <= 0 ||
            am.latticeDims[1] <= 0 ||
            am.latticeDims[2] <= 0)
            return false;

        // Look for a Lattice attribute
        for (const auto& a : am.attributes)
        {
            if (a.objectType == "Lattice")
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    enum class EFieldKind
    {
        None,

        RegularSteadyScalarField2,
        RegularUnsteadyScalarField2,
        RegularSteadyScalarField3,

        RegularSteadyVectorField2,
        RegularUnsteadyVectorField2,
        RegularSteadyVectorField3,

        RegularSteadyTensorField2,
        RegularUnsteadyTensorField2,
        RegularSteadyTensorField3
    };

    inline EFieldKind parseContentType(const std::string& ct)
    {
        if (ct == "HxRegularSteadyScalarField2")
            return EFieldKind::RegularSteadyScalarField2;
        if (ct == "HxRegularSteadyScalarField3")
            return EFieldKind::RegularSteadyScalarField3;
        if (ct == "HxRegularUnsteadyScalarField2")
            return EFieldKind::RegularUnsteadyScalarField2;

        if (ct == "HxRegularSteadyVectorField2")
            return EFieldKind::RegularSteadyVectorField2;
        if (ct == "HxRegularSteadyVectorField3")
            return EFieldKind::RegularSteadyVectorField3;
        if (ct == "HxRegularUnsteadyVectorField2")
            return EFieldKind::RegularUnsteadyVectorField2;

        if (ct == "HxRegularSteadyTensorField2")
            return EFieldKind::RegularSteadyTensorField2;
        if (ct == "HxRegularSteadyTensorField3")
            return EFieldKind::RegularSteadyTensorField3;
        if (ct == "HxRegularUnsteadyTensorField2")
            return EFieldKind::RegularUnsteadyTensorField2;

        return EFieldKind::None;
    }

    static EFieldKind classifyField(const amira::AmiraMesh& am)
    {
        if (!isField(am))
            return EFieldKind::None;

        const amira::Attribute* lattice = nullptr;
        for (const auto& a : am.attributes)
        {
            if (a.objectType == "Lattice")
            {
                lattice = &a;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!lattice)
            return EFieldKind::None;

        // 1. New format: ContentType
        if (auto it = am.parameters.find("ContentType"); it != am.parameters.end())
        {
            EFieldKind kind = parseContentType(it->second.value);
            if (kind != EFieldKind::None)
                return kind;
        }

        // 2. Legacy fallback
        const int nz    = am.latticeDims[2];
        const int comps = lattice->components;

        const bool is2DGrid = (nz == 1);
        const bool is3DGrid = (nz > 1);

        const bool isScalar  = (comps == 1);
        const bool isVector2 = (comps == 2);
        const bool isVector3 = (comps == 3);
        const bool isTensor  = (comps == 4 || comps == 9);

        // --- 2D grid -> steady 2D fields ---
        if (is2DGrid)
        {
            if (isScalar)
                return EFieldKind::RegularSteadyScalarField2;
            if (isVector2)
                return EFieldKind::RegularSteadyVectorField2;
            if (isTensor)
                return EFieldKind::RegularSteadyTensorField2;
            return EFieldKind::None;
        }

        // --- 3D grid -> either unsteady 2D or steady 3D ---

        // Unsteady 2D vector: (x, y, t) with 2 components
        if (is3DGrid && isVector2)
            return EFieldKind::RegularUnsteadyVectorField2;

        // Steady 3D fields
        if (is3DGrid && isScalar)
            return EFieldKind::RegularSteadyScalarField3;
        if (is3DGrid && isVector3)
            return EFieldKind::RegularSteadyVectorField3;
        if (is3DGrid && isTensor)
            return EFieldKind::RegularSteadyTensorField3;

        return EFieldKind::None;
    }

    struct AllocatedField
    {
        std::shared_ptr<Data> field;
        void* dataPtr;           // pointer to the underlying array memory
        Eigen::Index components; // number of components per voxel
    };

    AllocatedField allocateField(
        EFieldKind kind,
        amira::ScalarType scalarType,
        const Eigen::AlignedBox2d& domain2d,
        const Eigen::AlignedBox3d& domain3d,
        const Eigen::Vector3i& resolution,
        const std::array<EBoundaryBehavior, 3>& boundaryBehavior,
        int derivativeAccuracy)
    {
        auto init2d = [&](auto field)
        {
            // 2D domain + 2D resolution
            field->setDomain(domain2d);
            field->getGrid().setDomain(domain2d);
            field->getGrid().setResolution(resolution.head<2>());
            field->getArray().setSize(field->getGrid().getResolution().prod());

            // boundary behavior for x,y
            for (int d = 0; d < 2; ++d)
                field->setBoundaryBehavior(d, boundaryBehavior[d]);

            field->setAccuracy(derivativeAccuracy);

            return AllocatedField{
                std::static_pointer_cast<Data>(field),
                field->getArray().getPtr(),
                field->getArray().getNumComponents()
            };
        };

        auto init3d = [&](auto field)
        {
            // 3D domain + 3D resolution
            field->setDomain(domain3d);
            field->getGrid().setDomain(domain3d);
            field->getGrid().setResolution(resolution);
            field->getArray().setSize(field->getGrid().getResolution().prod());

            // boundary behavior for x,y,z
            for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d)
                field->setBoundaryBehavior(d, boundaryBehavior[d]);

            field->setAccuracy(derivativeAccuracy);

            return AllocatedField{
                std::static_pointer_cast<Data>(field),
                field->getArray().getPtr(),
                field->getArray().getNumComponents()
            };
        };

        switch (kind)
        {
            // ============================================================
            // SCALAR FIELDS
            // ============================================================

        case EFieldKind::RegularSteadyScalarField2:
            return (scalarType == amira::ScalarType::Float32)
                       ? init2d(std::make_shared<RegularSteadyScalarField2f>())
                       : init2d(std::make_shared<RegularSteadyScalarField2d>());

        case EFieldKind::RegularUnsteadyScalarField2:
            // Unsteady 2D → 3D grid (x,y,t)
            return (scalarType == amira::ScalarType::Float32)
                       ? init3d(std::make_shared<RegularUnsteadyScalarField2f>())
                       : init3d(std::make_shared<RegularUnsteadyScalarField2d>());

        case EFieldKind::RegularSteadyScalarField3:
            return (scalarType == amira::ScalarType::Float32)
                       ? init3d(std::make_shared<RegularSteadyScalarField3f>())
                       : init3d(std::make_shared<RegularSteadyScalarField3d>());

            // ============================================================
            // VECTOR FIELDS
            // ============================================================

        case EFieldKind::RegularSteadyVectorField2:
            return (scalarType == amira::ScalarType::Float32)
                       ? init2d(std::make_shared<RegularSteadyVectorField2f>())
                       : init2d(std::make_shared<RegularSteadyVectorField2d>());

        case EFieldKind::RegularUnsteadyVectorField2:
            // Unsteady 2D → 3D grid (x,y,t)
            return (scalarType == amira::ScalarType::Float32)
                       ? init3d(std::make_shared<RegularUnsteadyVectorField2f>())
                       : init3d(std::make_shared<RegularUnsteadyVectorField2d>());

        case EFieldKind::RegularSteadyVectorField3:
            return (scalarType == amira::ScalarType::Float32)
                       ? init3d(std::make_shared<RegularSteadyVectorField3f>())
                       : init3d(std::make_shared<RegularSteadyVectorField3d>());
        }

        throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported field kind or scalar type in allocateField()");
    }

    inline std::array<EBoundaryBehavior, 3>
    parseBoundaryBehavior(const std::string& text)
    {
        // Default: Clamp in all dimensions
        std::array<EBoundaryBehavior, 3> result = {
            EBoundaryBehavior::Clamp,
            EBoundaryBehavior::Clamp,
            EBoundaryBehavior::Clamp
        };

        // Find parentheses
        auto l = text.find('(');
        auto r = text.find(')');
        if (l == std::string::npos || r == std::string::npos || r <= l)
            return result;

        // Extract inside "( ... )"
        std::string inside = text.substr(l + 1, r - l - 1);

        // Split by comma
        std::vector<std::string> tokens;
        {
            std::stringstream ss(inside);
            std::string item;
            while (std::getline(ss, item, ','))
            {
                // trim whitespace
                item.erase(0, item.find_first_not_of(" \t\n\r"));
                item.erase(item.find_last_not_of(" \t\n\r") + 1);
                if (!item.empty())
                    tokens.push_back(item);
            }
        }

        // Accept 1, 2, or 3 entries
        if (tokens.empty() || tokens.size() > 3)
            return result;

        auto toEnum = [](const std::string& s) -> EBoundaryBehavior
        {
            std::string t = s;
            std::transform(t.begin(), t.end(), t.begin(),
                           [](unsigned char c)
                           { return std::tolower(c); });

            if (t == "clamp")
                return EBoundaryBehavior::Clamp;
            if (t == "periodic")
                return EBoundaryBehavior::Periodic;

            return EBoundaryBehavior::Clamp;
        };

        // Fill available dimensions
        for (size_t i = 0; i < tokens.size(); ++i)
            result[i] = toEnum(tokens[i]);

        // Missing dimensions remain Clamp

        return result;
    }

    std::shared_ptr<Data> loadField(const amira::AmiraMesh& am)
    {
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 1. Classify field type
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        EFieldKind kind = classifyField(am);
        if (kind == EFieldKind::None)
            throw std::runtime_error("Not a recognized field");

        // Find Lattice attribute
        const amira::Attribute* lattice = nullptr;
        for (const auto& a : am.attributes)
        {
            if (a.objectType == "Lattice")
            {
                lattice = &a;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!lattice)
            throw std::runtime_error("Missing Lattice attribute");

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 2. Scalar type and resolution
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        amira::ScalarType scalarType = lattice->scalarType;

        Eigen::Vector3i resolution(am.latticeDims[0],
                                   am.latticeDims[1],
                                   am.latticeDims[2]);

        const Eigen::Index totalVoxels =
            static_cast<Eigen::Index>(resolution[0]) *
            static_cast<Eigen::Index>(resolution[1]) *
            static_cast<Eigen::Index>(resolution[2]);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 3. Domains (2D + 3D)
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        Eigen::AlignedBox2d domain2d;
        Eigen::AlignedBox3d domain3d;

        {
            auto it = am.parameters.find("BoundingBox");
            if (it != am.parameters.end())
            {
                std::stringstream ss(it->second.value);
                double xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax;
                ss >> xmin >> xmax >> ymin >> ymax >> zmin >> zmax;

                domain2d = Eigen::AlignedBox2d(
                    Eigen::Vector2d(xmin, ymin),
                    Eigen::Vector2d(xmax, ymax));

                domain3d = Eigen::AlignedBox3d(
                    Eigen::Vector3d(xmin, ymin, zmin),
                    Eigen::Vector3d(xmax, ymax, zmax));
            }
            else
            {
                domain2d = Eigen::AlignedBox2d();
                domain3d = Eigen::AlignedBox3d();
            }
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 4. Boundary behavior
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        std::array<EBoundaryBehavior, 3> boundaryBehavior = {
            EBoundaryBehavior::Clamp,
            EBoundaryBehavior::Clamp,
            EBoundaryBehavior::Clamp
        };

        {
            auto it = am.parameters.find("BoundaryBehavior");
            if (it != am.parameters.end())
                boundaryBehavior = parseBoundaryBehavior(it->second.value);
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 5. Derivative accuracy
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        int derivativeAccuracy = 2;
        {
            auto it = am.parameters.find("DerivativeAccuracy");
            if (it != am.parameters.end())
                derivativeAccuracy = std::stoi(it->second.value);
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 6. Allocate and initialize field
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        AllocatedField allocated = allocateField(
            kind,
            scalarType,
            domain2d,
            domain3d,
            resolution,
            boundaryBehavior,
            derivativeAccuracy);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 7. Extract the single data block
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        if (am.dataBlocks.empty())
            throw std::runtime_error("No data block found in AmiraMesh");

        const auto& dataBlock = am.dataBlocks.begin()->second;
        const void* srcPtr    = dataBlock.data.data(); // or dataBlock.ptr, depending on your struct

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 8. Copy data (memcpy when possible)
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const Eigen::Index amiraComponents = lattice->components;
        const Eigen::Index fieldComponents = allocated.components;

        if (amiraComponents == fieldComponents)
        {
            const Eigen::Index count = totalVoxels * fieldComponents;

            if (scalarType == amira::ScalarType::Float32)
            {
                std::memcpy(
                    allocated.dataPtr,
                    srcPtr,
                    static_cast<size_t>(count) * sizeof(float));
            }
            else if (scalarType == amira::ScalarType::Float64)
            {
                std::memcpy(
                    allocated.dataPtr,
                    srcPtr,
                    static_cast<size_t>(count) * sizeof(double));
            }
            else
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported scalar type for field data");
            }
        }
        else
        {
            // Slow path: legacy case (e.g. 3 components in file, 2 in field)
            if (scalarType == amira::ScalarType::Float32)
            {
                const float* src = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(srcPtr);
                float* dst       = reinterpret_cast<float*>(allocated.dataPtr);

                for (Eigen::Index i = 0; i < totalVoxels; ++i)
                    for (Eigen::Index c = 0; c < fieldComponents; ++c)
                        dst[i * fieldComponents + c] = src[i * amiraComponents + c];
            }
            else if (scalarType == amira::ScalarType::Float64)
            {
                const double* src = reinterpret_cast<const double*>(srcPtr);
                double* dst       = reinterpret_cast<double*>(allocated.dataPtr);

                for (Eigen::Index i = 0; i < totalVoxels; ++i)
                    for (Eigen::Index c = 0; c < fieldComponents; ++c)
                        dst[i * fieldComponents + c] = src[i * amiraComponents + c];
            }
            else
            {
                throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported scalar type for field data");
            }
        }

        return allocated.field;
    }

    AmiraReader::AmiraReader(const std::shared_ptr<Data>& outData, const std::string& path)
        : paramPath(PathParameter::EFile::In, "Amira (*.am)")
    {
        outputData.setRequired(false);

        paramPath.setValue(path);

        outputData.setData(outData);
    }

    UpdateInfo AmiraReader::internalUpdate(ProgressInfo& progress)
    {
        try
        {
            const std::string& path = paramPath.getValue();

            amira::AmiraMesh am = amira::Amira::read(path);

            if (isMesh(am))
            {
                auto mesh = convertAmiraMeshToRawMesh(am);

                // allocate the remaining fields to reach full compatibility with typed meshes
                if (mesh->getPositions().isValueType<Eigen::Vector1f>())
                {
                    if (mesh->getNormals().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getNormals().allocate<Eigen::Vector1f>(0);
                    if (mesh->getTexCoords().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getTexCoords().allocate<Eigen::Vector1f>(0);
                    if (mesh->getIndexCollection().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getIndexCollection().allocate<Eigen::Vector1u>(0);
                }
                else if (mesh->getPositions().isValueType<Eigen::Vector2f>())
                {
                    if (mesh->getNormals().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getNormals().allocate<Eigen::Vector2f>(0);
                    if (mesh->getTexCoords().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getTexCoords().allocate<Eigen::Vector2f>(0);
                    if (mesh->getIndexCollection().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getIndexCollection().allocate<Eigen::Vector1u>(0);
                }
                else if (mesh->getPositions().isValueType<Eigen::Vector3f>())
                {
                    if (mesh->getNormals().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getNormals().allocate<Eigen::Vector3f>(0);
                    if (mesh->getTexCoords().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getTexCoords().allocate<Eigen::Vector2f>(0);
                    if (mesh->getIndexCollection().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getIndexCollection().allocate<Eigen::Vector1u>(0);
                }
                else if (mesh->getPositions().isValueType<Eigen::Vector4f>())
                {
                    if (mesh->getNormals().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getNormals().allocate<Eigen::Vector4f>(0);
                    if (mesh->getTexCoords().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getTexCoords().allocate<Eigen::Vector2f>(0);
                    if (mesh->getIndexCollection().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getIndexCollection().allocate<Eigen::Vector1u>(0);
                }
                else if (mesh->getPositions().isValueType<Eigen::Vector1d>())
                {
                    if (mesh->getNormals().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getNormals().allocate<Eigen::Vector1d>(0);
                    if (mesh->getTexCoords().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getTexCoords().allocate<Eigen::Vector1d>(0);
                    if (mesh->getIndexCollection().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getIndexCollection().allocate<Eigen::Vector1u>(0);
                }
                else if (mesh->getPositions().isValueType<Eigen::Vector2d>())
                {
                    if (mesh->getNormals().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getNormals().allocate<Eigen::Vector2d>(0);
                    if (mesh->getTexCoords().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getTexCoords().allocate<Eigen::Vector2d>(0);
                    if (mesh->getIndexCollection().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getIndexCollection().allocate<Eigen::Vector1u>(0);
                }
                else if (mesh->getPositions().isValueType<Eigen::Vector3d>())
                {
                    if (mesh->getNormals().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getNormals().allocate<Eigen::Vector3d>(0);
                    if (mesh->getTexCoords().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getTexCoords().allocate<Eigen::Vector2d>(0);
                    if (mesh->getIndexCollection().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getIndexCollection().allocate<Eigen::Vector1u>(0);
                }
                else if (mesh->getPositions().isValueType<Eigen::Vector4d>())
                {
                    if (mesh->getNormals().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getNormals().allocate<Eigen::Vector4d>(0);
                    if (mesh->getTexCoords().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getTexCoords().allocate<Eigen::Vector2d>(0);
                    if (mesh->getIndexCollection().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                        mesh->getIndexCollection().allocate<Eigen::Vector1u>(0);
                }

                if (Mesh1f::isCompatible(*mesh))
                    outputData.setData(std::make_shared<Mesh1f>(mesh));
                else if (Mesh2f::isCompatible(*mesh))
                    outputData.setData(std::make_shared<Mesh2f>(mesh));
                else if (Mesh3f::isCompatible(*mesh))
                    outputData.setData(std::make_shared<Mesh3f>(mesh));
                else if (Mesh4f::isCompatible(*mesh))
                    outputData.setData(std::make_shared<Mesh4f>(mesh));
                else if (Mesh1d::isCompatible(*mesh))
                    outputData.setData(std::make_shared<Mesh1d>(mesh));
                else if (Mesh2d::isCompatible(*mesh))
                    outputData.setData(std::make_shared<Mesh2d>(mesh));
                else if (Mesh3d::isCompatible(*mesh))
                    outputData.setData(std::make_shared<Mesh3d>(mesh));
                else if (Mesh4d::isCompatible(*mesh))
                    outputData.setData(std::make_shared<Mesh4d>(mesh));
                else
                {
                    return UpdateInfo::reportError("RawMesh not compatible with Typed Mesh.");
                }
                progress.allJobsDone();
                return UpdateInfo::reportValid();
            }
            else if (isField(am))
            {
                auto field = loadField(am);
                outputData.setData(field);
                progress.allJobsDone();
                return UpdateInfo::reportValid();
            }
            else
            {
                return UpdateInfo::reportError("Unsupported Amira file type");
            }
        }
        catch (const std::exception& e)
        {
            return UpdateInfo::reportError(std::string("Amira load failed: ") + e.what());
        }
        catch (...)
        {
            return UpdateInfo::reportError("Amira load failed: unknown error");
        }
    }
}
```

```
#include "amira_writer.hpp"

#include "amira.hpp"

#include <vislab/core/array.hpp>
#include <vislab/field/regular_field.hpp>
#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>

namespace scivis
{
    using namespace vislab;

    AmiraWriter::AmiraWriter(const std::string& path)
        : paramPath(PathParameter::EFile::Out, "Amira (*.am)")
    {
        paramPath.setValue(path);
    }

    AmiraWriter::AmiraWriter(const std::shared_ptr<Data>& inData, const std::string& path)
        : AmiraWriter(path)
    {
        inputData.setData(inData);
    }

    static amira::ScalarType convertFormatToScalarType(EFormat fmt)
    {
        using S = amira::ScalarType;

        switch (fmt)
        {
        case EFormat::Float32:
            return S::Float32;
        case EFormat::Float64:
            return S::Float64;
        case EFormat::Int16:
            return S::Int16;
        case EFormat::Int32:
            return S::Int32;
        case EFormat::Int64:
            return S::Int64;
        case EFormat::UInt16:
            return S::UInt16;
        case EFormat::UInt32:
            return S::UInt32;
        case EFormat::UInt64:
            return S::UInt64;
        default:
            return S::Unknown;
        }
    }

    static std::vector<std::byte, Eigen::aligned_allocator<std::byte>>
    flattenIndicesWithSeparators(const RawMesh& raw)
    {
        const RawArray& idx   = raw.getIndexCollection();
        const auto& submeshes = raw.getSubmeshes();

        std::vector<std::byte, Eigen::aligned_allocator<std::byte>> out;
        if (submeshes.getSize() == 0)
            return out;

        const std::byte* base      = idx.getData().data();
        const std::size_t elemSize = idx.getElementSizeInBytes();

        // We’ll write everything as int32
        auto appendInt32 = [&](int v)
        {
            int32_t vv         = static_cast<int32_t>(v);
            const std::byte* p = reinterpret_cast<const std::byte*>(&vv);
            out.insert(out.end(), p, p + sizeof(int32_t));
        };

        for (std::size_t s = 0; s < submeshes.getSize(); ++s)
        {
            const auto& sm         = submeshes[s];
            const std::byte* begin = base + sm.indexOffset * elemSize;
            const std::byte* end   = base + (sm.indexOffset + sm.indexCount) * elemSize;

            // Copy indices of this submesh, converting to int32
            for (const std::byte* p = begin; p < end; p += elemSize)
            {
                uint32_t v = 0;
                std::memcpy(&v, p, std::min(elemSize, sizeof(uint32_t)));
                appendInt32(static_cast<int>(v));
            }

            // Add -1 separator between submeshes (not after the last one)
            if (s + 1 < submeshes.getSize())
                appendInt32(-1);
        }

        return out;
    }

    amira::AmiraMesh convertRawMeshToAmiraMesh(const RawMesh& raw)
    {
        using namespace amira;

        AmiraMesh mesh;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Basic header
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        mesh.magicLine = "# AmiraMesh BINARY-LITTLE-ENDIAN 2.1";
        mesh.encoding  = FileEncoding::BinaryLittleEndian;

        int blockIndex = 1;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Topology
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const auto topo = raw.getMeshTopology();

        switch (topo)
        {
        case EMeshTopology::PointList:
            mesh.topology                  = PrimitiveTopology::PointList;
            mesh.parameters["ContentType"] = { "ContentType", "\"HxPointList\"" };
            break;

        case EMeshTopology::LineList:
            mesh.topology                  = PrimitiveTopology::LineList;
            mesh.parameters["ContentType"] = { "ContentType", "\"HxLineList\"" };
            break;

        case EMeshTopology::LineStrip:
            mesh.topology                  = PrimitiveTopology::LineStrip;
            mesh.parameters["ContentType"] = { "ContentType", "\"HxLineStrip\"" };
            break;

        case EMeshTopology::TriangleList:
            mesh.topology                  = PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList;
            mesh.parameters["ContentType"] = { "ContentType", "\"HxTriangleList\"" };
            break;

        case EMeshTopology::TriangleStrip:
            mesh.topology                  = PrimitiveTopology::TriangleStrip;
            mesh.parameters["ContentType"] = { "ContentType", "\"HxTriangleStrip\"" };
            break;

        default:
            mesh.topology = PrimitiveTopology::Undefined;
            break;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Positions
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const RawArray& pos = raw.getPositions();
        if (!pos.getData().empty())
        {
            mesh.vertexCount = static_cast<int>(pos.getSize());

            Attribute a;
            a.objectType     = "Vertices";
            a.name           = "Coordinates";
            a.scalarType     = convertFormatToScalarType(pos.getFormat());
            a.components     = static_cast<int>(pos.getNumComponents());
            a.dataBlockIndex = blockIndex;

            mesh.attributes.push_back(a);

            DataBlock b;
            b.index = blockIndex++;
            b.data  = pos.getData();

            mesh.dataBlocks[b.index] = std::move(b);
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Normals
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const RawArray& nrm = raw.getNormals();
        if (!nrm.getData().empty())
        {
            Attribute a;
            a.objectType     = "Vertices";
            a.name           = "Normals";
            a.scalarType     = convertFormatToScalarType(nrm.getFormat());
            a.components     = static_cast<int>(nrm.getNumComponents());
            a.dataBlockIndex = blockIndex;

            mesh.attributes.push_back(a);

            DataBlock b;
            b.index = blockIndex++;
            b.data  = nrm.getData();

            mesh.dataBlocks[b.index] = std::move(b);
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Texture coordinates
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const RawArray& tex = raw.getTexCoords();
        if (!tex.getData().empty())
        {
            Attribute a;
            a.objectType     = "Vertices";
            a.name           = "TexCoords";
            a.scalarType     = convertFormatToScalarType(tex.getFormat());
            a.components     = static_cast<int>(tex.getNumComponents());
            a.dataBlockIndex = blockIndex;

            mesh.attributes.push_back(a);

            DataBlock b;
            b.index = blockIndex++;
            b.data  = tex.getData();

            mesh.dataBlocks[b.index] = std::move(b);
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Additional vertex attributes
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        size_t numAttributes = raw.getAttributes().getSize();
        for (size_t ia = 0; ia < numAttributes; ++ia)
        {
            const RawArray& attrArray = raw.getAttributes().getByIndex(ia);

            // Skip empty arrays
            if (attrArray.getData().empty())
                continue;

            Attribute a;
            a.objectType     = "Vertices";                         // always vertex attributes
            a.name           = "Attribute_" + attrArray.getName(); // attribute name
            a.scalarType     = convertFormatToScalarType(attrArray.getFormat());
            a.components     = static_cast<int>(attrArray.getNumComponents());
            a.dataBlockIndex = blockIndex;

            mesh.attributes.push_back(a);

            DataBlock b;
            b.index = blockIndex++;
            b.data  = attrArray.getData(); // raw binary data

            mesh.dataBlocks[b.index] = std::move(b);
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Indices (flattened with separators)
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const RawArray& idx = raw.getIndexCollection();
        if (!idx.getData().empty())
        {
            // Flatten indices with -1 separators
            std::vector<std::byte, Eigen::aligned_allocator<std::byte>> flat =
                flattenIndicesWithSeparators(raw);

            int flatCount = static_cast<int>(flat.size() / sizeof(int32_t));

            Attribute a;
            a.name           = "Indices";
            a.scalarType     = ScalarType::Int32;
            a.components     = 1; // ALWAYS 1 for index buffers
            a.dataBlockIndex = blockIndex;

            switch (topo)
            {
            case EMeshTopology::PointList:
                a.objectType    = "Points";
                mesh.pointCount = flatCount;
                break;

            case EMeshTopology::LineList:
            case EMeshTopology::LineStrip:
                a.objectType   = "Lines";
                mesh.lineCount = flatCount;
                break;

            case EMeshTopology::TriangleList:
            case EMeshTopology::TriangleStrip:
                a.objectType       = "Triangles";
                mesh.triangleCount = flatCount;
                break;

            default:
                break;
            }

            mesh.attributes.push_back(a);

            DataBlock b;
            b.index = blockIndex++;
            b.data  = std::move(flat);

            mesh.dataBlocks[b.index] = std::move(b);
        }

        return mesh;
    }

    template <typename>
    inline constexpr bool always_false = false;

    template <typename TRegularField>
    inline std::string makeContentType()
    {
        using T = std::remove_cv_t<std::remove_reference_t<TRegularField>>;

        if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, vislab::RegularSteadyScalarField2f> ||
                      std::is_same_v<T, vislab::RegularSteadyScalarField2d>)
        {
            return "HxRegularSteadyScalarField2";
        }
        else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, vislab::RegularSteadyScalarField3f> ||
                           std::is_same_v<T, vislab::RegularSteadyScalarField3d>)
        {
            return "HxRegularSteadyScalarField3";
        }
        else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, vislab::RegularUnsteadyScalarField2f> ||
                           std::is_same_v<T, vislab::RegularUnsteadyScalarField2d>)
        {
            return "HxRegularUnsteadyScalarField2";
        }
        else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, vislab::RegularSteadyVectorField2f> ||
                           std::is_same_v<T, vislab::RegularSteadyVectorField2d>)
        {
            return "HxRegularSteadyVectorField2";
        }
        else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, vislab::RegularSteadyVectorField3f> ||
                           std::is_same_v<T, vislab::RegularSteadyVectorField3d>)
        {
            return "HxRegularSteadyVectorField3";
        }
        else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, vislab::RegularUnsteadyVectorField2f> ||
                           std::is_same_v<T, vislab::RegularUnsteadyVectorField2d>)
        {
            return "HxRegularUnsteadyVectorField2";
        }
        else
        {
            static_assert(always_false<T>, "makeContentType: Unsupported TRegularField type");
        }
    }

    template <typename TRegularField>
    amira::AmiraMesh convertFieldToAmiraMesh(const TRegularField& field)
    {
        static_assert(std::is_base_of_v<Data, TRegularField>,
                      "convertFieldToAmiraMesh requires a field type derived from Data");

        amira::AmiraMesh am;

        am.magicLine = "# AmiraMesh BINARY-LITTLE-ENDIAN 2.1";
        am.encoding  = amira::FileEncoding::BinaryLittleEndian;

        const bool is2DGrid = TRegularField::Dimensions == 2;
        const bool is3DGrid = TRegularField::Dimensions == 3;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 1. Resolution
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        if constexpr (is2DGrid)
        {
            const Eigen::Vector2i res = field.getGrid().getResolution();
            am.latticeDims[0]         = res[0];
            am.latticeDims[1]         = res[1];
            am.latticeDims[2]         = 1;
        }
        else if constexpr (is3DGrid)
        {
            const Eigen::Vector3i res = field.getGrid().getResolution();
            am.latticeDims[0]         = res[0];
            am.latticeDims[1]         = res[1];
            am.latticeDims[2]         = res[2];
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 2. Bounding box
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        {
            const auto& box = field.getGrid().getDomain();
            if constexpr (is2DGrid)
            {
                std::ostringstream ss;
                ss << box.min().x() << " "
                   << box.max().x() << " "
                   << box.min().y() << " "
                   << box.max().y();
                am.parameters["BoundingBox"] = { "BoundingBox", ss.str() };
            }
            else if constexpr (is3DGrid)
            {
                std::ostringstream ss;
                ss << box.min().x() << " "
                   << box.max().x() << " "
                   << box.min().y() << " "
                   << box.max().y() << " "
                   << box.min().z() << " "
                   << box.max().z();
                am.parameters["BoundingBox"] = { "BoundingBox", ss.str() };
            }
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 3. Boundary behavior
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        {
            std::array<EBoundaryBehavior, 3> boundaryBehavior = {
                EBoundaryBehavior::Clamp,
                EBoundaryBehavior::Clamp,
                EBoundaryBehavior::Clamp
            };

            for (int dim = 0; dim < TRegularField::Dimensions; ++dim)
                boundaryBehavior[dim] = field.getBoundaryBehavior(dim);

            auto toStr = [](EBoundaryBehavior b)
            {
                return (b == EBoundaryBehavior::Clamp) ? "Clamp" : "Periodic";
            };

            if constexpr (is2DGrid)
            {
                std::ostringstream ss;
                ss << "("
                   << toStr(boundaryBehavior[0]) << ", "
                   << toStr(boundaryBehavior[1]) << ")";
                am.parameters["BoundaryBehavior"] = { "BoundaryBehavior", ss.str() };
            }
            else if constexpr (is3DGrid)
            {
                std::ostringstream ss;
                ss << "("
                   << toStr(boundaryBehavior[0]) << ", "
                   << toStr(boundaryBehavior[1]) << ", "
                   << toStr(boundaryBehavior[2]) << ")";
                am.parameters["BoundaryBehavior"] = { "BoundaryBehavior", ss.str() };
            }
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 4. Derivative accuracy
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        {
            int acc                             = field.getAccuracy();
            am.parameters["DerivativeAccuracy"] = {
                "DerivativeAccuracy",
                std::to_string(acc)
            };
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 5. ContentType (new format)
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        {
            std::string ct = makeContentType<TRegularField>();
            if (!ct.empty())
                am.parameters["ContentType"] = { "ContentType", ct };
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 6. CoordType
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        am.parameters["CoordType"] = { "CoordType", "\"uniform\"" };

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 7. Lattice attribute
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const bool isFloat  = std::is_same_v<typename TRegularField::ArrayElement::Scalar, float>;
        const bool isDouble = std::is_same_v<typename TRegularField::ArrayElement::Scalar, double>;

        {
            amira::Attribute attr;
            attr.objectType     = "Lattice";
            attr.name           = "Data";
            attr.dataBlockIndex = 1;

            // scalar type
            attr.scalarType = amira::ScalarType::Unknown;
            if (isFloat)
                attr.scalarType = amira::ScalarType::Float32;
            else if (isDouble)
                attr.scalarType = amira::ScalarType::Float64;

            attr.components = TRegularField::Components;

            am.attributes.push_back(attr);
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 8. Data block
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        {
            amira::DataBlock block;
            block.index = 1;

            auto src = field.getArray().getRaw().getData().data();
            block.data.resize(field.getArray().getSizeInBytes());
            std::memcpy(block.data.data(), src, field.getArray().getSizeInBytes());
            am.dataBlocks[1] = std::move(block);
        }

        return am;
    }

    template <typename TField>
    bool tryConvertField(const std::shared_ptr<Data>& input, amira::AmiraMesh& result)
    {
        auto ptr = std::dynamic_pointer_cast<TField>(input);
        if (!ptr)
            return false;

        result = convertFieldToAmiraMesh(*ptr);
        return true;
    }

    UpdateInfo AmiraWriter::internalUpdate(ProgressInfo& progress)
    {
        // get the path parameter
        const std::string& path = paramPath.getValue();

        // get the input data
        auto input = inputData.getData();

        try
        {
            std::shared_ptr<RawMesh> raw_mesh = nullptr;

            auto mesh3f = std::dynamic_pointer_cast<Mesh3f>(input);
            auto mesh3d = std::dynamic_pointer_cast<Mesh3d>(input);
            raw_mesh    = mesh3f ? mesh3f->getRawShared() : raw_mesh;
            raw_mesh    = mesh3d ? mesh3d->getRawShared() : raw_mesh;
            if (raw_mesh)
            {
                auto amiraMesh = convertRawMeshToAmiraMesh(*raw_mesh);
                amira::Amira::write(amiraMesh, path);
                progress.allJobsDone();
                return UpdateInfo::reportValid();
            }

            // field writer
            {
                amira::AmiraMesh result;
                tryConvertField<RegularSteadyScalarField2f>(input, result);
                tryConvertField<RegularSteadyScalarField2d>(input, result);
                tryConvertField<RegularSteadyScalarField3f>(input, result);
                tryConvertField<RegularSteadyScalarField3d>(input, result);
                tryConvertField<RegularUnsteadyScalarField2f>(input, result);
                tryConvertField<RegularUnsteadyScalarField2d>(input, result);
                tryConvertField<RegularSteadyVectorField2f>(input, result);
                tryConvertField<RegularSteadyVectorField2d>(input, result);
                tryConvertField<RegularSteadyVectorField3f>(input, result);
                tryConvertField<RegularSteadyVectorField3d>(input, result);
                tryConvertField<RegularUnsteadyVectorField2f>(input, result);
                tryConvertField<RegularUnsteadyVectorField2d>(input, result);
                amira::Amira::write(result, path);
                progress.allJobsDone();
                return UpdateInfo::reportValid();
            }
        }
        catch (const std::exception& e)
        {
            return UpdateInfo::reportError(std::string("Amira load failed: ") + e.what());
        }
        catch (...)
        {
            return UpdateInfo::reportError("Amira load failed: unknown error");
        }
    }
}
```
