    std::unique_ptr<ISwapchain> D3D11Device::createSwapchain(
        void* windowHandle,
        const SwapchainDesc& desc)
    {
        HWND hwnd = static_cast<HWND>(windowHandle);

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDXGIFactory> factory;
        HRESULT hr = CreateDXGIFactory(__uuidof(IDXGIFactory), (void**)&factory);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            return nullptr;

        DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC sd = {};
        sd.BufferCount          = 1;
        sd.BufferDesc.Width     = desc.width;
        sd.BufferDesc.Height    = desc.height;
        sd.BufferDesc.Format    = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        sd.BufferUsage          = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;
        sd.OutputWindow         = hwnd;

        // MSAA settings � swapchain must be single-sample
        sd.SampleDesc.Count   = 1;
        sd.SampleDesc.Quality = 0;

        sd.Windowed   = TRUE;
        sd.SwapEffect = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_DISCARD;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDXGISwapChain> swapchain;
        hr = factory->CreateSwapChain(mDevice.Get(), &sd, &swapchain);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            return nullptr;

        // Get backbuffer texture
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> backbufferTex;
        hr = swapchain->GetBuffer(0, IID_PPV_ARGS(&backbufferTex));
        if (FAILED(hr))
            return nullptr;

        // Wrap backbuffer texture
        TextureDesc texDesc;
        texDesc.width     = desc.width;
        texDesc.height    = desc.height;
        texDesc.format    = ETextureFormat::RGBA8;
        texDesc.bindFlags = ETextureBindFlags::RenderTarget | ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource;
        texDesc.debugName = "Swapchain Backbuffer";

        auto backbuffer = std::make_unique<D3D11Texture>(backbufferTex, texDesc);

        // Create RTV
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11RenderTargetView> rtv;
        hr = mDevice->CreateRenderTargetView(backbufferTex.Get(), nullptr, &rtv);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            return nullptr;

        TextureViewDesc viewDesc;
        viewDesc.format = texDesc.format;

        auto renderTarget = std::make_unique<D3D11RenderTargetView>(rtv, viewDesc);

        // Construct swapchain object
        return std::make_unique<D3D11Swapchain>(
            swapchain,
            std::move(backbuffer),
            std::move(renderTarget),
            desc);
    }

    static DXGI_FORMAT toDXGIBufferFormat(EBufferFormat fmt)
    {
        switch (fmt)
        {
        // --- 8-bit ---
        case EBufferFormat::R8:
        case EBufferFormat::R8UNorm:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM;

        case EBufferFormat::R8U:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UINT;

        case EBufferFormat::R8I:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R8_SINT;

        // --- 16-bit ---
        case EBufferFormat::R16:
        case EBufferFormat::R16UNorm:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UNORM;

        case EBufferFormat::R16U:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UINT;

        case EBufferFormat::R16I:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R16_SINT;

        case EBufferFormat::R16F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R16_FLOAT;

        // --- 32-bit ---
        case EBufferFormat::R32F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;

        case EBufferFormat::R32U:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32_UINT;

        case EBufferFormat::R32I:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32_SINT;

        // --- RG ---
        case EBufferFormat::RG8:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM;

        case EBufferFormat::RG16F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT;

        case EBufferFormat::RG32F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT;

        // --- RGBA ---
        case EBufferFormat::RGBA8:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;

        case EBufferFormat::RGBA16F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;

        case EBufferFormat::RGBA32F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT;

        case EBufferFormat::Unknown:
        default:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
        }
    }

    inline UINT getDXGIFormatSize(DXGI_FORMAT fmt)
    {
        switch (fmt)
        {
        // --- 8-bit ---
        case DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM:
        case DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UINT:
        case DXGI_FORMAT_R8_SINT:
            return 1;

        // --- 16-bit ---
        case DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UNORM:
        case DXGI_FORMAT_R16_UINT:
        case DXGI_FORMAT_R16_SINT:
        case DXGI_FORMAT_R16_FLOAT:
            return 2;

        // --- 32-bit ---
        case DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT:
        case DXGI_FORMAT_R32_UINT:
        case DXGI_FORMAT_R32_SINT:
            return 4;

        // --- RG (2-channel) ---
        case DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM:
            return 2; // 2 � 1 byte

        case DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT:
            return 4; // 2 � 2 bytes

        case DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT:
            return 8; // 2 � 4 bytes

        // --- RGBA (4-channel) ---
        case DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM:
            return 4; // 4 � 1 byte

        case DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT:
            return 8; // 4 � 2 bytes

        case DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT:
            return 16; // 4 � 4 bytes

        // --- Unknown or unsupported ---
        case DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN:
        default:
            return 0;
        }
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuShaderResourceView>
    D3D11Device::createShaderResourceView(IGpuBuffer* buffer,
                                          const BufferViewDesc& desc)
    {
        auto* buf               = static_cast<D3D11Buffer*>(buffer);
        ID3D11Buffer* native    = buf->getBuffer();
        const BufferDesc& bdesc = buf->getDesc();

        DXGI_FORMAT dxgiFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
        UINT flags             = 0;

        // -----------------------------
        // 1. Determine view type
        // -----------------------------
        switch (desc.viewType)
        {
        case EBufferViewType::Raw:
            dxgiFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
            flags      = D3D11_BUFFEREX_SRV_FLAG_RAW;
            break;

        case EBufferViewType::Structured:
            dxgiFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN; // StructuredBuffer<T> has no DXGI format
            break;

        case EBufferViewType::Typed:
            dxgiFormat = toDXGIBufferFormat(desc.format);
            break;
        }

        // -----------------------------
        // 2. Compute element range
        // -----------------------------
        UINT elementSize = 0;

        if (desc.viewType == EBufferViewType::Raw)
            elementSize = 4; // ByteAddressBuffer = 4-byte elements
        else if (desc.viewType == EBufferViewType::Structured)
            elementSize = bdesc.stride;
        else // Typed
            elementSize = getDXGIFormatSize(dxgiFormat);

        UINT firstElement = UINT(desc.offset / elementSize);
        UINT numElements  = UINT(desc.size / elementSize);

        // -----------------------------
        // 3. Fill SRV description
        // -----------------------------
        D3D11_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC sd = {};
        sd.Format                          = dxgiFormat;
        sd.ViewDimension                   = D3D11_SRV_DIMENSION_BUFFEREX;
        sd.BufferEx.FirstElement           = firstElement;
        sd.BufferEx.NumElements            = numElements;
        sd.BufferEx.Flags                  = flags;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11ShaderResourceView> srv;
        mDevice->CreateShaderResourceView(native, &sd, &srv);

        return std::make_unique<D3D11ShaderResourceView>(srv);
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuUnorderedAccessView>
    D3D11Device::createUnorderedAccessView(IGpuBuffer* buffer,
                                           const BufferViewDesc& desc)
    {
        auto* buf               = static_cast<D3D11Buffer*>(buffer);
        ID3D11Buffer* native    = buf->getBuffer();
        const BufferDesc& bdesc = buf->getDesc();

        DXGI_FORMAT dxgiFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
        UINT flags             = 0;

        // -----------------------------
        // 1. Determine view type
        // -----------------------------
        switch (desc.viewType)
        {
        case EBufferViewType::Raw:
            dxgiFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
            flags      = D3D11_BUFFER_UAV_FLAG_RAW;
            break;

        case EBufferViewType::Structured:
            dxgiFormat = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
            break;

        case EBufferViewType::Typed:
            dxgiFormat = toDXGIBufferFormat(desc.format);
            break;
        }

        // -----------------------------
        // 2. Compute element range
        // -----------------------------
        UINT elementSize = 0;

        if (desc.viewType == EBufferViewType::Raw)
            elementSize = 4;
        else if (desc.viewType == EBufferViewType::Structured)
            elementSize = bdesc.stride;
        else // Typed
            elementSize = getDXGIFormatSize(dxgiFormat);

        UINT firstElement = UINT(desc.offset / elementSize);
        UINT numElements  = UINT(desc.size / elementSize);

        // -----------------------------
        // 3. Fill UAV description
        // -----------------------------
        D3D11_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC ud = {};
        ud.Format                           = dxgiFormat;
        ud.ViewDimension                    = D3D11_UAV_DIMENSION_BUFFER;
        ud.Buffer.FirstElement              = firstElement;
        ud.Buffer.NumElements               = numElements;
        ud.Buffer.Flags                     = flags;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11UnorderedAccessView> uav;
        mDevice->CreateUnorderedAccessView(native, &ud, &uav);

        return std::make_unique<D3D11UnorderedAccessView>(uav);
    }

    DXGI_FORMAT toDXGITextureTypelessFormat(ETextureFormat fmt)
    {
        switch (fmt)
        {
        case ETextureFormat::RGBA8:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::BGRA8:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::RGBA16F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::RGBA32F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_TYPELESS;

        case ETextureFormat::R8:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R8_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::R16:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R16_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::R16F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R16_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::R32F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::R32U:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::R32I:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;

        case ETextureFormat::RG8:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::RG16F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::RG32F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_TYPELESS;

        case ETextureFormat::R10G10B10A2:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::RG11B10F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R11G11B10_FLOAT; // no typeless variant

        case ETextureFormat::D16:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R16_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::D24S8:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R24G8_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::D32F:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS;
        case ETextureFormat::D32FS8:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32G8X24_TYPELESS;

        default:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
        }
    }

        case ETextureDimension::Tex2DArray:

        case ETextureDimension::TexCubeArray:
            return D3D11_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURECUBEARRAY;
        default:
            return D3D11_SRV_DIMENSION_UNKNOWN;
        }
    }

    {
        switch (dim)
        {
        case ETextureDimension::Tex2D:

        case ETextureDimension::Tex2DArray:
            return D3D11_RTV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DARRAY;

        case ETextureDimension::TexCubeArray:

        }
    }

            return D3D11_UAV_DIMENSION_UNKNOWN;
        }
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuTexture> D3D11Device::createTexture(const TextureDesc& desc)
    {
        // 3D textures use a different struct
        if (desc.dimension == ETextureDimension::Tex3D)
        {
            D3D11_TEXTURE3D_DESC td = {};
            td.Width                = desc.width;
            td.Height               = desc.height;
            td.Depth                = desc.depth;
            td.MipLevels            = desc.mipLevels;
            td.Format               = toDXGITextureTypelessFormat(desc.format);
            td.Usage                = D3D11_USAGE_DEFAULT;
            td.BindFlags            = 0;

            if (hasFlag(desc.bindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource))
                td.BindFlags |= D3D11_BIND_SHADER_RESOURCE;
            if (hasFlag(desc.bindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::RenderTarget))
                td.BindFlags |= D3D11_BIND_RENDER_TARGET;
            if (hasFlag(desc.bindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::UnorderedAccess))
                td.BindFlags |= D3D11_BIND_UNORDERED_ACCESS;

            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture3D> tex;

            D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA initData = {};
            initData.pSysMem                = desc.initialData;
            initData.SysMemPitch            = static_cast<UINT>(desc.initialRowPitch);
            initData.SysMemSlicePitch       = static_cast<UINT>(desc.initialSlicePitch);

            HRESULT hr = mDevice->CreateTexture3D(&td, &initData, &tex);

            if (FAILED(hr))
                return nullptr;

            return std::make_unique<D3D11Texture>(tex, desc);
        }

        // 2D, 2D array, cube, cube array
        D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC td = {};
        td.Width                = desc.width;
        td.Height               = desc.height;
        td.MipLevels            = desc.mipLevels;

        switch (desc.dimension)
        {
        case ETextureDimension::Tex2D:
            td.ArraySize = 1;
            break;

        case ETextureDimension::Tex2DArray:
            td.ArraySize = desc.arraySize;
            break;

        case ETextureDimension::TexCube:
            td.ArraySize = 6;
            td.MiscFlags |= D3D11_RESOURCE_MISC_TEXTURECUBE;
            break;

        case ETextureDimension::TexCubeArray:
            td.ArraySize = 6 * desc.arraySize;
            td.MiscFlags |= D3D11_RESOURCE_MISC_TEXTURECUBE;
            break;

        default:
            td.ArraySize = 1;
            break;
        }

        // Use concrete color format for color RTs, typeless only when needed for depth.
        if (hasFlag(desc.bindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::DepthStencil))
        {
            td.Format = toDXGITextureTypelessFormat(desc.format);
        }
        else
        {
            // For color RTs (RGBA8, etc.), use the RTV format as the resource format.
            td.Format = toDXGIRTVFormat(desc.format);
        }

        td.SampleDesc.Count   = desc.sampleCount;
        td.SampleDesc.Quality = 0;

        td.Usage     = D3D11_USAGE_DEFAULT;
        td.BindFlags = 0;

        if (hasFlag(desc.bindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource))
            td.BindFlags |= D3D11_BIND_SHADER_RESOURCE;
        if (hasFlag(desc.bindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::RenderTarget))
            td.BindFlags |= D3D11_BIND_RENDER_TARGET;
        if (hasFlag(desc.bindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::DepthStencil))
            td.BindFlags |= D3D11_BIND_DEPTH_STENCIL;
        if (hasFlag(desc.bindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::UnorderedAccess))
            td.BindFlags |= D3D11_BIND_UNORDERED_ACCESS;

        // Initial data (simple version: only supports single-mip, single-layer)
        D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA initData = {};
        D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA* initPtr = nullptr;

        if (desc.initialData)
        {
            initData.pSysMem = desc.initialData;

            UINT bpp = getDXGIFormatSize(td.Format);

            if (desc.initialRowPitch != 0)
                initData.SysMemPitch = static_cast<UINT>(desc.initialRowPitch);
            else
                initData.SysMemPitch = desc.width * bpp;

            initPtr = &initData;
        }

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> tex;
        HRESULT hr = mDevice->CreateTexture2D(&td, initPtr, &tex);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            return nullptr;

        return std::make_unique<D3D11Texture>(tex, desc);
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuShaderResourceView>
    D3D11Device::createShaderResourceView(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                          const TextureViewDesc& viewDesc)
    {
        auto* tex               = static_cast<D3D11Texture*>(texture);
        const TextureDesc& desc = tex->getDesc();
        ID3D11Resource* native  = tex->getResource();

        D3D11_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC sd = {};
        sd.Format                          = toDXGISRVFormat(desc.format);
        sd.ViewDimension                   = toSRVDimension(desc.dimension);

        switch (desc.dimension)
        {
        case ETextureDimension::Tex2D:
            sd.Texture2D.MostDetailedMip = viewDesc.baseMip;
            sd.Texture2D.MipLevels       = viewDesc.mipCount;
            break;

        case ETextureDimension::Tex2DArray:
            sd.Texture2DArray.MostDetailedMip = viewDesc.baseMip;
            sd.Texture2DArray.MipLevels       = viewDesc.mipCount;
            sd.Texture2DArray.FirstArraySlice = viewDesc.baseLayer;
            sd.Texture2DArray.ArraySize       = viewDesc.layerCount;
            break;

        case ETextureDimension::TexCube:
            sd.TextureCube.MostDetailedMip = viewDesc.baseMip;
            sd.TextureCube.MipLevels       = viewDesc.mipCount;
            break;

        case ETextureDimension::TexCubeArray:
            sd.TextureCubeArray.MostDetailedMip  = viewDesc.baseMip;
            sd.TextureCubeArray.MipLevels        = viewDesc.mipCount;
            sd.TextureCubeArray.First2DArrayFace = viewDesc.baseLayer * 6;
            sd.TextureCubeArray.NumCubes         = viewDesc.layerCount;
            break;

        case ETextureDimension::Tex3D:
            sd.Texture3D.MostDetailedMip = viewDesc.baseMip;
            sd.Texture3D.MipLevels       = viewDesc.mipCount;
            break;
        }

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11ShaderResourceView> srv;
        mDevice->CreateShaderResourceView(native, &sd, &srv);

        return std::make_unique<D3D11ShaderResourceView>(srv);
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuUnorderedAccessView>
    D3D11Device::createUnorderedAccessView(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                           const TextureViewDesc& viewDesc)
    {
        auto* tex               = static_cast<D3D11Texture*>(texture);
        const TextureDesc& desc = tex->getDesc();
        ID3D11Resource* native  = tex->getResource();

        if (desc.sampleCount > 1)
            throw std::runtime_error("MSAA textures cannot have UAVs");

        D3D11_UNORDERED_ACCESS_VIEW_DESC ud = {};
        ud.Format                           = toDXGIUAVFormat(desc.format);

        switch (desc.dimension)
        {
        case ETextureDimension::Tex2D:
            ud.ViewDimension      = D3D11_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
            ud.Texture2D.MipSlice = viewDesc.baseMip;
            break;

        case ETextureDimension::Tex2DArray:
            ud.ViewDimension                  = D3D11_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DARRAY;
            ud.Texture2DArray.MipSlice        = viewDesc.baseMip;
            ud.Texture2DArray.FirstArraySlice = viewDesc.baseLayer;
            ud.Texture2DArray.ArraySize       = viewDesc.layerCount;
            break;

        case ETextureDimension::Tex3D:
            ud.ViewDimension         = D3D11_UAV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE3D;
            ud.Texture3D.MipSlice    = viewDesc.baseMip;
            ud.Texture3D.FirstWSlice = viewDesc.baseLayer;
            ud.Texture3D.WSize       = viewDesc.layerCount;
            break;

        default:
            throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported texture dimension for UAV");
        }

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11UnorderedAccessView> uav;
        mDevice->CreateUnorderedAccessView(native, &ud, &uav);

        return std::make_unique<D3D11UnorderedAccessView>(uav);
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuRenderTargetView>
    D3D11Device::createRenderTargetView(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                        const TextureViewDesc& viewDesc)
    {
        auto* tex               = static_cast<D3D11Texture*>(texture);
        const TextureDesc& desc = tex->getDesc();
        ID3D11Resource* native  = tex->getResource();

        const bool isMSAA = desc.sampleCount > 1;

        D3D11_RENDER_TARGET_VIEW_DESC rd = {};
        rd.Format                        = toDXGIRTVFormat(desc.format);

        switch (desc.dimension)
        {
        case ETextureDimension::Tex2D:
            rd.ViewDimension = isMSAA
                                   ? D3D11_RTV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DMS
                                   : D3D11_RTV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;

            if (!isMSAA)
                rd.Texture2D.MipSlice = viewDesc.baseMip;
            break;

        case ETextureDimension::Tex2DArray:
            rd.ViewDimension = isMSAA
                                   ? D3D11_RTV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DMSARRAY
                                   : D3D11_RTV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DARRAY;

            if (!isMSAA)
            {
                rd.Texture2DArray.MipSlice        = viewDesc.baseMip;
                rd.Texture2DArray.FirstArraySlice = viewDesc.baseLayer;
                rd.Texture2DArray.ArraySize       = viewDesc.layerCount;
            }
            break;

        case ETextureDimension::Tex3D:
            rd.ViewDimension         = D3D11_RTV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE3D;
            rd.Texture3D.MipSlice    = viewDesc.baseMip;
            rd.Texture3D.FirstWSlice = viewDesc.baseLayer;
            rd.Texture3D.WSize       = viewDesc.layerCount;
            break;

        default:
            throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported texture dimension for RTV");
        }

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11RenderTargetView> rtv;
        mDevice->CreateRenderTargetView(native, &rd, &rtv);

        return std::make_unique<D3D11RenderTargetView>(rtv, viewDesc);
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuDepthStencilView>
    D3D11Device::createDepthStencilView(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                        const TextureViewDesc& viewDesc)
    {
        auto* tex               = static_cast<D3D11Texture*>(texture);
        const TextureDesc& desc = tex->getDesc();
        ID3D11Resource* native  = tex->getResource();

        const bool isMSAA = desc.sampleCount > 1;

        D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_VIEW_DESC dd = {};
        dd.Format                        = toDXGIDSVFormat(desc.format);

        switch (desc.dimension)
        {
        case ETextureDimension::Tex2D:
            dd.ViewDimension = isMSAA
                                   ? D3D11_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DMS
                                   : D3D11_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;

            if (!isMSAA)
                dd.Texture2D.MipSlice = viewDesc.baseMip;
            break;

        case ETextureDimension::Tex2DArray:
            dd.ViewDimension = isMSAA
                                   ? D3D11_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DMSARRAY
                                   : D3D11_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DARRAY;

            if (!isMSAA)
            {
                dd.Texture2DArray.MipSlice        = viewDesc.baseMip;
                dd.Texture2DArray.FirstArraySlice = viewDesc.baseLayer;
                dd.Texture2DArray.ArraySize       = viewDesc.layerCount;
            }
            break;

        default:
            throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported texture dimension for DSV");
        }

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11DepthStencilView> dsv;
        mDevice->CreateDepthStencilView(native, &dd, &dsv);

        return std::make_unique<D3D11DepthStencilView>(dsv);
    }

    static D3D11_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE toD3DAddress(EAddressMode mode)
    {
        switch (mode)
        {
        case EAddressMode::Repeat:
            return D3D11_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_WRAP;
        case EAddressMode::ClampToEdge:
            return D3D11_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_CLAMP;
        case EAddressMode::ClampToBorder:
            return D3D11_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_BORDER;
        case EAddressMode::MirrorRepeat:
            return D3D11_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MIRROR;
        default:
            return D3D11_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_WRAP;
        }
    }

    static D3D11_COMPARISON_FUNC toD3DCompare(ECompareFunc f)
    {
        switch (f)
        {
        case ECompareFunc::Never:
            return D3D11_COMPARISON_NEVER;
        case ECompareFunc::Less:
            return D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS;
        case ECompareFunc::Equal:
            return D3D11_COMPARISON_EQUAL;
        case ECompareFunc::LessEqual:
            return D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS_EQUAL;
        case ECompareFunc::Greater:
            return D3D11_COMPARISON_GREATER;
        case ECompareFunc::NotEqual:
            return D3D11_COMPARISON_NOT_EQUAL;
        case ECompareFunc::GreaterEqual:
            return D3D11_COMPARISON_GREATER_EQUAL;
        case ECompareFunc::Always:
            return D3D11_COMPARISON_ALWAYS;
        default:
            return D3D11_COMPARISON_ALWAYS;
        }
    }

    static D3D11_FILTER toD3DFilter(const SamplerDesc& d)
    {
        const bool minLinear = (d.minFilter == EFilterMode::Linear);
        const bool magLinear = (d.magFilter == EFilterMode::Linear);
        const bool mipLinear = (d.mipFilter == EMipFilterMode::Linear);

        // Anisotropy overrides everything
        if (d.enableAnisotropy)
            return d.enableComparison ? D3D11_FILTER_COMPARISON_ANISOTROPIC : D3D11_FILTER_ANISOTROPIC;

        // Comparison sampling
        if (d.enableComparison)
        {
            if (!minLinear && !magLinear && !mipLinear)
                return D3D11_FILTER_COMPARISON_MIN_MAG_MIP_POINT;
            if (!minLinear && !magLinear && mipLinear)
                return D3D11_FILTER_COMPARISON_MIN_MAG_POINT_MIP_LINEAR;
            if (!minLinear && magLinear && !mipLinear)
                return D3D11_FILTER_COMPARISON_MIN_POINT_MAG_LINEAR_MIP_POINT;
            if (!minLinear && magLinear && mipLinear)
                return D3D11_FILTER_COMPARISON_MIN_POINT_MAG_MIP_LINEAR;
            if (minLinear && !magLinear && !mipLinear)
                return D3D11_FILTER_COMPARISON_MIN_LINEAR_MAG_MIP_POINT;
            if (minLinear && !magLinear && mipLinear)
                return D3D11_FILTER_COMPARISON_MIN_LINEAR_MAG_POINT_MIP_LINEAR;
            if (minLinear && magLinear && !mipLinear)
                return D3D11_FILTER_COMPARISON_MIN_MAG_LINEAR_MIP_POINT;
            if (minLinear && magLinear && mipLinear)
                return D3D11_FILTER_COMPARISON_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR;
        }

        // Regular sampling
        if (!minLinear && !magLinear && !mipLinear)
            return D3D11_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_POINT;
        if (!minLinear && !magLinear && mipLinear)
            return D3D11_FILTER_MIN_MAG_POINT_MIP_LINEAR;
        if (!minLinear && magLinear && !mipLinear)
            return D3D11_FILTER_MIN_POINT_MAG_LINEAR_MIP_POINT;
        if (!minLinear && magLinear && mipLinear)
            return D3D11_FILTER_MIN_POINT_MAG_MIP_LINEAR;
        if (minLinear && !magLinear && !mipLinear)
            return D3D11_FILTER_MIN_LINEAR_MAG_MIP_POINT;
        if (minLinear && !magLinear && mipLinear)
            return D3D11_FILTER_MIN_LINEAR_MAG_POINT_MIP_LINEAR;
        if (minLinear && magLinear && !mipLinear)
            return D3D11_FILTER_MIN_MAG_LINEAR_MIP_POINT;
        if (minLinear && magLinear && mipLinear)
            return D3D11_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR;

        // Should never reach here
        return D3D11_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR;
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuSampler> D3D11Device::createSampler(const SamplerDesc& desc)
    {
        D3D11_SAMPLER_DESC sd = {};
        sd.Filter             = toD3DFilter(desc);

        sd.AddressU = toD3DAddress(desc.addressU);
        sd.AddressV = toD3DAddress(desc.addressV);
        sd.AddressW = toD3DAddress(desc.addressW);

        sd.MipLODBias = desc.mipLodBias;
        sd.MinLOD     = desc.minLod;
        sd.MaxLOD     = desc.maxLod;

        sd.MaxAnisotropy = desc.enableAnisotropy
                               ? std::min(desc.maxAnisotropy, 16u)
                               : 1;

        sd.ComparisonFunc = desc.enableComparison
                                ? toD3DCompare(desc.compareFunc)
                                : D3D11_COMPARISON_ALWAYS;

        sd.BorderColor[0] = desc.borderColor[0];
        sd.BorderColor[1] = desc.borderColor[1];
        sd.BorderColor[2] = desc.borderColor[2];
        sd.BorderColor[3] = desc.borderColor[3];

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11SamplerState> sampler;
        HRESULT hr = mDevice->CreateSamplerState(&sd, &sampler);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            return nullptr;

        return std::make_unique<D3D11Sampler>(sampler);
    }

    static DXGI_FORMAT toDXGIFormat(EVertexFormat fmt)
    {
        switch (fmt)
        {
        case EVertexFormat::Float32:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT;

        case EVertexFormat::Float32x2:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT;

        case EVertexFormat::Float32x3:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT;

        case EVertexFormat::Float32x4:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT;

        case EVertexFormat::Uint32:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32_UINT;

        case EVertexFormat::Uint32x2:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_UINT;

        case EVertexFormat::Uint32x3:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_UINT;

        case EVertexFormat::Uint32x4:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_UINT;

        default:
            return DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
        }
    }

    static D3D11_BLEND toD3DBlend(EBlendFactor f)
    {
        switch (f)
        {
        case EBlendFactor::Zero:
            return D3D11_BLEND_ZERO;
        case EBlendFactor::One:
            return D3D11_BLEND_ONE;
        case EBlendFactor::SrcColor:
            return D3D11_BLEND_SRC_COLOR;
        case EBlendFactor::OneMinusSrcColor:
            return D3D11_BLEND_INV_SRC_COLOR;
        case EBlendFactor::DstColor:
            return D3D11_BLEND_DEST_COLOR;
        case EBlendFactor::OneMinusDstColor:
            return D3D11_BLEND_INV_DEST_COLOR;
        case EBlendFactor::SrcAlpha:
            return D3D11_BLEND_SRC_ALPHA;
        case EBlendFactor::OneMinusSrcAlpha:
            return D3D11_BLEND_INV_SRC_ALPHA;
        case EBlendFactor::DstAlpha:
            return D3D11_BLEND_DEST_ALPHA;
        case EBlendFactor::OneMinusDstAlpha:
            return D3D11_BLEND_INV_DEST_ALPHA;
        default:
            return D3D11_BLEND_ONE;
        }
    }

    static D3D11_BLEND_OP toD3DBlendOp(EBlendOp op)
    {
        switch (op)
        {
        case EBlendOp::Add:
            return D3D11_BLEND_OP_ADD;
        case EBlendOp::Subtract:
            return D3D11_BLEND_OP_SUBTRACT;
        case EBlendOp::ReverseSubtract:
            return D3D11_BLEND_OP_REV_SUBTRACT;
        case EBlendOp::Min:
            return D3D11_BLEND_OP_MIN;
        case EBlendOp::Max:
            return D3D11_BLEND_OP_MAX;
        default:
            return D3D11_BLEND_OP_ADD;
        }
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> D3D11Device::createRenderPipeline(const RenderPipelineDesc& desc)
    {
        // Local COM objects (fully constructed before pipeline is created)
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11VertexShader> vs;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11HullShader> hs;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11DomainShader> ds;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11GeometryShader> gs;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11PixelShader> ps;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11InputLayout> il;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11RasterizerState> rs;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11DepthStencilState> dss;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11BlendState> bs;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 1. Create shaders
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        auto createShader = [&](const ShaderBinary& bin, auto createFn, auto& outShader) -> bool
        {
            if (bin.code.empty())
                return true; // optional stage

            const void* bytecode = bin.code.data();
            SIZE_T bytecodeSize  = bin.code.size();

            HRESULT hr = (mDevice.Get()->*createFn)(bytecode, bytecodeSize, nullptr, &outShader);
            return SUCCEEDED(hr);
        };

        if (!createShader(desc.vertexShader, &ID3D11Device::CreateVertexShader, vs))
            return nullptr;
        if (!createShader(desc.hullShader, &ID3D11Device::CreateHullShader, hs))
            return nullptr;
        if (!createShader(desc.domainShader, &ID3D11Device::CreateDomainShader, ds))
            return nullptr;
        if (!createShader(desc.geometryShader, &ID3D11Device::CreateGeometryShader, gs))
            return nullptr;
        if (!createShader(desc.fragmentShader, &ID3D11Device::CreatePixelShader, ps))
            return nullptr;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 2. Input layout
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (!desc.vertexLayout.attributes.empty() && vs)
        {
            std::vector<std::string> semanticNames;
            semanticNames.reserve(desc.vertexLayout.attributes.size());

            std::vector<D3D11_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC> elements;
            elements.reserve(desc.vertexLayout.attributes.size());

            for (const auto& attr : desc.vertexLayout.attributes)
            {
                semanticNames.push_back("ATTRIB");

                D3D11_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC e = {};
                e.SemanticName             = semanticNames.back().c_str();
                e.SemanticIndex            = attr.location;
                e.InputSlot                = attr.bufferSlot;
                e.AlignedByteOffset        = attr.offset;
                e.InputSlotClass           = D3D11_INPUT_PER_VERTEX_DATA;
                e.InstanceDataStepRate     = 0;
                e.Format                   = toDXGIFormat(attr.format);

                elements.push_back(e);
            }

            const void* vsBytecode = desc.vertexShader.code.data();
            SIZE_T vsBytecodeSize  = desc.vertexShader.code.size();

            HRESULT hr = mDevice->CreateInputLayout(
                elements.data(),
                static_cast<UINT>(elements.size()),
                vsBytecode,
                vsBytecodeSize,
                &il);

            if (FAILED(hr))
                return nullptr;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 3. Rasterizer state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        {
            D3D11_RASTERIZER_DESC rd = {};
            rd.FillMode              = desc.raster.wireframe ? D3D11_FILL_WIREFRAME : D3D11_FILL_SOLID;
            switch (desc.raster.cullMode)
            {
            case ECullMode::None:
                rd.CullMode = D3D11_CULL_NONE;
                break;
            case ECullMode::Front:
                rd.CullMode = D3D11_CULL_FRONT;
                break;
            case ECullMode::Back:
                rd.CullMode = D3D11_CULL_BACK;
                break;
            }
            rd.FrontCounterClockwise = TRUE;
            rd.DepthClipEnable       = desc.raster.depthClipEnable ? TRUE : FALSE;
#ifdef D3D11_CONSERVATIVE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_ON
            rd.ConservativeRaster = desc.raster.conservativeRaster ? D3D11_CONSERVATIVE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_ON : D3D11_CONSERVATIVE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_OFF;
#endif
            rd.AntialiasedLineEnable = FALSE;
            HRESULT hr               = mDevice->CreateRasterizerState(&rd, &rs);
            if (FAILED(hr))
                return nullptr;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 4. Depth/stencil state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        {
            D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC dd = {};
            dd.DepthEnable              = desc.depth.depthTest ? TRUE : FALSE;
            dd.DepthWriteMask           = desc.depth.depthWrite
                                              ? D3D11_DEPTH_WRITE_MASK_ALL
                                              : D3D11_DEPTH_WRITE_MASK_ZERO;

            // Depth comparison
            switch (desc.depth.depthFunc)
            {
            case ECompareFunc::Never:
                dd.DepthFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_NEVER;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::Less:
                dd.DepthFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::Equal:
                dd.DepthFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_EQUAL;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::LessEqual:
                dd.DepthFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS_EQUAL;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::Greater:
                dd.DepthFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_GREATER;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::NotEqual:
                dd.DepthFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_NOT_EQUAL;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::GreaterEqual:
                dd.DepthFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_GREATER_EQUAL;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::Always:
                dd.DepthFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_ALWAYS;
                break;
            }

            // Stencil enable
            dd.StencilEnable    = desc.stencil.enable ? TRUE : FALSE;
            dd.StencilReadMask  = desc.stencil.readMask;
            dd.StencilWriteMask = desc.stencil.writeMask;

            // Helper lambda to map EStencilOp to D3D11_STENCIL_OP
            auto MapStencilOp = [](EStencilOp op)
            {
                switch (op)
                {
                case EStencilOp::Keep:
                    return D3D11_STENCIL_OP_KEEP;
                case EStencilOp::Zero:
                    return D3D11_STENCIL_OP_ZERO;
                case EStencilOp::Replace:
                    return D3D11_STENCIL_OP_REPLACE;
                case EStencilOp::IncrSat:
                    return D3D11_STENCIL_OP_INCR_SAT;
                case EStencilOp::DecrSat:
                    return D3D11_STENCIL_OP_DECR_SAT;
                case EStencilOp::Invert:
                    return D3D11_STENCIL_OP_INVERT;
                case EStencilOp::IncrWrap:
                    return D3D11_STENCIL_OP_INCR;
                case EStencilOp::DecrWrap:
                    return D3D11_STENCIL_OP_DECR;
                }
                return D3D11_STENCIL_OP_KEEP;
            };

            // Front face stencil ops
            dd.FrontFace.StencilFailOp      = MapStencilOp(desc.stencil.front.failOp);
            dd.FrontFace.StencilDepthFailOp = MapStencilOp(desc.stencil.front.depthFailOp);
            dd.FrontFace.StencilPassOp      = MapStencilOp(desc.stencil.front.passOp);

            // Front face compare func
            switch (desc.stencil.front.func)
            {
            case ECompareFunc::Never:
                dd.FrontFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_NEVER;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::Less:
                dd.FrontFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::Equal:
                dd.FrontFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_EQUAL;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::LessEqual:
                dd.FrontFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS_EQUAL;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::Greater:
                dd.FrontFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_GREATER;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::NotEqual:
                dd.FrontFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_NOT_EQUAL;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::GreaterEqual:
                dd.FrontFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_GREATER_EQUAL;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::Always:
                dd.FrontFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_ALWAYS;
                break;
            }

            // Back face stencil ops
            dd.BackFace.StencilFailOp      = MapStencilOp(desc.stencil.back.failOp);
            dd.BackFace.StencilDepthFailOp = MapStencilOp(desc.stencil.back.depthFailOp);
            dd.BackFace.StencilPassOp      = MapStencilOp(desc.stencil.back.passOp);

            // Back face compare func
            switch (desc.stencil.back.func)
            {
            case ECompareFunc::Never:
                dd.BackFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_NEVER;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::Less:
                dd.BackFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::Equal:
                dd.BackFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_EQUAL;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::LessEqual:
                dd.BackFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS_EQUAL;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::Greater:
                dd.BackFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_GREATER;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::NotEqual:
                dd.BackFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_NOT_EQUAL;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::GreaterEqual:
                dd.BackFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_GREATER_EQUAL;
                break;
            case ECompareFunc::Always:
                dd.BackFace.StencilFunc = D3D11_COMPARISON_ALWAYS;
                break;
            }

            HRESULT hr = mDevice->CreateDepthStencilState(&dd, &dss);
            if (FAILED(hr))
                return nullptr;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 5. Blend state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        {
            D3D11_BLEND_DESC bd       = {};
            bd.AlphaToCoverageEnable  = desc.multisample.alphaToCoverage ? TRUE : FALSE;
            bd.IndependentBlendEnable = (desc.blend.targetCount > 1) ? TRUE : FALSE;

            for (UINT i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
            {
                const bool inRange                  = (i < desc.blend.targetCount);
                const RenderTargetBlend* src        = inRange ? &desc.blend.targets[i] : nullptr;
                D3D11_RENDER_TARGET_BLEND_DESC& dst = bd.RenderTarget[i];

                if (src && src->enable)
                {
                    dst.BlendEnable           = TRUE;
                    dst.RenderTargetWriteMask = src->writeMask;

                    dst.SrcBlend       = toD3DBlend(src->srcColor);
                    dst.DestBlend      = toD3DBlend(src->dstColor);
                    dst.BlendOp        = toD3DBlendOp(src->colorOp);
                    dst.SrcBlendAlpha  = toD3DBlend(src->srcAlpha);
                    dst.DestBlendAlpha = toD3DBlend(src->dstAlpha);
                    dst.BlendOpAlpha   = toD3DBlendOp(src->alphaOp);
                }
                else
                {
                    dst.BlendEnable           = FALSE;
                    dst.RenderTargetWriteMask = (inRange && src) ? src->writeMask : 0;

                    dst.SrcBlend       = D3D11_BLEND_ONE;
                    dst.DestBlend      = D3D11_BLEND_ZERO;
                    dst.BlendOp        = D3D11_BLEND_OP_ADD;
                    dst.SrcBlendAlpha  = D3D11_BLEND_ONE;
                    dst.DestBlendAlpha = D3D11_BLEND_ZERO;
                    dst.BlendOpAlpha   = D3D11_BLEND_OP_ADD;
                }
            }

            HRESULT hr = mDevice->CreateBlendState(&bd, &bs);
            if (FAILED(hr))
                return nullptr;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 6. Construct the pipeline (fully initialized)
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        auto pipeline = std::make_unique<D3D11RenderPipeline>(
            vs, hs, ds, gs, ps,
            il, rs, dss, bs,
            desc);

        return pipeline;
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IComputePipeline> D3D11Device::createComputePipeline(
        const ComputePipelineDesc& desc)
    {
        // Local COM object (fully constructed before pipeline is created)
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11ComputeShader> cs;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 1. Create compute shader
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        {
            const ShaderBinary& bin = desc.computeShader;

            if (bin.code.empty())
                return nullptr; // invalid compute pipeline

            const void* bytecode = bin.code.data();
            SIZE_T bytecodeSz    = bin.code.size();

            HRESULT hr = mDevice->CreateComputeShader(
                bytecode,
                bytecodeSz,
                nullptr,
                &cs);

            if (FAILED(hr))
                return nullptr;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // 2. Construct the pipeline (fully initialized)
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        auto pipeline = std::make_unique<D3D11ComputePipeline>(
            cs,
            desc);

        return pipeline;
    }

    std::unique_ptr<ICommandList> D3D11Device::createCommandList(ECommandListType commandListType)
    {
        return std::make_unique<D3D11CommandList>(this, mContext, commandListType);
    }

    // Helper: load entire file into memory
    static std::vector<uint8_t> loadFileBytes(const std::string& path)
    {
        std::ifstream file(path, std::ios::binary);
        if (!file)
            throw std::runtime_error("Failed to open shader file: " + path);

        return std::vector<uint8_t>(
            std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(file),
            std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    }

    ShaderBinary D3D11Device::compileShader(const ShaderDesc& desc)
    {
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Load shader source
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        std::vector<uint8_t> source = loadFileBytes(desc.filePath);

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Convert defines to D3D_SHADER_MACRO
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        std::vector<D3D_SHADER_MACRO> macros;
        macros.reserve(desc.defines.size() + 1);

        for (const auto& def : desc.defines)
        {
            D3D_SHADER_MACRO m;
            m.Name       = def.first.c_str();
            m.Definition = def.second.c_str();
            macros.push_back(m);
        }

        // Null terminator
        macros.push_back({ nullptr, nullptr });

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Choose shader profile based on stage
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        const char* profile = nullptr;

        switch (desc.stage)
        {
        case EShaderStage::Vertex:
            profile = "vs_5_0";
            break;
        case EShaderStage::Fragment:
            profile = "ps_5_0";
            break;
        case EShaderStage::Geometry:
            profile = "gs_5_0";
            break;
        case EShaderStage::Hull:
            profile = "hs_5_0";
            break;
        case EShaderStage::Domain:
            profile = "ds_5_0";
            break;

        default:
            throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported shader stage in compileShader");
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Compile using D3DCompile
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        ID3DBlob* bytecode = nullptr;
        ID3DBlob* errors   = nullptr;

        HRESULT hr = D3DCompile(
            source.data(),
            source.size(),
            desc.filePath.c_str(), // used for error messages
            macros.data(),         // preprocessor defines
            D3D_COMPILE_STANDARD_FILE_INCLUDE,
            desc.entryPoint.c_str(), // "main"
            profile,                 // "vs_5_0", "ps_5_0", ...
            D3DCOMPILE_ENABLE_STRICTNESS,
            0,
            &bytecode,
            &errors);

        if (FAILED(hr))
        {
            std::string msg = "Shader compilation failed: " + desc.filePath;

            if (errors)
            {
                msg += "\n";
                msg.append(
                    static_cast<const char*>(errors->GetBufferPointer()),
                    errors->GetBufferSize());
                errors->Release();
            }

            throw std::runtime_error(msg);
        }

        if (errors)
            errors->Release();

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Build ShaderBinary
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        ShaderBinary bin;
        bin.stage     = desc.stage;
        bin.debugName = desc.debugName;

        bin.code.assign(
            static_cast<uint8_t*>(bytecode->GetBufferPointer()),
            static_cast<uint8_t*>(bytecode->GetBufferPointer()) + bytecode->GetBufferSize());

        bytecode->Release();

        return bin;
    }

    void D3D11Device::readBuffer(IGpuBuffer* buffer,
                                 void* dst,
                                 size_t size,
                                 size_t offset)
    {
        if (!buffer || !dst || size == 0)
            return;

        auto* d3dBuf      = static_cast<D3D11Buffer*>(buffer);
        ID3D11Buffer* src = d3dBuf->getBuffer();
        if (!src)
            return;

        // Describe staging buffer
        D3D11_BUFFER_DESC desc{};
        src->GetDesc(&desc);
        desc.Usage          = D3D11_USAGE_STAGING;
        desc.BindFlags      = 0;
        desc.CPUAccessFlags = D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_READ;
        desc.MiscFlags      = 0;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Buffer> staging;
        HRESULT hr = mDevice->CreateBuffer(&desc, nullptr, staging.GetAddressOf());
        if (FAILED(hr))
            return; // or assert/log

        // Copy GPU buffer -> staging
        mContext->CopyResource(staging.Get(), src);

        // Map staging for CPU read
        D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE mapped{};
        hr = mContext->Map(staging.Get(), 0, D3D11_MAP_READ, 0, &mapped);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            return; // or assert/log

        const uint8_t* srcPtr = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(mapped.pData) + offset;
        std::memcpy(dst, srcPtr, size);

        mContext->Unmap(staging.Get(), 0);
    }

    void D3D11Device::readTexture1d(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                    void* dst,
                                    size_t rowPitch,
                                    uint32_t mipLevel)
    {
        // Simply call the 2D version with height = 1
        readTexture2d(texture, dst, rowPitch, mipLevel);
    }

    void D3D11Device::readTexture2d(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                    void* dst,
                                    size_t rowPitch,
                                    uint32_t mipLevel)
    {
        if (!texture || !dst)
            return;

        auto* d3dTex         = static_cast<D3D11Texture*>(texture);
        ID3D11Texture2D* src = d3dTex->getTexture2D();
        if (!src)
            return;

        // Describe staging texture
        D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC desc{};
        src->GetDesc(&desc);

        desc.Usage          = D3D11_USAGE_STAGING;
        desc.BindFlags      = 0;
        desc.CPUAccessFlags = D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_READ;
        desc.MiscFlags      = 0;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> staging;
        HRESULT hr = mDevice->CreateTexture2D(&desc, nullptr, staging.GetAddressOf());
        if (FAILED(hr))
            return;

        // Copy GPU texture -> staging
        UINT subresource = D3D11CalcSubresource(mipLevel, 0, desc.MipLevels);
        mContext->CopySubresourceRegion(staging.Get(), subresource, 0, 0, 0, src, subresource, nullptr);

        // Map staging for CPU read
        D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE mapped{};
        hr = mContext->Map(staging.Get(), subresource, D3D11_MAP_READ, 0, &mapped);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            return;

        uint8_t* dstBytes       = static_cast<uint8_t*>(dst);
        const uint8_t* srcBytes = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(mapped.pData);

        // Copy row by row
        for (UINT y = 0; y < desc.Height; ++y)
        {
            std::memcpy(dstBytes + y * rowPitch,
                        srcBytes + y * mapped.RowPitch,
                        rowPitch);
        }

        mContext->Unmap(staging.Get(), subresource);
    }

    void D3D11Device::readTexture3d(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                    void* dst,
                                    size_t rowPitch,
                                    size_t slicePitch,
                                    uint32_t mipLevel)
    {
        if (!texture || !dst)
            return;

        auto* d3dTex         = static_cast<D3D11Texture*>(texture);
        ID3D11Texture3D* src = d3dTex->getTexture3D();
        if (!src)
            return;

        // Describe staging texture
        D3D11_TEXTURE3D_DESC desc{};
        src->GetDesc(&desc);

        desc.Usage          = D3D11_USAGE_STAGING;
        desc.BindFlags      = 0;
        desc.CPUAccessFlags = D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_READ;
        desc.MiscFlags      = 0;

        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture3D> staging;
        HRESULT hr = mDevice->CreateTexture3D(&desc, nullptr, staging.GetAddressOf());
        if (FAILED(hr))
            return;

        UINT subresource = D3D11CalcSubresource(mipLevel, 0, desc.MipLevels);
        mContext->CopySubresourceRegion(staging.Get(), subresource, 0, 0, 0, src, subresource, nullptr);

        // Map staging for CPU read
        D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE mapped{};
        hr = mContext->Map(staging.Get(), subresource, D3D11_MAP_READ, 0, &mapped);
        if (FAILED(hr))
            return;

        uint8_t* dstBytes       = static_cast<uint8_t*>(dst);
        const uint8_t* srcBytes = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(mapped.pData);

        for (UINT z = 0; z < desc.Depth; ++z)
        {
            const uint8_t* srcSlice = srcBytes + z * mapped.DepthPitch;
            uint8_t* dstSlice       = dstBytes + z * slicePitch;

            for (UINT y = 0; y < desc.Height; ++y)
            {
                std::memcpy(dstSlice + y * rowPitch,
                            srcSlice + y * mapped.RowPitch,
                            rowPitch);
            }
        }

        mContext->Unmap(staging.Get(), subresource);
    }

    ShaderDialect D3D11Device::getShaderDialect() const
    {
        ShaderDialect dialect;
        dialect.language    = "hlsl";
        dialect.vertexExt   = "vs";
        dialect.hullExt     = "hs";
        dialect.domainExt   = "ds";
        dialect.geometryExt = "gs";
        dialect.fragmentExt = "ps";
        dialect.computeExt  = "cs";
        return dialect;
    }
}

### vislab/geometry/src/attributes.cpp
```
#include <vislab/geometry/attributes.hpp>

#include <vislab/core/iarchive.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    Attributes::Attributes() {}

    Attributes::Attributes(const Attributes& other)
    {
        mAttributes.resize(other.getSize());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mAttributes.size(); ++i)
        {
            mAttributes[i] = other.getByIndex(i).clone();
        }
    }
    Attributes::~Attributes() {}

    std::size_t Attributes::getSize() const { return mAttributes.size(); }
    void Attributes::setSize(std::size_t size) { mAttributes.resize(size); }

    std::shared_ptr<RawArray> Attributes::getByIndexShared(std::size_t index) { return mAttributes[index]; }
    std::shared_ptr<const RawArray> Attributes::getByIndexShared(std::size_t index) const { return mAttributes[index]; }

    RawArray& Attributes::getByIndex(std::size_t index) { return *mAttributes[index].get(); }
    const RawArray& Attributes::getByIndex(std::size_t index) const { return *mAttributes[index].get(); }

    RawArray* Attributes::getByName(const std::string& name)
    {
        for (auto& attr : mAttributes)
            if (attr->getName() == name)
                return attr.get();
        return NULL;
    }

    const RawArray* Attributes::getByName(const std::string& name) const
    {
        for (auto& attr : mAttributes)
            if (attr->getName() == name)
                return attr.get();
        return NULL;
    }

    std::shared_ptr<RawArray> Attributes::getByNameShared(const std::string& name)
    {
        for (auto& attr : mAttributes)
            if (attr->getName() == name)
                return attr;
        return nullptr;
    }

    std::shared_ptr<const RawArray> Attributes::getByNameShared(const std::string& name) const
    {
        for (auto& attr : mAttributes)
            if (attr->getName() == name)
                return attr;
        return nullptr;
    }

    void Attributes::setByIndexShared(std::size_t index, std::shared_ptr<RawArray> iarray)
    {
        assert(0 <= index && index < mAttributes.size());
        mAttributes[index] = iarray;
    }

    bool Attributes::has(const std::string& name) const
    {
        for (auto& attr : mAttributes)
            if (attr->getName() == name)
                return true;
        return false;
    }

    void Attributes::clear()
    {
        mAttributes.clear();
    }

    void Attributes::append(const Attributes& attributes)
    {
        assert(this->getSize() == attributes.getSize());
        for (std::size_t a = 0; a < this->getSize(); ++a)
            this->getByIndex(a).append(attributes.getByIndex(a));
    }

    void Attributes::prepend(const Attributes& attributes)
    {
        assert(this->getSize() == attributes.getSize());
        for (std::size_t a = 0; a < this->getSize(); ++a)
            this->getByIndex(a).prepend(attributes.getByIndex(a));
    }

    void Attributes::add(std::shared_ptr<RawArray> _array)
    {
        mAttributes.push_back(_array);
    }

    void Attributes::pop_front(std::size_t n)
    {
        for (std::size_t a = 0; a < this->getSize(); ++a)
            this->getByIndex(a).pop_front(n);
    }

    void Attributes::pop_back(std::size_t n)
    {
        for (std::size_t a = 0; a < this->getSize(); ++a)
            this->getByIndex(a).pop_back(n);
    }

    void Attributes::reverse()
    {
        for (std::size_t a = 0; a < this->getSize(); ++a)
            this->getByIndex(a).reverse();
    }

    bool Attributes::isEqual(const Attributes& other) const
    {
        if (this->getSize() != other.getSize())
            return false;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < other.getSize(); ++i)
            if (!this->getByIndex(i).isEqual(other.getByIndex(i)))
                return false;
        return true;
    }

    const std::string& Attributes::getName(const std::size_t& attributeIndex) const
    {
        assert(attributeIndex >= 0 && attributeIndex < mAttributes.size() && "Attribute with index does not exist.");
        return mAttributes[attributeIndex]->getName();
    }

    void Attributes::serialize(IArchive& archive)
    {
        archive("Attribute", mAttributes);
    }

    bool Attributes::isValid() const
    {
        for (std::size_t a = 0; a < this->getSize(); ++a)
            if (mAttributes[a] == nullptr)
                return false;
        return true;
    }
}

### vislab/geometry/src/vertex_normals.cpp
```
#include <vislab/geometry/vertex_normals.hpp>

#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    UpdateInfo VertexNormals::internalUpdate(ProgressInfo& progress)
    {
        // get input mesh and output mesh
        auto inMesh  = inputMesh.getData();
        auto outMesh = outputMesh.getData();

        // is there an index buffer?
        if (inMesh->getPositions().getSize() > 0 && inMesh->getIndices().getSize() == 0)
            return UpdateInfo::reportError("Mesh with positions, but without indices.");

        if (inMesh->getPositions().getNumComponents() != 3)
            return UpdateInfo::reportError("Mesh must contain three-dimensional coordinates.");

        // switch depending on mesh topology
        if (inMesh->getMeshTopology() != EMeshTopology::TriangleList)
            return UpdateInfo::reportError("Algorithm not implemented for mesh topology.");

        // copy positions, indices, attributes, and optional texcoords
        outMesh->setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology::TriangleList);
        outMesh->setPositions(inMesh->getPositions());
        outMesh->setIndexCollection(inMesh->getIndexCollection());
        outMesh->setAttributes(inMesh->getAttributes());
        outMesh->setTexCoords(inMesh->getTexCoords());
        outMesh->recomputeBoundingBox();

        // invoke the vertex normal computation
        computeNormals(*outMesh);

        progress.allJobsDone();
        return UpdateInfo::reportValid();
    }

    void VertexNormals::computeNormals(const RawArray& positions, const RawArray& indices, RawArray& normals)
    {
        // resize the normal buffer (nothing happens if it already has the right size)
        normals.setSize(positions.getSize());

        // clear the normals to zero.
        normals.setZero();

        // for each triangle
        size_t numTriangles = indices.getSize() / 3;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < numTriangles; ++i)
        {
            // get vertex positions
            uint32_t i0        = indices.getValueAs<Eigen::Vector1u>(3 * i + 0).x();
            uint32_t i1        = indices.getValueAs<Eigen::Vector1u>(3 * i + 1).x();
            uint32_t i2        = indices.getValueAs<Eigen::Vector1u>(3 * i + 2).x();
            Eigen::Vector3d p0 = positions.getValueAs<Eigen::Vector3d>(i0);
            Eigen::Vector3d p1 = positions.getValueAs<Eigen::Vector3d>(i1);
            Eigen::Vector3d p2 = positions.getValueAs<Eigen::Vector3d>(i2);

            // compute face normal (area weighted)
            Eigen::Vector3d n = (p1 - p0).cross(p2 - p0);

            // sum up on vertices
            normals.setValueAs(i0, normals.getValueAs<Eigen::Vector3d>(i0) + n);
            normals.setValueAs(i1, normals.getValueAs<Eigen::Vector3d>(i1) + n);
            normals.setValueAs(i2, normals.getValueAs<Eigen::Vector3d>(i2) + n);
        }

        // normalize all normals (area-weighted averaging)
        size_t numNormals = normals.getSize();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNormals; ++i)
        {
            Eigen::Vector3d n = normals.getValueAs<Eigen::Vector3d>(i);
            double norm       = n.norm();
            if (norm > 0)
                normals.setValueAs(i, n / norm);
        }
    }

    void VertexNormals::computeNormals(RawMesh& mesh)
    {
        computeNormals(mesh.getPositions(), mesh.getIndexCollection(), mesh.getNormals());
    }
}

### vislab/gpu/src/interfaces.cpp
```
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>

#include <fstream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace vislab
{
    ShaderBinary IGraphicsDevice::loadShader(
        EShaderStage stage,
        const std::filesystem::path& filename,
        const std::string& debugName)
    {
        ShaderBinary bin;
        bin.stage     = stage;
        bin.debugName = debugName;

        std::ifstream file(filename, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
        if (!file)
            throw std::runtime_error("Failed to open shader file: " + filename.string());

        const std::streamsize size = file.tellg();
        file.seekg(0, std::ios::beg);

        bin.code.resize(size);
        if (!file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(bin.code.data()), size))
            throw std::runtime_error("Failed to read shader file: " + filename.string());

        return bin;
    }
}

### vislab/image/src/bmp_reader.cpp
```
#include <vislab/image/bmp_reader.hpp>

#include <fstream>

namespace vislab
{
    // ==========================================================================================

    UpdateInfo BmpReader::internalUpdate(ProgressInfo& progress)
    {
        // get output
        auto image = outputImage.getData();

        // get the path parameter
        const std::string& path = paramPath.getValue();

        // open the file
        FILE* fp = fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
        if (!fp)
            return UpdateInfo::reportError("File could not be opened!");

        // reader the header information
        int width, height;
        short bit_count; // bit count per pixel (24 if no palette)
        fseek(fp, 18, SEEK_SET);
        fread(&width, sizeof(int), 1, fp);
        fread(&height, sizeof(int), 1, fp);
        fseek(fp, 28, SEEK_SET);
        fread(&bit_count, sizeof(short), 1, fp);
        fseek(fp, 54, SEEK_SET);

        // read image data as unsigned char array in [0,255]
        int width_file      = (width + 3) / 4 * 4; // Increase the width to make sure it's multiple of 4
        int size            = width_file * height;
        unsigned char* data = (unsigned char*)malloc(sizeof(unsigned char) * size * 3);
        if (!data)
            return UpdateInfo::reportError("File too large to allocate!");
        if (bit_count == 24)
            fread(data, sizeof(unsigned char), (std::size_t)size * 3, fp);
        else
            return UpdateInfo::reportError("Bit count is not 24!");
        fclose(fp);

        // copy into a Image3D object
        image->setResolution(width, height);
        int padSize = (4 - (width * 3) % 4) % 4;
        for (int iy = 0; iy < height; ++iy)
        {
            for (int ix = 0; ix < width; ++ix)
            {
                int linIndex = (iy * width + ix) * 3 + iy * padSize;
                Eigen::Vector3d color(
                    data[linIndex + 2] / 255.,
                    data[linIndex + 1] / 255.,
                    data[linIndex + 0] / 255.);
                image->setValue(ix, iy, color);
            }
        }
        free(data);

        progress.allJobsDone();
        return UpdateInfo::reportValid();
    }
}
```

### vislab/image/src/bmp_writer.cpp
```
#include <vislab/image/bmp_writer.hpp>

#include <vislab/image/image.hpp>

#include <fstream>

namespace vislab
{
    UpdateInfo BmpWriter::internalUpdate(ProgressInfo& progress)
    {
        // get the path parameter
        const std::string& path = paramPath.getValue();

        // get the input data
        auto image = inputImage.getData();
        if (image == nullptr)
            return UpdateInfo::reportError("Parameter InputImage no longer valid!");

        unsigned char file[14] = {
            'B', 'M',        // magic
            0, 0, 0, 0,      // size in bytes
            0, 0,            // app data
            0, 0,            // app data
            40 + 14, 0, 0, 0 // start of data offset
        };
        unsigned char info[40] = {
            40, 0, 0, 0,      // info hd size
            0, 0, 0, 0,       // width
            0, 0, 0, 0,       // heigth
            1, 0,             // number color planes
            24, 0,            // bits per pixel
            0, 0, 0, 0,       // compression is none
            0, 0, 0, 0,       // image bits size
            0x13, 0x0B, 0, 0, // horz resoluition in pixel / m
            0x13, 0x0B, 0, 0, // vert resolutions (0x03C3 = 96 dpi, 0x0B13 = 72 dpi)
            0, 0, 0, 0,       // #colors in pallete
            0, 0, 0, 0,       // #important colors
        };

        int w = image->getResolution().x();
        int h = image->getResolution().y();

        int padSize  = (4 - (w * 3) % 4) % 4;
        int sizeData = w * h * 3 + h * padSize;
        int sizeAll  = sizeData + sizeof(file) + sizeof(info);

        file[2] = (unsigned char)(sizeAll);
        file[3] = (unsigned char)(sizeAll >> 8);
        file[4] = (unsigned char)(sizeAll >> 16);
        file[5] = (unsigned char)(sizeAll >> 24);

        info[4] = (unsigned char)(w);
        info[5] = (unsigned char)(w >> 8);
        info[6] = (unsigned char)(w >> 16);
        info[7] = (unsigned char)(w >> 24);

        info[8]  = (unsigned char)(h);
        info[9]  = (unsigned char)(h >> 8);
        info[10] = (unsigned char)(h >> 16);
        info[11] = (unsigned char)(h >> 24);

        info[20] = (unsigned char)(sizeData);
        info[21] = (unsigned char)(sizeData >> 8);
        info[22] = (unsigned char)(sizeData >> 16);
        info[23] = (unsigned char)(sizeData >> 24);

        std::ofstream stream(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::out);
        stream.write((char*)file, sizeof(file));
        stream.write((char*)info, sizeof(info));

        unsigned char pad[3] = { 0, 0, 0 };

        for (int y = 0; y < h; y++)
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < w; x++)
            {
                // get color
                Eigen::Vector3d color = image->getValue(y * w + x);

                unsigned char pixel[3] = { 0 };
                pixel[0]               = (unsigned char)(std::min(std::max(0., color.z()), 1.) * 255);
                pixel[1]               = (unsigned char)(std::min(std::max(0., color.y()), 1.) * 255);
                pixel[2]               = (unsigned char)(std::min(std::max(0., color.x()), 1.) * 255);

                stream.write((char*)pixel, 3);
            }
            stream.write((char*)pad, padSize);
        }
        stream.close();
        progress.allJobsDone();
        return UpdateInfo::reportValid();
    }
}
```

### vislab/opengl/src/gl_command_list.cpp
```
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_command_list.hpp>

#include <vislab/opengl/gl_buffer.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_depth_stencil_view.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_pipeline.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_render_target_view.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_sampler.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_shader_resource_view.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_texture.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_unordered_access_view.hpp>

#include <assert.h>

namespace vislab
{
    static thread_local GlRenderPipeline* sCurrentPipeline = nullptr;

    void GlCommandList::replay()
    {
        assert(mCommandListType == ECommandListType::Primary);
        replayInto();
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayInto()
    {
        for (auto& cmd : mCommands)
            std::visit([&](auto& c)
                       { replayOn(c); }, cmd);
    }

    void GlCommandList::executeCommands(std::span<ICommandList* const> lists)
    {
        assert(mCommandListType == ECommandListType::Primary);

        CmdExecuteCommands cmd;
        cmd.lists.assign(lists.begin(), lists.end());
        mCommands.emplace_back(std::move(cmd));
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdBeginRenderPass& c)
    {
        auto* render = static_cast<GlRenderTargetView*>(c.renderTarget);
        auto* depth  = static_cast<GlDepthStencilView*>(c.depthTarget);

        GLuint fbo = 0;
        if (render)
            fbo = render->getFramebuffer();
        else if (depth)
            fbo = depth->getFramebuffer();

        glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, fbo);

        // Validate invariants (debug only)
#ifndef NDEBUG
        if (render && depth)
        {
            const auto& rd = render->getDesc();
            const auto& dd = depth->getDesc();

            assert(rd.width == dd.width);
            assert(rd.height == dd.height);
            assert(rd.sampleCount == dd.sampleCount);
        }
#endif

        // Attach depth dynamically
        if (render && depth)
        {
            const auto& td = depth->getDesc();

            GLenum attachment = GL_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT;
            if (td.format == ETextureFormat::D24S8 ||
                td.format == ETextureFormat::D32FS8)
            {
                attachment = GL_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT;
            }

            glFramebufferTexture2D(
                GL_FRAMEBUFFER,
                attachment,
                depth->getTarget(),
                depth->getTexture(),
                0);
        }

#ifndef NDEBUG
        GLenum status = glCheckFramebufferStatus(GL_FRAMEBUFFER);
        assert(status == GL_FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE);
#endif

        if (render)
        {
            GLenum buf = GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0;
            glDrawBuffers(1, &buf);
        }
        else
        {
            GLenum none = GL_NONE;
            glDrawBuffer(none);
            glReadBuffer(none);
        }
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn([[maybe_unused]] const CmdEndRenderPass& c)
    {
        assert(mCommandListType == ECommandListType::Primary);
        // Nothing to do; caller decides when to bind default FBO again.
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdClearRenderTargetView& c)
    {
        assert(mCommandListType == ECommandListType::Primary);

        // Assume correct FBO already bound by beginRenderPass.
        glClearColor(c.color[0], c.color[1], c.color[2], c.color[3]);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdClearDepthStencilView& c)
    {
        assert(mCommandListType == ECommandListType::Primary);

        auto* view              = static_cast<GlDepthStencilView*>(c.target);
        const TextureDesc& desc = view->getDesc();

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Save current depth/stencil write masks
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        GLboolean oldDepthMask;
        glGetBooleanv(GL_DEPTH_WRITEMASK, &oldDepthMask);

        GLint oldStencilMask;
        glGetIntegerv(GL_STENCIL_WRITEMASK, &oldStencilMask);

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Force masks ON so clear always works
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        glDepthMask(GL_TRUE);
        glStencilMask(0xFF);

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Clear depth (always)
        // Use glClearBufferfv because it IGNORES the depth mask entirely
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        GLfloat depth = c.depth;
        glClearBufferfv(GL_DEPTH, 0, &depth);

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Clear stencil only if the format actually has stencil
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        if (desc.format == ETextureFormat::D24S8 ||
            desc.format == ETextureFormat::D32FS8)
        {
            GLint stencil = c.stencil;
            glClearBufferiv(GL_STENCIL, 0, &stencil);
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Restore previous masks
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        glDepthMask(oldDepthMask);
        glStencilMask(oldStencilMask);
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdClearUnorderedAccessView& c)
    {
        assert(mCommandListType == ECommandListType::Primary);

        if (!c.target)
            return;

        auto* v = static_cast<GlUnorderedAccessView*>(c.target);

        // D3D11-style pattern replicated across 4 lanes
        const GLuint pattern[4] = {
            c.pattern, c.pattern, c.pattern, c.pattern
        };

        if (v->isBuffer())
        {
            // Clear entire buffer (OpenGL 4.5)
            glClearNamedBufferData(
                v->getHandle(),  // buffer name
                GL_R32UI,        // internal format of clear
                GL_RED_INTEGER,  // format
                GL_UNSIGNED_INT, // type
                pattern);        // data
        }
        else
        {
            // Clear entire texture level (OpenGL 4.5)
            glClearTexImage(
                v->getHandle(),  // texture name
                v->getMip(),     // mip level
                GL_RED_INTEGER,  // format
                GL_UNSIGNED_INT, // type
                pattern);        // data
        }
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdSetRenderPipeline& c)
    {
        mCurrentPipeline = static_cast<GlRenderPipeline*>(c.pipeline);
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdSetComputePipeline& c)
    {
        if (!c.pipeline)
            return;

        auto* p = static_cast<GlComputePipeline*>(c.pipeline);
        glUseProgram(p->getProgram());
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdSetVertexBuffer& c)
    {
        auto* buf = static_cast<GlBuffer*>(c.buffer);
        if (!buf)
        {
            mVertexBindings[c.slot] = {};
            return;
        }

        const auto& desc = buf->getDesc();

        mVertexBindings[c.slot].buffer = buf->getBuffer();
        mVertexBindings[c.slot].offset = 0;
        mVertexBindings[c.slot].stride = static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.stride);
    }

    static GLenum toGLIndexType(EIndexFormat fmt)
    {
        switch (fmt)
        {
        case EIndexFormat::Uint16:
            return GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT;
        case EIndexFormat::Uint32:
            return GL_UNSIGNED_INT;
        default:
            return GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT;
        }
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdSetIndexBuffer& c)
    {
        auto* buf = static_cast<GlBuffer*>(c.buffer);
        if (!buf)
        {
            mCurrentIndexBuffer = 0;
            return;
        }

        mCurrentIndexBuffer = buf->getBuffer();
        mCurrentIndexType   = toGLIndexType(buf->getDesc().indexFormat);
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdSetViewport& c)
    {
        glViewport(
            static_cast<GLint>(c.x),
            static_cast<GLint>(c.y),
            static_cast<GLsizei>(c.width),
            static_cast<GLsizei>(c.height));

        glDepthRangef(c.minDepth, c.maxDepth);
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdSetScissorRect& c)
    {
        glEnable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
        glScissor(
            static_cast<GLint>(c.x),
            static_cast<GLint>(c.y),
            static_cast<GLsizei>(c.width),
            static_cast<GLsizei>(c.height));
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdSetStencilRef& c)
    {
        mCurrentStencilRef = c.ref;
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdSetBlendFactor& c)
    {
        mCurrentBlendFactor[0] = c.factor[0];
        mCurrentBlendFactor[1] = c.factor[1];
        mCurrentBlendFactor[2] = c.factor[2];
        mCurrentBlendFactor[3] = c.factor[3];
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdSetSampleMask& c)
    {
        mCurrentSampleMask = c.mask;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Primitive topology
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    static GLenum toGLPrimitive(EPrimitiveTopology topo)
    {
        switch (topo)
        {
        case EPrimitiveTopology::PointList:
            return GL_POINTS;
        case EPrimitiveTopology::LineList:
            return GL_LINES;
        case EPrimitiveTopology::LineStrip:
            return GL_LINE_STRIP;
        case EPrimitiveTopology::TriangleList:
            return GL_TRIANGLES;
        case EPrimitiveTopology::TriangleStrip:
            return GL_TRIANGLE_STRIP;
        default:
            return GL_TRIANGLES;
        }
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdSetPrimitiveTopology& c)
    {
