```
        mCurrentPrimitiveTopology = toGLPrimitive(c.topology);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Uniform buffers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdBindUniformBuffer& c)
    {
        if (!c.buffer)
            return;

        auto* buf = static_cast<GlBuffer*>(c.buffer);
        GLuint id = buf->getBuffer();

        // GL does not distinguish stages for UBO bindings; the binding
        // point is per-program. We bind to the slot and rely on the
        // program's uniform block layout.
        glBindBufferBase(GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER, c.slot, id);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Read-only
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdBindShaderResourceView& c)
    {
        if (!c.view)
            return;

        auto* v = static_cast<GlShaderResourceView*>(c.view);

        if (v->isBuffer())
        {
            glBindBufferBase(v->getTarget(), c.slot, v->getHandle());
        }
        else
        {
            glBindTextureUnit(c.slot, v->getHandle());
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Read-write
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdBindUnorderedAccessView& c)
    {
        if (!c.view)
            return;

        auto* v = static_cast<GlUnorderedAccessView*>(c.view);

        if (v->isBuffer())
        {
            glBindBufferBase(GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER, c.slot, v->getHandle());
        }
        else
        {
            glBindImageTexture(
                c.slot,
                v->getHandle(),
                v->getMip(),
                GL_FALSE,
                v->getLayer(),
                GL_READ_WRITE,
                v->getInternalFormat());
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Samplers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdBindSampler& c)
    {
        if (!c.sampler)
            return;

        auto* s   = static_cast<GlSampler*>(c.sampler);
        GLuint ss = s->getSampler();

        // GL does not distinguish stages for samplers; they are bound
        // per texture unit. The program's sampler uniforms decide usage.
        glBindSampler(c.slot, ss);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Resolve texture (MSAA resolve / copy)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdResolveTexture& c)
    {
        if (!c.src || !c.dst)
            return;

        auto* srcTex = static_cast<GlTexture*>(c.src);
        auto* dstTex = static_cast<GlTexture*>(c.dst);

        GLuint srcId = srcTex->getTexture();
        GLuint dstId = dstTex->getTexture();
        if (!srcId || !dstId)
            return;

        const TextureDesc& srcDesc = srcTex->getDesc();

        // Create temporary FBOs for blit
        GLuint srcFbo = 0;
        GLuint dstFbo = 0;
        glGenFramebuffers(1, &srcFbo);
        glGenFramebuffers(1, &dstFbo);

        glBindFramebuffer(GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, srcFbo);
        glFramebufferTexture2D(GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER,
                               GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
                               srcTex->getTarget(),
                               srcId,
                               0);

        glBindFramebuffer(GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, dstFbo);
        glFramebufferTexture2D(GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER,
                               GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0,
                               dstTex->getTarget(),
                               dstId,
                               0);

        glBlitFramebuffer(
            0, 0,
            static_cast<GLint>(srcDesc.width),
            static_cast<GLint>(srcDesc.height),
            0, 0,
            static_cast<GLint>(srcDesc.width),
            static_cast<GLint>(srcDesc.height),
            GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
            GL_LINEAR);

        glBindFramebuffer(GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);
        glBindFramebuffer(GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

        glDeleteFramebuffers(1, &srcFbo);
        glDeleteFramebuffers(1, &dstFbo);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Buffer update
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdUpdateBuffer& c)
    {
        if (!c.buffer || !c.data || c.size == 0)
            return;

        auto* buf = static_cast<GlBuffer*>(c.buffer);
        GLuint id = buf->getBuffer();

        glNamedBufferSubData(
            id,
            static_cast<GLintptr>(c.offset),
            static_cast<GLsizeiptr>(c.size),
            c.data);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Texture updates
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    static void getUploadFormat(ETextureFormat fmt, GLenum& format, GLenum& type)
    {
        switch (fmt)
        {
        case ETextureFormat::R8:
            format = GL_RED;
            type   = GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE;
            break;

        case ETextureFormat::R16:
            format = GL_RED;
            type   = GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT;
            break;

        case ETextureFormat::R16F:
            format = GL_RED;
            type   = GL_HALF_FLOAT;
            break;

        case ETextureFormat::R32F:
            format = GL_RED;
            type   = GL_FLOAT;
            break;

        case ETextureFormat::R32U:
            format = GL_RED_INTEGER;
            type   = GL_UNSIGNED_INT;
            break;

        case ETextureFormat::R32I:
            format = GL_RED_INTEGER;
            type   = GL_INT;
            break;

        case ETextureFormat::RG8:
            format = GL_RG;
            type   = GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE;
            break;

        case ETextureFormat::RG16F:
            format = GL_RG;
            type   = GL_HALF_FLOAT;
            break;

        case ETextureFormat::RG32F:
            format = GL_RG;
            type   = GL_FLOAT;
            break;

        case ETextureFormat::RGBA8:
            format = GL_RGBA;
            type   = GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE;
            break;

        case ETextureFormat::RGBA16F:
            format = GL_RGBA;
            type   = GL_HALF_FLOAT;
            break;

        case ETextureFormat::RGBA32F:
            format = GL_RGBA;
            type   = GL_FLOAT;
            break;

        default:
            // Safe fallback
            format = GL_RGBA;
            type   = GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE;
            break;
        }
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdUpdateTexture2d& c)
    {
        if (!c.texture || !c.data)
            return;

        auto* tex               = static_cast<GlTexture*>(c.texture);
        GLuint id               = tex->getTexture();
        const TextureDesc& desc = tex->getDesc();

        const GLint level    = static_cast<GLint>(c.mipLevel);
        const GLsizei width  = static_cast<GLsizei>(std::max(1u, desc.width >> c.mipLevel));
        const GLsizei height = static_cast<GLsizei>(std::max(1u, desc.height >> c.mipLevel));

        GLenum format = 0;
        GLenum type   = 0;
        getUploadFormat(desc.format, format, type);

        glTextureSubImage2D(
            id,
            level,
            0, 0,
            width,
            height,
            format,
            type,
            c.data);
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdUpdateTexture3d& c)
    {
        if (!c.texture || !c.data)
            return;

        auto* tex               = static_cast<GlTexture*>(c.texture);
        GLuint id               = tex->getTexture();
        const TextureDesc& desc = tex->getDesc();

        const GLint level    = static_cast<GLint>(c.mipLevel);
        const GLsizei width  = static_cast<GLsizei>(std::max(1u, desc.width >> c.mipLevel));
        const GLsizei height = static_cast<GLsizei>(std::max(1u, desc.height >> c.mipLevel));
        const GLsizei depth  = static_cast<GLsizei>(std::max(1u, desc.depth >> c.mipLevel));

        GLenum format = 0;
        GLenum type   = 0;
        getUploadFormat(desc.format, format, type);

        glTextureSubImage3D(
            id,
            level,
            0, 0, 0,
            width,
            height,
            depth,
            format,
            type,
            c.data);
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdUpdateTexture1d& c)
    {
        // 1D = special case of 2D (height = 1)
        CmdUpdateTexture2d as2d{ c.texture, c.data, c.rowPitch, c.mipLevel };
        replayOn(as2d);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Draw / Dispatch
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    void GlCommandList::applyGraphicsState(bool indexed)
    {
        if (!mCurrentPipeline)
            return;

        auto* p = mCurrentPipeline;

        // Program + VAO
        glUseProgram(p->getProgram());
        glBindVertexArray(p->getVao());

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Raster state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const auto& rs = p->getRasterState();

        glFrontFace(GL_CCW);

        if (rs.cullEnable)
        {
            glEnable(GL_CULL_FACE);
            glCullFace(rs.cullFace);
        }
        else
        {
            glDisable(GL_CULL_FACE);
        }

        glPolygonMode(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, rs.polygonMode);

        if (rs.depthClampEnable)
            glEnable(GL_DEPTH_CLAMP);
        else
            glDisable(GL_DEPTH_CLAMP);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Depth state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const auto& ds = p->getDepthState();

        if (ds.depthTest)
        {
            glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
            glDepthFunc(ds.depthFunc);
        }
        else
        {
            glDisable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
        }

        glDepthMask(ds.depthWrite ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Stencil state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const auto& ss = p->getStencilState();

        if (ss.enable)
        {
            glEnable(GL_STENCIL_TEST);

            // Write masks
            glStencilMaskSeparate(GL_FRONT, ss.writeMask);
            glStencilMaskSeparate(GL_BACK, ss.writeMask);

            // Front face compare func
            glStencilFuncSeparate(GL_FRONT,
                                  ss.front.func,
                                  static_cast<GLint>(ss.reference),
                                  ss.readMask);

            // Back face compare func
            glStencilFuncSeparate(GL_BACK,
                                  ss.back.func,
                                  static_cast<GLint>(ss.reference),
                                  ss.readMask);

            // Front face ops
            glStencilOpSeparate(GL_FRONT,
                                ss.front.failOp,
                                ss.front.depthFailOp,
                                ss.front.passOp);

            // Back face ops
            glStencilOpSeparate(GL_BACK,
                                ss.back.failOp,
                                ss.back.depthFailOp,
                                ss.back.passOp);
        }
        else
        {
            glDisable(GL_STENCIL_TEST);
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Blend state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        const auto& bs = p->getBlendState();

        if (bs.alphaToCoverage)
            glEnable(GL_SAMPLE_ALPHA_TO_COVERAGE);
        else
            glDisable(GL_SAMPLE_ALPHA_TO_COVERAGE);

        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < bs.targetCount; ++i)
        {
            const auto& rt = bs.targets[i];

            if (rt.enable)
            {
                glEnablei(GL_BLEND, i);

                glBlendFuncSeparatei(i,
                                     rt.srcColor,
                                     rt.dstColor,
                                     rt.srcAlpha,
                                     rt.dstAlpha);

                glBlendEquationSeparatei(i,
                                         rt.colorOp,
                                         rt.alphaOp);
            }
            else
            {
                glDisablei(GL_BLEND, i);
            }

            glColorMaski(i,
                         rt.colorMask[0],
                         rt.colorMask[1],
                         rt.colorMask[2],
                         rt.colorMask[3]);
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Multisample state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        if (mCurrentPipeline->getMultisampleState().sampleShading)
        {
            glEnable(GL_SAMPLE_SHADING);
            glMinSampleShading(mCurrentPipeline->getMultisampleState().minSampleShading);
        }
        else
        {
            glDisable(GL_SAMPLE_SHADING);
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Dynamic OM state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        glBlendColor(mCurrentBlendFactor[0],
                     mCurrentBlendFactor[1],
                     mCurrentBlendFactor[2],
                     mCurrentBlendFactor[3]);

        glSampleMaski(0, mCurrentSampleMask);

        glStencilFuncSeparate(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK,
                              GL_ALWAYS,
                              static_cast<GLint>(mCurrentStencilRef),
                              0xFF);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Vertex buffers (VAO rebinding)
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        for (uint32_t slot = 0; slot < 8; ++slot)
        {
            const auto& vb = mVertexBindings[slot];
            if (vb.buffer != 0 && vb.stride > 0)
            {
                glBindVertexBuffer(slot,
                                   vb.buffer,
                                   vb.offset,
                                   vb.stride);
            }
        }

        if (indexed)
            glBindBuffer(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, mCurrentIndexBuffer);
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdDraw& c)
    {
        applyGraphicsState(false);

        glDrawArrays(
            mCurrentPrimitiveTopology,
            static_cast<GLint>(c.firstVertex),
            static_cast<GLsizei>(c.vertexCount));
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdDrawIndexed& c)
    {
        applyGraphicsState(true);

        glDrawElementsBaseVertex(
            mCurrentPrimitiveTopology,
            c.indexCount,
            mCurrentIndexType,
            reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(
                c.firstIndex * (mCurrentIndexType == GL_UNSIGNED_INT ? 4 : 2))),
            c.vertexOffset);
    }

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdDispatch& c)
    {
        glDispatchCompute(c.groupX, c.groupY, c.groupZ);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Execute nested command lists
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    void GlCommandList::replayOn(const CmdExecuteCommands& c)
    {
        assert(mCommandListType == ECommandListType::Primary);

        for (auto* list : c.lists)
        {
            auto* glList = static_cast<GlCommandList*>(list);
            glList->replayInto();
        }
    }

} // namespace vislab
```

### vislab/opengl/src/gl_device.cpp
```
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_device.hpp>

#include <stdexcept>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_buffer.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_command_list.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_depth_stencil_view.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_pipeline.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_render_target_view.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_sampler.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_shader_resource_view.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_swapchain.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_texture.hpp>
#include <vislab/opengl/gl_unordered_access_view.hpp>

#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>

#if defined(_WIN32) || defined(_WIN64)
extern "C"
{
    __declspec(dllexport) unsigned long NvOptimusEnablement        = 0x00000001;
    __declspec(dllexport) int AmdPowerXpressRequestHighPerformance = 1;
}
#endif

namespace vislab
{
    std::unique_ptr<GlDevice> GlDevice::create()
    {
        return std::make_unique<GlDevice>();
    }

#ifdef _DEBUG
    // convenience helper function. use when debugging.
    static void glCheck([[maybe_unused]] const char* what)
    {
        GLenum err = glGetError();
        if (err != GL_NO_ERROR)
        {
            assert(false && "OpenGL error");
        }
    }
#else
    static void glCheck(const char*) {}
#endif

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuBuffer> GlDevice::createBuffer(const BufferDesc& desc)
    {
        GLuint id = 0;
        glGenBuffers(1, &id);

        if (id == 0)
            return nullptr;

        glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, id);

        GLenum usage = GL_STATIC_DRAW;

        switch (desc.memoryType)
        {
        case EMemoryType::DeviceLocal:
            usage = GL_STATIC_DRAW;
            break;

        case EMemoryType::HostVisible:
        case EMemoryType::HostCoherent:
            usage = GL_DYNAMIC_DRAW;
            break;

        case EMemoryType::HostCached:
        case EMemoryType::Staging:
            usage = GL_STREAM_DRAW;
            break;
        }

        glBufferData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,
                     static_cast<GLsizeiptr>(desc.size),
                     desc.initialData,
                     usage);

        glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0);

        return std::make_unique<GlBuffer>(id, desc);
    }

    std::unique_ptr<ISwapchain> GlDevice::createSwapchain(
        void* windowHandle,
        const SwapchainDesc& desc)
    {
        // A valid OpenGL context must already be current.
        // We only verify that GLEW is initialized.

        static bool glewInitialized = false;

        if (!glewInitialized)
        {
            GLenum err = glewInit();
            if (err != GLEW_OK)
            {
                // glewInit() may generate a GL_INVALID_ENUM error internally.
                // We clear it to avoid confusing the user.
                glGetError();
                return nullptr;
            }

            glewInitialized = true;
        }

        // Core profile requires a VAO != 0 for any draw call.
        static GLuint sGlobalVao = 0;
        if (sGlobalVao == 0)
            glGenVertexArrays(1, &sGlobalVao);
        glBindVertexArray(sGlobalVao);

        // Generally turn on GL_MULTISAMPLE.
        glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // 1. Create color texture (the "backbuffer"), honoring sampleCount
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        const bool msaa = desc.sampleCount > 1;
        const GLenum target =
            msaa ? GL_TEXTURE_2D_MULTISAMPLE : GL_TEXTURE_2D;

        GLuint tex = 0;
        glGenTextures(1, &tex);
        glBindTexture(target, tex);

        if (msaa)
        {
            glTexImage2DMultisample(
                target,
                static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.sampleCount),
                GL_RGBA8,
                static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.width),
                static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.height),
                GL_TRUE);
        }
        else
        {
            glTexImage2D(
                target,
                0,
                GL_RGBA8,
                static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.width),
                static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.height),
                0,
                GL_RGBA,
                GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE,
                nullptr);

            glTexParameteri(target, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
            glTexParameteri(target, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
        }

        glBindTexture(target, 0);

        TextureDesc texDesc;
        texDesc.width       = desc.width;
        texDesc.height      = desc.height;
        texDesc.depth       = 1;
        texDesc.arraySize   = 1;
        texDesc.mipLevels   = 1;
        texDesc.dimension   = ETextureDimension::Tex2D;
        texDesc.format      = ETextureFormat::RGBA8;
        texDesc.sampleCount = desc.sampleCount;
        texDesc.bindFlags   = ETextureBindFlags::RenderTarget | ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource;

        auto backbuffer = std::make_unique<GlTexture>(tex, target, texDesc);

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // 2. Create texture view (owns the FBO we render into)
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        TextureViewDesc viewDesc{};
        viewDesc.format     = texDesc.format;
        viewDesc.baseMip    = 0;
        viewDesc.mipCount   = 1;
        viewDesc.baseLayer  = 0;
        viewDesc.layerCount = 1;

        auto renderTarget = std::make_unique<GlRenderTargetView>(
            tex,
            target,
            texDesc,
            viewDesc);

        // Use the view's FBO as the swapchain FBO
        GLuint fbo = renderTarget->getFramebuffer();

        if (!mSwapCallback)
            return nullptr;

        return std::make_unique<GlSwapchain>(
            std::move(backbuffer),
            std::move(renderTarget),
            fbo,
            windowHandle,
            mSwapCallback,
            desc);
    }

    static GLenum toGLInternalFormat(EBufferFormat fmt)
    {
        switch (fmt)
        {
        // 8-bit
        case EBufferFormat::R8: // treat as UNorm
        case EBufferFormat::R8UNorm:
            return GL_R8;
        case EBufferFormat::R8U:
            return GL_R8UI;
        case EBufferFormat::R8I:
            return GL_R8I;

        // 16-bit
        case EBufferFormat::R16: // treat as UNorm
        case EBufferFormat::R16UNorm:
            return GL_R16;
        case EBufferFormat::R16U:
            return GL_R16UI;
        case EBufferFormat::R16I:
            return GL_R16I;
        case EBufferFormat::R16F:
            return GL_R16F;

        // 32-bit
        case EBufferFormat::R32F:
            return GL_R32F;
        case EBufferFormat::R32U:
            return GL_R32UI;
        case EBufferFormat::R32I:
            return GL_R32I;

        // 2-channel
        case EBufferFormat::RG8:
            return GL_RG8;
        case EBufferFormat::RG16F:
            return GL_RG16F;
        case EBufferFormat::RG32F:
            return GL_RG32F;

        // 4-channel
        case EBufferFormat::RGBA8:
            return GL_RGBA8;
        case EBufferFormat::RGBA16F:
            return GL_RGBA16F;
        case EBufferFormat::RGBA32F:
            return GL_RGBA32F;
        }

        // Should never happen if enum is exhaustive
        return GL_R8;
    }

    static GLenum toGLInternalFormat(ETextureFormat fmt)
    {
        switch (fmt)
        {
        // --- 4-channel color formats ---
        case ETextureFormat::RGBA8:
            return GL_RGBA8;

        case ETextureFormat::BGRA8:
            return GL_RGBA8; // fall back!

        case ETextureFormat::RGBA16F:
            return GL_RGBA16F;

        case ETextureFormat::RGBA32F:
            return GL_RGBA32F;

        // --- 1-channel formats ---
        case ETextureFormat::R8:
            return GL_R8;

        case ETextureFormat::R16:
            return GL_R16;

        case ETextureFormat::R16F:
            return GL_R16F;

        case ETextureFormat::R32F:
            return GL_R32F;

        case ETextureFormat::R32U:
            return GL_R32UI;

        case ETextureFormat::R32I:
            return GL_R32I;

        // --- 2-channel formats ---
        case ETextureFormat::RG8:
            return GL_RG8;

        case ETextureFormat::RG16F:
            return GL_RG16F;

        case ETextureFormat::RG32F:
            return GL_RG32F;

        // --- Packed formats ---
        case ETextureFormat::R10G10B10A2:
            return GL_RGB10_A2;

        case ETextureFormat::RG11B10F:
            return GL_R11F_G11F_B10F;

        // --- Depth formats ---
        case ETextureFormat::D16:
            return GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT16;

        case ETextureFormat::D24S8:
            return GL_DEPTH24_STENCIL8;

        case ETextureFormat::D32F:
            return GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT32F;

        case ETextureFormat::D32FS8:
            return GL_DEPTH32F_STENCIL8;

        default:
            return GL_RGBA8; // safe fallback
        }
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuShaderResourceView>
    GlDevice::createShaderResourceView(IGpuBuffer* buffer,
                                       const BufferViewDesc& desc)
    {
        auto* buf = static_cast<GlBuffer*>(buffer);
        GLuint id = buf->getBuffer();

        GLenum target         = 0;
        GLenum internalFormat = 0;

        switch (desc.viewType)
        {
        case EBufferViewType::Structured:
        case EBufferViewType::Raw:
            // SSBO as SRV (read-only)
            target         = GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER;
            internalFormat = 0; // not used for SSBO
            break;

        case EBufferViewType::Typed:
            // Typed buffer SRV = GL_TEXTURE_BUFFER
            target         = GL_TEXTURE_BUFFER;
            internalFormat = toGLInternalFormat(desc.format);
            break;
        }

        return std::make_unique<GlShaderResourceView>(
            GlShaderResourceView::GlViewKind::Buffer,
            id,
            target,
            static_cast<GLintptr>(desc.offset),
            static_cast<GLsizeiptr>(desc.size),
            internalFormat);
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuUnorderedAccessView>
    GlDevice::createUnorderedAccessView(IGpuBuffer* buffer,
                                        const BufferViewDesc& desc)
    {
        auto* buf = static_cast<GlBuffer*>(buffer);
        GLuint id = buf->getBuffer();

        GLenum target         = 0;
        GLenum internalFormat = 0;

        switch (desc.viewType)
        {
        case EBufferViewType::Structured:
        case EBufferViewType::Raw:
            // SSBO UAV
            target = GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER;
            break;

        case EBufferViewType::Typed:
            // Typed UAV = GL_TEXTURE_BUFFER + image load/store
            target         = GL_TEXTURE_BUFFER;
            internalFormat = toGLInternalFormat(desc.format);
            break;
        }

        return std::make_unique<GlUnorderedAccessView>(
            GlUnorderedAccessView::GlViewKind::Buffer,
            id,
            target,
            static_cast<GLintptr>(desc.offset),
            static_cast<GLsizeiptr>(desc.size),
            internalFormat);
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuShaderResourceView>
    GlDevice::createShaderResourceView(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                       const TextureViewDesc& desc)
    {
        auto* tex = static_cast<GlTexture*>(texture);

        const TextureDesc& tdesc = tex->getDesc();
        GLenum target            = tex->getTarget();
        GLenum parentFormat      = toGLInternalFormat(tdesc.format);
        GLenum viewFormat        = toGLInternalFormat(desc.format);

        const bool fullMipRange = (desc.baseMip == 0) &&
                                  (desc.mipCount == tdesc.mipLevels);
        const bool fullLayerRange = (desc.baseLayer == 0) &&
                                    (desc.layerCount == tdesc.arraySize);
        const bool sameFormat = (viewFormat == parentFormat);

        const bool needsView = !(fullMipRange && fullLayerRange && sameFormat);

        GLuint viewId = 0;

        if (needsView)
        {
            glGenTextures(1, &viewId);

            glTextureView(viewId,
                          target,
                          tex->getTexture(),
                          viewFormat,
                          desc.baseMip,
                          desc.mipCount,
                          desc.baseLayer,
                          desc.layerCount);

            if (!desc.debugName.empty())
            {
                glObjectLabel(GL_TEXTURE,
                              viewId,
                              static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.debugName.size()),
                              desc.debugName.c_str());
            }
        }
        else
        {
            // Identity view -> reuse original texture
            viewId = tex->getTexture();
        }

        return std::make_unique<GlShaderResourceView>(
            GlShaderResourceView::GlViewKind::Texture,
            viewId,
            target,
            /*offset*/ 0,
            /*size*/ 0,
            viewFormat);
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuUnorderedAccessView>
    GlDevice::createUnorderedAccessView(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                        const TextureViewDesc& desc)
    {
        auto* tex = static_cast<GlTexture*>(texture);

        const TextureDesc& tdesc = tex->getDesc();
        GLenum target            = tex->getTarget();
        GLenum parentFormat      = toGLInternalFormat(tdesc.format);
        GLenum viewFormat        = toGLInternalFormat(desc.format);

        const bool fullMipRange = (desc.baseMip == 0) &&
                                  (desc.mipCount == tdesc.mipLevels);
        const bool fullLayerRange = (desc.baseLayer == 0) &&
                                    (desc.layerCount == tdesc.arraySize);
        const bool sameFormat = (viewFormat == parentFormat);

        const bool needsView = !(fullMipRange && fullLayerRange && sameFormat);

        GLuint viewId = 0;

        if (needsView)
        {
            glGenTextures(1, &viewId);

            glTextureView(viewId,
                          target,
                          tex->getTexture(),
                          viewFormat,
                          desc.baseMip,
                          desc.mipCount,
                          desc.baseLayer,
                          desc.layerCount);

            if (!desc.debugName.empty())
            {
                glObjectLabel(GL_TEXTURE,
                              viewId,
                              static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.debugName.size()),
                              desc.debugName.c_str());
            }
        }
        else
        {
            viewId = tex->getTexture();
        }

        return std::make_unique<GlUnorderedAccessView>(
            GlUnorderedAccessView::GlViewKind::Texture,
            viewId,
            target,
            static_cast<GLenum>(viewFormat),     // 4th param -> GLenum
            static_cast<GLint>(desc.baseMip),    // 5th param -> GLint
            static_cast<GLint>(desc.baseLayer)); // 6th param -> GLint
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuRenderTargetView>
    GlDevice::createRenderTargetView(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                     const TextureViewDesc& view)
    {
        auto* tex = static_cast<GlTexture*>(texture);

        return std::make_unique<GlRenderTargetView>(
            tex->getTexture(),
            tex->getTarget(),
            tex->getDesc(), // full texture description
            view            // full view description
        );
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuDepthStencilView>
    GlDevice::createDepthStencilView(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                     const TextureViewDesc& view)
    {
        auto* tex = static_cast<GlTexture*>(texture);

        return std::make_unique<GlDepthStencilView>(
            tex->getTexture(),
            tex->getTarget(),
            tex->getDesc(), // full texture description
            view            // full view description
        );
    }

    static void toGLTextureFormat(ETextureFormat fmt,
                                  GLenum& internalFormat,
                                  GLenum& format,
                                  GLenum& type)
    {
        switch (fmt)
        {
        // -------------------------
        // Color formats
        // -------------------------
        case ETextureFormat::RGBA8:
            internalFormat = GL_RGBA8;
            format         = GL_RGBA;
            type           = GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::BGRA8:
            internalFormat = GL_RGBA8; // storage
            format         = GL_BGRA;  // upload
            type           = GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::RGBA16F:
            internalFormat = GL_RGBA16F;
            format         = GL_RGBA;
            type           = GL_HALF_FLOAT;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::RGBA32F:
            internalFormat = GL_RGBA32F;
            format         = GL_RGBA;
            type           = GL_FLOAT;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::R8:
            internalFormat = GL_R8;
            format         = GL_RED;
            type           = GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::R16:
            internalFormat = GL_R16;
            format         = GL_RED;
            type           = GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::R16F:
            internalFormat = GL_R16F;
            format         = GL_RED;
            type           = GL_HALF_FLOAT;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::R32F:
            internalFormat = GL_R32F;
            format         = GL_RED;
            type           = GL_FLOAT;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::R32U:
            internalFormat = GL_R32UI;
            format         = GL_RED_INTEGER;
            type           = GL_UNSIGNED_INT;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::R32I:
            internalFormat = GL_R32I;
            format         = GL_RED_INTEGER;
            type           = GL_INT;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::RG8:
            internalFormat = GL_RG8;
            format         = GL_RG;
            type           = GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::RG16F:
            internalFormat = GL_RG16F;
            format         = GL_RG;
            type           = GL_HALF_FLOAT;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::RG32F:
            internalFormat = GL_RG32F;
            format         = GL_RG;
            type           = GL_FLOAT;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::R10G10B10A2:
            internalFormat = GL_RGB10_A2;
            format         = GL_RGBA;
            type           = GL_UNSIGNED_INT_2_10_10_10_REV;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::RG11B10F:
            internalFormat = GL_R11F_G11F_B10F;
            format         = GL_RGB;
            type           = GL_UNSIGNED_INT_10F_11F_11F_REV;
            return;

        // -------------------------
        // Depth formats
        // -------------------------
        case ETextureFormat::D16:
            internalFormat = GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT16;
            format         = GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT;
            type           = GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::D24S8:
            internalFormat = GL_DEPTH24_STENCIL8;
            format         = GL_DEPTH_STENCIL;
            type           = GL_UNSIGNED_INT_24_8;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::D32F:
            internalFormat = GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT32F;
            format         = GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT;
            type           = GL_FLOAT;
            return;

        case ETextureFormat::D32FS8:
            internalFormat = GL_DEPTH32F_STENCIL8;
            format         = GL_DEPTH_STENCIL;
            type           = GL_FLOAT_32_UNSIGNED_INT_24_8_REV;
            return;
        }

        // Fallback
        internalFormat = GL_RGBA8;
        format         = GL_RGBA;
        type           = GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE;
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuTexture> GlDevice::createTexture(const TextureDesc& desc)
    {
        GLuint tex = 0;
        glGenTextures(1, &tex);
        glCheck("glGenTextures");

        GLenum internalFormat = 0;
        GLenum format         = 0;
        GLenum type           = 0;
        toGLTextureFormat(desc.format, internalFormat, format, type);

        GLenum target = GL_TEXTURE_2D;
        switch (desc.dimension)
        {
        case ETextureDimension::Tex2D:
            target = (desc.sampleCount > 1) ? GL_TEXTURE_2D_MULTISAMPLE : GL_TEXTURE_2D;
            break;
        case ETextureDimension::Tex2DArray:
            target = (desc.sampleCount > 1) ? GL_TEXTURE_2D_MULTISAMPLE_ARRAY : GL_TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY;
            break;
        case ETextureDimension::TexCube:
            target = GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP;
            break;
        case ETextureDimension::TexCubeArray:
            target = GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_ARRAY;
            break;
        case ETextureDimension::Tex3D:
            target = GL_TEXTURE_3D;
            break;
        }

        glBindTexture(target, tex);
        glCheck("glBindTexture");

        const GLsizei baseW     = static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.width);
        const GLsizei baseH     = static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.height);
        const GLsizei baseD     = static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.depth);
        const GLsizei mipLevels = static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.mipLevels);

        // Immutable storage allowed only for GPU-only, non-MSAA textures
        const bool useImmutable =
            desc.memoryType == EMemoryType::DeviceLocal &&
            desc.sampleCount == 1;

        // -----------------------------
        // MSAA textures (immutable only)
        // -----------------------------
        if (target == GL_TEXTURE_2D_MULTISAMPLE ||
            target == GL_TEXTURE_2D_MULTISAMPLE_ARRAY)
        {
            assert(mipLevels == 1 && "MSAA textures cannot have mipmaps in GL");
            const GLsizei samples = static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.sampleCount);
            assert(samples > 1);

            if (target == GL_TEXTURE_2D_MULTISAMPLE)
            {
                glTexImage2DMultisample(
                    target, samples, internalFormat, baseW, baseH, GL_TRUE);
                glCheck("glTexImage2DMultisample");
            }
            else
            {
                glTexImage3DMultisample(
                    target, samples, internalFormat, baseW, baseH,
                    static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.arraySize), GL_TRUE);
                glCheck("glTexImage3DMultisample");
            }

            assert(desc.initialData == nullptr);
        }
        // -----------------------------
        // Immutable storage path
        // -----------------------------
        else if (useImmutable)
        {
            switch (target)
            {
            case GL_TEXTURE_2D:
                glTexStorage2D(target, mipLevels, internalFormat, baseW, baseH);
                break;

            case GL_TEXTURE_3D:
                glTexStorage3D(target, mipLevels, internalFormat, baseW, baseH, baseD);
                break;

            case GL_TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY:
            case GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_ARRAY:
            {
                GLsizei layers =
                    (target == GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_ARRAY)
                        ? 6 * static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.arraySize)
                        : static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.arraySize);

                glTexStorage3D(target, mipLevels, internalFormat, baseW, baseH, layers);
                break;
            }

            case GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP:
                glTexStorage2D(GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP, mipLevels, internalFormat, baseW, baseH);
                break;
            }

            glCheck("glTexStorage");

            // Upload initial data to mip 0 only
            if (desc.initialData)
            {
                if (target == GL_TEXTURE_3D)
                {
                    glTexSubImage3D(target, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                                    baseW, baseH, baseD,
                                    format, type, desc.initialData);
                }
                else if (target == GL_TEXTURE_2D)
                {
                    glTexSubImage2D(target, 0, 0, 0,
                                    baseW, baseH,
                                    format, type, desc.initialData);
                }
                else if (target == GL_TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY ||
                         target == GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_ARRAY)
                {
                    GLsizei layers =
                        (target == GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_ARRAY)
                            ? 6 * static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.arraySize)
                            : static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.arraySize);

                    glTexSubImage3D(target, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                                    baseW, baseH, layers,
                                    format, type, desc.initialData);
                }
                else if (target == GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP)
                {
                    for (int face = 0; face < 6; ++face)
                    {
                        glTexSubImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_X + face,
                                        0, 0, 0,
                                        baseW, baseH,
                                        format, type, desc.initialData);
                    }
                }

                glCheck("glTexSubImage");
            }
        }
        // -----------------------------
        // Mutable storage fallback
        // -----------------------------
        else
        {
            if (target == GL_TEXTURE_3D)
            {
                for (GLint level = 0; level < mipLevels; ++level)
                {
                    GLsizei w = std::max(1, baseW >> level);
                    GLsizei h = std::max(1, baseH >> level);
                    GLsizei d = std::max(1, baseD >> level);

                    const void* data = (level == 0) ? desc.initialData : nullptr;

                    glTexImage3D(target, level, internalFormat,
                                 w, h, d, 0, format, type, data);
                    glCheck("glTexImage3D");
                }
            }
            else if (target == GL_TEXTURE_2D)
            {
                for (GLint level = 0; level < mipLevels; ++level)
                {
                    GLsizei w = std::max(1, baseW >> level);
                    GLsizei h = std::max(1, baseH >> level);

                    const void* data = (level == 0) ? desc.initialData : nullptr;

                    glTexImage2D(target, level, internalFormat,
                                 w, h, 0, format, type, data);
                    glCheck("glTexImage2D");
                }
            }
            else if (target == GL_TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY ||
                     target == GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_ARRAY)
            {
                GLsizei layers =
                    (target == GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_ARRAY)
                        ? 6 * static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.arraySize)
                        : static_cast<GLsizei>(desc.arraySize);

                for (GLint level = 0; level < mipLevels; ++level)
                {
                    GLsizei w = std::max(1, baseW >> level);
                    GLsizei h = std::max(1, baseH >> level);

                    const void* data = (level == 0) ? desc.initialData : nullptr;

                    glTexImage3D(target, level, internalFormat,
                                 w, h, layers, 0, format, type, data);
                    glCheck("glTexImage3D");
                }
            }
            else if (target == GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP)
            {
                assert(desc.arraySize == 1);

                for (GLint level = 0; level < mipLevels; ++level)
                {
                    GLsizei w = std::max(1, baseW >> level);
                    GLsizei h = std::max(1, baseH >> level);

                    const void* data = (level == 0) ? desc.initialData : nullptr;

                    for (int face = 0; face < 6; ++face)
                    {
                        glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_X + face,
                                     level, internalFormat,
                                     w, h, 0, format, type, data);
                        glCheck("glTexImage2D Cube");
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Sampler-independent defaults
        if (target != GL_TEXTURE_2D_MULTISAMPLE &&
            target != GL_TEXTURE_2D_MULTISAMPLE_ARRAY)
        {
            glTexParameteri(target, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
            glTexParameteri(target, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
            glTexParameteri(target, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
            glTexParameteri(target, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);

            if (target == GL_TEXTURE_3D ||
                target == GL_TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY ||
                target == GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_ARRAY)
            {
                glTexParameteri(target, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_R, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
            }
        }
        glCheck("glTexParameteri");

        glBindTexture(target, 0);
        glCheck("glBindTexture(0)");

        return std::make_unique<GlTexture>(tex, target, desc);
    }

    static GLint toGLAddress(EAddressMode mode)
    {
        switch (mode)
        {
        case EAddressMode::Repeat:
            return GL_REPEAT;
        case EAddressMode::ClampToEdge:
            return GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
        case EAddressMode::ClampToBorder:
            return GL_CLAMP_TO_BORDER;
        case EAddressMode::MirrorRepeat:
            return GL_MIRRORED_REPEAT;
        default:
            return GL_REPEAT;
        }
    }

    static GLint toGLCompare(ECompareFunc f)
    {
        switch (f)
        {
        case ECompareFunc::Never:
            return GL_NEVER;
        case ECompareFunc::Less:
            return GL_LESS;
        case ECompareFunc::Equal:
            return GL_EQUAL;
        case ECompareFunc::LessEqual:
            return GL_LEQUAL;
        case ECompareFunc::Greater:
            return GL_GREATER;
        case ECompareFunc::NotEqual:
            return GL_NOTEQUAL;
        case ECompareFunc::GreaterEqual:
            return GL_GEQUAL;
        case ECompareFunc::Always:
            return GL_ALWAYS;
        default:
            return GL_ALWAYS;
        }
    }

    static void toGLFilter(const SamplerDesc& desc,
                           GLint& minFilter,
                           GLint& magFilter)
    {
        // Magnification: no mipmaps involved
        magFilter = (desc.magFilter == EFilterMode::Nearest)
                        ? GL_NEAREST
                        : GL_LINEAR;

        // Minification: depends on mipFilter
        if (desc.mipFilter == EMipFilterMode::Nearest)
        {
            minFilter = (desc.minFilter == EFilterMode::Nearest)
                            ? GL_NEAREST_MIPMAP_NEAREST
                            : GL_LINEAR_MIPMAP_NEAREST;
        }
        else // mipFilter == Linear
        {
            minFilter = (desc.minFilter == EFilterMode::Nearest)
                            ? GL_NEAREST_MIPMAP_LINEAR
                            : GL_LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR;
        }

        // BUT: if the texture has only 1 mip level, override to non-mip filters
        // (GL requires this or sampling returns 0)
        if (desc.maxLod <= 0.0f) // or if you know mipLevels == 1
        {
            minFilter = (desc.minFilter == EFilterMode::Nearest)
                            ? GL_NEAREST
                            : GL_LINEAR;
        }
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IGpuSampler> GlDevice::createSampler(const SamplerDesc& desc)
    {
        GLuint sampler = 0;
        glGenSamplers(1, &sampler);

        GLint minFilter = GL_LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR;
        GLint magFilter = GL_LINEAR;
        toGLFilter(desc, minFilter, magFilter);

        glSamplerParameteri(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, minFilter);
        glSamplerParameteri(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, magFilter);

        glSamplerParameteri(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, toGLAddress(desc.addressU));
        glSamplerParameteri(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, toGLAddress(desc.addressV));
        glSamplerParameteri(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_R, toGLAddress(desc.addressW));

        glSamplerParameterf(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_LOD_BIAS, desc.mipLodBias);
        glSamplerParameterf(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_LOD, desc.minLod);
        glSamplerParameterf(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_MAX_LOD, desc.maxLod);

        if (desc.enableAnisotropy)
        {
            const float maxAniso = static_cast<float>(std::min(desc.maxAnisotropy, 16u));
            glSamplerParameterf(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT, maxAniso);
        }
        else
        {
            glSamplerParameterf(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT, 1.0f);
        }

        if (desc.enableComparison)
        {
            glSamplerParameteri(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_COMPARE_MODE, GL_COMPARE_REF_TO_TEXTURE);
            glSamplerParameteri(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_COMPARE_FUNC, toGLCompare(desc.compareFunc));
        }
        else
        {
            glSamplerParameteri(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_COMPARE_MODE, GL_NONE);
        }

        glSamplerParameterfv(sampler, GL_TEXTURE_BORDER_COLOR, desc.borderColor);

        return std::make_unique<GlSampler>(sampler);
    }

    static GLenum toGLBlendFactor(EBlendFactor f)
    {
        switch (f)
        {
        case EBlendFactor::Zero:
            return GL_ZERO;
        case EBlendFactor::One:
            return GL_ONE;
        case EBlendFactor::SrcColor:
            return GL_SRC_COLOR;
        case EBlendFactor::OneMinusSrcColor:
            return GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_COLOR;
        case EBlendFactor::DstColor:
            return GL_DST_COLOR;
        case EBlendFactor::OneMinusDstColor:
            return GL_ONE_MINUS_DST_COLOR;
        case EBlendFactor::SrcAlpha:
            return GL_SRC_ALPHA;
        case EBlendFactor::OneMinusSrcAlpha:
            return GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA;
        case EBlendFactor::DstAlpha:
            return GL_DST_ALPHA;
        case EBlendFactor::OneMinusDstAlpha:
            return GL_ONE_MINUS_DST_ALPHA;
        default:
            return GL_ONE;
        }
    }

    static GLenum toGLBlendOp(EBlendOp op)
    {
        switch (op)
        {
        case EBlendOp::Add:
            return GL_FUNC_ADD;
        case EBlendOp::Subtract:
            return GL_FUNC_SUBTRACT;
        case EBlendOp::ReverseSubtract:
            return GL_FUNC_REVERSE_SUBTRACT;
        case EBlendOp::Min:
            return GL_MIN;
        case EBlendOp::Max:
            return GL_MAX;
        default:
            return GL_FUNC_ADD;
        }
    }

    static bool createAndAttachShader(GLuint program,
                                      GLenum stage,
                                      const ShaderBinary& bin,
                                      GLuint& outShader)
    {
        if (bin.code.empty())
            return true; // optional stage

        const GLchar* src = reinterpret_cast<const GLchar*>(bin.code.data());
        GLint length      = static_cast<GLint>(bin.code.size());

        GLuint shader = glCreateShader(stage);
        glShaderSource(shader, 1, &src, &length);
        glCompileShader(shader);

        GLint status = GL_FALSE;
        glGetShaderiv(shader, GL_COMPILE_STATUS, &status);
        if (status != GL_TRUE)
        {
            GLint logLen = 0;
            glGetShaderiv(shader, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &logLen);

            if (logLen > 1)
            {
                std::string log(logLen, '\0');
                glGetShaderInfoLog(shader, logLen, nullptr, log.data());
                std::cerr << "Shader compilation failed (" << stage << "):\n"
                          << log << std::endl;
            }

            glDeleteShader(shader);
            return false;
        }

        glAttachShader(program, shader);
        outShader = shader;
        return true;
    }

    static GLenum toGLStencilOp(EStencilOp op)
    {
        switch (op)
        {
        case EStencilOp::Keep:
            return GL_KEEP;
        case EStencilOp::Zero:
            return GL_ZERO;
        case EStencilOp::Replace:
            return GL_REPLACE;
        case EStencilOp::IncrSat:
            return GL_INCR; // saturating increment
        case EStencilOp::DecrSat:
            return GL_DECR; // saturating decrement
        case EStencilOp::Invert:
            return GL_INVERT;
        case EStencilOp::IncrWrap:
            return GL_INCR_WRAP; // wrapping increment
        case EStencilOp::DecrWrap:
            return GL_DECR_WRAP; // wrapping decrement
        }
        return GL_KEEP; // safe default
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> GlDevice::createRenderPipeline(
        const RenderPipelineDesc& desc)
    {
        GLuint program = glCreateProgram();
        if (!program)
            return nullptr;

        GLuint vs = 0, hs = 0, ds = 0, gs = 0, fs = 0;
        bool ok = true;

        if (!desc.vertexShader.code.empty())
            ok &= createAndAttachShader(program, GL_VERTEX_SHADER, desc.vertexShader, vs);
        if (!desc.hullShader.code.empty())
            ok &= createAndAttachShader(program, GL_TESS_CONTROL_SHADER, desc.hullShader, hs);
        if (!desc.domainShader.code.empty())
            ok &= createAndAttachShader(program, GL_TESS_EVALUATION_SHADER, desc.domainShader, ds);
        if (!desc.geometryShader.code.empty())
            ok &= createAndAttachShader(program, GL_GEOMETRY_SHADER, desc.geometryShader, gs);
        if (!desc.fragmentShader.code.empty())
            ok &= createAndAttachShader(program, GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER, desc.fragmentShader, fs);

        if (!ok)
        {
            if (vs)
                glDeleteShader(vs);
            if (hs)
                glDeleteShader(hs);
            if (ds)
                glDeleteShader(ds);
            if (gs)
                glDeleteShader(gs);
            if (fs)
                glDeleteShader(fs);
            glDeleteProgram(program);
            return nullptr;
        }

        glLinkProgram(program);
        glCheck("glLinkProgram");

        GLint linkStatus = GL_FALSE;
        glGetProgramiv(program, GL_LINK_STATUS, &linkStatus);
        glCheck("glGetProgramiv");

        if (linkStatus != GL_TRUE)
        {
            // Retrieve and print the link log
            GLint logLength = 0;
            glGetProgramiv(program, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &logLength);
            glCheck("glGetProgramiv(GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH)");

            if (logLength > 1)
            {
                std::string log;
                log.resize(logLength);

                glGetProgramInfoLog(program, logLength, nullptr, log.data());
                glCheck("glGetProgramInfoLog");

                std::cerr << "GL program link error (" << desc.debugName << "):\n"
                          << log << std::endl;
            }

            if (vs)
                glDeleteShader(vs);
            if (hs)
                glDeleteShader(hs);
            if (ds)
                glDeleteShader(ds);
            if (gs)
                glDeleteShader(gs);
            if (fs)
                glDeleteShader(fs);
            glDeleteProgram(program);
            glCheck("glDeleteProgram");
            return nullptr;
        }

        if (vs)
            glDeleteShader(vs);
        if (hs)
            glDeleteShader(hs);
        if (ds)
            glDeleteShader(ds);
        if (gs)
            glDeleteShader(gs);
        if (fs)
            glDeleteShader(fs);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Bake GL raster state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        GlRasterState raster = {};
        switch (desc.raster.cullMode)
        {
        case ECullMode::None:
            raster.cullEnable = GL_FALSE;
            raster.cullFace   = GL_BACK;
            break;
        case ECullMode::Front:
            raster.cullEnable = GL_TRUE;
            raster.cullFace   = GL_FRONT;
            break;
        case ECullMode::Back:
            raster.cullEnable = GL_TRUE;
            raster.cullFace   = GL_BACK;
            break;
        }
        raster.polygonMode = desc.raster.wireframe ? GL_LINE : GL_FILL;
        // depthClipEnable = true  -> depth clamp disabled
        // depthClipEnable = false -> depth clamp enabled
        raster.depthClampEnable = desc.raster.depthClipEnable ? GL_FALSE : GL_TRUE;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Bake GL depth state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        GlDepthState depth = {};
        depth.depthTest    = desc.depth.depthTest ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE;
        depth.depthWrite   = desc.depth.depthWrite ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE;
        depth.depthFunc    = toGLCompare(desc.depth.depthFunc);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Bake GL stencil state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        GlStencilState stencil = {};
        stencil.enable         = desc.stencil.enable ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE;
        stencil.readMask       = desc.stencil.readMask;
        stencil.writeMask      = desc.stencil.writeMask;
        stencil.reference      = desc.stencil.reference;

        // Front
        stencil.front.failOp      = toGLStencilOp(desc.stencil.front.failOp);
        stencil.front.depthFailOp = toGLStencilOp(desc.stencil.front.depthFailOp);
        stencil.front.passOp      = toGLStencilOp(desc.stencil.front.passOp);
        stencil.front.func        = toGLCompare(desc.stencil.front.func);

        // Back
        stencil.back.failOp      = toGLStencilOp(desc.stencil.back.failOp);
        stencil.back.depthFailOp = toGLStencilOp(desc.stencil.back.depthFailOp);
        stencil.back.passOp      = toGLStencilOp(desc.stencil.back.passOp);
        stencil.back.func        = toGLCompare(desc.stencil.back.func);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Bake GL blend state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        GlBlendState blend     = {};
        blend.alphaToCoverage  = desc.multisample.alphaToCoverage ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE;
        blend.independentBlend = (desc.blend.targetCount > 1) ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE;
        blend.targetCount      = desc.blend.targetCount;

        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < desc.blend.targetCount; ++i)
        {
            const auto& src = desc.blend.targets[i];
            auto& dst       = blend.targets[i];

            dst.enable = src.enable ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE;

            dst.colorMask[0] = (src.writeMask & 1) ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE;
            dst.colorMask[1] = (src.writeMask & 2) ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE;
            dst.colorMask[2] = (src.writeMask & 4) ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE;
            dst.colorMask[3] = (src.writeMask & 8) ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE;

            if (src.enable)
            {
                dst.srcColor = toGLBlendFactor(src.srcColor);
                dst.dstColor = toGLBlendFactor(src.dstColor);
                dst.colorOp  = toGLBlendOp(src.colorOp);

                dst.srcAlpha = toGLBlendFactor(src.srcAlpha);
                dst.dstAlpha = toGLBlendFactor(src.dstAlpha);
                dst.alphaOp  = toGLBlendOp(src.alphaOp);
            }
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Bake GL multisample state
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        GlMultisampleState multisample;
        multisample.sampleShading    = desc.multisample.sampleShading ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE;
        multisample.minSampleShading = static_cast<GLfloat>(desc.multisample.minSampleShading);

        return std::make_unique<GlRenderPipeline>(program, desc, raster, depth, stencil, blend, multisample);
    }

    static bool createAndAttachComputeShader(GLuint program,
                                             const ShaderBinary& bin,
                                             GLuint& outShader)
    {
        if (bin.code.empty())
            return false; // invalid compute pipeline

        const GLchar* src = reinterpret_cast<const GLchar*>(bin.code.data());
        GLint length      = static_cast<GLint>(bin.code.size());

        GLuint shader = glCreateShader(GL_COMPUTE_SHADER);
        glShaderSource(shader, 1, &src, &length);
        glCompileShader(shader);

        GLint status = GL_FALSE;
        glGetShaderiv(shader, GL_COMPILE_STATUS, &status);
        if (status != GL_TRUE)
        {
            glDeleteShader(shader);
            return false;
        }

        glAttachShader(program, shader);
        outShader = shader;
        return true;
    }

    std::unique_ptr<IComputePipeline> GlDevice::createComputePipeline(
        const ComputePipelineDesc& desc)
    {
        const ShaderBinary& bin = desc.computeShader;
        if (bin.code.empty())
            return nullptr;

        GLuint program = glCreateProgram();
        GLuint cs      = 0;

        if (!createAndAttachComputeShader(program, bin, cs))
        {
            glDeleteProgram(program);
            return nullptr;
        }

        glLinkProgram(program);

        GLint status = GL_FALSE;
        glGetProgramiv(program, GL_LINK_STATUS, &status);
        if (status != GL_TRUE)
        {
            glDeleteShader(cs);
            glDeleteProgram(program);
            return nullptr;
        }

        // Shader can be deleted after linking
        glDeleteShader(cs);

        return std::make_unique<GlComputePipeline>(program, desc);
    }

    std::unique_ptr<ICommandList> GlDevice::createCommandList(ECommandListType type)
    {
        return std::make_unique<GlCommandList>(this, type);
    }

    // Helper: load entire file into memory
    static std::vector<uint8_t> loadFileBytes(const std::string& path)
    {
        std::ifstream file(path, std::ios::binary);
        if (!file)
            throw std::runtime_error("Failed to open shader file: " + path);

        return std::vector<uint8_t>(
            std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(file),
            std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    }

    ShaderBinary GlDevice::compileShader(const ShaderDesc& desc)
    {
        // Load GLSL source
        std::vector<uint8_t> fileBytes = loadFileBytes(desc.filePath);
        std::string source(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(fileBytes.data()),
                           fileBytes.size());

        // Build #define block
        std::string defines;
        for (const auto& def : desc.defines)
            defines += "#define " + def.first + " " + def.second + "\n";

        // Helpers
        std::string helpers =
            "vec4 mulView(vec3 worldPos, mat4 viewMat) {return viewMat * vec4(worldPos, 1.0);} "
            "vec4 mulProj(vec4 viewPos, mat4 projMat) {vec4 clip = projMat * viewPos; clip.z = clip.z * 2.0 - clip.w; return clip;}\n";

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // 1. Extract #version
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        size_t versionPos = source.find("#version");
        std::string versionLine;
        std::string rest = source;

        if (versionPos != std::string::npos)
        {
            size_t lineEnd = source.find('\n', versionPos);
            if (lineEnd == std::string::npos)
                lineEnd = source.size();

            versionLine = source.substr(versionPos, lineEnd - versionPos);
            rest        = source.substr(lineEnd + 1);
        }
        else
        {
            versionLine = "#version 430 core";
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // 2. Extract all #extension lines from the original shader
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        std::string extensions;
        {
            std::istringstream iss(rest);
            std::string line;
            std::string newRest;

            while (std::getline(iss, line))
            {
                if (line.rfind("#extension", 0) == 0)
                {
                    extensions += line + "\n";
                }
                else
                {
                    newRest += line + "\n";
                }
            }

            rest = newRest;
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // 3. Rebuild final shader in GLSL-legal order
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        std::string finalSource;
        finalSource.reserve(source.size() + defines.size() + 128);

        finalSource += versionLine + "\n";
        finalSource += extensions; // must come immediately after #version
        finalSource += defines;    // then your injected defines
        finalSource += helpers;    // then helpers
        finalSource += rest;       // then the rest of the shader

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // 4. Package into ShaderBinary
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        ShaderBinary bin;
        bin.stage     = desc.stage;
        bin.debugName = desc.debugName;

        bin.code.assign(
            reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(finalSource.data()),
            reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(finalSource.data()) + finalSource.size());

        return bin;
    }

    void GlDevice::readBuffer(IGpuBuffer* buffer,
                              void* dst,
                              size_t size,
                              size_t offset)
    {
        if (!buffer || !dst || size == 0)
            return;

        auto* glBuf = static_cast<GlBuffer*>(buffer);
        GLuint id   = glBuf->getBuffer();
        if (id == 0)
            return;

        // Bind to a generic target for mapping
        glBindBuffer(GL_COPY_READ_BUFFER, id);

        // Map the requested range
        void* ptr = glMapBufferRange(
            GL_COPY_READ_BUFFER,
            static_cast<GLintptr>(offset),
            static_cast<GLsizeiptr>(size),
            GL_MAP_READ_BIT);

        if (!ptr)
        {
            glBindBuffer(GL_COPY_READ_BUFFER, 0);
            return;
        }

        std::memcpy(dst, ptr, size);

        glUnmapBuffer(GL_COPY_READ_BUFFER);
        glBindBuffer(GL_COPY_READ_BUFFER, 0);
    }

    void GlDevice::readTexture1d(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                 void* dst,
                                 size_t rowPitch,
                                 uint32_t mipLevel)
    {
        readTexture2d(texture, dst, rowPitch, mipLevel);
    }

    void GlDevice::readTexture2d(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                 void* dst,
                                 size_t rowPitch,
                                 uint32_t mipLevel)
    {
        if (!texture || !dst)
            return;

        auto* glTex             = static_cast<GlTexture*>(texture);
        GLuint tex              = glTex->getTexture();
        GLenum target           = glTex->getTarget();
        const TextureDesc& desc = glTex->getDesc();

        if (tex == 0)
            return;

        // Only 2D textures supported here
        if (target != GL_TEXTURE_2D && target != GL_TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY)
            return;

        // Create temporary PBO
        GLuint pbo = 0;
        glGenBuffers(1, &pbo);
        glBindBuffer(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, pbo);

        const GLsizeiptr pboSize = static_cast<GLsizeiptr>(rowPitch * desc.height);
        glBufferData(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, pboSize, nullptr, GL_STREAM_READ);

        // Read texture into PBO
        glBindTexture(target, tex);

        GLenum format = GL_RGBA;
        GLenum type   = GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE;

        // TODO: derive format/type from desc.format if needed

        glGetTexImage(target, mipLevel, format, type, 0);

        // Map PBO
        void* ptr = glMapBufferRange(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER,
                                     0,
                                     pboSize,
                                     GL_MAP_READ_BIT);

        if (!ptr)
        {
            glBindBuffer(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, 0);
            glDeleteBuffers(1, &pbo);
            return;
        }

        // Copy row-by-row
        uint8_t* dstBytes       = static_cast<uint8_t*>(dst);
        const uint8_t* srcBytes = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(ptr);

        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < desc.height; ++y)
        {
            std::memcpy(dstBytes + y * rowPitch,
                        srcBytes + y * rowPitch,
                        rowPitch);
        }

        glUnmapBuffer(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER);

        // Cleanup
        glBindBuffer(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, 0);
        glDeleteBuffers(1, &pbo);
    }

    void GlDevice::readTexture3d(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                 void* dst,
                                 size_t rowPitch,
                                 size_t slicePitch,
                                 uint32_t mipLevel)
    {
        if (!texture || !dst)
            return;

        auto* glTex             = static_cast<GlTexture*>(texture);
        GLuint tex              = glTex->getTexture();
        GLenum target           = glTex->getTarget();
        const TextureDesc& desc = glTex->getDesc();

        if (tex == 0)
            return;

        // Only handle 3D textures here
        if (target != GL_TEXTURE_3D)
            return;

        const uint32_t height = std::max(1u, desc.height >> mipLevel);
        const uint32_t depth  = std::max(1u, desc.depth >> mipLevel);

        // Create temporary PBO
        GLuint pbo = 0;
        glGenBuffers(1, &pbo);
        glBindBuffer(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, pbo);

        const GLsizeiptr pboSize = static_cast<GLsizeiptr>(slicePitch * depth);
        glBufferData(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, pboSize, nullptr, GL_STREAM_READ);

        // Bind texture and read into PBO
        glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_3D, tex);

        GLenum format = GL_RGBA;
        GLenum type   = GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE;
        // TODO: derive from desc.format if needed

        glGetTexImage(GL_TEXTURE_3D, mipLevel, format, type, 0);

        // Map PBO
        void* ptr = glMapBufferRange(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER,
                                     0,
                                     pboSize,
                                     GL_MAP_READ_BIT);

        if (!ptr)
        {
            glBindBuffer(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, 0);
            glDeleteBuffers(1, &pbo);
            return;
        }

        uint8_t* dstBytes       = static_cast<uint8_t*>(dst);
        const uint8_t* srcBytes = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(ptr);

        // Copy slice-by-slice, row-by-row
        for (uint32_t z = 0; z < depth; ++z)
        {
            const uint8_t* srcSlice = srcBytes + z * slicePitch;
            uint8_t* dstSlice       = dstBytes + z * slicePitch;

            for (uint32_t y = 0; y < height; ++y)
            {
                std::memcpy(dstSlice + y * rowPitch,
                            srcSlice + y * rowPitch,
                            rowPitch);
            }
        }

        glUnmapBuffer(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER);

        glBindBuffer(GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, 0);
        glDeleteBuffers(1, &pbo);
    }

    ShaderDialect GlDevice::getShaderDialect() const
    {
        ShaderDialect dialect;
        dialect.language    = "glsl";
        dialect.vertexExt   = "vert";
        dialect.hullExt     = "tesc";
        dialect.domainExt   = "tese";
        dialect.geometryExt = "geom";
        dialect.fragmentExt = "frag";
        dialect.computeExt  = "comp";
        return dialect;
    }
}
```

### vislab/render/src/gpu_array.cpp
```
#include <vislab/render/gpu_array.hpp>

#include <vislab/render/gpu_buffer.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_shader_resource_view.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_unordered_access_view.hpp>

#include <vislab/core/raw_array.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>

#include <stdexcept>

namespace vislab
{
    GpuArray::~GpuArray() = default;

    GpuArray::GpuArray(IGraphicsDevice* device,
                       const RawArray* cpuArray,
                       EBufferBindFlags bindFlags,
                       EMemoryType memoryType,
                       uint32_t stride,
                       EIndexFormat indexFormat,
                       bool raw,
                       const std::string& debugName)
        : mDevice(device)
        , mCpuArray(cpuArray)
    {
        if (!mDevice)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuArray: device must not be null");

        if (!mCpuArray)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuArray: cpuArray must not be null");

        mSize = mCpuArray->getSizeInBytes();

        mDesc.size        = mSize;
        mDesc.bindFlags   = bindFlags;
        mDesc.memoryType  = memoryType;
        mDesc.stride      = stride;
        mDesc.indexFormat = indexFormat;
        mDesc.raw         = raw;
        mDesc.debugName   = debugName;
        mDesc.initialData = mCpuArray->getData().data();

        mBuffer = std::make_unique<GpuBuffer>(mDevice, mDesc);

        createViewsIfNeeded();
    }

    void GpuArray::recreateBufferIfNeeded()
    {
        const size_t newSize = mCpuArray->getSizeInBytes();
        if (newSize == mSize)
            return;

        mSize             = newSize;
        mDesc.size        = mSize;
        mDesc.initialData = mCpuArray->getData().data();

        mBuffer = std::make_unique<GpuBuffer>(mDevice, mDesc);

        mSRV.reset();
        mUAV.reset();

        createViewsIfNeeded();
    }

    void GpuArray::createViewsIfNeeded()
    {
        if (!mBuffer)
            return;

        auto resolveViewType = [&]()
        {
            if (mDesc.raw)
                return EBufferViewType::Raw;
            if (mDesc.stride > 0)
                return EBufferViewType::Structured;
            return EBufferViewType::Typed;
        };

        // SRV
        if (hasFlag(mDesc.bindFlags, EBufferBindFlags::ShaderResource))
        {
            BufferViewDesc viewDesc{};
            viewDesc.debugName = mDesc.debugName + "_SRV";
            viewDesc.viewType  = resolveViewType();

            // Typed buffers: user must set viewDesc.format manually
            mSRV = std::make_unique<GpuShaderResourceView>(
                mDevice, mBuffer.get(), viewDesc);
        }

        // UAV
        if (hasFlag(mDesc.bindFlags, EBufferBindFlags::UnorderedAccess))
        {
            BufferViewDesc viewDesc{};
            viewDesc.debugName = mDesc.debugName + "_UAV";
            viewDesc.viewType  = resolveViewType();

            // Typed buffers: user must set viewDesc.format manually
            mUAV = std::make_unique<GpuUnorderedAccessView>(
                mDevice, mBuffer.get(), viewDesc);
        }
    }

    void GpuArray::update(ICommandList* cmd)
    {
        if (!cmd)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuArray::update: cmd must not be null");

        recreateBufferIfNeeded();

        cmd->updateBuffer(
            mBuffer->getHandle(),
            mCpuArray->getData().data(),
            mSize,
            0);
    }

    void GpuArray::bindSRV(EShaderStage stages,
                           uint32_t slot,
                           ICommandList* cmd) const
    {
        if (!cmd)
            return;

        if (mSRV)
        {
            cmd->bindShaderResourceView(
                stages,
                slot,
                mSRV->getHandle());
        }
    }

    void GpuArray::bindUAV(EShaderStage stages,
                           uint32_t slot,
                           ICommandList* cmd) const
    {
        if (!cmd)
            return;

        if (mUAV)
        {
            cmd->bindUnorderedAccessView(
                stages,
                slot,
                mUAV->getHandle());
        }
    }

}
```

### vislab/render/src/gpu_buffer.cpp
```
#include <vislab/render/gpu_buffer.hpp>

#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    GpuBuffer::GpuBuffer(IGraphicsDevice* device, const BufferDesc& desc)
        : Reflectable<GpuBuffer, GpuResource>()
        , mDevice(device)
        , mDesc(desc)
    {
        mBuffer = mDevice->createBuffer(mDesc);
    }

    void GpuBuffer::upload(ICommandList* cmd, const void* data, size_t size, size_t offset)
    {
        if (!data || size == 0)
            return;

        cmd->updateBuffer(mBuffer.get(), data, size, offset);
    }

    void GpuBuffer::read(void* dst, size_t size, size_t offset) const
    {
        if (!dst || size == 0)
            return;

        mDevice->readBuffer(mBuffer.get(), dst, size, offset);
    }
}
```

```
    void GpuCamera::allocate()
    {
        // Fill CPU-side data first
        fillParams();

        // Create GPU constant buffer with initial data
        mBuffer = GpuConstantBuffer<Params>(mDevice, mBuffer.getData(), "CameraBuffer");
    }

    void GpuCamera::update(ICommandList* cmd)
    {
        fillParams(); // write into mBuffer.getData()
        mBuffer.update(cmd);
    }

                         EShaderStage stages,
                         uint32_t slot) const
    {
        cmd->bindUniformBuffer(stages, slot, mBuffer.getHandle());
    }
```

```
#include <vislab/render/gpu_depth_stencil_view.hpp>

{
    GpuDepthStencilView::GpuDepthStencilView(IGraphicsDevice* device,
                                             GpuTexture2d* texture,
                                             const TextureViewDesc& viewDesc)
    {
        if (!device)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuDepthStencilView: device must not be null");
        if (!texture)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuDepthStencilView: texture2d must not be null");

        IGpuTexture* handle = texture->getHandle();
        if (!handle)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuDepthStencilView: texture2d has no valid handle");

        mView = device->createDepthStencilView(handle, viewDesc);
        if (!mView)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuDepthStencilView: failed to create DSV");
    }
}
```
