### vislab/render/src/gpu_image.cpp
```
#include <vislab/render/gpu_image.hpp>

#include <vislab/image/raw_image.hpp>

#include <stdexcept>

namespace vislab
{
    static ETextureFormat toTextureFormat(EFormat scalarFormat, int numChannels)
    {
        switch (numChannels)
        {
        case 1:
            switch (scalarFormat)
            {
            case EFormat::Float32:
                return ETextureFormat::R32F;
            case EFormat::Float64:
                return ETextureFormat::R32F; // no R64F in your enum
            case EFormat::Int16:
                return ETextureFormat::R16;
            case EFormat::Int32:
                return ETextureFormat::R32I;
            case EFormat::Int64:
                return ETextureFormat::R32I; // no R64I
            case EFormat::UInt16:
                return ETextureFormat::R16;
            case EFormat::UInt32:
                return ETextureFormat::R32U;
            case EFormat::UInt64:
                return ETextureFormat::R32U; // no R64U
            default:
                return ETextureFormat::R32F;
            }

        case 2:
            switch (scalarFormat)
            {
            case EFormat::Float32:
                return ETextureFormat::RG32F;
            case EFormat::Float64:
                return ETextureFormat::RG32F;
            case EFormat::Int16:
                return ETextureFormat::RG16F; // closest
            case EFormat::Int32:
                return ETextureFormat::RG32F; // no RG32I
            case EFormat::UInt16:
                return ETextureFormat::RG16F;
            case EFormat::UInt32:
                return ETextureFormat::RG32F; // no RG32U
            default:
                return ETextureFormat::RG32F;
            }

        case 3:
            // No RGB formats in your enum -> promote to RGBA
            switch (scalarFormat)
            {
            case EFormat::Float32:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA32F;
            case EFormat::Float64:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA32F;
            case EFormat::Int16:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA16F;
            case EFormat::Int32:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA32F;
            case EFormat::UInt16:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA16F;
            case EFormat::UInt32:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA32F;
            default:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA32F;
            }

        case 4:
            switch (scalarFormat)
            {
            case EFormat::Float32:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA32F;
            case EFormat::Float64:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA32F;
            case EFormat::Int16:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA16F;
            case EFormat::Int32:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA32F;
            case EFormat::UInt16:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA16F;
            case EFormat::UInt32:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA32F;
            default:
                return ETextureFormat::RGBA32F;
            }

        default:
            throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported channel count in RawImage.");
        }
    }

    GpuImage::GpuImage(IGraphicsDevice* device,
                       const RawImage* cpuImage,
                       ETextureBindFlags bindFlags,
                       EMemoryType memoryType,
                       const std::string& debugName)
        : mDevice(device)
        , mCpuImage(cpuImage)
        , mBindFlags(bindFlags)
    {
        if (!mDevice)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuImage: device must not be null");
        if (!mCpuImage)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuImage: RawImage must not be null");

        mWidth  = mCpuImage->getResolution().x();
        mHeight = mCpuImage->getResolution().y();

        // Build minimal TextureDesc
        TextureDesc desc{};
        desc.width       = mWidth;
        desc.height      = mHeight;
        desc.depth       = 1;
        desc.arraySize   = 1;
        desc.mipLevels   = 1;
        desc.dimension   = ETextureDimension::Tex2D;
        desc.format      = toTextureFormat(mCpuImage->getValues().getFormat(), mCpuImage->getNumChannels());
        desc.bindFlags   = bindFlags;
        desc.memoryType  = memoryType;
        desc.sampleCount = 1;

        desc.initialData       = mCpuImage->getValues().getData().data();
        desc.initialRowPitch   = mCpuImage->getRowPitch();
        desc.initialSlicePitch = 0;

        desc.debugName = debugName;

        mDesc = desc;

        recreateTextureIfNeeded();
        createViewsIfNeeded();
        createSamplerIfNeeded();
    }

    void GpuImage::recreateTextureIfNeeded()
    {
        uint32_t newWidth  = mCpuImage->getResolution().x();
        uint32_t newHeight = mCpuImage->getResolution().y();

        const bool sizeChanged = (newWidth != mWidth) || (newHeight != mHeight);

        if (!mTexture || sizeChanged)
        {
            mWidth  = newWidth;
            mHeight = newHeight;

            mDesc.width  = mWidth;
            mDesc.height = mHeight;

            mDesc.initialData       = mCpuImage->getValues().getData().data();
            mDesc.initialRowPitch   = mCpuImage->getRowPitch();

            mTexture.reset();
            mSRV.reset();
            mUAV.reset();
            mRTV.reset();
            mDSV.reset();

            mTexture = std::make_unique<GpuTexture2d>(mDevice, mDesc);

            createViewsIfNeeded();
        }
    }

    void GpuImage::createViewsIfNeeded()
    {
        if (!mTexture)
            return;

        // Sampled view
        if (hasFlag(mBindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource) && !mSRV)
        {
            TextureViewDesc viewDesc{};
            viewDesc.debugName = mDesc.debugName + "_SRV";

            mSRV = std::make_unique<GpuShaderResourceView>(
                mDevice, mTexture.get(), viewDesc);
        }

        // Storage view
        if (hasFlag(mBindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::UnorderedAccess) && !mUAV)
        {
            TextureViewDesc viewDesc{};
            viewDesc.debugName = mDesc.debugName + "_UAV";

            mUAV = std::make_unique<GpuUnorderedAccessView>(
                mDevice, mTexture.get(), viewDesc);
        }

        // Render-target view
        if (hasFlag(mBindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::RenderTarget) && !mRTV)
        {
            TextureViewDesc viewDesc{};
            viewDesc.debugName = mDesc.debugName + "_RTV";

            mRTV = std::make_unique<GpuRenderTargetView>(
                mDevice, mTexture.get(), viewDesc);
        }

        // Depth-stencil view
        if (hasFlag(mBindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::DepthStencil) && !mDSV)
        {
            TextureViewDesc viewDesc{};
            viewDesc.debugName = mDesc.debugName + "_DSV";

            mDSV = std::make_unique<GpuDepthStencilView>(
                mDevice, mTexture.get(), viewDesc);
        }
    }

    void GpuImage::createSamplerIfNeeded()
    {
        if (!hasFlag(mBindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource))
            return;

        if (!mSampler)
        {
            SamplerDesc sdesc{};
            sdesc.debugName = mDesc.debugName + "_Sampler";

            mSampler = std::make_unique<GpuSampler>(mDevice, sdesc);
        }
    }

    void GpuImage::upload(ICommandList* cmd)
    {
        if (!mTexture)
            return;

        const void* data = mCpuImage->getValues().getData().data();
        size_t rowPitch  = mCpuImage->getRowPitch();

        if (!data)
            return;

        mTexture->upload(cmd, data, rowPitch);
    }

    void GpuImage::update(ICommandList* cmd)
    {
        recreateTextureIfNeeded();
        upload(cmd);
    }

    void GpuImage::bindSampler(ICommandList* cmd, EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot) const
    {
        if (!cmd)
            return;

        if (mSampler)
            cmd->bindSampler(stages, slot, mSampler->getHandle());
    }

    void GpuImage::bindSRV(ICommandList* cmd, EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot) const
    {
        if (!cmd)
            return;

        if (mSRV)
            cmd->bindShaderResourceView(stages, slot, mSRV->getHandle());
    }

    void GpuImage::bindUAV(ICommandList* cmd, EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot) const
    {
        if (!cmd)
            return;

        if (mUAV)
            cmd->bindUnorderedAccessView(stages, slot, mUAV->getHandle());
    }

    void GpuImage::unbindSRV(ICommandList* cmd, EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot) const
    {
        if (!cmd)
            return;

        if (mSRV)
            cmd->bindShaderResourceView(stages, slot, nullptr);
    }

    void GpuImage::unbindUAV(ICommandList* cmd, EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot) const
    {
        if (!cmd)
            return;

        if (mUAV)
            cmd->bindUnorderedAccessView(stages, slot, nullptr);
    }

    void GpuImage::resize()
    {
        recreateTextureIfNeeded();
        createViewsIfNeeded();
        createSamplerIfNeeded();
    }

} // namespace vislab
```

### vislab/render/src/gpu_mesh.cpp
```
#include <vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_mesh.hpp>

#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    GpuMesh::ArrayPtr GpuMesh::makeNonOwning(GpuArray* ptr)
    {
        return ArrayPtr(ptr, ArrayDeleter{ false });
    }

    GpuMesh::ArrayPtr GpuMesh::makeOwning(GpuArray* ptr)
    {
        return ArrayPtr(ptr, ArrayDeleter{ true });
    }

    GpuMesh::GpuMesh(IGraphicsDevice* device,
                     const Mesh3f* mesh,
                     GpuResourceCache* cache)
        : mDevice(device)
        , mCache(cache)
        , mMesh(mesh)
        , mPositions(nullptr, ArrayDeleter{})
        , mNormals(nullptr, ArrayDeleter{})
        , mTexCoords(nullptr, ArrayDeleter{})
        , mIndices(nullptr, ArrayDeleter{})
    {
        if (!mMesh)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuMesh: mesh pointer must not be null");

        // Positions
        {
            auto raw = mesh->getPositions().getRawShared();
            if (raw && raw->getSize() > 0)
            {
                if (cache)
                {
                    GpuArray* ptr = cache->getOrCreate<GpuArray, RawArray>(
                        raw,
                        [&]()
                        {
                            return std::make_unique<GpuArray>(
                                device,
                                raw.get(),
                                EBufferBindFlags::Vertex,
                                EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
                                static_cast<uint32_t>(raw->getElementSizeInBytes()),
                                EIndexFormat::Uint16,
                                false,
                                "Mesh_PositionBuffer");
                        });
                    mPositions = makeNonOwning(ptr);
                }
                else
                {
                    mPositions = makeOwning(
                        new GpuArray(
                            device,
                            raw.get(),
                            EBufferBindFlags::Vertex,
                            EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
                            static_cast<uint32_t>(raw->getElementSizeInBytes()),
                            EIndexFormat::Uint16,
                            false,
                            "Mesh_PositionBuffer"));
                }
            }
        }

        // Normals
        {
            auto raw = mesh->getNormals().getRawShared();
            if (raw && raw->getSize() > 0)
            {
                if (cache)
                {
                    GpuArray* ptr = cache->getOrCreate<GpuArray, RawArray>(
                        raw,
                        [&]()
                        {
                            return std::make_unique<GpuArray>(
                                device,
                                raw.get(),
                                EBufferBindFlags::Vertex,
                                EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
                                static_cast<uint32_t>(raw->getElementSizeInBytes()),
                                EIndexFormat::Uint16,
                                false,
                                "Mesh_NormalBuffer");
                        });
                    mNormals = makeNonOwning(ptr);
                }
                else
                {
                    mNormals = makeOwning(
                        new GpuArray(
                            device,
                            raw.get(),
                            EBufferBindFlags::Vertex,
                            EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
                            static_cast<uint32_t>(raw->getElementSizeInBytes()),
                            EIndexFormat::Uint16,
                            false,
                            "Mesh_NormalBuffer"));
                }
            }
        }

        // Texcoords
        {
            auto raw = mesh->getTexCoords().getRawShared();
            if (raw && raw->getSize() > 0)
            {
                if (cache)
                {
                    GpuArray* ptr = cache->getOrCreate<GpuArray, RawArray>(
                        raw,
                        [&]()
                        {
                            return std::make_unique<GpuArray>(
                                device,
                                raw.get(),
                                EBufferBindFlags::Vertex,
                                EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
                                static_cast<uint32_t>(raw->getElementSizeInBytes()),
                                EIndexFormat::Uint16,
                                false,
                                "Mesh_TexCoordBuffer");
                        });
                    mTexCoords = makeNonOwning(ptr);
                }
                else
                {
                    mTexCoords = makeOwning(
                        new GpuArray(
                            device,
                            raw.get(),
                            EBufferBindFlags::Vertex,
                            EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
                            static_cast<uint32_t>(raw->getElementSizeInBytes()),
                            EIndexFormat::Uint16,
                            false,
                            "Mesh_TexCoordBuffer"));
                }
            }
        }

        // Attributes
        {
            const auto& attrs = mesh->getAttributes();
            mAttributes.clear();
            mAttributes.reserve(attrs.getSize());

            for (size_t i = 0; i < attrs.getSize(); ++i)
            {
                mAttributes.emplace_back(nullptr, ArrayDeleter{});

                auto raw = attrs.getByIndexShared(i);
                if (!raw || raw->getSize() == 0)
                    continue;

                if (cache)
                {
                    GpuArray* ptr = cache->getOrCreate<GpuArray, RawArray>(
                        raw,
                        [&]()
                        {
                            return std::make_unique<GpuArray>(
                                device,
                                raw.get(),
                                EBufferBindFlags::Vertex,
                                EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
                                static_cast<uint32_t>(raw->getElementSizeInBytes()),
                                EIndexFormat::Uint16,
                                false,
                                "Mesh_Attribute" + std::to_string(i));
                        });
                    mAttributes[i] = makeNonOwning(ptr);
                }
                else
                {
                    mAttributes[i] = makeOwning(
                        new GpuArray(
                            device,
                            raw.get(),
                            EBufferBindFlags::Vertex,
                            EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
                            static_cast<uint32_t>(raw->getElementSizeInBytes()),
                            EIndexFormat::Uint16,
                            false,
                            "Mesh_Attribute" + std::to_string(i)));
                }
            }
        }

        // Indices
        if (mesh->hasExplicitIndices())
        {
            auto raw = mesh->getIndexCollection().getRawShared();
            if (raw && raw->getSize() > 0)
            {
                if (cache)
                {
                    GpuArray* ptr = cache->getOrCreate<GpuArray, RawArray>(
                        raw,
                        [&]()
                        {
                            return std::make_unique<GpuArray>(
                                device,
                                raw.get(),
                                EBufferBindFlags::Index,
                                EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
                                static_cast<uint32_t>(raw->getSizeInBytes()),
                                EIndexFormat::Uint32,
                                false,
                                "Mesh_IndexBuffer");
                        });
                    mIndices = makeNonOwning(ptr);
                }
                else
                {
                    mIndices = makeOwning(
                        new GpuArray(
                            device,
                            raw.get(),
                            EBufferBindFlags::Index,
                            EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
                            static_cast<uint32_t>(raw->getSizeInBytes()),
                            EIndexFormat::Uint32,
                            false,
                            "Mesh_IndexBuffer"));
                }
            }
        }

        computeBounds();
    }

    void GpuMesh::update(ICommandList* cmd)
    {
        if (mPositions)
            mPositions->update(cmd);
        if (mNormals)
            mNormals->update(cmd);
        if (mTexCoords)
            mTexCoords->update(cmd);

        for (auto& a : mAttributes)
            if (a)
                a->update(cmd);

        if (mIndices)
            mIndices->update(cmd);

        computeBounds();
    }

    void GpuMesh::bind(ICommandList* cmd, EVertexStream streams) const
    {
        if (hasStream(streams, EVertexStream::Position) && mPositions)
            cmd->setVertexBuffer(0, mPositions->getBuffer()->getHandle());

        if (hasStream(streams, EVertexStream::Normal) && mNormals)
            cmd->setVertexBuffer(1, mNormals->getBuffer()->getHandle());

        if (hasStream(streams, EVertexStream::TexCoord) && mTexCoords)
            cmd->setVertexBuffer(2, mTexCoords->getBuffer()->getHandle());

        // Attribute streams
        for (size_t i = 0; i < mAttributes.size(); ++i)
        {
            EVertexStream flag = static_cast<EVertexStream>(1u << (3 + i));

            if (hasStream(streams, flag) && mAttributes[i])
            {
                cmd->setVertexBuffer(static_cast<uint32_t>(3 + i),
                                     mAttributes[i]->getBuffer()->getHandle());
            }
        }

        if (mIndices)
            cmd->setIndexBuffer(mIndices->getBuffer()->getHandle());
    }

    void GpuMesh::draw(ICommandList* cmd) const
    {
        if (mMesh->getPositions().getSize() == 0)
            return;

        const auto& subs = mMesh->getSubmeshes();

        switch (mMesh->getMeshTopology())
        {
        case EMeshTopology::PointList:
            cmd->setPrimitiveTopology(EPrimitiveTopology::PointList);
            break;
        case EMeshTopology::LineList:
            cmd->setPrimitiveTopology(EPrimitiveTopology::LineList);
            break;
        case EMeshTopology::LineStrip:
            cmd->setPrimitiveTopology(EPrimitiveTopology::LineStrip);
            break;
        case EMeshTopology::TriangleList:
            cmd->setPrimitiveTopology(EPrimitiveTopology::TriangleList);
            break;
        case EMeshTopology::TriangleStrip:
            cmd->setPrimitiveTopology(EPrimitiveTopology::TriangleStrip);
            break;
        default:
            throw std::runtime_error("Undefined topology.");
        }

        if (subs.getSize() > 0)
        {
            for (const auto& sm : subs)
            {
                if (mIndices)
                    cmd->drawIndexed(static_cast<uint32_t>(sm.indexCount),
                                     static_cast<uint32_t>(sm.indexOffset),
                                     0);
                else
                    cmd->draw(static_cast<uint32_t>(sm.indexCount),
                              static_cast<uint32_t>(sm.indexOffset));
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (mIndices)
            {
                const size_t indexCount = mMesh->getIndexCollection().getSize();
                cmd->drawIndexed(static_cast<uint32_t>(indexCount), 0, 0);
            }
            else
            {
                const size_t vertexCount =
                    mMesh->getPositions().getSize() > 0 ? mMesh->getPositions().getSize() : 1;

                cmd->draw(static_cast<uint32_t>(vertexCount), 0);
            }
        }
    }

    VertexLayoutDesc GpuMesh::getVertexLayout() const
    {
        VertexLayoutDesc layout;
        uint32_t location = 0;

        const Mesh3f& mesh = *mMesh;

        auto toVertexFormat = [](EFormat fmt, size_t comps) -> EVertexFormat
        {
            if (fmt == EFormat::Float32)
            {
                switch (comps)
                {
                case 1:
                    return EVertexFormat::Float32;
                case 2:
                    return EVertexFormat::Float32x2;
                case 3:
                    return EVertexFormat::Float32x3;
                case 4:
                    return EVertexFormat::Float32x4;
                }
            }
            if (fmt == EFormat::UInt32)
            {
                switch (comps)
                {
                case 1:
                    return EVertexFormat::Uint32;
                case 2:
                    return EVertexFormat::Uint32x2;
                case 3:
                    return EVertexFormat::Uint32x3;
                case 4:
                    return EVertexFormat::Uint32x4;
                }
            }
            throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported vertex format");
        };

        // Position -> slot 0
        {
            const auto& pos     = mesh.getPositions();
            const RawArray& raw = pos.getRaw();

            layout.attributes.push_back({ location++,
                                          0,
                                          0,
                                          static_cast<uint32_t>(pos.getElementSizeInBytes()),
                                          toVertexFormat(raw.getFormat(), raw.getNumComponents()) });
        }

        // Normal -> slot 1
        if (mesh.getNormals().getSize() > 0)
        {
            const auto& n       = mesh.getNormals();
            const RawArray& raw = n.getRaw();

            layout.attributes.push_back({ location++,
                                          1,
                                          0,
                                          static_cast<uint32_t>(n.getElementSizeInBytes()),
                                          toVertexFormat(raw.getFormat(), raw.getNumComponents()) });
        }

        // Texcoord -> slot 2
        if (mesh.getTexCoords().getSize() > 0)
        {
            const auto& t       = mesh.getTexCoords();
            const RawArray& raw = t.getRaw();

            layout.attributes.push_back({ location++,
                                          2,
                                          0,
                                          static_cast<uint32_t>(t.getElementSizeInBytes()),
                                          toVertexFormat(raw.getFormat(), raw.getNumComponents()) });
        }

        // Attributes -> slots 3+i
        {
            const auto& attrs = mesh.getAttributes();
            for (size_t i = 0; i < attrs.getSize(); ++i)
            {
                const RawArray& raw = attrs.getByIndex(i);
                if (raw.getSize() == 0)
                    continue;

                layout.attributes.push_back({ location++,
                                              static_cast<uint32_t>(3 + i),
                                              0,
                                              static_cast<uint32_t>(raw.getElementSizeInBytes()),
                                              toVertexFormat(raw.getFormat(), raw.getNumComponents()) });
            }
        }

        return layout;
    }

    void GpuMesh::computeBounds()
    {
        mBounds = Eigen::AlignedBox3f();

        const auto& pos = mMesh->getPositions();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < pos.getSize(); ++i)
            mBounds.extend(pos[i]);
    }

} // namespace vislab
```

#include <vislab/render/gpu_perspective_camera.hpp>
#include <vislab/scene/perspective_camera.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    GpuPerspectiveCamera::GpuPerspectiveCamera(
        IGraphicsDevice* device,
        const PerspectiveCamera* camera)
        : Reflectable<GpuPerspectiveCamera, GpuCamera>(device)
        , mCamera(camera)
    {
        allocate();
    }

    void GpuPerspectiveCamera::fillParams()
    {
        auto& p = mBuffer.getData();

        const Eigen::Matrix4d& viewD = mCamera->getView();
        const Eigen::Matrix4d& projD = mCamera->getProj();

        p.view = viewD.cast<float>();
        p.proj = projD.cast<float>();

        const Eigen::Vector3d& pos = mCamera->getPosition();
        p.cameraPosition           = pos.cast<float>();
    }
}

### vislab/render/src/gpu_regular_field.cpp
```
#include <vislab/render/gpu_regular_field.hpp>

#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_sampler.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_shader_resource_view.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_texture3d.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f::GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f(
        IGraphicsDevice* device,
        const RegularSteadyScalarField3f* field,
        ETextureBindFlags bindFlags,
        EMemoryType memoryType,
        const std::string& debugName)
        : mDevice(device)
        , mField(field)
    {
        Eigen::Vector3i res = mField->getGrid().getResolution();

        mDesc.width       = static_cast<uint32_t>(res.x());
        mDesc.height      = static_cast<uint32_t>(res.y());
        mDesc.depth       = static_cast<uint32_t>(res.z());
        mDesc.arraySize   = 1;
        mDesc.mipLevels   = 1;
        mDesc.dimension   = ETextureDimension::Tex3D;
        mDesc.format      = ETextureFormat::R32F;
        mDesc.bindFlags   = bindFlags;
        mDesc.memoryType  = memoryType;
        mDesc.sampleCount = 1;
        mDesc.debugName   = debugName;

        mDesc.initialData       = mField->getArray().getRaw().getData().data();
        mDesc.initialRowPitch   = mDesc.width * sizeof(float);
        mDesc.initialSlicePitch = mDesc.width * mDesc.height * sizeof(float);

        // Create GPU 3D texture wrapper (internally creates IGpuTexture)
        mTexture = std::make_unique<GpuTexture3d>(mDevice, mDesc);

        createViewIfNeeded();
        createSamplerIfNeeded();
    }

    GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f::~GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f() = default;

    void GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f::update(ICommandList* cmd)
    {
        recreateTextureIfNeeded();
        upload(cmd);
    }

    void GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f::bindSampler(ICommandList* cmd, EShaderStage stages, uint32_t samplerSlot) const
    {
        if (mSampler)
            cmd->bindSampler(stages, samplerSlot, mSampler->getHandle());
    }

    void GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f::bindSRV(ICommandList* cmd, EShaderStage stages, uint32_t srvSlot) const
    {
        if (mSRV)
            cmd->bindShaderResourceView(stages, srvSlot, mSRV->getHandle());
    }

    void GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f::recreateTextureIfNeeded()
    {
        Eigen::Vector3i res = mField->getGrid().getResolution();

        uint32_t newW = static_cast<uint32_t>(res.x());
        uint32_t newH = static_cast<uint32_t>(res.y());
        uint32_t newD = static_cast<uint32_t>(res.z());

        bool sizeChanged =
            (mDesc.width != newW) ||
            (mDesc.height != newH) ||
            (mDesc.depth != newD);

        mDesc.width  = newW;
        mDesc.height = newH;
        mDesc.depth  = newD;

        mDesc.initialData       = mField->getArray().getRaw().getData().data();
        mDesc.initialRowPitch   = mDesc.width * sizeof(float);
        mDesc.initialSlicePitch = mDesc.width * mDesc.height * sizeof(float);

        if (!mTexture || sizeChanged)
        {
            // Recreate GPU 3D texture wrapper (and underlying IGpuTexture)
            mTexture = std::make_unique<GpuTexture3d>(mDevice, mDesc);

            // Views depend on the texture; recreate SRV
            mSRV.reset();
            createViewIfNeeded();
        }
    }

    void GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f::upload(ICommandList* cmd)
    {
        if (!mTexture)
            return;

        const void* data  = mField->getArray().getRaw().getData().data();
        size_t rowPitch   = static_cast<size_t>(mDesc.width) * sizeof(float);
        size_t slicePitch = static_cast<size_t>(mDesc.width) *
                            static_cast<size_t>(mDesc.height) *
                            sizeof(float);

        // Upload into existing 3D texture via the wrapper
        mTexture->upload(cmd, data, rowPitch, slicePitch);
    }

    void GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f::createViewIfNeeded()
    {
        if (!mTexture)
            return;

        if (!hasFlag(mDesc.bindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource))
            return;

        TextureViewDesc view{};
        view.format     = mDesc.format;
        view.baseMip    = 0;
        view.mipCount   = 1;
        view.baseLayer  = 0;
        view.layerCount = 1;
        view.debugName  = mDesc.debugName;

        // Use the high-level SRV wrapper, which internally talks to the device
        mSRV = std::make_unique<GpuShaderResourceView>(mDevice, mTexture.get(), view);
    }

    void GpuRegularSteadyScalarField3f::createSamplerIfNeeded()
    {
        if (!hasFlag(mDesc.bindFlags, ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource))
            return;

        if (mSampler)
            return;

        SamplerDesc s{};
        s.minFilter        = EFilterMode::Linear;
        s.magFilter        = EFilterMode::Linear;
        s.mipFilter        = EMipFilterMode::Nearest; // no mipmaps in 3D field
        s.addressU         = EAddressMode::ClampToEdge;
        s.addressV         = EAddressMode::ClampToEdge;
        s.addressW         = EAddressMode::ClampToEdge;
        s.enableAnisotropy = false;
        s.debugName        = mDesc.debugName;

        // Use the high-level sampler wrapper
        mSampler = std::make_unique<GpuSampler>(mDevice, s);
    }

### vislab/render/src/gpu_texture2d.cpp

#include <vislab/render/gpu_texture2d.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    GpuTexture2d::GpuTexture2d(IGraphicsDevice* device, const TextureDesc& desc)
        : mDevice(device)
        , mDesc(desc)
    {
        if (!mDevice)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTexture2d: device must not be null");

        mTexture = mDevice->createTexture(mDesc);
        if (!mTexture)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTexture2d: failed to create texture");
    }

    void GpuTexture2d::upload(ICommandList* cmd, const void* data, size_t rowPitch)
    {
        if (!cmd)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTexture2d::upload: cmd must not be null");

        if (!data)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTexture2d::upload: data must not be null");

        // Matches previous engine behavior
        cmd->updateTexture2d(
            mTexture.get(),
            data,
            rowPitch,
            0u // mip level
        );
    }

    void GpuTexture2d::read(ICommandList* /*cmd*/, void* dst, size_t rowPitch) const
    {
        if (!mDevice)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTexture2d::read: device must not be null");

        if (!dst)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTexture2d::read: dst must not be null");

        mDevice->readTexture2d(
            mTexture.get(),
            dst,
            rowPitch,
            0u // mip level
        );
    }

} // namespace vislab

    void GpuTexture3d::upload(ICommandList* cmd,
                              const void* data,
                              size_t rowPitch,
                              size_t slicePitch)
    {
        if (!cmd)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTexture3d::upload: cmd must not be null");

        if (!data)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTexture3d::upload: data must not be null");

        // Matches engine semantics
        cmd->updateTexture3d(
            mTexture.get(),
            data,
            rowPitch,
            slicePitch,
            0u // mip level
        );
    }

    void GpuTexture3d::read(ICommandList* /*cmd*/,
                            void* dst,
                            size_t rowPitch,
                            size_t slicePitch) const
    {
        if (!mDevice)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTexture3d::read: device must not be null");

        if (!dst)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTexture3d::read: dst must not be null");

        // Matches engine semantics
        mDevice->readTexture3d(
            mTexture.get(),
            dst,
            rowPitch,
            slicePitch,
            0u // mip level
        );
    }

} // namespace vislab
```

### vislab/render/src/gpu_transfer_function.cpp
```
// gpu_transfer_function.cpp
#include <vislab/render/gpu_transfer_function.hpp>

#include <vislab/render/gpu_sampler.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_shader_resource_view.hpp>
#include <vislab/render/gpu_texture2d.hpp>

#include <vislab/core/transfer_function.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>

#include <stdexcept>

namespace vislab
{
    GpuTransferFunction::GpuTransferFunction(IGraphicsDevice* device,
                                             const TransferFunction4d* cpuTF,
                                             int resolution,
                                             const std::string& debugName)
        : Reflectable<GpuTransferFunction, GpuResource>()
        , mCpuTF(cpuTF)
        , mDevice(device)
        , mResolution(resolution)
        , mDebugName(debugName)
    {
        if (!mDevice)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTransferFunction: device must not be null");
        if (!mCpuTF)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTransferFunction: cpuTF must not be null");
        if (resolution <= 1)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTransferFunction: resolution must be > 1");

        resampleCpu(mCpuData);
        createGpuObjects(mCpuData);
    }

    GpuTransferFunction::~GpuTransferFunction() = default;

    void GpuTransferFunction::resampleCpu(std::vector<Eigen::Vector4f>& outData) const
    {
        outData.resize(mResolution);

        const double tMin = mCpuTF->getMinValue();
        const double tMax = mCpuTF->getMaxValue();

        for (int i = 0; i < mResolution; ++i)
        {
            const double t = double(i) / double(mResolution - 1);
            const double x = tMin + t * (tMax - tMin);

            const Eigen::Vector4d c = mCpuTF->map(x);
            outData[i]              = c.cast<float>();
        }
    }

    void GpuTransferFunction::createGpuObjects(const std::vector<Eigen::Vector4f>& initialData)
    {
        TextureDesc desc{};
        desc.width           = mResolution;
        desc.height          = 1;
        desc.mipLevels       = 1;
        desc.dimension       = ETextureDimension::Tex2D;
        desc.format          = ETextureFormat::RGBA32F;
        desc.bindFlags       = ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource;
        desc.memoryType      = EMemoryType::DeviceLocal;
        desc.initialData     = initialData.data();
        desc.initialRowPitch = mResolution * sizeof(Eigen::Vector4f);
        desc.debugName       = mDebugName;

        mTexture = std::make_unique<GpuTexture2d>(mDevice, desc);

        TextureViewDesc viewDesc{};
        viewDesc.format     = desc.format;
        viewDesc.baseMip    = 0;
        viewDesc.mipCount   = 1;
        viewDesc.baseLayer  = 0;
        viewDesc.layerCount = 1;
        viewDesc.debugName  = mDebugName + "_SRV";

        mSRV = std::make_unique<GpuShaderResourceView>(mDevice, mTexture.get(), viewDesc);

        SamplerDesc sdesc{};
        sdesc.minFilter = EFilterMode::Linear;
        sdesc.magFilter = EFilterMode::Linear;
        sdesc.mipFilter = EMipFilterMode::Linear;
        sdesc.addressU  = EAddressMode::ClampToEdge;
        sdesc.addressV  = EAddressMode::ClampToEdge;
        sdesc.addressW  = EAddressMode::ClampToEdge;
        sdesc.debugName = mDebugName + "_Sampler";

        mSampler = std::make_unique<GpuSampler>(mDevice, sdesc);
    }

    void GpuTransferFunction::uploadToGpu(ICommandList* cmd,
                                          const std::vector<Eigen::Vector4f>& data)
    {
        const size_t rowPitch = mResolution * sizeof(Eigen::Vector4f);
        mTexture->upload(cmd, data.data(), rowPitch);
    }

    void GpuTransferFunction::update(ICommandList* cmd)
    {
        resampleCpu(mCpuData);
        uploadToGpu(cmd, mCpuData);
    }

    void GpuTransferFunction::bind(EShaderStage stages,
                                   uint32_t slot,
                                   ICommandList* cmd) const
    {
        if (!cmd)
            return;

        cmd->bindShaderResourceView(stages, slot, mSRV->getHandle());
        cmd->bindSampler(stages, slot, mSampler->getHandle());
    }
}
```

### vislab/render/src/gpu_transform.cpp
```
#include <vislab/render/gpu_transform.hpp>

#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/scene/transform.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    GpuTransform::GpuTransform(IGraphicsDevice* device,
                               const Transform* transform)
        : Reflectable<GpuTransform, GpuResource>()
        , mTransform(transform)
        , mDevice(device)
        , mParamsBuffer(device, "TransformCB")
    {
        if (!mDevice)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTransform: device must not be null");
        if (!mTransform)
            throw std::runtime_error("GpuTransform: transform must not be null");

        fillParams();
    }

    void GpuTransform::update(ICommandList* cmd)
    {
        fillParams();
        mParamsBuffer.update(cmd);
    }

    void GpuTransform::bind(ICommandList* cmd,
                            EShaderStage stages,
                            uint32_t slot) const
    {
        cmd->bindUniformBuffer(stages, slot, mParamsBuffer.getHandle());
    }

    void GpuTransform::fillParams()
    {
        auto& p = mParamsBuffer.getData();

        p.world    = mTransform->getMatrix().cast<float>();
        p.invWorld = mTransform->getMatrixInverse().cast<float>();

        Eigen::Matrix3f normal =
            p.invWorld.topLeftCorner<3, 3>().transpose();

        p.normal.setIdentity();
        p.normal.topLeftCorner<3, 3>() = normal;
    }
}

### vislab/scene/src/camera.cpp
```
#include <vislab/scene/camera.hpp>

#include <vislab/core/iarchive.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    Camera::Camera()
        : mPosition(1, 0, 0)
        , mLookAt(0, 0, 0)
        , mUp(0, 0, 1)
        , mView(Eigen::Matrix4d::Identity())
    {
        updateViewMatrix();
    }

    const Eigen::Matrix4d& Camera::getView() const { return mView; }
    const Eigen::Vector3d& Camera::getPosition() const { return mPosition; }
    const Eigen::Vector3d& Camera::getLookAt() const { return mLookAt; }
    const Eigen::Vector3d& Camera::getUp() const { return mUp; }

    void Camera::setPosition(const Eigen::Vector3d& Position)
    {
        mPosition = Position;
        updateViewMatrix();
    }

    void Camera::setLookAt(const Eigen::Vector3d& LookAt)
    {
        mLookAt = LookAt;
        updateViewMatrix();
    }

    void Camera::setUp(const Eigen::Vector3d& Up)
    {
        mUp = Up;
        updateViewMatrix();
    }

    Eigen::AlignedBox3d Camera::getViewspaceAABB(const Eigen::AlignedBox3d& box) const
    {
        Eigen::AlignedBox3d resBox;
        resBox.setEmpty();
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
        {
            Eigen::Vector3d corner    = box.corner((Eigen::AlignedBox3d::CornerType)i);
            Eigen::Vector4d vrcCorner = mView * Eigen::Vector4d(corner.x(), corner.y(), corner.z(), 1);
            vrcCorner /= vrcCorner.w();
            resBox.extend(vrcCorner.xyz());
        }
        return resBox;
    }

    void Camera::serialize(IArchive& archive)
    {
        archive("Position", mPosition);
        archive("LookAt", mLookAt);
        archive("Up", mUp);
        archive("View", mView);
    }

    void Camera::updateViewMatrix()
    {
        mView = Eigen::Matrix4d::lookAtLH(mPosition, mLookAt, mUp);
        markChanged();
    }
}

        {
            mHorizontalFieldOfView = hfov;
            updateProjMatrix();
        }
    }

### vislab/scene/src/projective_camera.cpp
```
#include <vislab/scene/projective_camera.hpp>

//#include <vislab/graphics/interaction.hpp>
//#include <vislab/graphics/ray.hpp>

#include <vislab/core/iarchive.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    ProjectiveCamera::ProjectiveCamera()
        : mProj(Eigen::Matrix4d::Identity())
        , mNear(0.01)
        , mFar(1.0)
        , mWidth(1.0)
        , mHeight(1.0)
    {
    }

    const Eigen::Matrix4d& ProjectiveCamera::getProj() const { return mProj; }
    double ProjectiveCamera::getNear() const { return mNear; }
    double ProjectiveCamera::getFar() const { return mFar; }
    double ProjectiveCamera::getWidth() const { return mWidth; }
    double ProjectiveCamera::getHeight() const { return mHeight; }
    double ProjectiveCamera::getAspectRatio() const { return mWidth / mHeight; }

    void ProjectiveCamera::setNear(double near)
    {
        if (mNear != near)
        {
            mNear = near;
            updateProjMatrix();
        }
    }

    void ProjectiveCamera::setFar(double far)
    {
        if (mFar != far)
        {
            mFar = far;
            updateProjMatrix();
        }
    }

    void ProjectiveCamera::setWidth(double width)
    {
        if (mWidth != width)
        {
            mWidth = width;
            updateProjMatrix();
        }
    }

    void ProjectiveCamera::setHeight(double height)
    {
        if (mHeight != height)
        {
            mHeight = height;
            updateProjMatrix();
        }
    }

    Eigen::Vector2d ProjectiveCamera::project(const Eigen::Vector3d& coord) const
    {
        Eigen::Vector4d p   = Eigen::Vector4d(coord.x(), coord.y(), coord.z(), 1);
        Eigen::Vector4d npc = mProj * (mView * p);
        npc /= npc.w();
        return Eigen::Vector2d(
            (npc.x() * 0.5 + 0.5) * mWidth,
            (-npc.y() * 0.5 + 0.5) * mHeight);
    }

    Eigen::Vector3d ProjectiveCamera::unproject(const Eigen::Vector3d& coord) const
    {
        const double viewport_minx = 0;
        const double viewport_miny = 0;
        Eigen::Matrix4d matrix     = mProj * mView;
        Eigen::Vector3d v(
            (((coord.x() - viewport_minx) / mWidth) * 2.0) - 1.0,
            -((((coord.y() - viewport_miny) / mHeight) * 2.0) - 1.0),
            (coord.z() - mNear) / (mFar - mNear));
        Eigen::Vector4d vv = matrix.inverse() * Eigen::Vector4d(v.x(), v.y(), v.z(), 1);
        return vv.xyz() / vv.w();
    }

    void ProjectiveCamera::serialize(IArchive& archive)
    {
        Camera::serialize(archive);
        archive("Near", mNear);
        archive("Far", mFar);
        archive("Width", mWidth);
        archive("Height", mHeight);
        archive("Proj", mProj);
    }
}

### vislab/scene/src/transform.cpp
```
#include <vislab/scene/transform.hpp>

#include <vislab/core/iarchive.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    Transform::Transform()
        : mMatrix(Eigen::Matrix4d::Identity())
        , mMatrixInverse(Eigen::Matrix4d::Identity())
    {
    }
    Transform::Transform(const Eigen::Matrix4d& matrix)
        : mMatrix(matrix)
        , mMatrixInverse(matrix.inverse())
    {
    }

    Transform::Transform(const Eigen::Vector3d& translation, const Eigen::Quaterniond& rotation, const Eigen::Vector3d& scale)
    {
        mMatrix       = Eigen::Matrix4d::diag(scale);
        mMatrix(3, 3) = 1.0;
        mMatrix.block(0, 0, 3, 3) *= rotation.toRotationMatrix();
        mMatrix.block(0, 3, 3, 1) = translation;
        mMatrixInverse            = mMatrix.inverse();
    }

    const Eigen::Matrix4d& Transform::getMatrix() const { return mMatrix; }
    const Eigen::Matrix4d& Transform::getMatrixInverse() const { return mMatrixInverse; }

    void Transform::setMatrix(const Eigen::Matrix4d& matrix)
    {
        mMatrix        = matrix;
        mMatrixInverse = matrix.inverse();
        markChanged();
        onChanged(mMatrix);
    }

    void Transform::serialize(IArchive& archive)
    {
        archive("Matrix", mMatrix);
        archive("MatrixInverse", mMatrixInverse);
    }

    Eigen::Vector3d Transform::transformPoint(const Eigen::Vector3d& point) const
    {
        Eigen::Vector4d p4 = mMatrix * Eigen::Vector4d(point.x(), point.y(), point.z(), 1.);
        return p4.xyz() / p4.w();
    }

    Eigen::Vector3d Transform::transformVector(const Eigen::Vector3d& direction) const
    {
        return mMatrix.block(0, 0, 3, 3) * direction;
    }

    Eigen::Vector3d Transform::transformNormal(const Eigen::Vector3d& normal) const
    {
        return (mMatrixInverse.block(0, 0, 3, 3).transpose() * normal).stableNormalized();
    }

    /*Ray3d Transform::transformRay(const Ray3d& ray) const
    {
        Ray3d result     = ray;
        result.origin    = transformPoint(ray.origin);
        result.direction = transformVector(ray.direction);
        return result;
    }*/

    Eigen::Vector3d Transform::transformPointInverse(const Eigen::Vector3d& point) const
    {
        Eigen::Vector4d p4 = mMatrixInverse * Eigen::Vector4d(point.x(), point.y(), point.z(), 1.);
        return p4.xyz() / p4.w();
    }

    Eigen::Vector3d Transform::transformVectorInverse(const Eigen::Vector3d& direction) const
    {
        return mMatrixInverse.block(0, 0, 3, 3) * direction;
    }

    Eigen::AlignedBox3d Transform::transformBox(const Eigen::AlignedBox3d& oob) const
    {
        Eigen::AlignedBox3d aabb;
        aabb.setEmpty();
        aabb.extend(transformPoint(oob.corner(Eigen::AlignedBox3d::CornerType::BottomLeftFloor)));
        aabb.extend(transformPoint(oob.corner(Eigen::AlignedBox3d::CornerType::BottomRightFloor)));
        aabb.extend(transformPoint(oob.corner(Eigen::AlignedBox3d::CornerType::TopLeftFloor)));
        aabb.extend(transformPoint(oob.corner(Eigen::AlignedBox3d::CornerType::TopRightFloor)));
        aabb.extend(transformPoint(oob.corner(Eigen::AlignedBox3d::CornerType::BottomLeftCeil)));
        aabb.extend(transformPoint(oob.corner(Eigen::AlignedBox3d::CornerType::BottomRightCeil)));
        aabb.extend(transformPoint(oob.corner(Eigen::AlignedBox3d::CornerType::TopLeftCeil)));
        aabb.extend(transformPoint(oob.corner(Eigen::AlignedBox3d::CornerType::TopRightCeil)));
        return aabb;
    }
}

### scivis/1_point/shaders/glsl/spheres.frag
```
﻿#version 430 core
#extension GL_ARB_sample_shading : require

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Constants
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
const vec3 COLOR_A = vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);
const vec3 COLOR_B = vec3(1.0, 0.2, 0.1);

const vec3 LIGHT_DIR = normalize(vec3(0.3, 0.6, 0.7));
const float AMBIENT = 0.3;

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CameraBuffer
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 0) uniform CameraBuffer {
    mat4 uView;
    mat4 uProj;
    vec3 uCameraPos;
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ConstantBuffer
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 1) uniform ConstantBuffer {
    float uRadiusScale;
    float uDataMin;
    float uDataMax;
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Input from geometry shader
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
sample in vec4 ClipPos;
sample in vec3 WorldPos;
sample in vec3 CenterWS;
sample in float Radius;
sample in float Data;

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Output
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(location = 0) out vec4 outColor;

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO: Implement raysphere intersection here
// For now, this is just a stub so the shader compiles.
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool IntersectRaySphere(vec3 o, vec3 l, vec3 c, float r, out vec2 d)
{
    d = vec2(0.0); 

    float b = dot(l, o - c);
    float c_coeff = dot(o - c, o - c) - r * r;
    float discrim = b * b - c_coeff;
    
    if (discrim < 0.0) {
        return false;
    }

    float t_pos = -b + sqrt(discrim); 
    float t_neg = -b - sqrt(discrim);

    if (t_pos < 0.0 && t_neg < 0.0) {
        return false;
    }
    else if (t_neg < 0.0) {
        d = vec2(t_pos, 0.0);
        return true;
    }
    else {
        d = vec2(t_neg, 0.0);
        return true;
    }
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
void main()
{
    // TODO 1: Construct the ray
    vec3 origin = uCameraPos;
    vec3 dir    = normalize(WorldPos - origin);

    // TODO 2: Raysphere intersection
    vec2 d;
    bool hit = IntersectRaySphere(origin, dir, CenterWS, Radius, d);
    
    if (!hit) {
        discard;
    }

    // TODO 3: Compute hit point and normal
    vec3 hitWS  = origin + (d.x * dir); 
    vec3 normal = normalize(hitWS - CenterWS); 

    // TODO 4: Color mapping
    float s = (Data - uDataMin) / (uDataMax - uDataMin);
    s = clamp(s, 0.0, 1.0);
    vec3 color = (1.0 - s) * COLOR_A + s * COLOR_B;

    // TODO 5: Shading
    float D = max(0.0, dot(normal, LIGHT_DIR));
    vec3 shaded = color * (AMBIENT + D);                 
    outColor = vec4(shaded, 1.0);

    // TODO 6: Depth writing
    vec4 hitView = mulView(hitWS, uView);
    vec4 h_clip = mulProj(hitView, uProj);
    gl_FragDepth = h_clip.z / h_clip.w;
}
```

### scivis/1_point/shaders/glsl/spheres.geom
```
#version 430 core

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CameraBuffer
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 0) uniform CameraBuffer {
    mat4 uView;
    mat4 uProj;
    vec3 uCameraPos;
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ConstantBuffer
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 1) uniform ConstantBuffer {
    float uRadiusScale;
    float uDataMin;
    float uDataMax;
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Input from vertex shader
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(points) in;

in VS_OUT {
    vec4 WorldPos;
    float Radius;
    float Data;
} gs_in[];

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Output to fragment shader
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(triangle_strip, max_vertices = 4) out;

sample out vec4 ClipPos;
sample out vec3 WorldPos;
sample out vec3 CenterWS;
sample out float Radius;
sample out float Data;

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
void main()
{
    vec3 centerWS = gs_in[0].WorldPos.xyz;
    float r       = gs_in[0].Radius;
    float data    = gs_in[0].Data;

    float splatRadius = r * sqrt(2.0);
    
    vec3 camWS = uCameraPos;

    vec3 forward = normalize(centerWS - camWS);
    vec3 upRef   = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);

    if (abs(dot(forward, upRef)) > 0.99)
        upRef = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);

    vec3 right = normalize(cross(forward, upRef));
    vec3 up    = normalize(cross(right, forward));

    vec3 offsets[4] = vec3[4](
        (-right - up) * splatRadius,
        (-right + up) * splatRadius,
        ( right - up) * splatRadius,
        ( right + up) * splatRadius
    );

    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    {
        vec3 cornerWS = centerWS + offsets[i];

        WorldPos = cornerWS;
        CenterWS = centerWS;
        Radius   = r;
        Data     = data;

        vec4 viewPos = mulView(cornerWS, uView);
        ClipPos = mulProj(viewPos, uProj);

        gl_Position = ClipPos;

        EmitVertex();
    }

    EndPrimitive();
}
```

};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    float Radius;
    float Data;
} vs_out;

// Main
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
void main()
{
    vs_out.WorldPos = vec4(inPosition, 1.0);

    // reverse the range, since low potential corresponds to web structure
    float reverseData = 1 - inData;

    // normalize data to target range
    float normalizedData = min(max(0, ((reverseData - uDataMin) / (uDataMax - uDataMin))), 1);

    vs_out.Radius   = normalizedData * uRadiusScale;
    vs_out.Data     = normalizedData;
    
    gl_Position = vec4(inPosition, 1.0); // placeholder to keep pipeline valid
}

### scivis/2_volren/shaders/glsl/volren.frag
```
#version 430 core

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Constant Buffers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 0) uniform CameraUBO {
    mat4 uView;
    mat4 uProj;
    vec3 uCameraPos;
    float _pad0;
};

layout(std140, binding = 1) uniform VolumeUBO {
    vec3 uDomainMin;
    float uStepSize;

    vec3 uDomainMax;
    float uTfMin;

    float uTfMax;
    int   uEnableShadows;
    float uExtinctionScale;
    float _pad1;
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Textures and Samplers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(binding = 0) uniform sampler3D volumeTex;
layout(binding = 1) uniform sampler2D transferTex;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Input / Output
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
in VS_OUT {
    vec4 clipPos;
    vec3 tex;    // [0,1]^3 cube coords
    vec3 world;  // world-space cube coords
} fs_in;

layout(location = 0) out vec4 outColor;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Sample scalar field (world -> texture)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
float sampleDensityWorld(vec3 worldPos)
{
    vec3 tx = (worldPos - uDomainMin) / (uDomainMax - uDomainMin);
    return textureLod(volumeTex, tx, 0.0).r;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 1: Transfer function sampling
// Implement windowing, TF lookup, and exponential extinction.
// Return color (rgb) and alpha_src in .a.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
vec4 sampleTF(float density, float stepSize)
{
    // Map density to [0,1] using uTfMin/uTfMax
    float s = clamp((density - uTfMin) / (uTfMax - uTfMin), 0.0, 1.0);
    
    // Sample transferTex
    vec4 tf = textureLod(transferTex, vec2(s, 0.5), 0.0);
    
    // Compute alpha_src using Beer-Lambert law
    float sigma_t = tf.a * uExtinctionScale;
    float alpha_src = 1.0 - exp(-sigma_t * stepSize);
    
    // Return vec4(color_src, alpha_src)
    return vec4(tf.rgb, alpha_src);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Ray-box intersection (given)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
bool intersectDomainBox(vec3 origin, vec3 dir, out float tMin, out float tMax)
{
    vec3 invD = 1.0 / dir;

    vec3 t0 = (uDomainMin - origin) * invD;
    vec3 t1 = (uDomainMax - origin) * invD;

    vec3 tmin3 = min(t0, t1);
    vec3 tmax3 = max(t0, t1);

    tMin = max(max(tmin3.x, tmin3.y), tmin3.z);
    tMax = min(min(tmax3.x, tmax3.y), tmax3.z);

    return tMax > tMin;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 3: Shadow ray integration
// March along the light direction and accumulate transmittance.
// Use sampleTF to obtain alpha_src.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
float integrateShadowRayWorld(vec3 origin, vec3 dir)
{
    float tMin, tMax;
    if (!intersectDomainBox(origin, dir, tMin, tMax))
        return 1.0; // no intersection -> fully lit

    float t = max(tMin, 3.0 * uStepSize); // add small offset to avoid self-shadowing
    float shadowStepSize = uStepSize * 2.0; // coarser steps for shadows

    float T_L = 1.0; // accumulated light transmittance
    const float shadowThreshold = 0.01; // stop when fully shadowed

    // Implement shadow ray marching
    while (t < tMax && T_L > shadowThreshold)
    {
        vec3 pos = origin + t * dir;
        float density = sampleDensityWorld(pos);
        
        // Note: passing shadowStepSize here, not uStepSize
        vec4 tf_res = sampleTF(density, shadowStepSize);
        float a_src = tf_res.a;
        
        // Update transmittance
        T_L *= (1.0 - a_src);
        
        // Advance shadow ray
        t += shadowStepSize;
    }

    return T_L;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 2: Primary ray integration
// Implement front-to-back compositing using transmittance form:
//   C_dst += a_dst * a_src * C_src
//   a_dst *= (1 - a_src)
// Use sampleTF() and optionally integrateShadowRayWorld().
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct VolumeResult {
    vec3 color;  // accumulated color C_dst
    float alpha; // accumulated transmittance a_dst
};

VolumeResult integratePrimaryRayWorld(vec3 origin, vec3 dir, float tStart, float tEnd)
{
    VolumeResult res;
    res.color = vec3(0.0);  // C_dst: accumulated color
    res.alpha = 1.0;        // a_dst: accumulated transmittance (starts at 1)

    float t = tStart;       // current distance along the ray
    const float transmittanceThreshold = 0.01; // stop when almost opaque

    vec3 lightDirWorld = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, -1.0)); // fixed light direction

    while (t < tEnd && res.alpha > transmittanceThreshold)
    {
        // Compute sample position
        vec3 pos = origin + t * dir;

        // Sample density
        float density = sampleDensityWorld(pos);

        // Call sampleTF to get (C_src, a_src)
        vec4 tf_res = sampleTF(density, uStepSize);
        vec3 C_src = tf_res.rgb;
        float a_src = tf_res.a;

        // Optional single-scattering shadowing
        if (uEnableShadows == 1 && a_src < 0.99)
        {
            // Compute light transmittance from shadow ray
            float T_L = integrateShadowRayWorld(pos, lightDirWorld);
            // Modulate color by shadow factor T_L
            C_src *= T_L;
        }

        // Apply front-to-back compositing formulas
        res.color += res.alpha * a_src * C_src;
        res.alpha *= (1.0 - a_src);

        // Advance ray
        t += uStepSize;
    }

    return res;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main Fragment Shader
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void main()
{
    // Ray origin is the camera position
    vec3 rayOrigin = uCameraPos;

    // Ray direction from camera toward the cube surface (in world space)
    vec3 rayDir = normalize(fs_in.world - uCameraPos);

    // Compute entry/exit distances for ray-box intersection
    float tMin, tMax;
    intersectDomainBox(rayOrigin, rayDir, tMin, tMax);

    // If no valid intersection interval, return empty pixel
    if (tMax <= tMin)
    {
        outColor = vec4(0.0);
        return;
    }

    // Clamp start to avoid marching behind the camera
    float tStart = max(tMin, 0.0);
    float tEnd   = tMax;

    // TODO 2: Remove the next two lines!
    //outColor = vec4(fs_in.tex, 1.0);
    //return;

    // Perform front-to-back volume ray marching
    VolumeResult vr = integratePrimaryRayWorld(rayOrigin, rayDir, tStart, tEnd);

    // If transmittance stayed at 1, nothing contributed -> fully transparent
    if (vr.alpha == 1.0)
    {
        outColor = vec4(0.0);
        return;
    }

    // Convert accumulated color + transmittance into final premultiplied output
    outColor = vec4(vr.color / (1.0 - vr.alpha), 1.0 - vr.alpha);
}
```

### scivis/3_isocontour/shaders/glsl/isocontour.frag
```
#version 430 core

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Constant Buffers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 0) uniform CameraUBO {
    mat4 uView;
    mat4 uProj;
    vec3 uCameraPos;
    float _pad0;
};

layout(std140, binding = 1) uniform VolumeUBO {
    vec3  uDomainMin;
    float uStepSize;

    vec3  uDomainMax;
    float uIsovalue;

    float uLightAngle;
    int   uEnableShadows;
    int   uRefinementIterations;
    float _pad1;
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Textures and Samplers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(binding = 0) uniform sampler3D volumeTex;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Input / Output
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
in VS_OUT {
    vec4 clipPos;
    vec3 tex;    // [0,1]^3 cube coords
    vec3 world;  // world-space cube coords
} fs_in;

layout(location = 0) out vec4 outColor;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Sample scalar field (world -> texture)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
float sampleDensityWorld(vec3 worldPos)
{
    vec3 tx = (worldPos - uDomainMin) / (uDomainMax - uDomainMin);
    return textureLod(volumeTex, tx, 0.0).r;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Ray-box intersection
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
bool intersectDomainBox(vec3 origin, vec3 dir, out float tMin, out float tMax)
{
    vec3 invD = 1.0 / dir;

    vec3 t0 = (uDomainMin - origin) * invD;
    vec3 t1 = (uDomainMax - origin) * invD;

    vec3 tmin3 = min(t0, t1);
    vec3 tmax3 = max(t0, t1);

    tMin = max(max(tmin3.x, tmin3.y), tmin3.z);
    tMax = min(min(tmax3.x, tmax3.y), tmax3.z);

    return tMax > tMin;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Isosurface helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Signed distance to isosurface
float sampleIso(vec3 p)
{
    return sampleDensityWorld(p) - uIsovalue;
}

bool hasSignChange(float dPrev, float dCurr)
{
    return dPrev * dCurr <= 0.0;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 2: Hit refinement via bisection
// Refine the isosurface hit within [ta, tb] using uRefinementIterations
// iterations of the bisection method. Return the refined tHit.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
float refineIsoHitBisection(vec3 origin, vec3 dir, float ta, float tb, float da, float db)
{
    // TODO 2: implement bisection refinement
    float currentTa = ta;   // ray distance
    float currentTb = tb;   // ray distance
    float currentDa = da;   // signed function at t_a i.e. g(t_a)

    for (int i = 0; i < uRefinementIterations; ++i)
    {
        float tm = (currentTa + currentTb) / 2;
        float dm = sampleIso(origin + tm * dir);    // signed function at t_m i.e. g(t_m)

        if (hasSignChange(currentDa, dm)) {     // checks for g(t_a)*g(t_m) <= 0
            currentTb = tm;     // if sign change; true isosurface in left half of window; new interval [t_a, t_m]
        }
        else {
            currentTa = tm;
            currentDa = dm;
        }
    }
    return (currentTa + currentTb) / 2; // replaced placeholder with refined result
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 3: Normal computation
// Compute the density gradient using central differences with step size
// uStepSize and return the normalized negative gradient.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
vec3 computeNormal(vec3 p)
{
    // TODO 3: compute central differences and normalize
    float h = uStepSize;

    float gradX = sampleDensityWorld(p + vec3(h, 0.0, 0.0)) - sampleDensityWorld(p - vec3(h, 0.0, 0.0));
    float gradY = sampleDensityWorld(p + vec3(0.0, h, 0.0)) - sampleDensityWorld(p - vec3(0.0, h, 0.0));
    float gradZ = sampleDensityWorld(p + vec3(0.0, 0.0, h)) - sampleDensityWorld(p - vec3(0.0, 0.0, h));

    vec3 grad = vec3(gradX, gradY, gradZ);

    if (length(grad) > 0.0) {   // sampling uniform region of value => differences = 0, grad = 0 (result: invalid normal)
        return normalize(-grad);    // points vector point outward
    }
    return vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); // default fallback vector if local field is uniform
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 4: Shadow ray traversal
// Cast a ray toward the light direction and determine whether the isosurface
// is encountered again before leaving the volume.
// Return 0.0 if in shadow, 1.0 if fully lit.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
float traceShadowRay(vec3 origin, vec3 dir, float stepSize)
{
    // TODO 4: implement shadow ray traversal
    float tMin, tMax;

    if (!intersectDomainBox(origin, dir, tMin, tMax)) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    float tStart = 2.0 * stepSize;
    float tEnd = tMax;

    float t = tStart;
    while (t < tEnd)
    {
        vec3 p = origin + t * dir;
        if (sampleDensityWorld(p) >= uIsovalue) {   // if true, means hit an opaque contruction
                                                    // e.g. jaw bone blocking light from neck
            return 0.0;
        }
        t += stepSize;  // point is empty air, advanced to next zone
    }
    return 1.0; // replaced placeholder with fully lit status
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 5: Shading
// Compute Lambertian shading using the normal and light direction.
// If shadows are enabled, modulate the result by the shadow factor.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
vec3 shadeIsoPoint(vec3 pHit, vec3 lightDirWorld)
{
    // TODO 5: implement shading (normal, Lambert term, optional shadows)
    vec3 normal = computeNormal(pHit);

    float lambert = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDirWorld));

    vec3 baseColor = vec3(1.0);     // white base color
    vec3 color = baseColor * lambert;

    if (uEnableShadows != 0) {
        float shadowFactor = traceShadowRay(pHit, lightDirWorld, uStepSize);
        color *= shadowFactor;
    }
    return color; // replaced placeholder with computed shade color
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 1: Primary ray integration (isosurface detection)
// March along the ray inside the volume, detect the first sign change of
// g(t) = f(x(t)) - uIsovalue, refine the hit, and shade it.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct IsoResult {
    vec3 color;
    bool hit;
};

IsoResult integrateIsoRayWorld(vec3 origin, vec3 dir, float tStart, float tEnd)
{
    IsoResult res;
    res.color = vec3(0.0);
    res.hit   = false;

    // Compute light direction from angle parameter
    float a = uLightAngle * 6.28318; // 2*pi
    vec3 lightDirWorld = normalize(vec3(cos(a), sin(a), -1.0));

    // TODO 1:
    // - march along the ray in steps of uStepSize
    // - evaluate sampleIso along the ray
    // - detect the first interval [ta, tb] with a sign change
    // - refine the hit using refineIsoHitBisection()
    // - compute the hit position and shade it using shadeIsoPoint()
    // - set res.hit and res.color accordingly

    float t = tStart;
    float dPrev = sampleIso(origin + t * dir);

    while (t < tEnd)
    {
        float tNext = t + uStepSize;
        if (tNext > tEnd)
            tNext = tEnd;

        float dNext = sampleIso(origin + tNext * dir);

        if (hasSignChange(dPrev, dNext))
        {
            float tHit = refineIsoHitBisection(origin, dir, t, tNext, dPrev, dNext);
            vec3 pHit = origin + tHit * dir;

            res.hit = true;
            res.color = shadeIsoPoint(pHit, lightDirWorld);
            break;  // Stop casting. Only first visible surface required
        }

        t = tNext;
        dPrev = dNext;
    }

    return res;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main Fragment Shader
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void main()
{
    vec3 rayOrigin = uCameraPos;
    vec3 rayDir    = normalize(fs_in.world - uCameraPos);

    float tMin, tMax;
    intersectDomainBox(rayOrigin, rayDir, tMin, tMax);

    if (tMax <= tMin)
    {
        outColor = vec4(0.0);
        return;
    }

    float tStart = max(tMin, 0.0);
    float tEnd   = tMax;

    IsoResult iso = integrateIsoRayWorld(rayOrigin, rayDir, tStart, tEnd);

    if (!iso.hit)
    {
        outColor = vec4(0.0);
        return;
    }

    outColor = vec4(iso.color, 1.0);
}
```

### scivis/4_critical/shaders/glsl/critical.frag

#version 430 core

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CameraBuffer
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 0) uniform CameraBuffer
{
    mat4 uView;
    mat4 uProj;
    vec3 uCameraPos;
    float _pad0;
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TransformBuffer
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

{
    mat4 uWorld;
    mat4 uInvWorld;
    mat4 uNormal;
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ColorBuffer
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 2) uniform ColorBuffer
{
    vec3 uColor;
    float _pad1;
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Input from vertex shader
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
in vec3 vWorldPos;
in vec3 vNormalWS;

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Output
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
out vec4 fragColor;

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Constants
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
const vec3 LIGHT_DIR = normalize(vec3(0.3, 0.6, 0.7));
const float AMBIENT  = 0.3;

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
void main()
{
    vec3 N = normalize(vNormalWS);
    vec3 L = LIGHT_DIR;

    float NdotL = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
    vec3 shaded = uColor * (AMBIENT + NdotL);

    fragColor = vec4(shaded, 1.0);
}

### scivis/5_lines/shaders/glsl/lines.frag
```
#version 430 core

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Constant Buffers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 1) uniform ColorUBO {
    vec4  uColor;       // base color
    float uTimeOffset;  // controls animation speed
    float uLength;      // controls length of streamlet
    float _pad1;        // std140 alignment
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Input / Output
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
in VS_OUT {
    vec4 clipPos;
    vec3 viewPos;
    vec3 viewTangent;
    float time;
} fs_in;

layout(location = 0) out vec4 outColor;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void main()
{
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TODO 4: Compute vectors
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TODO: normalize the view-space tangent of the streamline
    vec3 T = normalize(fs_in.viewTangent);

    // TODO: normalize the view-space position and negate it to get the outgoing view direction
    vec3 V = -normalize(fs_in.viewPos);

    // TODO: define the outgoing view-space light direction
    vec3 L = V;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TODO 5: Compute shading
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TODO: compute the dot products LdotT, VdotT, and VdotL
    float LdotT = dot(L, T);
    float VdotT = dot(V, T);
    float VdotL = dot(V, L);

    // TODO: compute the products LdotN and VdotR for illuminated streamline shading
    float LdotN = sqrt(1.0 - LdotT * LdotT);
    float VdotR = VdotL - 2.0 * LdotT * VdotT;

    // TODO: define the diffuse and specular components
    vec3  kd      = uColor.rgb;
    vec3  ks      = 0.5 * kd;
    float n       = 16.0;
    vec3  diffuse  = kd * abs(LdotN);
    vec3  specular = ks * pow(abs(VdotR), n);

    // TODO: sum up the diffuse and specular components to get the shaded color.
    vec3 C = diffuse + specular;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TODO 6: Animation
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TODO: compute a periodic animation factor, depending on input.Time
    float anim = 0.75 + 0.25 * sin(fs_in.time / (1e-8 + uLength) + uTimeOffset);

    // TODO: return shaded color (RGB) with A=1.
    outColor = vec4(C * anim, 1.0);
}
```
