### scivis/6_lic/shaders/glsl/lic.comp
```
#version 430 core

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Constant Buffer (matches CPU Constants struct, binding = 1)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 1) uniform ConstantsUBO {
    vec3  uDomainMin;
    float uTime;

    vec3  uDomainMax;
    float uStepSize;

    int   uNumSteps;
    float uContrast;
    ivec2 uGridResolution;
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Textures and Samplers
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(binding = 0) uniform sampler3D flowTex;
layout(binding = 1) uniform sampler2D noiseTex;

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Output
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(binding = 0, r32f) uniform writeonly image2D uOut;

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 1: Map worldPos to normalized texture coordinates in [0,1]^2
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
vec2 worldToTex(vec2 worldPos)
{
    return (worldPos - uDomainMin.xy) / (uDomainMax.xy - uDomainMin.xy);
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 2: Map (worldPos, time) to normalized texture coordinates in [0,1]^3
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
vec3 worldToTex(vec2 worldPos, float time)
{
    return (vec3(worldPos, time) - uDomainMin) / (uDomainMax - uDomainMin);
}

// Sample vector field at world position (x,y) and time
vec2 sampleFlow(vec2 worldPos, float time)
{
    vec3 tx = worldToTex(worldPos, time);

    // Sample 3D vector field
    vec2 v = textureLod(flowTex, tx, 0.0).xy;

    // Normalize safely
    float len2 = dot(v, v);
    if (len2 < 1e-8)
        return vec2(0.0);

    return v * inversesqrt(len2);
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 3: Implement RK4 step in 2D (x,y), time fixed at uTime
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
vec2 stepRK4(vec2 pos, float h)
{
    vec2 k1 = sampleFlow(pos,                 uTime);
    vec2 k2 = sampleFlow(pos + 0.5 * h * k1, uTime);
    vec2 k3 = sampleFlow(pos + 0.5 * h * k2, uTime);
    vec2 k4 = sampleFlow(pos +       h * k3, uTime);
    return pos + (h / 6.0) * (k1 + 2.0 * k2 + 2.0 * k3 + k4);
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 4: Sample noise texture in [0,1]^2
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
float sampleNoise(vec2 worldPos)
{
    // Use worldToTex(worldPos)
    // Sample noiseTex with textureLod
    vec2 tx = worldToTex(worldPos);
    return textureLod(noiseTex, tx, 0.0).r;
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Compute Shader Entry
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(local_size_x = 16, local_size_y = 16, local_size_z = 1) in;
void main()
{
    ivec2 gid = ivec2(gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy);

    if (gid.x >= uGridResolution.x || gid.y >= uGridResolution.y)
        return;

    // Map pixel to world-space
    vec2 uv = (vec2(gid) + 0.5) / vec2(uGridResolution);
    vec2 worldMin = uDomainMin.xy;
    vec2 worldMax = uDomainMax.xy;
    vec2 pos0 = mix(worldMin, worldMax, uv);

    // Adjust step size to world-space spacing
    float dx = (worldMax.x - worldMin.x) / float(uGridResolution.x - 1);
    float dy = (worldMax.y - worldMin.y) / float(uGridResolution.y - 1);
    float h = uStepSize * min(dx, dy);

    float sum = 0.0;
    float count = 0.0;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TODO 5: Forward LIC integration
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Starting from pos0:
    //   - repeatedly call stepRK4(pos, h)
    //   - stop when leaving domain
    //   - accumulate noise weighted by step length
    //   - update sum and count
    {
        vec2 pos = pos0;
        for (int i = 0; i < uNumSteps; i++) {
            vec2 newPos = stepRK4(pos, h);
            if (any(lessThan(newPos, worldMin)) || any(greaterThan(newPos, worldMax)))
                break;
            sum   += sampleNoise(newPos) * h;
            count += h;
            pos    = newPos;
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TODO 6: Backward LIC integration
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Same as forward, but integrate with step size -h
    {
        vec2 pos = pos0;
        for (int i = 0; i < uNumSteps; i++) {
            vec2 newPos = stepRK4(pos, -h);
            if (any(lessThan(newPos, worldMin)) || any(greaterThan(newPos, worldMax)))
                break;
            sum   += sampleNoise(newPos) * h;
            count += h;
            pos    = newPos;
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TODO 7: Normalize + contrast
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Divide sum by count and apply contrast enhancement
    float value = (count > 0.0) ? sum / count : 0.5;
    value = (value - 0.5) * uContrast + 0.5;
    value = clamp(value, 0.0, 1.0);

    imageStore(uOut, gid, vec4(value, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
}
```

### scivis/7_ftle/shaders/glsl/ftle.comp
```
#version 430 core

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Constant Buffer
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 1) uniform ConstantsUBO {
    int   uMethod;              // 0 = finite diff, 1 = localized
    float uStartTime;           // integration start time
    float uStepSize;            // RK4 step size
    int   uNumSteps;            // number of RK4 steps

    float uTfMax;               // visualization normalization (unused here)
    float uSeparationDistance;  // finite-difference epsilon in domain space
    ivec2 uGridResolution;      // FTLE image resolution
};

const int METHOD_FINITE_DIFF      = 0;
const int METHOD_LOCALIZED_EULER  = 1;
const int METHOD_LOCALIZED_RK4    = 2;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Output
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(r32f, binding = 0) uniform writeonly image2D uOut;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Double Gyre Flow 
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
float a(float t)
{
    const float PI    = 3.14159265359;
    const float EPS   = 0.25;
    const float OMEGA = 2.0 * PI / 10.0;
    return EPS * sin(OMEGA * t);
}

float b(float t)
{
    const float PI    = 3.14159265359;
    const float EPS   = 0.25;
    const float OMEGA = 2.0 * PI / 10.0;
    return 1.0 - 2.0 * EPS * sin(OMEGA * t);
}

float f(float x, float t)
{
    return a(t) * x * x + b(t) * x;
}

float dfdx(float x, float t)
{
    return 2.0 * a(t) * x + b(t);
}

vec2 sampleFlow(vec2 pos, float t)
{
    const float A  = 0.1;
    const float PI = 3.14159265359;

    return vec2(
        -PI * A * sin(PI * f(pos.x, t)) * cos(PI * pos.y),
         PI * A * cos(PI * f(pos.x, t)) * sin(PI * pos.y) * dfdx(pos.x, t)
    );
}

mat2 sampleJacobian(vec2 pos, float t)
{
    const float A  = 0.1;
    const float PI = 3.14159265359;

    float x   = pos.x;
    float y   = pos.y;

    float fx   = f(x, t);
    float f_x  = dfdx(x, t);
    float f_xx = 2.0 * a(t);

    float sin_pf = sin(PI * fx);
    float cos_pf = cos(PI * fx);
    float sin_py = sin(PI * y);
    float cos_py = cos(PI * y);

    float dudx = -PI * PI * A * f_x * cos_pf * cos_py;
    float dudy =  PI * PI * A * sin_pf * sin_py;
    float dvdx =  PI * A * sin_py * (-PI * f_x * f_x * sin_pf + f_xx * cos_pf);
    float dvdy =  PI * PI * A * f_x * cos_pf * cos_py;

    // GLSL mat2(a,b,c,d) is column-major:
    // [a c]
    // [b d]
    return mat2(
        dudx, dvdx,
        dudy, dvdy 
    );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 1: Implement RK4 integration for x'(t) = sampleFlow(x,t)
// This is similar to the previous exercise, but with a time coordinate.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
vec2 stepRK4(vec2 pos, float time, float h)
{
    vec2 k1 = sampleFlow(pos, time);
    vec2 k2 = sampleFlow(pos + (h / 2.0) * k1, time + h / 2.0);
    vec2 k3 = sampleFlow(pos + (h / 2.0) * k2, time + h / 2.0);
    vec2 k4 = sampleFlow(pos + h * k3, time + h);
    return pos + (h / 6.0) * (k1 + 2.0 * k2 + 2.0 * k3 + k4);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Largest Eigenvalue of Symmetric 2x2 Matrix
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
float largestEigenvalue(mat2 C)
{
    float a = C[0][0];
    float b = C[0][1];
    float d = C[1][1];

    float trace = a + d;
    float diff  = a - d;
    float disc  = sqrt(diff * diff + 4.0 * b * b);

    float lambdaMax = 0.5 * (trace + disc);
    return lambdaMax;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 2: Integrate the trajectory from (pos,t0) by calling stepRK4 'uNumSteps' times.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
vec2 flowmap(vec2 pos, float t0)
{
    float t = t0;
    for (int i = 0; i < uNumSteps; i++) {
        pos = stepRK4(pos, t, uStepSize);
        t += uStepSize;
    }
    return pos;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 3: Compute flow map gradient via finite differences.
// Use flowmap(pos +/- (hh,0)) and flowmap(pos +/- (0,hh))
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Use central differences on the flow map with uSeparationDistance as epsilon.
mat2 sampleFlowMapGradient_FiniteDifference(vec2 pos)
{
    float hh = uSeparationDistance;
    vec2 col0 = (flowmap(pos + vec2(hh, 0.0), uStartTime) - flowmap(pos - vec2(hh, 0.0), uStartTime)) / (2.0 * hh);
    vec2 col1 = (flowmap(pos + vec2(0.0, hh), uStartTime) - flowmap(pos - vec2(0.0, hh), uStartTime)) / (2.0 * hh);
    mat2 F = mat2(col0, col1);
    return F;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 4: Flow Map Gradient - Localized linearization with explicit Euler
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Integrate coupled system:
//   x' = v(x,t)
//   F' = J(x,t) F
// using explicit Euler for F and stepRK4 for x.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mat2 sampleFlowMapGradient_LocalizedEuler(vec2 pos0)
{
    // initialize F as identity and update along the trajectory.
    mat2 F = mat2(1.0, 0.0,
                  0.0, 1.0);
    vec2 x = pos0;
    float t = uStartTime;
    float h = uStepSize;
    for (int i = 0; i < uNumSteps; i++) {
        F = F + h * sampleJacobian(x, t) * F;
        x = stepRK4(x, t, h);
        t += h;
    }
    return F;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 5: Flow Map Gradient - Localized RK4
// Implement RK4 for the coupled system:
//   x' = v(x,t)
//   F' = J(x,t) F
// advancing both x and F in time.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mat2 sampleFlowMapGradient_LocalizedRK4(vec2 pos0)
{
    // initialize F as identity at t = uStartTime and
    // advance for uNumSteps with uStepSize.
    // Use sampleFlow and sampleJacobian to evaluate v(x,t) and J(x,t).
    mat2 F = mat2(1.0, 0.0,
                  0.0, 1.0);
    vec2 x = pos0;
    float t = uStartTime;
    float h = uStepSize;
    for (int i = 0; i < uNumSteps; i++) {
        vec2 k1 = sampleFlow(x, t);
        mat2 K1 = sampleJacobian(x, t) * F;
        vec2 k2 = sampleFlow(x + (h / 2.0) * k1, t + h / 2.0);
        mat2 K2 = sampleJacobian(x + (h / 2.0) * k1, t + h / 2.0) * (F + (h / 2.0) * K1);
        vec2 k3 = sampleFlow(x + (h / 2.0) * k2, t + h / 2.0);
        mat2 K3 = sampleJacobian(x + (h / 2.0) * k2, t + h / 2.0) * (F + (h / 2.0) * K2);
        vec2 k4 = sampleFlow(x + h * k3, t + h);
        mat2 K4 = sampleJacobian(x + h * k3, t + h) * (F + h * K3);
        x = x + (h / 6.0) * (k1 + 2.0 * k2 + 2.0 * k3 + k4);
        F = F + (h / 6.0) * (K1 + 2.0 * K2 + 2.0 * K3 + K4);
        t += h;
    }
    return F;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// FTLE at a Point
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
float sampleFTLE(vec2 pos)
{
    float t0 = uStartTime;
    float t1 = uStartTime + uStepSize * float(uNumSteps);

    mat2 F;

    // choose flow map gradient computation method
    switch (uMethod)
    {
        case METHOD_FINITE_DIFF:
            F = sampleFlowMapGradient_FiniteDifference(pos);
            break;

        case METHOD_LOCALIZED_EULER:
            F = sampleFlowMapGradient_LocalizedEuler(pos);
            break;

        case METHOD_LOCALIZED_RK4:
            F = sampleFlowMapGradient_LocalizedRK4(pos);
            break;

        default:
            F = mat2(1.0, 0.0,
                     0.0, 1.0);
            break;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TODO 6: Compute FTLE from F
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Compute Cauchy-Green tensor: P = F^T * F
    // 2. Compute largest eigenvalue Lmax = largestEigenvalue(P)
    // 3. Apply the FTLE formular
    mat2 C = transpose(F) * F;
    float Lmax = largestEigenvalue(C);
    float ftle = (1.0 / abs(t1 - t0)) * log(sqrt(Lmax));
    return ftle;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Compute Shader Entry
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(local_size_x = 16, local_size_y = 16, local_size_z = 1) in;

void main()
{
    ivec2 gid = ivec2(gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy);

    if (gid.x >= uGridResolution.x || gid.y >= uGridResolution.y)
        return;

    vec2 uv  = (vec2(gid) + 0.5) / vec2(uGridResolution);
    vec2 pos = vec2(2.0 * uv.x, uv.y);

    float ftle = sampleFTLE(pos);

    imageStore(uOut, gid, vec4(ftle, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
}
```

### scivis/7_ftle/shaders/glsl/ftle.frag
```
#version 430 core

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Constant Buffers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 1) uniform ConstantsUBO {
    int   uMethod;              // 0 = finite diff
    float uStartTime;           // integration start time
    float uStepSize;            // RK4 step size
    int   uNumSteps;            // number of RK4 steps

    float uTfMax;               // visualization normalization
    float uSeparationDistance;  // finite-difference epsilon
    ivec2 uGridResolution;      // FTLE image resolution
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Resources
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(binding = 0) uniform sampler2D uFtleTex;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Input / Output
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
in VS_OUT {
    vec4 clipPos;
} fs_in;

layout(location = 0) out vec4 outColor;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
float saturate(float x) { return clamp(x, 0.0, 1.0); }
vec3  saturate(vec3  x) { return clamp(x, 0.0, 1.0); }

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Colormap
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
vec4 transferFunction(float value, float minValue, float maxValue)
{
    // Normalize to [0,1]
    float t = 1.0 - saturate((value - minValue) / (maxValue - minValue));

    // Polynomial RGB
    vec3 color =
        (((vec3( 5.0048,   7.4158,   6.1246) * t +
           vec3(-8.0915, -15.9415, -16.2287)) * t +
           vec3( 1.1657,   7.4696,  11.9910)) * t +
           vec3( 1.4380,   1.2767,  -1.4886)) * t +
         vec3( 0.6639,  -0.0013,   0.1685);

    color = saturate(color);

    return vec4(color, 1.0);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void main()
{
    ivec2 pixel = ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy);
    float ftle  = texelFetch(uFtleTex, pixel, 0).r;
    outColor    = transferFunction(ftle, 0.0, uTfMax);
}

// Constant Buffer
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cbuffer Constants : register(b1)
{
    int uMethod;               // 0 = finite diff, 1 = localized
    float uStartTime;          // integration start time
    float uStepSize;           // RK4 step size
    int uNumSteps;             // number of RK4 steps

    float uTfMax;              // visualization normalization (unused here)
    float uSeparationDistance; // finite-difference epsilon in domain space
    int2 uGridResolution;      // FTLE image resolution
}

static const int METHOD_FINITE_DIFF = 0;
static const int METHOD_LOCALIZED_EULER = 1;
static const int METHOD_LOCALIZED_RK4 = 2;

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Output
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
RWTexture2D<float> uOut : register(u0);

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Double Gyre Flow 
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
float a(float t)
{
    const float PI = 3.14159265359;
    const float EPS = 0.25;
    const float OMEGA = 2.0 * PI / 10.0;
    return EPS * sin(OMEGA * t);
}

float b(float t)
{
    const float PI = 3.14159265359;
    const float EPS = 0.25;
    const float OMEGA = 2.0 * PI / 10.0;
    return 1.0 - 2.0 * EPS * sin(OMEGA * t);
}

float f(float x, float t)
{
    return a(t) * x * x + b(t) * x;
}

float dfdx(float x, float t)
{
    return 2.0 * a(t) * x + b(t);
}

float2 sampleFlow(float2 pos, float t)
{
    const float A = 0.1;
    const float PI = 3.14159265359;

    return float2(
        -PI * A * sin(PI * f(pos.x, t)) * cos(PI * pos.y),
         PI * A * cos(PI * f(pos.x, t)) * sin(PI * pos.y) * dfdx(pos.x, t)
    );
}

float2x2 sampleJacobian(float2 pos, float t)
{
    const float A = 0.1;
    const float PI = 3.14159265359;

    float x = pos.x;
    float y = pos.y;

    float fx = f(x, t);
    float f_x = dfdx(x, t);
    float f_xx = 2.0 * a(t);

    float sin_pf = sin(PI * fx);
    float cos_pf = cos(PI * fx);
    float sin_py = sin(PI * y);
    float cos_py = cos(PI * y);

    float dudx = -PI * PI * A * f_x * cos_pf * cos_py;
    float dudy = PI * PI * A * sin_pf * sin_py;
    float dvdx = PI * A * sin_py * (-PI * f_x * f_x * sin_pf + f_xx * cos_pf);
    float dvdy = PI * PI * A * f_x * cos_pf * cos_py;

    // HLSL float2x2(a,b,c,d) is row-major:
    // [a b]
    // [c d]
    return float2x2(
        dudx, dudy,
        dvdx, dvdy
    );
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 1: Implement RK4 integration for x'(t) = sampleFlow(x,t)
// This is similar to the previous exercise, but with a time coordinate.
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
float2 stepRK4(float2 pos, float time, float h)
{
    return pos; // placeholder
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Largest Eigenvalue of Symmetric 2x2 Matrix
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
float largestEigenvalue(float2x2 C)
{
    float a = C._11;
    float b = C._12;
    float d = C._22;

    float trace = a + d;
    float diff = a - d;
    float disc = sqrt(diff * diff + 4.0 * b * b);

    float lambdaMax = 0.5 * (trace + disc);
    return lambdaMax;
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 2: Integrate the trajectory from (pos,t0) by calling stepRK4 'uNumSteps' times.
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
float2 flowmap(float2 pos, float t0)
{
    return pos; // placeholder
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 3: Compute flow map gradient via finite differences.
// Use flowmap(pos +/- (hh,0)) and flowmap(pos +/- (0,hh))
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Use central differences on the flow map with uSeparationDistance as epsilon.
float2x2 sampleFlowMapGradient_FiniteDifference(float2 pos)
{
    float2x2 F = float2x2(1, 0, 0, 1); // placeholder
    return F;
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 4: Flow Map Gradient - Localized linearization with explicit Euler
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Integrate coupled system:
//   x' = v(x,t)
//   F' = J(x,t) F
// using explicit Euler for F and stepRK4 for x.
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
float2x2 sampleFlowMapGradient_LocalizedEuler(float2 pos0)
{
    // initialize F as identity and update along the trajectory.
    float2x2 F = float2x2(1, 0, 0, 1); // placeholder
    return F;
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TODO 5: Flow Map Gradient - Localized RK4
// Implement RK4 for the coupled system:
//   x' = v(x,t)
//   F' = J(x,t) F
// advancing both x and F in time.
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
float2x2 sampleFlowMapGradient_LocalizedRK4(float2 pos0)
{
    // initialize F as identity at t = uStartTime and
    // advance for uNumSteps with uStepSize.
    // Use sampleFlow and sampleJacobian to evaluate v(x,t) and J(x,t).
    float2x2 F = float2x2(1, 0, 0, 1); // placeholder
    return F;
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// FTLE at a Point
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
float sampleFTLE(float2 pos)
{
    float t0 = uStartTime;
    float t1 = uStartTime + uStepSize * uNumSteps;

    float2x2 F;

    // choose flow map gradient computation method
    switch (uMethod)
    {
        case METHOD_FINITE_DIFF:
            F = sampleFlowMapGradient_FiniteDifference(pos);
            break;

        case METHOD_LOCALIZED_EULER:
            F = sampleFlowMapGradient_LocalizedEuler(pos);
            break;

        case METHOD_LOCALIZED_RK4:
            F = sampleFlowMapGradient_LocalizedRK4(pos);
            break;

        default:
            F = float2x2(1, 0, 0, 1);
            break;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TODO 6: Compute FTLE from F
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Compute Cauchy-Green tensor: P = F^T * F
    // 2. Compute largest eigenvalue Lmax = largestEigenvalue(P)
    // 3. Apply the FTLE formular
    float ftle = 0.0f; // placeholder
    return ftle;
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Compute Shader Entry
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
[numthreads(16, 16, 1)]
void main(uint3 gid : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    if (gid.x >= (uint)uGridResolution.x || gid.y >= (uint)uGridResolution.y)
        return;

    float2 uv = (float2(gid.xy) + 0.5) / float2(uGridResolution);
    float2 pos = float2(2.0 * uv.x, uv.y);

    float ftle = sampleFTLE(pos);

    uOut[uint2(gid.x, uGridResolution.y - 1 - gid.y)] = ftle;
}

### scivis/8_surface/shaders/glsl/surface.frag
```
#version 430 core

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Constant Buffers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 1) uniform ColorUBO {
    vec4 uColor;       // base color
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Input / Output
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
in VS_OUT {
    vec4 clipPos;
    vec3 normal;
} fs_in;

layout(location = 0) out vec4 outColor;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void main()
{
    // Normal from vertex shader
    vec3 N = normalize(fs_in.normal);

    // Two directional lights
    vec3 L1 = normalize(vec3( 1.0,  1.0, 1.0));
    vec3 L2 = normalize(vec3(-1.0, -1.0, 1.0));

    float NdotL1 = max(dot(N, L1), 0.0);
    float NdotL2 = max(dot(N, L2), 0.0);

    // Base color blend
    vec3 baseColor = mix(uColor.rgb, N, 0.5);

    const vec3 lightColor1 = vec3(1.0, 0.95, 0.95);
    const vec3 lightColor2 = vec3(0.95, 0.95, 1.0);
    const float ambient    = 0.3;

    vec3 color = baseColor * (NdotL1 * lightColor1 +
                              NdotL2 * lightColor2 +
                              ambient);
    outColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

### scivis/8_surface/shaders/glsl/surface.vert
```
#version 430 core

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Constant Buffers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(std140, binding = 0) uniform CameraUBO {
    mat4 uView;
    mat4 uProj;
    vec3 uEyePos;
    float _pad0;
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Injected Helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
vec4 mulView(vec3 worldPos, mat4 viewMat);
vec4 mulProj(vec4 viewPos, mat4 projMat);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Input / Output
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
layout(location = 0) in vec3 inPosition;
layout(location = 1) in vec3 inNormal;

out VS_OUT {
    vec4 clipPos;
    vec3 normal;
} vs_out;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void main()
{
    // Transform to view space
    vec4 viewPos = mulView(inPosition, uView);

    // Pass through normal (no transform here)
    vs_out.normal = inNormal;

    // Clip-space position
    vs_out.clipPos = mulProj(viewPos, uProj);
    gl_Position    = vs_out.clipPos;
}

### vislab/app/include/vislab/app/iinteractor.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <vislab/core/data.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/iarchive.hpp>

#include <memory>

namespace vislab
{
    struct MouseState;
    struct KeyState;
    class Camera;

    /**
     * @brief Base class for camera interactors.
     *
     * Interactors translate user input (mouse, keyboard) into camera
     * manipulations. They do NOT manipulate data objects or filters.
     *
     * This is a *passive* interactor model:
     *  - The interactor does not subscribe to input events.
     *  - scivis::Application receives input from the InputDispatcher.
     *  - scivis::Application forwards events to the active interactor.
     *
     * This avoids lifetime issues, avoids storing InputDispatcher,
     * keeps cloning trivial, and keeps the architecture predictable.
     */
    class IInteractor : public Interface<IInteractor, Data>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         */
        IInteractor() = default;

        /**
         * @brief Virtual destructor.
         */
        virtual ~IInteractor() = default;

        /**
         * @brief Processes mouse events.
         *
         * Derived interactors override this to implement camera manipulation
         * based on mouse movement, button presses, and scroll input.
         */
        virtual void onMouseEvent(const MouseState& mouseState) = 0;

        /**
         * @brief Processes key events.
         *
         * Derived interactors override this to implement camera manipulation
         * based on keyboard input.
         */
        virtual void onKeyEvent(const KeyState& keyState) = 0;

        /**
         * @brief Assigns the camera controlled by this interactor.
         */
        void setCamera(std::shared_ptr<Camera> camera)
        {
            mCamera = std::move(camera);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns the camera controlled by this interactor.
         * @warning Undefined behavior if no camera is set.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Camera& getCamera()
        {
            return *mCamera;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns the camera controlled by this interactor.
         * @warning Undefined behavior if no camera is set.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const Camera& getCamera() const
        {
            return *mCamera;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns the shared pointer to the camera.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<Camera> getCameraShared() const
        {
            return mCamera;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Whether the interactor is active.
         *
         * Inactive interactors ignore all input events. This is typically
         * controlled by the UI layer (e.g., disabled when ImGui wants input).
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool isActive() const { return mActive; }

        /**
         * @brief Activates or deactivates the interactor.
         */
        void setActive(bool active) { mActive = active; }

        /**
         * @brief Serializes the interactor state.
         *
         * Currently only serializes the active flag. Derived interactors
         * may override serialize() to store additional state, but should
         * call the base implementation.
         */
        void serialize(IArchive& archive) override;

    protected:
        /// Camera controlled by this interactor.
        std::shared_ptr<Camera> mCamera;

        /// Whether the interactor is currently active.
        bool mActive = true;
    };

} // namespace vislab
```

### vislab/app/include/vislab/app/input_dispatcher.hpp
```
/**
 * @file input_dispatcher.hpp
 * @brief High-level input state tracker and event dispatcher.
 *
 * InputDispatcher receives raw input events from Window and converts them into
 * higher-level semantic events such as:
 * - mouseMoved
 * - mousePressed / mouseReleased
 * - keyPressed / keyReleased
 * - scroll
 *
 * It also maintains per-frame state transitions:
 * - beginFrame() clears transient events
 * - endFrame() finalizes the frame
 *
 * This class does not poll OS events; it only processes events forwarded by
 * Window or WindowedApp.
 */

#pragma once

#include <vislab/app/window.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/event.hpp>

#include <array>

namespace vislab
{

    class InputDispatcher
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Constructs an empty InputDispatcher with all states initialized.
         */
        InputDispatcher();

        /**
         * @brief Clears per-frame transient states.
         *
         * Must be called once at the beginning of each frame.
         */
        void beginFrame();

        /**
         * @brief Finalizes per-frame state.
         *
         * Must be called once at the end of each frame.
         */
        void endFrame();

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Raw event ingestion (called by WindowedApp)
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        /**
         * @brief Processes a mouse movement event.
         */
        void onMouseMove(const MouseState& m);

        /**
         * @brief Processes a mouse button change.
         * @param button Button index (0�7).
         * @param pressed True if pressed, false if released.
         */
        void onMouseButton(int button, bool pressed);

        /**
         * @brief Processes a scroll event.
         */
        void onScroll(double dx, double dy);

        /**
         * @brief Processes a key change.
         * @param key Key code (GLFW key index).
         * @param pressed True if pressed or repeated, false if released.
         */
        void onKey(int key, bool pressed);

        /**
         * @brief Updates modifier key states.
         */
        void onModifiers(bool shift, bool ctrl, bool alt, bool super);

        /**
         * @brief Process a character input.
         * @param codepoint Character
         */
        void onChar(unsigned int codepoint);

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // High-level semantic events
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        Event<double, double> mouseMoved; ///< Emitted when the mouse moves.
        Event<int> mousePressed;          ///< Emitted when a mouse button is pressed.
        Event<int> mouseReleased;         ///< Emitted when a mouse button is released.
        Event<double, double> scrolled;   ///< Emitted when the mouse wheel scrolls.

        Event<int> keyPressed;  ///< Emitted when a key is pressed.
        Event<int> keyReleased; ///< Emitted when a key is released.
        Event<unsigned int> charEntered; ///< Emitted when a character input occurred.

    private:
        // Mouse state
        double mMouseX = 0.0;
        double mMouseY = 0.0;
        std::array<bool, 8> mMouseButtons{};

        // Keyboard state
        std::array<bool, 512> mKeys{};
        bool mShift = false;
        bool mCtrl  = false;
        bool mAlt   = false;
        bool mSuper = false;
    };

} // namespace vislab
```

### vislab/app/include/vislab/app/key_state.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <array>

namespace vislab
{

    struct KeyState
    {
        // GLFW key codes go up to ~350, so 512 is safe
        std::array<bool, 512> keys{};
        std::array<bool, 512> keysPrev{};

        // Modifier keys
        bool shift = false;
        bool ctrl  = false;
        bool alt   = false;
        bool super = false;

        int lastKey      = -1;
        int lastScancode = -1;
        int lastAction   = -1;
        int lastMods     = 0;

        // for text input
        unsigned int lastCodepoint = 0;

        // Helpers
        inline bool isPressed(int key) const
        {
            return keys[key] && !keysPrev[key];
        }

        inline bool isReleased(int key) const
        {
            return !keys[key] && keysPrev[key];
        }

        inline bool isHeld(int key) const
        {
            return keys[key];
        }
    };

} // namespace vislab

#pragma once

#include <array>

namespace vislab
{

    struct MouseState
    {
        // Position
        double x = 0.0;
        double y = 0.0;

        // Movement delta since last frame
        double deltaX = 0.0;
        double deltaY = 0.0;

        // Scroll wheel
        double scrollX = 0.0;
        double scrollY = 0.0;

        // Button states (GLFW supports up to 8 mouse buttons)
        std::array<bool, 8> buttons{};
        std::array<bool, 8> buttonsPrev{};

        int lastButton = -1;
        int lastAction = -1;
        int lastMods   = 0;

        // Helpers
        inline bool isPressed(int button) const
        {
            return buttons[button] && !buttonsPrev[button];
        }

        inline bool isReleased(int button) const
        {
            return !buttons[button] && buttonsPrev[button];
        }

        inline bool isHeld(int button) const
        {
            return buttons[button];
        }
    };

#pragma once

namespace vislab

    struct MouseState;

    /**
     * @brief Interactor implementing a classic trackball camera.

     *  - Left mouse drag: orbit around look-at point
     *  - Middle mouse drag: pan

         */

         * @brief Serializes the interactor state.
         */

#pragma once

#include "base_algorithm.hpp"

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Using for interface algorithms.
     * @tparam TDerived Derived type.
     */
    template <typename TDerived>
    using InterfaceAlgorithm = Interface<TDerived, BaseAlgorithm<TDerived>>;

    /**
     * @brief Using for concrete algorithms.
     * @tparam TDerived Derived type.
     */
    template <typename TDerived>
    using ConcreteAlgorithm = Concrete<TDerived, BaseAlgorithm<TDerived>>;
}
```

#pragma once

#include "raw_array.hpp"

#include "array_fwd.hpp"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#include <span>
#endif

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Class that holds an array of typed elements.
     * @tparam TElement Type of the elements. Must be an Eigen::Vector type.
     */
    template <typename TElement>
        requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement>
    class Array : public Concrete<Array<TElement>, Data>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Underlying scalar type.
         */
        using Scalar = typename TElement::Scalar;

        /**
         * @brief Number of components in each of the element entries.
         */
        static constexpr int Dimensions = TElement::RowsAtCompileTime * TElement::ColsAtCompileTime;

        /**
         * @brief Underlying element vector stored at each array index.
         */
        using Element = TElement;

        /**
         * @brief Iterator type for traversing the elements.
         */
        using iterator = ArrayIterator<TElement>;

        /**
         * @brief Const iterator type for traversing the elements.
         */
        using const_iterator = ArrayIterator<const TElement>;

        /**
         * @brief Allocates an array with a certain number of elements.
         * @param name Optional name of the array.
         * @param numElements Number of elements in the initial array. Default value is zero.
         */
        explicit Array(const std::string& name = "", size_t numElements = 0)
            : mData(std::make_shared<RawArray>(name))
        {
            mData->allocate<TElement>(numElements);
#ifdef _DEBUG
            subscribeSizeChange();
            respan();
#endif
        }

        /**
         * @brief Allocates an array by receiving the data from an externally existing RawArray. Ownership is shared.
         * @param data RawArray to use as data source.
         */
        explicit Array(std::shared_ptr<RawArray> data)
            : mData(data)
        {
            assert(data->isValueType<TElement>());
#ifdef _DEBUG
            subscribeSizeChange();
            respan();
#endif
        }

        /**
         * @brief Copy-constructor. Clones the underlying data. This object will be owning the resulting RawArray.
         */
        Array(const Array& other)
            : mData(other.mData->clone())
        {
#ifdef _DEBUG
            subscribeSizeChange();
            respan();
#endif
        }

        /**
         * @brief Move constructor.
         * @param other Other array to move.
         */
        Array(Array&& other) noexcept
            : mData(std::move(other.mData))
        {
#ifdef _DEBUG
            subscribeSizeChange();
            respan();
#endif
        }

        /**
         * @brief Copy assignment.
         * @param other Other element to copy.
         * @return Reference to self.
         */
        Array& operator=(const Array& other)
        {
            if (this != &other)
            {
                mData = other.mData->clone();
#ifdef _DEBUG
                subscribeSizeChange();
                respan();
#endif
            }
            return *this;
        }

        {
            if (this != &other)

                mData = std::move(other.mData);
#ifdef _DEBUG
                subscribeSizeChange();
                respan();
#endif
            }
            return *this;
        }

        void setName(const std::string& name) { mData->setName(name); }

        /**

         * @return Number of elements in the array.
         */

        {
            return mData->getSize();
        }

         * @param size New number of elements.

#endif

         * @return Number of components per element.

        }

        [[nodiscard]] Eigen::Index getElementSizeInBytes() const

            return sizeof(Element);

        [[nodiscard]] Eigen::Index getSizeInBytes() const

        }

        // Insert a range [first, last) before pos
        template <typename InputIt>
        iterator insert(iterator pos, InputIt first, InputIt last)
        {
            size_t insertIndex = pos - begin();              // element offset
            size_t count       = std::distance(first, last); // number of new elements

            // compute byte offsets
            size_t byteInsertOffset = insertIndex * sizeof(TElement);
            size_t byteCount        = count * sizeof(TElement);
            size_t oldSizeBytes     = getSize() * sizeof(TElement);

            // grow underlying RayArray
            setSize(getSize() + count);

            std::byte* base = mData->getData().data();

            // shift tail up by byteCount (safe for overlap)
            std::memmove(base + byteInsertOffset + byteCount,
                         base + byteInsertOffset,
                         oldSizeBytes - byteInsertOffset);

            // copy new elements into the gap
            std::byte* dest = base + byteInsertOffset;
            for (auto it = first; it != last; ++it)
            {
                std::memcpy(dest, &*it, sizeof(TElement));
                dest += sizeof(TElement);
            }

            return begin() + insertIndex;
        }

        // Insert a single element at position `idx`
        void insert(size_t idx, const TElement& value)
        {
            if (idx > getSize())
            {
                throw std::out_of_range("insert index out of range");
            }

            // compute byte offsets
            size_t byteInsertOffset = idx * sizeof(TElement);
            size_t oldSizeBytes     = getSize() * sizeof(TElement);

            // grow underlying RayArray
            mData->setSize(mData->getSize() + 1);

            std::byte* base = mData->getData().data();

            // shift tail up by sizeof(TElement)
            std::memmove(base + byteInsertOffset + sizeof(TElement),
                         base + byteInsertOffset,
                         oldSizeBytes - byteInsertOffset);

            // copy new element into the gap
            std::memcpy(base + byteInsertOffset, &value, sizeof(TElement));
        }

        // convenience overload for rvalue
        void insert(size_t idx, TElement&& value)
        {
            insert(idx, static_cast<const TElement&>(value));
        }

        /**
         * @brief Prepends an element at the front (linear time complexity, since the entire array is copied).
         * @param value Element to prepend.
         */
        void push_front(const Element& value)
        {
            mData->push_front(value);
        }

        /**

         * @param other Array to prepend.

        void prepend(const Array& other)
        {

        /**
         * @brief Casts from another array type into this one. If the type is matching, then they share the data. If the types don't match, then each element is casted.
         * @tparam TOtherArray The type of the other array.
         * @param otherArray The other array to convert into this one.
         * @return The converted typed array.
         */
        template <typename TOtherArray>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<typename TOtherArray::Element>
        static std::shared_ptr<Array> cast(std::shared_ptr<TOtherArray> otherArray)
        {
            if constexpr (std::is_same_v<Array, TOtherArray>)
                return otherArray;
            else
                return cast(*otherArray);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Casts from another array type into this one. If the type is matching, then they share the data. If the types don't match, then each element is casted.
         * @tparam TOtherArray The type of the other array.
         * @param otherArray The other array to convert into this one.
         * @return The converted typed array.
         */
        template <typename TOtherArray>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<typename TOtherArray::Element>
        static std::shared_ptr<Array> cast(TOtherArray& otherArray)
        {
            return cast(otherArray.getRawShared());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Casts from a general raw array into this type. If the type is matching, then they share the data, although this object is not receiving ownership. If the types don't match, then each element is casted and this object owns the casted data.
         * @param rawArray Raw array to cast from.
         * @return The converted typed array.
         */
        static std::shared_ptr<Array> cast(std::shared_ptr<RawArray> rawArray)
        {
            if (rawArray->isValueType<TElement>())
                return std::make_shared<Array>(rawArray);
            else
            {
                auto newRaw        = std::make_shared<RawArray>(rawArray->getName());
                size_t numElements = rawArray->getSize();
                newRaw->allocate<TElement>(numElements);
                for (size_t i = 0; i < numElements; ++i)
                    newRaw->setValue(i, rawArray->getValueAs<TElement>(i));
                return std::make_shared<Array>(newRaw);
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Casts this array into another type. If the type is matching, then they share the data, although this object is not receiving ownership. If the types don't match, then each element is casted and this object owns the casted data.
         * @tparam TOtherArray The type of the other array.
         * @return The converted typed array.
         */
        template <typename TOtherArray>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<typename TOtherArray::Element>
        std::shared_ptr<TOtherArray> cast()
        {
            return TOtherArray::cast(*this);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Tests if the data object is fully initialized and ready for use.
         * @return True if the data object is in a valid state.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool isValid() const override
        {
            // ensure that we have proper byte alignment
            assert(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mData->getData().data()) % alignof(TElement) == 0);

            return mData->isValid();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Serializes the object into/from an archive.
         * @param archive Archive to serialize into/from.
         */
        void serialize(IArchive& archive) override
        {
            mData->serialize(archive);
        }

        ///**
        // * @brief Linearly loops through all elements and recomputes the bounds.
        // */
        // void recomputeBoundingBox()

        //}

        // * @return Bounds in the expected format.
        // */
        //[[nodiscard]] const Eigen::AlignedBox<typename TElement::Scalar, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>& getBoundingBox() const
        //{

        /**
         * @brief Gets an iterator that starts at the beginning of the array.
         * @return Iterator at beginning.
         */
        iterator begin() { return iterator(mData->getData().data()); }

        /**
         * @brief Gets an iterator that is positioned after the end of the array.
         * @return Iterator at ending.
         */
        iterator end() { return iterator(mData->getData().data() + mData->getSizeInBytes()); }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a const iterator that starts at the beginning of the array.
         * @return Iterator at beginning.
         */
        const_iterator begin() const { return const_iterator(mData->getData().data()); }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a const iterator that is positioned after the end of the array.
         * @return Iterator at ending.
         */
        const_iterator end() const { return const_iterator(mData->getData().data() + mData->getSizeInBytes()); }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a const iterator that starts at the beginning of the array.
         * @return Iterator at beginning.
         */
        const_iterator cbegin() const { return begin(); }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a const iterator that is positioned after the end of the array.
         * @return Iterator at ending.
         */
        const_iterator cend() const { return end(); }

    protected:
#ifdef _DEBUG
        /**
         * @brief Connection that captures the handle of the onSizeChange event of the RawArray using RAII. On destruction of the connection, the event is deregistered automatically.
         */
        EventConnection mSizeChangedConn;

        /**
         * @brief Subscribes to the onSizeChange event.
         */
        void subscribeSizeChange()
        {
            mSizeChangedConn = mData->onSizeChange.subscribe(
                [this]([[maybe_unused]] std::size_t newSize)
                {
                    this->respan();
                });
        }

        /**
         * @brief Recomputes the span.
         */
        void respan()
        {
            mSpan = std::span<TElement>(getPtr(), mData->getSize());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Same data, but viewed via span. Kept around for convenient debugger access.
         */
        std::span<TElement> mSpan;
#endif

        /**
         * @brief Shared pointer that holds the raw array. If a raw pointer was given, then this shared pointer holds a no-op deleter and should therefore not be handed out of the object.
         */
        std::shared_ptr<RawArray> mData;
    };
}

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/array_fwd.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <stdint.h>

#include "types.hpp"
#include "traits.hpp"

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Type-safe data array with one or multiple components.
     * @tparam TElement Element type that is stored in the array.
     */
    template <typename TElement>
        requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement>
    class Array;

    /**
     * @brief Dense one-dimensional array of float values with one component.
     */
    using Array1f = Array<Eigen::Vector1f>;

    /**
     * @brief Dense one-dimensional array of float values with two components.
     */
    using Array2f = Array<Eigen::Vector2f>;

    /**
     * @brief Dense one-dimensional array of float values with three components.
     */
    using Array3f = Array<Eigen::Vector3f>;

    /**
     * @brief Dense one-dimensional array of float values with four components.
     */
    using Array4f = Array<Eigen::Vector4f>;

    /**
     * @brief Dense one-dimensional array of float 2x2 matrices.
     */
    using Array2x2f = Array<Eigen::Matrix2f>;

    /**
     * @brief Dense one-dimensional array of float 3x3 matrices.
     */
    using Array3x3f = Array<Eigen::Matrix3f>;

    /**
     * @brief Dense one-dimensional array of float 4x4 matrices.
     */
    using Array4x4f = Array<Eigen::Matrix4f>;

    /**
     * @brief Dense one-dimensional array of double values with one component.
     */
    using Array1d = Array<Eigen::Vector1d>;

    /**
     * @brief Dense one-dimensional array of double values with two components.
     */
    using Array2d = Array<Eigen::Vector2d>;

    /**
     * @brief Dense one-dimensional array of double values with three components.
     */
    using Array3d = Array<Eigen::Vector3d>;

    /**

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/array_iterator.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <cstddef>
#include <iterator>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Random-access iterator for contiguous arrays of fixed-size elements.
     *
     * @tparam TElement  The element type stored in the array. Must be trivially
     *                   copyable and have a fixed compile-time size, because the
     *                   iterator advances in memory by sizeof(TElement).
     *
     * This iterator provides full random-access semantics over a raw byte buffer
     * that stores tightly packed elements of type TElement. It behaves similarly
     * to a pointer-based iterator, but uses a std::byte* internally to allow
     * iteration over custom memory layouts.
     *
     * Supported operations:
     * - Dereference (operator*, operator->)
     * - Pre/post increment and decrement
     * - Random access (operator[], operator+=, operator-=)
     * - Iterator arithmetic (operator+, operator-)
     * - Full comparison operators (==, !=, <, <=, >, >=)
     *
     * Iterator category:
     * This iterator satisfies the requirements of a
     * std::random_access_iterator. It can be used with all standard algorithms
     * that expect at least an input iterator, including:
     *
     * - std::distance
     * - std::copy
     * - std::sort (if the underlying data is mutable)
     * - std::for_each
     *
     * Example:
     * @code
     * ArrayIterator<double> it = array.begin();
     * double first = *it;     // access first element
     * it += 3;                // jump ahead by 3 elements
     * double fourth = *it;
     * @endcode
     */
    template <typename TElement>
    class ArrayIterator
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Alias for the underlying element type.
         */
        using Element = TElement;

        /**
         * @brief Iterator category tag (random-access).
         */
        using iterator_category = std::random_access_iterator_tag;

        /**
         * @brief Value type returned by dereferencing.
         */
        using value_type = TElement;

        /**
         * @brief Difference type used for iterator arithmetic.
         */
        using difference_type = std::ptrdiff_t;

        /**
         * @brief Pointer to an element.
         */
        using pointer = TElement*;

        /**
         * @brief Reference to an element.
         */
        using reference = TElement&;

        /**
         * @brief Iterator concept.
         */
        using iterator_concept = std::random_access_iterator_tag;

        /**
         * @brief Constructs an iterator pointing to the given raw memory location.
         *
         * @param ptr  Pointer to the first byte of an element.
         */
        explicit ArrayIterator(std::byte* ptr)
            : mPtr(ptr)
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Dereferences the iterator.
         * @return Reference to the current element.
         */
        reference operator*() const { return *reinterpret_cast<pointer>(mPtr); }

        /**
         * @brief Member access operator.
         * @return Pointer to the current element.
         */
        pointer operator->() const { return reinterpret_cast<pointer>(mPtr); }

        /**
         * @brief Advances the iterator to the next element (prefix).
         * @return Reference to this iterator.
         */
        ArrayIterator& operator++()
        {
            mPtr += sizeof(TElement);
            return *this;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Advances the iterator to the next element (postfix).
         * @return A copy of the iterator before incrementing.
         */
        ArrayIterator operator++(int)
        {
            ArrayIterator tmp(*this);
            ++(*this);
            return tmp;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Moves the iterator to the previous element (prefix).
         * @return Reference to this iterator.
         */
        ArrayIterator& operator--()
        {
            mPtr -= sizeof(TElement);
            return *this;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Moves the iterator to the previous element (postfix).
         * @return A copy of the iterator before decrementing.
         */
        ArrayIterator operator--(int)
        {
            ArrayIterator tmp(*this);
            --(*this);
            return tmp;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Advances the iterator by n elements.
         * @param n  Number of elements to move forward.
         * @return Reference to this iterator.
         */
        ArrayIterator& operator+=(difference_type n)
        {
            mPtr += n * sizeof(TElement);
            return *this;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Moves the iterator backward by n elements.
         * @param n  Number of elements to move backward.
         * @return Reference to this iterator.
         */
        ArrayIterator& operator-=(difference_type n)
        {
            mPtr -= n * sizeof(TElement);
            return *this;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Random-access indexing.
         * @param n  Offset from the current iterator.
         * @return Reference to the element at the given offset.
         */
        reference operator[](difference_type n) const
        {
            return *reinterpret_cast<pointer>(mPtr + n * sizeof(TElement));
        }

        friend ArrayIterator operator+(ArrayIterator it, difference_type n) { return it += n; }
        friend ArrayIterator operator+(difference_type n, ArrayIterator it) { return it += n; }
        friend ArrayIterator operator-(ArrayIterator it, difference_type n) { return it -= n; }
        friend difference_type operator-(const ArrayIterator& a, const ArrayIterator& b)
        {
            return (a.mPtr - b.mPtr) / sizeof(TElement);
        }

        friend bool operator==(const ArrayIterator& a, const ArrayIterator& b) { return a.mPtr == b.mPtr; }
        friend bool operator!=(const ArrayIterator& a, const ArrayIterator& b) { return !(a == b); }
        friend bool operator<(const ArrayIterator& a, const ArrayIterator& b) { return a.mPtr < b.mPtr; }
        friend bool operator>(const ArrayIterator& a, const ArrayIterator& b) { return b < a; }
        friend bool operator<=(const ArrayIterator& a, const ArrayIterator& b) { return !(b < a); }
        friend bool operator>=(const ArrayIterator& a, const ArrayIterator& b) { return !(a < b); }

    private:
        /**
         * @brief Raw pointer to the current element's first byte.
         *
         * This pointer always points to the beginning of a TElement object.
         */
        std::byte* mPtr;
    };
}
```

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/array_math.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "array.hpp"

#include "raw_array_math.hpp"

namespace vislab
{
    namespace detail
    {
        /**
         * @brief Concept for typed array, requring that there is an Element type and a getRaw function.
         */
        template <typename T>
        concept CArray =
            requires(const T& a) {
                typename T::Element;
                { a.getRaw() } -> std::same_as<const RawArray&>;
            };
    }

    /**
     * @brief Accesses the content of the Array through an Eigen::Map. This exposes Eigen operations on the Array.
     * @tparam TArray Array type to view through into Eigen::Matrix
     * @param typedArray Array to map to Eigen.
     * @return Map to the Eigen::Matrix
     */
    template <detail::CArray TArray>
    auto toEigen(const TArray& typedArray)
    {
        using TElement = typename TArray::Element;
        using Scalar   = typename TElement::Scalar;
        static_assert(TElement::SizeAtCompileTime != Eigen::Dynamic, "Typed arrays must have fixed-size element types");

        const RawArray& raw = typedArray.getRaw();

        // Safety checks
        assert(raw.getNumComponents() == TElement::SizeAtCompileTime);
        assert(raw.getElementSizeInBytes() == sizeof(Scalar) * TElement::SizeAtCompileTime);
        assert(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(raw.getData().data()) % alignof(Scalar) == 0);

        using TMatrix = Eigen::Matrix<
            Scalar,
            Eigen::Dynamic,
            TElement::SizeAtCompileTime,
            Eigen::RowMajor>;

        return Eigen::Map<const TMatrix>(
            reinterpret_cast<const Scalar*>(raw.getData().data()),
            raw.getSize(),              // rows = number of elements
            TElement::SizeAtCompileTime // cols = number of components
        );
    }

    /**
     * @brief Computes component-wise the minimum value in O(n).
     * @tparam TArray Typed array with known TElement.
     * @param typedArray Array to compute minimum value for.
     * @return Smallest value per component as TElement.
     */
    template <detail::CArray TArray>
    [[nodiscard]] auto getMin(const TArray& typedArray)
    {
        using TElement = typename TArray::Element;
        return getMin<TElement>(typedArray.getRaw());
    }

    /**
     * @brief Computes component-wise the maximum value in O(n).
     * @tparam TArray Typed array with known TElement.
     * @param typedArray Array to compute maximum value for.
     * @return Largest value per component as TElement.
     */
    template <detail::CArray TArray>
    [[nodiscard]] auto getMax(const TArray& typedArray)
    {
        using TElement = typename TArray::Element;
        return getMax<TElement>(typedArray.getRaw());
    }

    /**
     * @brief Computes component-wise minimum and casts to the element type of TArray.
     * @tparam TElement Requested TElement type to convert into.
     * @tparam TArray Typed array with known TElement.
     * @param typedArray Array to compute minimum value for.
     * @return Smallest value per component, cast to TElement::Scalar.
     */
    template <typename TElement, detail::CArray TArray>
    [[nodiscard]] auto getMinAs(const TArray& typedArray)
    {
        return getMinAs<TElement>(typedArray.getRaw());
    }

    /**
     * @brief Computes component-wise maximum and casts to the element type of TArray.
     * @tparam TElement Requested TElement type to convert into.
     * @tparam TArray Typed array with known TElement.
     * @param typedArray Array to compute maximum value for.
     * @return Largest value per component, cast to TElement::Scalar.
     */
    template <typename TElement, detail::CArray TArray>
    [[nodiscard]] auto getMaxAs(const TArray& typedArray)
    {
        return getMaxAs<TElement>(typedArray.getRaw());
    }

}

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/base_algorithm.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "ialgorithm.hpp"

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Base class for algorithms, which implements the functions for reflecting the input ports, output ports, and parameters.
     */
    template <typename TDerivedType>
    class BaseAlgorithm : public Interface<BaseAlgorithm<TDerivedType>, IAlgorithm>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Default constructor.
         */
        BaseAlgorithm() = default;

        /**
         * @brief Gets a map containing all input ports, indexed by the unique name of the port.
         * @return Map of all input ports.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::map<std::string, const vislab::IInputPort*> getInputPorts() const
        {
            return this->template getProperties<const vislab::IInputPort>(static_cast<const TDerivedType*>(this));
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a map containing all input ports, indexed by the unique name of the port.
         * @return Map of all input ports.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::map<std::string, vislab::IInputPort*> getInputPorts()
        {
            return this->template getProperties<vislab::IInputPort>(static_cast<TDerivedType*>(this));
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a map containing all output ports, indexed by the unique name of the port.
         * @return Map of all output ports.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::map<std::string, const vislab::IOutputPort*> getOutputPorts() const
        {
            return this->template getProperties<const vislab::IOutputPort>(static_cast<const TDerivedType*>(this));
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a map containing all output ports, indexed by the unique name of the port.
         * @return Map of all output ports.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::map<std::string, vislab::IOutputPort*> getOutputPorts()
        {
            return this->template getProperties<vislab::IOutputPort>(static_cast<TDerivedType*>(this));
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a map containing all parameters, indexed by the unique name.
         * @return Map of all parameters.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::map<std::string, const vislab::IParameter*> getParameters() const
        {
            return this->template getProperties<const vislab::IParameter>(static_cast<const TDerivedType*>(this));
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a map containing all parameters, indexed by the unique name.
         * @return Map of all parameters.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::map<std::string, vislab::IParameter*> getParameters()
        {
            return this->template getProperties<vislab::IParameter>(static_cast<TDerivedType*>(this));
        }
    };

}

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/base_transfer_function.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "base_transfer_function_fwd.hpp"
#include "itransfer_function.hpp"

#include "Eigen/Eigen"

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Transfer function with fixed number of output components.
     */
    template <int64_t TComponents>
    class BaseTransferFunction : public Interface<BaseTransferFunction<TComponents>, ITransferFunction>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Number of components that the transfer function maps to.
         */
        static const int64_t Components = TComponents;

        /**
         * @brief Value type that is mapped to.
         */
        using ValueDouble = Eigen::Vector<double, TComponents>;

        /**
         * @brief Constructor with default transfer function from [0,1].
         */
        BaseTransferFunction()
            : Interface<BaseTransferFunction<TComponents>, ITransferFunction>()
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Constructor. Receives global minimal and maximal transfer function bounds.
         * @param minValue Minimum bound for the transfer function.
         * @param maxValue Maximum bound for the transfer function.
         */
        BaseTransferFunction(double minValue, double maxValue)
            : Interface<BaseTransferFunction<TComponents>, ITransferFunction>(minValue, maxValue)
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Applies the transfer function to a single value.
         * @param value Value from the domain of the transfer function.
         * @return Mapped value.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] virtual ValueDouble map(double value) const = 0;
    };
}

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/binary_input_archive.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "iinput_archive.hpp"

#include <fstream>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Archive that reads from a binary file. Note that reads and writes must be in consistent order, since everything is read/written consecutively! The "name" of variables is not used!
     */
    class BinaryInputArchive : public Concrete<BinaryInputArchive, IInputArchive>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         */
        BinaryInputArchive();

        /**
         * @brief Copy-Constructor. (Does not use the same file handle.)
         */
        BinaryInputArchive(const BinaryInputArchive& other);

        /**
         * @brief Destructor (closes the archive).
         */
        ~BinaryInputArchive() override;

        /**
         * @brief Opens the archive.
         * @param path Path to the file to open.
         * @return True if opening was successful.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool open(const char* path);

        /**
         * @brief Closes the archive.
         */
        void close();

        /**
         * @brief Archives a bool variable.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */
        void operator()(const char* name, bool& value) override;

        /**
         * @brief Archives a char variable.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */
        void operator()(const char* name, char& value) override;

        /**
         * @brief Archives a byte variable.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */
        void operator()(const char* name, std::byte& value) override;

        /**
         * @brief Archives a float variable.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */
        void operator()(const char* name, float& value) override;

        /**
         * @brief Archives a double variable.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */
        void operator()(const char* name, double& value) override;

        /**
         * @brief Archives a 16-bit signed integer variable.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */
        void operator()(const char* name, int16_t& value) override;

        /**
         * @brief Archives a 16-bit unsigned integer variable.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */
        void operator()(const char* name, uint16_t& value) override;

        /**
         * @brief Archives a 32-bit signed integer variable.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */
        void operator()(const char* name, int32_t& value) override;

        /**
         * @brief Archives a 32-bit unsigned integer variable.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */

         * @brief Archives a variable-column float Eigen::Matrix variable.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.

        /**
         * @brief Archives a variable-column double Eigen::Matrix variable.

        /**

         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.

         */

        /**
         * @brief Archives a serializable variable recursively.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */
        void operator()(const char* name, ISerializable& value) override;

    protected:

        /**
         * @brief Notifies this archive that the given state has started.
         * @param name
         * @param state
         */
        void stateStarted(const char* name, EState state) override;

        /**
         * @brief Notifies this archive that the given state has ended.
         * @param name
         * @param state
         */
        void stateEnded(const char* name, EState state) override;

        /**
         * @brief Archive an index.
         * @param index
         */
        void archiveIndex(size_t& index) override;

        /**
         * @brief Archive a size.
         * @param size
         */
        void archiveSize(size_t& size) override;

        /**
         * @brief Check if this is an input archive.
         * @return
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool isInputArchive() override;

    private:
        /**
         * @brief Writes an Eigen::Vector type.
         * @tparam TValue Scalar type inside the Eigen::Vector.
         * @tparam Size Number of elements in the Eigen::Vector.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */
        template <typename TValue, int Size>
        void processVector([[maybe_unused]] const char* name, Eigen::Vector<TValue, Size>& value)
        {
            if constexpr (Size == Eigen::Dynamic)
            {
                Eigen::Index size;
                mStream.read((char*)&size, sizeof(Eigen::Index));
                value.resize(size);
            }
            mStream.read((char*)value.data(), sizeof(TValue) * Size);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Reads an Eigen::Matrix type.
         * @tparam TValue Scalar type inside the Eigen::Matrix.
         * @tparam Rows Number of rows.
         * @tparam Cols Number of columns.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */
        template <typename TValue, int Rows, int Cols>
        void processMatrix([[maybe_unused]] const char* name, Eigen::Matrix<TValue, Rows, Cols>& value)
        {
            Eigen::Index rows, cols;
            mStream.read((char*)&rows, sizeof(Eigen::Index));
            mStream.read((char*)&cols, sizeof(Eigen::Index));
            value.resize(rows, cols);
            mStream.read((char*)value.data(), sizeof(TValue) * rows * cols);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Reads an Eigen::SparseMatrix type
         * @tparam TValue Scalar type inside the Eigen::SparseMatrix.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */
        template <typename TValue>
        void processSparseMatrix([[maybe_unused]] const char* name, Eigen::SparseMatrix<TValue>& value)
        {
            Eigen::Index rows, cols, nnz;
            mStream.read((char*)&rows, sizeof(Eigen::Index));
            mStream.read((char*)&cols, sizeof(Eigen::Index));
            mStream.read((char*)&nnz, sizeof(Eigen::Index));
            typedef Eigen::Triplet<TValue> T;
            std::vector<T> tripletList(nnz);
            mStream.read((char*)tripletList.data(), sizeof(T) * nnz);
            value = Eigen::SparseMatrix<TValue>(rows, cols);
            value.setFromTriplets(tripletList.begin(), tripletList.end());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Reads an Eigen::AlignedBox type
         * @tparam TValue Scalar type inside the Eigen::AlignedBox.
         * @tparam Size Number of dimensions.
         * @param name Name of the variable to archive.
         * @param value Value to archive.
         */
        template <typename TValue, int Size>
        void processAlignedBox([[maybe_unused]] const char* name, Eigen::AlignedBox<TValue, Size>& value)
        {
            processVector("Min", value.min());
            processVector("Max", value.max());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Stream to read from.
         */
        std::ifstream mStream;
    };
}
```

    /**

     */
    class BinaryOutputArchive : public Concrete<BinaryOutputArchive, IOutputArchive>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Constructor.

        BinaryOutputArchive() = default;

         */
        void close();
