### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/parameter.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "data.hpp"
#include "event.hpp"
#include "iarchive.hpp"
#include "iparameter.hpp"
#include "parameter_fwd.hpp"
#include "traits.hpp"
#include "transfer_function.hpp"

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Base class for a parameter.
     * @tparam TValueType Type of value that is stored in the parameter.
     */
    template <typename TValueType>
    class Parameter : public Concrete<Parameter<TValueType>, IParameter>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Type of the value stored in this parameter.
         */
        using ValueType = TValueType;

        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         */
        Parameter()
            : Concrete<Parameter<TValueType>, IParameter>()
            , mHidden(false)
        {
            if constexpr (std::is_scalar_v<TValueType>)
                mValue = TValueType(0);
            else if constexpr (detail::is_eigen_v<TValueType>)
                mValue = TValueType::Zero();
            else
                mValue = TValueType();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         * @param value Initial value.
         */
        Parameter(const TValueType& value)
            : Concrete<Parameter<TValueType>, IParameter>()
            , mHidden(false)
            , mValue(value)
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Copy-assignment operator. Event listeners are not copied.
         * @param other Other parameter to copy from.
         * @return Reference to self.
         */
        Parameter& operator=(const Parameter& other)
        {
            mValue  = other.mValue;
            mHidden = other.mHidden;
            return *this;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Assignment operator for direct value assignment.
         * @param value New value to be set.
         */
        Parameter& operator=(const ValueType& value)
        {
            setValue(value);
            return *this;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the value stored in this parameter.
         * @return Values stored in this parameter.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const TValueType& getValue() const { return mValue; }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the value stored in this parameter.
         * @param value New value to be set.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether an event is raised to all listeners.
         */
        virtual void setValue(const TValueType& value, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            if (mValue != value)
            {
                mValue = value;
                this->markChanged();
                if (notifyOnChange)
                    onChange(mValue);
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Serializes the object into/from an archive.
         * @param archive Archive to serialize from/into.
         */
        void serialize(IArchive& archive) override
        {
            archive("Value", mValue);
            archive("Hidden", mHidden);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Event that is raised when the value changes.
         */
        Event<TValueType> onChange;

        /**
         * @brief Is the parameter hidden from the UI?
         * @return True if the parameter is hidden from the UI.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool isHidden() const { return mHidden; }

        /**
         * @brief Tests if another parameter stores the exact same value and whether they have the same visibilty.
         * @param other Other parameter to compare with.
         * @return True, if the values and visibility are the same.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool operator==(const Parameter& other) const
        {
            return mValue == other.mValue && mHidden == other.mHidden;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Hides this parameter.
         */
        void hide()
        {
            if (!mHidden)
            {
                mHidden = true;
                onHiddenChange(mHidden);
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Shows this parameter.
         */
        void show()
        {
            if (mHidden)
            {
                mHidden = false;
                onHiddenChange(mHidden);
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Event that is raised when the hidden flag changes.
         */
        Event<bool> onHiddenChange;

    protected:
        /**
         * @brief Data value stored by this parameter.
         */
        TValueType mValue;

        /**
         * @brief Flag that stored whether this parameter is hidden from the UI.
         */
        bool mHidden;

        void setValueImpl(std::any value) override
        {
            setValue(std::any_cast<TValueType>(value));
        }

        [[nodiscard]] std::any getValueImpl() override
        {
            return std::any(mValue);
        }
    };
}
```

```
    /**

        /**
```

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/progress_info.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <atomic>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Class that logs the progress of an update. Derive from this class to handle reporting or logging.
     */
    class ProgressInfo
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         */
        ProgressInfo();

        /**
         * @brief Copy constructor to handle copy of atomic value.
         *
         * @param other
         */
        ProgressInfo(const ProgressInfo& other);

        /**
         * @brief Copy assignment operator to handle copy of atomic value.
         * @param other
         * @return
         */
        ProgressInfo& operator=(const ProgressInfo& other);

        /**
         * @brief Gets the current progress of the computation in [0,1].
         * @return Progress in [0=nothing done, 1=complete].
         */
        [[nodiscard]] double getProgress() const;

        /**
         * @brief Tells the progress info that one job was completed.
         */
        void jobDone();

        /**
         * @brief Tells the progress info that multiple jobs were completed.
         * @param jobsDone Number of completed jobs.
         */
        void jobsDone(uint64_t jobsDone);

        /**
         * @brief Tells the progress info that all jobs are completed.
         */
        void allJobsDone();

        /**
         * @brief Tells the progress info that none of the jobs are completed.
         */
        void noJobsDone();

        /**
         * @brief Sets the total number of jobs.
         * @param jobs Total number of jobs.
         */
        void setTotalJobs(uint64_t jobs);

    protected:
        /**
         * @brief Virtual function that is called when an update occurred. Overwrite this function to handle the reports.
         * @param progress Current progress.
         */
        virtual void onReport(double progress);

    private:
        /**
         * @brief Total number of jobs that need to be finished.
         */
        uint64_t mJobs;

        /**
         * @brief Current number of completed jobs.
         */
        std::atomic_uint64_t mJobsDone;
    };
}
```

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/raw_array.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "data.hpp"

#include "array_iterator.hpp"
#include "event.hpp"
#include "format.hpp"
#include "iarchive.hpp"
#include "traits.hpp"

#include <vector>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Class that represents an array of vector elements with a certain number of components. Each element can be interpreted as an Eigen::Vector. This type is generic and may hold any kind of Eigen::Vector.
     */
    class RawArray : public Concrete<RawArray, Data>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Empty constructor. Creates an unitialized array of 0 size.
         * @param name Optional name of the array.
         */
        explicit RawArray(const std::string& name = "")
            : mNumComponents(0)
            , mNumElements(0)
            , mElementSizeInBytes(0)
            , mFormat(EFormat::Undefined)
            , mName(name)
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the name of the array.
         * @return Name of the array.
         */
        const std::string& getName() const { return mName; }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the name of the array.
         * @param name Name of the array.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onNameChange event is raised.
         */
        void setName(const std::string& name, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            if (mName == name)
                return;
            mName = name;
            if (notifyOnChange)
                onNameChange(mName);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Allocates a buffer with a certain number elements, components, and format.
         * @param numElements Number of elements to allocate space for.
         * @param numComponents Number of components per element.
         * @param format Format of the scalar type.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange, onComponentsChange, and onFormatChange events are raised.
         */
        void allocate(size_t numElements, size_t numComponents, EFormat format, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            bool numElementsChanged   = mNumElements != numElements;
            bool numComponentsChanged = mNumComponents != numComponents;
            bool formatChanged        = mFormat != format;

            mNumElements   = numElements;
            mNumComponents = numComponents;
            mFormat        = format;
            computeElementSizeInBytes();
            mData.resize(numElements * mElementSizeInBytes);
            // mBoundingBox.resize(2 * mElementSizeInBytes);
            // setBoundingBoxEmpty();

            if (notifyOnChange)
            {
                if (numElementsChanged)
                    onSizeChange(mNumElements);
                if (numComponentsChanged)
                    onComponentsChange(mNumComponents);
                if (formatChanged)
                    onFormatChange(mFormat);
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Allocates the array for a certain element type TElement and for a certain number of elements.
         * @tparam TElement Type of the elements, which determines format and number of components.
         * @param numElements Number of elements to allocate space for. The memory is not initialized.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange, onComponentsChange, and onFormatChange events are raised.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        void allocate(size_t numElements, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            allocate(numElements,
                     detail::EigenFormatTraits<TElement>::components,
                     detail::EigenFormatTraits<TElement>::format,
                     notifyOnChange);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the format of the scalar type.
         * @return Format of scalar type.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] EFormat getFormat() const { return mFormat; }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the format of the scalar type. Note that this funcion increases or decreases the size of the buffer. The byte entries are not cast to the new format.
         * @param format Format to set.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onFormatChange event is raised.
         */
        void setFormat(EFormat format, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            if (mFormat == format)
                return;

            size_t prevElementSize = mElementSizeInBytes;

            mFormat = format;
            computeElementSizeInBytes();

            if (prevElementSize != mElementSizeInBytes)
            {
                mData.resize(mNumElements * mElementSizeInBytes);
                // mBoundingBox.resize(2 * mElementSizeInBytes);
                // setBoundingBoxEmpty();
            }
            if (notifyOnChange)
                onFormatChange(mFormat);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the number of elements in the array.
         * @return Number of elements.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] size_t getSize() const { return mNumElements; }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the number of elements in the array.
         * @param size New number of elements.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange event is raised.
         */
        void setSize(size_t size, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            if (mNumElements == size)
                return;

            mNumElements = size;
            mData.resize(mNumElements * mElementSizeInBytes);
            if (notifyOnChange)
                onSizeChange(mNumElements);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the number of components per element.
         * @return Number of components.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] size_t getNumComponents() const { return mNumComponents; }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the number of components per element. Note that this method simply resizes the underlying buffer. After changing the number of components, the stride will no longer match the elements.
         * @param numComponents Number of components to set.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onComponentsChange event is raised.
         */
        void setNumComponents(size_t numComponents, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            if (mNumComponents == numComponents)
                return;

            mNumComponents = numComponents;
            computeElementSizeInBytes();

            mData.resize(mNumElements * mElementSizeInBytes);
            // mBoundingBox.resize(2 * mElementSizeInBytes);
            // setBoundingBoxEmpty();
            if (notifyOnChange)
                onComponentsChange(mNumComponents);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the size of each element in bytes.
         * @return Element size in bytes.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] size_t getElementSizeInBytes() const { return mElementSizeInBytes; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the size of the complete raw buffer in bytes.
         * @return Size of the raw buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] size_t getSizeInBytes() const { return mData.size(); }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a reference to the underlying std::vector containing the data.
         * @return Raw vector of bytes.
         */
        const std::vector<std::byte, Eigen::aligned_allocator<std::byte>>& getData() const& { return mData; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a reference to the underlying std::vector containing the data.
         * @return Raw vector of bytes.
         */
        std::vector<std::byte, Eigen::aligned_allocator<std::byte>>& getData() & { return mData; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a reference to the underlying std::vector containing the data.
         * @return Raw vector of bytes.
         */
        std::vector<std::byte, Eigen::aligned_allocator<std::byte>>&& getData() && { return std::move(mData); }

        /**
         * @brief Constructs the array with an initializer list.
         * @tparam TElement Type of each element.
         * @param list List of elements.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange, onComponentsChange, and onFormatChange events are raised.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        void setValues(std::initializer_list<TElement> list, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            size_t numElements   = mNumElements;
            size_t numComponents = mNumComponents;
            EFormat format       = mFormat;

            allocate<TElement>(list.size(), false);
            std::size_t i = 0;
            for (auto& elem : list)
                setValue<TElement>(i++, elem);

            if (notifyOnChange)
            {
                if (numElements != mNumElements)
                    onSizeChange(mNumElements);
                if (numComponents != mNumComponents)
                    onComponentsChange(mNumComponents);
                if (format != mFormat)
                    onFormatChange(mFormat);
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets values into the array by using a begin and end iterator.
         * @tparam TElement Type of the array elements.
         * @tparam InputIt Type of the iterator.
         * @param first begin() iterator.
         * @param last end() iterator.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange, onComponentsChange, and onFormatChange events are raised.
         */
        template <typename TElement, typename InputIt>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> &&
                     (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        void setValues(InputIt first, InputIt last, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            size_t numElements   = mNumElements;
            size_t numComponents = mNumComponents;
            EFormat format       = mFormat;

            const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(std::distance(first, last));

            allocate<TElement>(count, false);

            std::size_t i = 0;
            for (auto it = first; it != last; ++it)
                setValue<TElement>(i++, *it);

            if (notifyOnChange)
            {
                if (numElements != mNumElements)
                    onSizeChange(mNumElements);
                if (numComponents != mNumComponents)
                    onComponentsChange(mNumComponents);
                if (format != mFormat)
                    onFormatChange(mFormat);
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Constructs the array with an initializer list.
         * @tparam TElement Type of each element. Must be a pod type.
         * @param list List of elements.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange, onComponentsChange, and onFormatChange events are raised.
         */
        template <typename TScalar>
            requires std::is_trivial_v<TScalar>
        void setValues(std::initializer_list<TScalar> list, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            size_t numElements   = mNumElements;
            size_t numComponents = mNumComponents;
            EFormat format       = mFormat;

            allocate<Eigen::Vector<TScalar, 1>>(list.size(), false);
            std::size_t i = 0;
            for (auto elem : list)
                setValue<TScalar>(i++, elem);

            if (notifyOnChange)
            {
                if (numElements != mNumElements)
                    onSizeChange(mNumElements);
                if (numComponents != mNumComponents)
                    onComponentsChange(mNumComponents);
                if (format != mFormat)
                    onFormatChange(mFormat);
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets values into the array by using a begin and end iterator.
         * @tparam TScalar Scalar type of elements to insert.
         * @tparam InputIt Type of the iterator.
         * @param first begin() iterator.
         * @param last end() iterator.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange, onComponentsChange, and onFormatChange events are raised.
         */
        template <typename TScalar, typename InputIt>
            requires std::is_trivial_v<TScalar>
        void setValues(InputIt first, InputIt last, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            size_t numElements   = mNumElements;
            size_t numComponents = mNumComponents;
            EFormat format       = mFormat;

            const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(std::distance(first, last));

            allocate<Eigen::Vector<TScalar, 1>>(count, false);

            std::size_t i = 0;
            for (auto it = first; it != last; ++it)
                setValue<TScalar>(i++, *it);

            if (notifyOnChange)
            {
                if (numElements != mNumElements)
                    onSizeChange(mNumElements);
                if (numComponents != mNumComponents)
                    onComponentsChange(mNumComponents);
                if (format != mFormat)
                    onFormatChange(mFormat);
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the value at a specific index. Note that this function assumes that the given TElement type matches the underlying format. If this is not the case, the bytes are interpreted incorrectly.
         * @tparam TElement Assumed Eigen::Vector type of the underlying data.
         * @param index Index to set the value.
         * @param value Value to set.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        void setValue(size_t index, const TElement& value)
        {
            assert(isValueType<TElement>());
            reinterpret_cast<TElement*>(mData.data())[index] = value;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the value at a specific index. Note that this function assumes that the given TScalar type matches the underlying format. If this is not the case, the bytes are interpreted incorrectly.
         * @tparam TScalar Assumed scalar type of the underlying data.
         * @param index Index to set the value.
         * @param value Value to set.
         */
        template <typename TScalar>
            requires std::is_trivial_v<TScalar>
        void setValue(size_t index, const TScalar& value)
        {
            using TElement = Eigen::Vector<TScalar, 1>;
            assert(isValueType<TElement>());
            reinterpret_cast<TElement*>(mData.data())[index][0] = value;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the value at a specific index. Note that this function converts the given TElement into the type that is stored in the array. If the given TElement type matches the underlying type, then this function has basically the same speed as setValue.
         * @tparam TElement Element type of the value to set. This type gets converted automatically to the target type.
         * @param index Index to set the value.
         * @param value Value to set.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        void setValueAs(size_t index, const TElement& value)
        {
            assert(TElement::RowsAtCompileTime == mNumComponents);
            switch (mFormat)
            {
            case EFormat::Float32:
                reinterpret_cast<Eigen::Vector<float, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index] = value.template cast<float>();
                break;
            case EFormat::Float64:
                reinterpret_cast<Eigen::Vector<double, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index] = value.template cast<double>();
                break;
            case EFormat::Int16:
                reinterpret_cast<Eigen::Vector<int16_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index] = value.template cast<int16_t>();
                break;
            case EFormat::Int32:
                reinterpret_cast<Eigen::Vector<int32_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index] = value.template cast<int32_t>();
                break;
            case EFormat::Int64:
                reinterpret_cast<Eigen::Vector<int64_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index] = value.template cast<int64_t>();
                break;
            case EFormat::UInt16:
                reinterpret_cast<Eigen::Vector<uint16_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index] = value.template cast<uint16_t>();
                break;
            case EFormat::UInt32:
                reinterpret_cast<Eigen::Vector<uint32_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index] = value.template cast<uint32_t>();
                break;
            case EFormat::UInt64:
                reinterpret_cast<Eigen::Vector<uint64_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index] = value.template cast<uint64_t>();
                break;
            default:
                throw std::runtime_error("Unknown format.");
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the value at a specific index. Note that this function converts the given TElement into the type that is stored in the array. If the given TElement type matches the underlying type, then this function has basically the same speed as setValue.
         * @tparam TElement Element type of the value to set. This type gets converted automatically to the target type.
         * @param index Index to set the value.
         * @param value Value to set.
         */
        template <typename TScalar>
            requires std::is_trivial_v<TScalar>
        void setValueAs(size_t index, const TScalar& value)
        {
            assert(mNumComponents == 1);
            switch (mFormat)
            {
            case EFormat::Float32:
                reinterpret_cast<float*>(mData.data())[index] = static_cast<float>(value);
                break;
            case EFormat::Float64:
                reinterpret_cast<double*>(mData.data())[index] = static_cast<double>(value);
                break;
            case EFormat::Int16:
                reinterpret_cast<int16_t*>(mData.data())[index] = static_cast<int16_t>(value);
                break;
            case EFormat::Int32:
                reinterpret_cast<int32_t*>(mData.data())[index] = static_cast<int32_t>(value);
                break;
            case EFormat::Int64:
                reinterpret_cast<int64_t*>(mData.data())[index] = static_cast<int64_t>(value);
                break;
            case EFormat::UInt16:
                reinterpret_cast<uint16_t*>(mData.data())[index] = static_cast<uint16_t>(value);
                break;
            case EFormat::UInt32:
                reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(mData.data())[index] = static_cast<uint32_t>(value);
                break;
            case EFormat::UInt64:
                reinterpret_cast<uint64_t*>(mData.data())[index] = static_cast<uint64_t>(value);
                break;
            default:
                throw std::runtime_error("Unknown format.");
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the value at a certain index. Note that this function assumes that the given TElement type matches the underlying format. If this is not the case, the bytes are interpreted incorrectly.
         * @tparam TElement Assumed Eigen::Vector type of the underlying data.
         * @param index Index to get the value.
         * @return Value at the index.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        [[nodiscard]] const TElement& getValue(size_t index) const
        {
            assert(isValueType<TElement>());
            return reinterpret_cast<const TElement*>(mData.data())[index];
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the value at a certain index. Note that this function assumes that the given TElement type matches the underlying format. If this is not the case, the bytes are interpreted incorrectly.
         * @tparam TElement Assumed Eigen::Vector type of the underlying data.
         * @param index Index to get the value.
         * @return Value at the index.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        [[nodiscard]] TElement& getValue(size_t index)
        {
            assert(isValueType<TElement>());
            return reinterpret_cast<TElement*>(mData.data())[index];
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the value at a specific index. Note that this function converts into the given TElement type. If the given TElement type matches the underlying type, then this function has basically the same speed as getValue.
         * @tparam TElement Target Element type of the value to get. The underlying type gets converted automatically to the target type.
         * @param index Index to get the value.
         * @return Value to get.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        [[nodiscard]] TElement getValueAs(size_t index) const
        {
            assert(TElement::RowsAtCompileTime == mNumComponents);
            switch (mFormat)
            {
            case EFormat::Float32:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::Vector<float, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index].template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::Float64:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::Vector<double, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index].template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::Int16:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::Vector<int16_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index].template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::Int32:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::Vector<int32_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index].template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::Int64:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::Vector<int64_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index].template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::UInt16:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::Vector<uint16_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index].template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::UInt32:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::Vector<uint32_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index].template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::UInt64:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::Vector<uint64_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mData.data())[index].template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            default:
                throw std::runtime_error("Unknown format.");
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a raw pointer to the underlying data.
         * @tparam TElement Assumed type of the data.
         * @return Raw pointer to the data.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        [[nodiscard]] const TElement* getPtr() const
        {
            assert(isValueType<TElement>());
            return reinterpret_cast<const TElement*>(mData.data());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a raw pointer to the underlying data.
         * @tparam TElement Assumed type of the data.
         * @return Raw pointer to the data.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        [[nodiscard]] TElement* getPtr()
        {
            assert(isValueType<TElement>());
            return reinterpret_cast<TElement*>(mData.data());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Checks if the given TElement type matches with the data stored in this array, i.e., the format and the number of components are checked.
         * @tparam TElement Element type to check.
         * @return True if the TElement type is equivalent to the type in which the underlying data is stored.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        [[nodiscard]] bool isValueType() const
        {
            return getFormat() == detail::EigenFormatTraits<TElement>::format &&
                   getNumComponents() == detail::EigenFormatTraits<TElement>::components &&
                   getElementSizeInBytes() == sizeof(TElement);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets all values to zero.
         */
        void setZero()
        {
            std::memset(mData.data(), 0, getSizeInBytes());
            // std::memset(mBoundingBox.data(), 0, mElementSizeInBytes * 2);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Deletes all elements.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange event is raised.
         */
        void clear(bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            mData.clear();
            mNumElements = 0;
            // setBoundingBoxEmpty();
            if (notifyOnChange)
                onSizeChange(mNumElements);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Tests if two arrays are equal.
         * @param other Array to compare with.
         * @return True if equal.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool isEqual(const RawArray& other) const
        {
            if (mNumComponents != other.mNumComponents)
                return false;
            if (mNumElements != other.mNumElements)
                return false;
            if (mElementSizeInBytes != other.mElementSizeInBytes)
                return false;
            if (mFormat != other.mFormat)
                return false;
            if (mName != other.mName)
                return false;
            return mData == other.mData;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Appends a value at the end.
         * @tparam TElement Assumed element type of the underlying data.
         * @param value Value to append.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange event is raised.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        void push_back(const TElement& value, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            assert(isValueType<TElement>());
            setSize(getSize() + 1, false);
            setValue(getSize() - 1, value);
            if (notifyOnChange)
                onSizeChange(mNumElements);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Appends an entire array at the end.
         * @param other Array to append.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange event is raised.
         */
        void append(const RawArray& other, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            assert(mNumComponents == other.getNumComponents());
            assert(mFormat == other.getFormat());
            std::size_t oldsize = getSizeInBytes();
            setSize(getSize() + other.getSize(), false);
            memcpy(mData.data() + oldsize, other.getData().data(), other.getSizeInBytes());
            if (notifyOnChange)
                onSizeChange(mNumElements);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Prepends an element at the front (linear time complexity, since the entire array is copied).
         * @tparam TElement Assumed element type of the underlying data.
         * @param value Element to prepend.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange event is raised.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        void push_front(const TElement& value, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            assert(isValueType<TElement>());
            std::size_t oldsize = getSize();
            setSize(getSize() + 1, false);
            for (int i = (int)oldsize - 1; i >= 0; --i)
                setValue(i + 1, getValue<TElement>(i));
            setValue(0, value);
            if (notifyOnChange)
                onSizeChange(mNumElements);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Prepends an entire array at the front (linear time complexity, since the entire array is copied).
         * @param other Array to prepend.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange event is raised.
         */
        void prepend(const RawArray& other, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            assert(mNumComponents == other.getNumComponents());
            assert(mFormat == other.getFormat());
            // resize the buffer to accomodate the current and the other ones data
            std::size_t oldsize   = getSize();
            std::size_t othersize = other.getSize();
            setSize(oldsize + othersize, false);
            // move all entries to the end
            for (int i = (int)oldsize - 1; i >= 0; --i)
                memcpy(mData.data() + (othersize + i) * mElementSizeInBytes, mData.data() + i * mElementSizeInBytes, mElementSizeInBytes);
            // insert the new values at the front
            memcpy(mData.data(), other.getData().data(), other.getSizeInBytes());
            if (notifyOnChange)
                onSizeChange(mNumElements);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Reverses the order of the elements.
         */
        void reverse()
        {
            assert(isValid());
            const Eigen::Index n = getSize();
            std::vector<std::byte> temp(mElementSizeInBytes);
            for (Eigen::Index i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i)
            {
                memcpy(temp.data(), mData.data() + i * mElementSizeInBytes, mElementSizeInBytes);
                memcpy(mData.data() + i * mElementSizeInBytes, mData.data() + (n - 1 - i) * mElementSizeInBytes, mElementSizeInBytes);
                memcpy(mData.data() + (n - 1 - i) * mElementSizeInBytes, temp.data(), mElementSizeInBytes);
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Erases a range of elements from the array.
         * @param first First element index to remove (inclusive).
         * @param last Last element index to remove (exclusive).
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange event is raised.
         */
        void erase(std::size_t first, std::size_t last, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            if (first >= last || last > mNumElements)
                return;

            std::byte* data = mData.data();

            std::size_t tailBytes = (mNumElements - last) * mElementSizeInBytes;

            // shift tail down
            std::memmove(data + first * mElementSizeInBytes,
                         data + last * mElementSizeInBytes,
                         tailBytes);

            // shrink vector
            mData.resize((mNumElements - (last - first)) * mElementSizeInBytes);
            mNumElements -= (last - first);
            if (notifyOnChange)
                onSizeChange(mNumElements);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Removes the element at a certain index.
         * @param pos Index of the element to remove.
         */
        void erase(std::size_t pos) { erase(pos, pos + 1); }

        /**
         * @brief Removes the last n elements of this array.
         * @param n Number of elements to remove at the end.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange event is raised.
         */
        void pop_back(std::size_t n = 1, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            setSize(getSize() - n, false);
            if (notifyOnChange)
                onSizeChange(mNumElements);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Removes the first n elements of this array.
         * @param n Number of elements to remove at the front.
         * @param notifyOnChange Flag that determines whether the onSizeChange event is raised.
         */
        void pop_front(std::size_t n = 1, bool notifyOnChange = true)
        {
            // Copy each element n places ahead
            for (size_t i = n; i < mNumElements; ++i)
                memcpy(mData.data() + (i - n) * mElementSizeInBytes, mData.data() + i * mElementSizeInBytes, mElementSizeInBytes);
            pop_back(n, false);
            if (notifyOnChange)
                onSizeChange(mNumElements);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Get the first element.
         * @tparam TElement Assumed element type of the underlying data.
         * @return First element.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        [[nodiscard]] const TElement& front() const
        {
            assert(isValueType<TElement>());
            return getValue<TElement>(0);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Get the first element.
         * @tparam TElement Target Element type of the value to get. The underlying type gets converted automatically to the target type.
         * @return First element.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        [[nodiscard]] TElement frontAs() const
        {
            return getValueAs<TElement>(0);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Get the last element.
         * @tparam TElement Assumed element type of the underlying data.
         * @return Last element.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        [[nodiscard]] const TElement& back() const
        {
            assert(isValueType<TElement>());
            return getValue<TElement>(getSize() - 1);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Get the last element.
         * @tparam TElement Target Element type of the value to get. The underlying type gets converted automatically to the target type.
         * @return Last element.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        [[nodiscard]] TElement backAs() const
        {
            return getValueAs<TElement>(getSize() - 1);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Tests if the data object is fully initialized and ready for use.
         * @return True if the data object is in a valid state.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool isValid() const override
        {
            // is entirely uninitialized, then we count this as valid
            if (mFormat == EFormat::Undefined && mElementSizeInBytes == 0 && mNumElements == 0 && mNumComponents == 0)
                return true;

            // if at least one parameter has changed, then the others need to be valid, although it is ok if the mNumElement==0.
            if (mFormat == EFormat::Undefined)
                return false;
            if (mElementSizeInBytes == 0)
                return false;
            if (mNumComponents == 0)
                return false;
            return true;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Serializes the object into/from an archive.
         * @param archive Archive to serialize into/from.
         */
        void serialize(IArchive& archive) override
        {
            std::string name = mName;
            archive("Name", mName);
            if (name != mName)
                onNameChange(mName);

            size_t numComponents = mNumComponents;
            archive("NumComponents", mNumComponents);
            if (numComponents != mNumComponents)
                onComponentsChange(mNumComponents);

            size_t numElements = mNumElements;
            archive("NumElements", mNumElements);
            if (numElements != mNumElements)
                onSizeChange(mNumElements);

            archive("ElementSizeInBytes", mElementSizeInBytes);

            int format = (int)mFormat;
            archive("Format", format);
            if (format != (int)mFormat)
                onFormatChange(mFormat);
            mFormat = (EFormat)format;

            archive("Data", mData);
        }

        //    default:
        //        throw std::runtime_error("Unknown format.");
        //    }
        //}

        /**
         * @brief Assigns an element from another RawArray into this RawArray. Assumes that the number of components and the format match.
         * @param ito Index in this array to write into.
         * @param ifrom Index of other array to read from.
         * @param other Other array to read from.
         */
        void assign(size_t ito, size_t ifrom, const RawArray& other)
        {
            assert(mNumComponents == other.mNumComponents);
            assert(mFormat == other.mFormat);
            std::memcpy(mData.data() + mElementSizeInBytes * ito,
                        other.mData.data() + mElementSizeInBytes * ifrom,
                        mElementSizeInBytes);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Inserts a range of elements from another RawArray into this RawArray at the given position.
         * @param pos Index in this array where the new elements should be inserted.
         * @param first Index of the first element in the other array to copy.
         * @param last Index one past the last element in the other array to copy.
         * @param other Other array to read from.
         */
        void insert(size_t pos, size_t first, size_t last, const RawArray& other)
        {
            assert(mNumComponents == other.mNumComponents);
            assert(mFormat == other.mFormat);
            assert(pos <= getSize());
            assert(first <= last && last <= other.getSize());

            size_t count = last - first;
            size_t bytes = count * mElementSizeInBytes;

            const std::byte* src = other.mData.data() + other.mElementSizeInBytes * first;
            auto dstIt           = mData.begin() + mElementSizeInBytes * pos;

            // Make room for count elements
            mData.insert(dstIt, bytes, std::byte{});

            // Copy bytes into the new slot
            std::memcpy(mData.data() + mElementSizeInBytes * pos,
                        src,
                        bytes);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Event that is raised when the name of the raw array changes.
         */
        Event<std::string> onNameChange;

        /**
         * @brief Event that is raised when the number of elements in the raw array changes.
         */
        Event<size_t> onSizeChange;

        /**
         * @brief Event that is raised when the number of components in the raw array changes.
         */
        Event<size_t> onComponentsChange;

        /**
         * @brief Event that is raised when the format in the raw array changes.
         */
        Event<EFormat> onFormatChange;

    private:
        /**
         * @brief Helper function that computes the size in bytes of each element.
         */
        void computeElementSizeInBytes()
        {
            switch (mFormat)
            {
            case EFormat::Float32:
                mElementSizeInBytes = mNumComponents * sizeof(float);
                break;
            case EFormat::Float64:
                mElementSizeInBytes = mNumComponents * sizeof(double);
                break;
            case EFormat::Int16:
                mElementSizeInBytes = mNumComponents * sizeof(int16_t);
                break;
            case EFormat::Int32:
                mElementSizeInBytes = mNumComponents * sizeof(int32_t);
                break;
            case EFormat::Int64:
                mElementSizeInBytes = mNumComponents * sizeof(int64_t);
                break;
            case EFormat::UInt16:
                mElementSizeInBytes = mNumComponents * sizeof(uint16_t);
                break;
            case EFormat::UInt32:
                mElementSizeInBytes = mNumComponents * sizeof(uint32_t);
                break;
            case EFormat::UInt64:
                mElementSizeInBytes = mNumComponents * sizeof(uint64_t);
                break;
            default:
                throw std::runtime_error("Unknown format.");
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Name of the array.
         */
        std::string mName;

        /**
         * @brief Vector containing the raw data. We use an allocator that aligns the memory for Eigen.
         */
        std::vector<std::byte, Eigen::aligned_allocator<std::byte>> mData;

        /**
         * @brief Number of components per element.
         */
        size_t mNumComponents;

        /**
         * @brief Number of elements in the array.
         */
        size_t mNumElements;

        /**
         * @brief Size of an individual element in bytes.
         */
        size_t mElementSizeInBytes;

        /**
         * @brief Underlying format of the scalar types.
         */
        EFormat mFormat;
    };
}
```

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/raw_array_math.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "raw_array.hpp"

#ifdef _MSC_VER
#pragma warning(push)
#pragma warning(disable : 5054)
#endif

namespace vislab
{
    namespace detail
    {
        template <typename Scalar, typename Reducer>
        Eigen::Matrix<Scalar, 1, Eigen::Dynamic>
        reduceEigen(const RawArray& raw, Reducer reducer)
        {
            auto M                                       = toEigen<Scalar>(raw);
            Eigen::Matrix<Scalar, 1, Eigen::Dynamic> row = reducer(M);
            return row;
        }

        template <typename Scalar, typename Reducer>
        std::vector<std::byte, Eigen::aligned_allocator<std::byte>>
        reduceRawBytes(const RawArray& raw, Reducer reducer)
        {
            auto M                                       = toEigen<Scalar>(raw);
            Eigen::Matrix<Scalar, 1, Eigen::Dynamic> row = reducer(M);

            std::vector<std::byte, Eigen::aligned_allocator<std::byte>> out(
                row.size() * sizeof(Scalar));
            std::memcpy(out.data(), row.data(), out.size());
            return out;
        }

        template <typename Reducer>
        auto reduceBytesByFormat(const RawArray& raw, Reducer reducer)
        {
            switch (raw.getFormat())
            {
            case EFormat::Float32:
                return reduceRawBytes<float>(raw, reducer);
            case EFormat::Float64:
                return reduceRawBytes<double>(raw, reducer);
            case EFormat::Int16:
                return reduceRawBytes<int16_t>(raw, reducer);
            case EFormat::Int32:
                return reduceRawBytes<int32_t>(raw, reducer);
            case EFormat::Int64:
                return reduceRawBytes<int64_t>(raw, reducer);
            case EFormat::UInt16:
                return reduceRawBytes<uint16_t>(raw, reducer);
            case EFormat::UInt32:
                return reduceRawBytes<uint32_t>(raw, reducer);
            case EFormat::UInt64:
                return reduceRawBytes<uint64_t>(raw, reducer);
            default:
                throw std::runtime_error("Unknown format.");
            }
        }

        inline auto computeMin(const RawArray& raw)
        {
            return reduceBytesByFormat(raw, [](auto& M)
                                       { return M.colwise().minCoeff(); });
        }

        inline auto computeMax(const RawArray& raw)
        {
            return reduceBytesByFormat(raw, [](auto& M)
                                       { return M.colwise().maxCoeff(); });
        }

        /**
         * @brief Concept for scalar types compatible with Array.
         */
        template <typename Scalar>
        concept CScalar =
            std::is_same_v<Scalar, float> ||
            std::is_same_v<Scalar, double> ||
            std::is_same_v<Scalar, int16_t> ||
            std::is_same_v<Scalar, int32_t> ||
            std::is_same_v<Scalar, int64_t> ||
            std::is_same_v<Scalar, uint16_t> ||
            std::is_same_v<Scalar, uint32_t> ||
            std::is_same_v<Scalar, uint64_t>;
    }

    /**
     * @brief Accesses the content of the RawArray through an Eigen::Map. This exposes Eigen operations on the RawArray.
     * @tparam Scalar Scalar type of the Eigen::Matrix. Must match the RawArray type.
     * @param raw RawArray to map to Eigen.
     * @return Map to the Eigen::Matrix
     */
    template <detail::CScalar Scalar>
    auto toEigen(const RawArray& raw)
    {
        static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<Scalar>);
        assert(raw.getElementSizeInBytes() == sizeof(Scalar) * raw.getNumComponents());
        assert(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(raw.getData().data()) % alignof(Scalar) == 0);

        using TMatrix = Eigen::Matrix<Scalar, Eigen::Dynamic, Eigen::Dynamic, Eigen::RowMajor>;
        return Eigen::Map<const TMatrix>(
            reinterpret_cast<const Scalar*>(raw.getData().data()),
            raw.getSize(),         // rows = number of elements
            raw.getNumComponents() // cols = number of components
        );
    }

    /**
     * @brief Accesses the content of the RawArray through an Eigen::Map. This exposes Eigen operations on the RawArray.
     * @tparam Scalar Scalar type of the Eigen::Matrix. Must match the RawArray type.
     * @param raw RawArray to map to Eigen.
     * @return Map to the Eigen::Matrix
     */
    template <detail::CScalar Scalar>
    auto toEigen(RawArray& raw)
    {
        static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<Scalar>);
        assert(raw.getElementSizeInBytes() == sizeof(Scalar) * raw.getNumComponents());
        assert(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(raw.getData().data()) % alignof(Scalar) == 0);

        using TMatrix = Eigen::Matrix<Scalar, Eigen::Dynamic, Eigen::Dynamic, Eigen::RowMajor>;
        return Eigen::Map<TMatrix>(
            reinterpret_cast<Scalar*>(raw.getData().data()),
            raw.getSize(),         // rows = number of elements
            raw.getNumComponents() // cols = number of components
        );
    }

    /**
     * @brief Computes component-wise the minimum value in O(n).
     * @tparam TElement Assumed element type of the underlying data.
     * @param rawArray Array to compute minimum value for.
     * @return Smallest value per component.
     */
    template <typename TElement>
    [[nodiscard]] TElement getMin(const RawArray& raw)
    {
        using Scalar = typename TElement::Scalar;

        static_assert(TElement::SizeAtCompileTime != Eigen::Dynamic, "TElement must be fixed-size");
        assert(raw.getNumComponents() == TElement::SizeAtCompileTime);
        assert(raw.getElementSizeInBytes() == sizeof(Scalar) * TElement::SizeAtCompileTime);

        auto row = detail::reduceEigen<Scalar>(
            raw,
            [](auto& M)
            { return M.colwise().minCoeff(); });

        assert(row.size() == TElement::SizeAtCompileTime);
        return Eigen::Map<const TElement>(row.data());
    }

    /**
     * @brief Gets component-wise the minimum value.
     * @tparam TElement Target Element type of the value to get. The underlying type gets converted automatically to the target type.
     * @param rawArray Array to compute minimum value for.
     * @return Smallest value per component.
     */
    template <typename TElement>
    [[nodiscard]] TElement getMinAs(const RawArray& raw)
    {
        using TargetScalar = typename TElement::Scalar;

        static_assert(TElement::SizeAtCompileTime != Eigen::Dynamic, "TElement must be fixed-size");
        assert(raw.getNumComponents() == TElement::SizeAtCompileTime);

        auto reducer = [](auto& M)
        { return M.colwise().minCoeff(); };

        auto make = [&](auto scalarTag) -> TElement
        {
            using Scalar = decltype(scalarTag);

            auto row = detail::reduceEigen<Scalar>(raw, reducer);

            // IMPORTANT: evaluate cast into a concrete vector
            Eigen::Matrix<TargetScalar, 1, Eigen::Dynamic> casted =
                row.template cast<TargetScalar>();

            assert(casted.size() == TElement::SizeAtCompileTime);
            return Eigen::Map<const TElement>(casted.data());
        };

        switch (raw.getFormat())
        {
        case EFormat::Float32:
            return make(float{});
        case EFormat::Float64:
            return make(double{});
        case EFormat::Int16:
            return make(int16_t{});
        case EFormat::Int32:
            return make(int32_t{});
        case EFormat::Int64:
            return make(int64_t{});
        case EFormat::UInt16:
            return make(uint16_t{});
        case EFormat::UInt32:
            return make(uint32_t{});
        case EFormat::UInt64:
            return make(uint64_t{});
        default:
            throw std::runtime_error("Unknown format.");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @brief Computes component-wise the maximum value in O(n).
     * @tparam TElement Assumed element type of the underlying data.
     * @param rawArray Array to compute maximum value for.
     * @return Largest value per component.
     */
    template <typename TElement>
    [[nodiscard]] TElement getMax(const RawArray& raw)
    {
        using Scalar = typename TElement::Scalar;

        static_assert(TElement::SizeAtCompileTime != Eigen::Dynamic, "TElement must be fixed-size");
        assert(raw.getNumComponents() == TElement::SizeAtCompileTime);
        assert(raw.getElementSizeInBytes() == sizeof(Scalar) * TElement::SizeAtCompileTime);

        auto row = detail::reduceEigen<Scalar>(
            raw,
            [](auto& M)
            { return M.colwise().maxCoeff(); });

        assert(row.size() == TElement::SizeAtCompileTime);
        return Eigen::Map<const TElement>(row.data());
    }

    /**
     * @brief Gets component-wise the maximum value.
     * @tparam TElement Target Element type of the value to get. The underlying type gets converted automatically to the target type.
     * @param rawArray Array to compute maximum value for.
     * @return Largest value per component.
     */
    template <typename TElement>
    [[nodiscard]] TElement getMaxAs(const RawArray& raw)
    {
        using TargetScalar = typename TElement::Scalar;

        static_assert(TElement::SizeAtCompileTime != Eigen::Dynamic, "TElement must be fixed-size");
        assert(raw.getNumComponents() == TElement::SizeAtCompileTime);

        auto reducer = [](auto& M)
        { return M.colwise().maxCoeff(); };

        auto make = [&](auto scalarTag) -> TElement
        {
            using Scalar = decltype(scalarTag);

            auto row = detail::reduceEigen<Scalar>(raw, reducer);

            // IMPORTANT: evaluate cast into a concrete vector
            Eigen::Matrix<TargetScalar, 1, Eigen::Dynamic> casted =
                row.template cast<TargetScalar>();

            assert(casted.size() == TElement::SizeAtCompileTime);
            return Eigen::Map<const TElement>(casted.data());
        };

        switch (raw.getFormat())
        {
        case EFormat::Float32:
            return make(float{});
        case EFormat::Float64:
            return make(double{});
        case EFormat::Int16:
            return make(int16_t{});
        case EFormat::Int32:
            return make(int32_t{});
        case EFormat::Int64:
            return make(int64_t{});
        case EFormat::UInt16:
            return make(uint16_t{});
        case EFormat::UInt32:
            return make(uint32_t{});
        case EFormat::UInt64:
            return make(uint64_t{});
        default:
            throw std::runtime_error("Unknown format.");
        }
    }

}

#pragma warning(pop)
#endif
```

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/raw_array_sort.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "raw_array.hpp"

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Sort componentwise in ascending order.
     * @tparam TElement Assumed element type of the underlying data.
     */
    template <typename TElement>
        requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> &&
                 (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
    void sortAscending(RawArray& rawArray)
    {
        using Scalar = typename TElement::Scalar;

        auto M = toEigen<Scalar>(rawArray); // dynamic × fixed matrix

        const size_t rows = M.rows();
        const size_t cols = M.cols();

        std::vector<Scalar> buffer(rows);

        for (size_t c = 0; c < cols; ++c)
        {
            // copy column into buffer
            for (size_t r = 0; r < rows; ++r)
                buffer[r] = M(r, c);

            std::sort(buffer.begin(), buffer.end());

            // write back
            for (size_t r = 0; r < rows; ++r)
                M(r, c) = buffer[r];
        }
    }

    /**
     * @brief Sort componentwise in descending order.
     * @tparam TElement Assumed element type of the underlying data.
     */
    template <typename TElement>
        requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> &&
                 (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
    void sortDescending(RawArray& rawArray)
    {
        using Scalar = typename TElement::Scalar;

        auto M = toEigen<Scalar>(rawArray);

        const size_t rows = M.rows();
        const size_t cols = M.cols();

        std::vector<Scalar> buffer(rows);

        for (size_t c = 0; c < cols; ++c)
        {
            for (size_t r = 0; r < rows; ++r)
                buffer[r] = M(r, c);

            std::sort(buffer.rbegin(), buffer.rend());

            for (size_t r = 0; r < rows; ++r)
                M(r, c) = buffer[r];
        }
    }
}
```

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/reflect.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "type.hpp"

#include "input_port.hpp"
#include "output_port.hpp"

namespace vislab
{
    template <typename TDerived>
    class FactoryWrapper
    {
    public:
        FactoryWrapper(meta::factory<TDerived> _factory)
            : factory(_factory)
        {
        }

        template <auto TMember>
        FactoryWrapper& member(const std::string& name, const std::string& description, const std::string& label)
        {
            std::hash<std::string> hash;
            // clang-format off
            factory.template data<TMember, meta::as_alias_t>(hash(name),
                meta::make_name_property(name),
                meta::make_property("Description", description),
                meta::make_property("Label", label));
            // clang-format on
            return *this;
        }

    private:
        meta::factory<TDerived> factory;
    };

    template <typename TDerived>
    FactoryWrapper<TDerived> reflect(const std::string& name, const std::vector<std::string>& aliases = {})
    {
        std::hash<std::string> hash;
        meta::factory<TDerived> m = aliases.empty() ? meta::named_reflect<TDerived>(name) : meta::named_reflect<TDerived>(name, aliases);
        if constexpr (std::is_constructible_v<TDerived>)
        {
            m = m.ctor();
        }
        if constexpr (std::is_base_of_v<Data, TDerived>)
        {
            meta::reflect<InputPort<TDerived>>().template base<IInputPort>().template func<&vislab::InputPort<TDerived>::getDataTypeInput>(hash("getDataTypeInput"));
            meta::reflect<OutputPort<TDerived>>().template base<IOutputPort>().template func<&vislab::OutputPort<TDerived>::getDataTypeOutput>(hash("getDataTypeOutput"));
        }
        return FactoryWrapper<TDerived>(m);
    }

    template <typename TDerived, typename TBase>
    FactoryWrapper<TDerived> reflect(const std::string& name, const std::vector<std::string>& aliases = {})
    {
        std::hash<std::string> hash;
        meta::factory<TDerived> m = aliases.empty() ? meta::named_reflect<TDerived>(name) : meta::named_reflect<TDerived>(name, aliases);
        m                         = m.template base<TBase>();
        if constexpr (std::is_constructible_v<TDerived>)
        {
            m = m.ctor();
        }
        if constexpr (std::is_base_of_v<Data, TDerived>)
        {
            meta::reflect<InputPort<TDerived>>().template base<IInputPort>().template func<&vislab::InputPort<TDerived>::getDataTypeInput>(hash("getDataTypeInput"));
            meta::reflect<OutputPort<TDerived>>().template base<IOutputPort>().template func<&vislab::OutputPort<TDerived>::getDataTypeOutput>(hash("getDataTypeOutput"));
        }
        return FactoryWrapper<TDerived>(m);
    }

    template <typename TDerived, typename TBase1, typename TBase2>
    FactoryWrapper<TDerived> reflect(const std::string& name, const std::vector<std::string>& aliases = {})
    {
        std::hash<std::string> hash;
        meta::factory<TDerived> m = aliases.empty() ? meta::named_reflect<TDerived>(name) : meta::named_reflect<TDerived>(name, aliases);
        m                         = m.template base<TBase1>();
        m                         = m.template base<TBase2>();
        if constexpr (std::is_constructible_v<TDerived>)
        {
            m = m.ctor();
        }
        if constexpr (std::is_base_of_v<Data, TDerived>)
        {
            meta::reflect<InputPort<TDerived>>().template base<IInputPort>().template func<&vislab::InputPort<TDerived>::getDataTypeInput>(hash("getDataTypeInput"));
            meta::reflect<OutputPort<TDerived>>().template base<IOutputPort>().template func<&vislab::OutputPort<TDerived>::getDataTypeOutput>(hash("getDataTypeOutput"));
        }
        return FactoryWrapper<TDerived>(m);
    }

    template <typename TDerived, typename TBase1, typename TBase2, typename TBase3>
    FactoryWrapper<TDerived> reflect(const std::string& name, const std::vector<std::string>& aliases = {})
    {
        std::hash<std::string> hash;
        meta::factory<TDerived> m = aliases.empty() ? meta::named_reflect<TDerived>(name) : meta::named_reflect<TDerived>(name, aliases);
        m                         = m.template base<TBase1>();
        m                         = m.template base<TBase2>();
        m                         = m.template base<TBase3>();
        if constexpr (std::is_constructible_v<TDerived>)
        {
            m = m.ctor();
        }
        if constexpr (std::is_base_of_v<Data, TDerived>)
        {
            meta::reflect<InputPort<TDerived>>().template base<IInputPort>().template func<&vislab::InputPort<TDerived>::getDataTypeInput>(hash("getDataTypeInput"));
            meta::reflect<OutputPort<TDerived>>().template base<IOutputPort>().template func<&vislab::OutputPort<TDerived>::getDataTypeOutput>(hash("getDataTypeOutput"));
        }
        return FactoryWrapper<TDerived>(m);
    }
```

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/reflectable.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "type.hpp"

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief CRTP-based reflection provider for GPU-side types.
     *
     * This class mirrors the reflection behavior of vislab::Cloneable,
     * but without cloning or abstract/concrete semantics.
     *
     * It provides:
     *   - static Type type()               -> compile-time reflection
     *   - virtual Type getType() const     -> dynamic reflection
     *   - CRTP-based refinement of getTypeImpl()
     *
     * @tparam Derived  The CRTP type (the class being reflected).
     * @tparam Bases    Optional list of base classes.
     */
    template <typename Derived, typename... Bases>
    class Reflectable : public Bases...
    {
    public:
        using Bases::Bases...;
        virtual ~Reflectable() = default;

        /**
         * @brief Static reflection: returns the meta::Type of Derived.
         *
         * This is equivalent to Cloneable<Derived>::type() on the CPU side.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] static inline Type type() noexcept
        {
            return ::meta::resolve<Derived>();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Dynamic reflection: returns the meta::Type of the actual object.
         *
         * This mirrors Cloneable::getType() and ensures correct dynamic behavior
         * when accessed through a base pointer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] inline Type getType() const noexcept
        {
            return getTypeImpl();
        }

    private:
        /**
         * @brief Virtual hook for CRTP-based dynamic reflection.
         *
         * This is automatically refined for each Derived type, exactly like
         * Cloneable<T>::getTypeImpl() on the CPU side.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] virtual inline Type getTypeImpl() const noexcept
        {
            return ::meta::resolve<Derived>();
        }
    };
}
```

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/traits.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <Eigen/Eigen>

#include <type_traits>

namespace vislab
{
    namespace detail
    {
        /**
         * @brief Is 'T' an Eigen matrix?
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        using is_eigen_matrix = std::is_base_of<Eigen::MatrixBase<std::decay_t<T>>, std::decay_t<T>>;

        /**
         * @brief Value for is 'T' an Eigen matrix?
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        constexpr bool is_eigen_matrix_v = is_eigen_matrix<T>::value;

        /**
         * @brief Enable if 'T' is an Eigen matrix
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        using enable_if_eigen_matrix_t = std::enable_if_t<is_eigen_matrix_v<T>>;

        /**
         * @brief Enable if 'T' is not an Eigen matrix
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        using enable_if_not_eigen_matrix_t = std::enable_if_t<!is_eigen_matrix_v<T>>;
    }

    namespace detail
    {
        /**
         * @brief Is 'T' a sparse Eigen matrix?
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        using is_sparse_eigen_matrix = std::is_base_of<Eigen::SparseMatrixBase<std::decay_t<T>>, std::decay_t<T>>;

        /**
         * @brief Value for is 'T' a sparse Eigen matrix?
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        constexpr bool is_sparse_eigen_matrix_v = is_sparse_eigen_matrix<T>::value;

        /**
         * @brief Enable if 'T' is a sparse Eigen matrix
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        using enable_if_sparse_eigen_matrix_t = std::enable_if_t<is_sparse_eigen_matrix_v<T>>;

        /**
         * @brief Enable if 'T' is not a sparse Eigen matrix
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        using enable_if_not_sparse_eigen_matrix_t = std::enable_if_t<!is_sparse_eigen_matrix_v<T>>;
    }

    namespace detail
    {
        /**
         * @brief Is 'T' an Eigen array?
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        using is_eigen_array = std::is_base_of<Eigen::ArrayBase<std::decay_t<T>>, std::decay_t<T>>;

        /**
         * @brief Value for is 'T' an Eigen array?
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        constexpr bool is_eigen_array_v = is_eigen_array<T>::value;

        /**
         * @brief Enable if 'T' is an Eigen array
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        using enable_if_eigen_array_t = std::enable_if_t<is_eigen_array_v<T>>;

        /**
         * @brief Enable if 'T' is not an Eigen array
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        using enable_if_not_eigen_array_t = std::enable_if_t<!is_eigen_array_v<T>>;
    }

    namespace detail
    {
        /**
         * @brief Is 'T' an Eigen array or Eigen matrix?
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        using is_eigen = std::bool_constant<is_eigen_matrix_v<T> || is_sparse_eigen_matrix_v<T> || is_eigen_array_v<T>>;

        /**
         * @brief Value for is 'T' an Eigen array or Eigen matrix?
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        constexpr bool is_eigen_v = is_eigen<T>::value;

        /**
         * @brief Enable if 'T' is an Eigen array or Eigen matrix
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        using enable_if_eigen_t = std::enable_if_t<is_eigen_v<T>>;

        /**
         * @brief Enable if 'T' is not an Eigen array or Eigen matrix
         * @tparam T Type to inspect.
         */
        template <typename T>
        using enable_if_not_eigen_t = std::enable_if_t<!is_eigen_v<T>>;
    }

    namespace detail
    {
        /**
         * @brief Copies the modifiers of type S to type T (const/pointer/lvalue/rvalue reference)
         * @tparam S Source type.
         * @tparam T Target type.
         */
        template <typename S, typename T>
        struct copy_flags
        {
        private:
            using R  = std::remove_reference_t<S>;
            using T1 = std::conditional_t<std::is_const_v<R>, std::add_const_t<T>, T>;
            using T2 = std::conditional_t<std::is_pointer_v<S>, std::add_pointer_t<T1>, T1>;
            using T3 = std::conditional_t<std::is_lvalue_reference_v<S>, std::add_lvalue_reference_t<T2>, T2>;
            using T4 = std::conditional_t<std::is_rvalue_reference_v<S>, std::add_rvalue_reference_t<T3>, T3>;

        public:
            using type = T4;
        };

        /**
         * @brief Copies the modifiers of type S to type T (const/pointer/lvalue/rvalue reference)
         * @tparam S Source type.
         * @tparam T Target type.
         */
        template <typename S, typename T>
        using copy_flags_t = typename detail::copy_flags<S, T>::type;
    }

    namespace detail
    {
        // Replace the base scalar type
        template <typename T, typename Value, bool CopyFlags = true, typename = void>
        struct replace_scalar
        {
        };

        template <typename T, typename Value, bool CopyFlags>
        struct replace_scalar<T, Value, CopyFlags, std::enable_if_t<std::bool_constant</*!is_forward_dual_v<T> &&*/ !is_eigen_v<T> /*&& !is_autodiff_scalar_v<T>*/>::value>>
        {
            using type = std::conditional_t<CopyFlags, copy_flags_t<T, Value>, Value>;
        };

        // Replace the base scalar type (Eigen matrix specialization)
        template <typename T, typename Value, bool CopyFlags>
        struct replace_scalar<T, Value, CopyFlags, enable_if_eigen_matrix_t<T>>
        {
        private:
            using Matrix = Eigen::Matrix<Value, std::decay_t<T>::RowsAtCompileTime, std::decay_t<T>::ColsAtCompileTime, std::decay_t<T>::Options, std::decay_t<T>::MaxRowsAtCompileTime, std::decay_t<T>::MaxColsAtCompileTime>;

        public:
            using type = std::conditional_t<CopyFlags, copy_flags_t<T, Matrix>, Matrix>;
        };

        // Replace the base scalar type (Eigen array specialization)
        template <typename T, typename Value, bool CopyFlags>
        struct replace_scalar<T, Value, CopyFlags, enable_if_eigen_array_t<T>>
        {
        private:
            using Array = Eigen::Array<Value, std::decay_t<T>::RowsAtCompileTime, std::decay_t<T>::ColsAtCompileTime, std::decay_t<T>::Options, std::decay_t<T>::MaxRowsAtCompileTime, std::decay_t<T>::MaxColsAtCompileTime>;

        public:
            using type = std::conditional_t<CopyFlags, copy_flags_t<T, Array>, Array>;
        };

        // Replace the base scalar type
        template <typename T, typename Value, bool CopyFlags = true>
        using replace_scalar_t = typename replace_scalar<T, Value, CopyFlags>::type;
    }

    template <typename T, bool CopyFlags = true>
    using as_int32_t = detail::replace_scalar_t<T, int32_t, CopyFlags>;
    template <typename T, bool CopyFlags = true>
    using as_uint32_t = detail::replace_scalar_t<T, uint32_t, CopyFlags>;
    template <typename T, bool CopyFlags = true>
    using as_int64_t = detail::replace_scalar_t<T, int64_t, CopyFlags>;
    template <typename T, bool CopyFlags = true>
    using as_uint64_t = detail::replace_scalar_t<T, uint64_t, CopyFlags>;
    template <typename T, bool CopyFlags = true>
    using as_float_t = detail::replace_scalar_t<T, float, CopyFlags>;
    template <typename T, bool CopyFlags = true>
    using as_double_t = detail::replace_scalar_t<T, double, CopyFlags>;
    template <typename T, bool CopyFlags = true>
    using as_bool_t = detail::replace_scalar_t<T, bool, CopyFlags>;
    template <typename T, bool CopyFlags = true>
    using as_size_t = detail::replace_scalar_t<T, std::size_t, CopyFlags>;

    namespace detail
    {
        // Default trait (identity)
        template <typename T, bool = detail::is_eigen_v<T>>
        struct extract_scalar
        {
            using type = T; // default: use T
        };

        // Specialization for Eigen types
        template <typename T>
        struct extract_scalar<T, true>
        {
            using type = typename T::Scalar; // Extract Scalar from Eigen types
        };

        // Gets the type directly.
        template <typename T>
        using extract_scalar_t = typename extract_scalar<T>::type;
    }
}
```
