### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/transfer_function.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "base_transfer_function.hpp"

#include "iarchive.hpp"
#include "transfer_function_fwd.hpp"

#include <map>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Discrete transfer function
     * @tparam TScalar Scalar value type of the output type.
     * @tparam TComponents Number of components that the transfer function maps to.
     */
    template <int64_t TComponents, typename TScalar>
    class TransferFunction : public Concrete<TransferFunction<TComponents, TScalar>, BaseTransferFunction<TComponents>>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Number of components that the transfer function maps to.
         */
        static const int64_t Components = TComponents;

        /**
         * @brief Scalar value type of the output type.
         */
        using Scalar = TScalar;

        /**
         * @brief Value type that is mapped to.
         */
        using ValueDouble = typename BaseTransferFunction<TComponents>::ValueDouble;

        /**
         * @brief Value type in which the transfer function is given.
         */
        using Value = Eigen::Vector<Scalar, TComponents>;

        /**
         * @brief Constructor with default transfer function from [0,1].
         */
        TransferFunction()
            : Concrete<TransferFunction<TComponents, TScalar>, BaseTransferFunction<TComponents>>()
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Constructor. Receives global minimal and maximal transfer function bounds.
         * @param minValue Minimum bound for the transfer function.
         * @param maxValue Maximum bound for the transfer function.
         */
        TransferFunction(double minValue, double maxValue)
            : Concrete<TransferFunction<TComponents, TScalar>, BaseTransferFunction<TComponents>>(minValue, maxValue)
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Applies the transfer function to a single value.
         * @param value Value from the domain of the transfer function.
         * @return Mapped value.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] ValueDouble map(double value) const override
        {
            // Handle trivial cases
            if (mValues.empty())
                return ValueDouble::Zero();
            if (mValues.size() == 1)
                return mValues.begin()->second.template cast<double>();

            // Apply global transfer function bounds
            double t = std::min(std::max(0.0, (value - this->mMinValue) / (this->mMaxValue - this->mMinValue)), 1.0);

            // auto lower = Values.lower_bound(t);
            auto lower = mValues.upper_bound(t);
            auto upper = lower;
            lower--;

            if (lower == mValues.end())
                return mValues.begin()->second.template cast<double>();
            if (upper == mValues.end())
                return mValues.rbegin()->second.template cast<double>();

            // Interpolate the value from the nearest entries
            double t0 = lower->first;
            double t1 = upper->first;

            assert(t0 <= t && t <= t1);

            t = std::min(std::max(0.0, (t - t0) / (t1 - t0)), 1.0);
            return lower->second.template cast<double>() + t * (upper->second - lower->second).template cast<double>();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Tests if two transfer functions are equal.
         * @param other Other transfer function to compare with.
         * @return True if equal.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool operator==(const TransferFunction& other) const
        {
            if (mValues.size() != other.mValues.size() || this->mMinValue != other.mMinValue || this->mMaxValue != other.mMaxValue)
                return false;
            return std::equal(mValues.begin(), mValues.end(), other.mValues.begin(), other.mValues.end());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Tests if two transfer functions are unequal.
         * @param other Other transfer function to compare with.
         * @return True if unequal.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool operator!=(const TransferFunction& other) const
        {
            return !operator==(other);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Serializes the object into/from an archive.
         * @param archive Archive to serialize into/from.
         */
        void serialize(IArchive& archive) override
        {
            BaseTransferFunction<TComponents>::serialize(archive);
            archive("Values", mValues);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the discrete transfer function representation. The first value of the pair is the 'value' and the second value is the corresponding color.
         * @return Discrete transfer function representation.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const std::map<double, Value>& getValues() const noexcept { return mValues; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the discrete transfer function representation. The first value of the pair is the 'value' and the second value is the corresponding color.
         * @return Discrete transfer function representation.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::map<double, Value>& getValues() noexcept { return mValues; }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the discrete transfer function representation. The first value of the pair is the 'value' and the second value is the corresponding color.
         * @param values Discrete transfer function representation.
         */
        void setValues(const std::map<double, Value>& values) noexcept { mValues = values; }

    protected:
        /**
         * @brief The discrete transfer function representation. The first value of the pair is the 'value' and the second value is the corresponding color.
         */
        std::map<double, Value> mValues;
    };
}
```

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/update_info.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <string>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Return type for the update function, which contains some general information about the success and a potential error message.
     */
    class UpdateInfo
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief State after the Update call.
         */
        enum class EValidationState
        {
            /**
             * @brief The update function terminated as expected.
             */
            Valid,

            /**
             * @brief A warning was reported but the update function was still able to terminate.
             */
            Warning,

            /**
             * @brief An error occured and the result of the update function is not valid.
             */
            Error
        };

        /**
         * @brief The Update call was successful.
         * @return Reports that a computation was valid.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] static UpdateInfo reportValid();

        /**
         * @brief Report a warning message.
         * @param string Warning message.
         * @return Reports that a computation finished with a warning.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] static UpdateInfo reportWarning(const std::string& string);

        /**
         * @brief Report an error message.
         * @param string Error message.
         * @return Reports that a computation failed due to an error.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] static UpdateInfo reportError(const std::string& string);

        /**
         * @brief Gets the validation state.
         * @return Last validation state.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] EValidationState getState() const;

        /**
         * @brief Gets the warning or error message.
         * @return Last error message.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const std::string& getError() const;

        /**
         * @brief Returns true if the computation was a success.
         * @return True if GetState() == UpdateInfo::EValidationState::Valid.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool success() const;

    private:
        /**
         * @brief Constructor for an update info.
         * @param state Validation state.
         * @param string Optional error message.
         */
        UpdateInfo(EValidationState state, const std::string& string);

        /**
         * @brief State after the Update call.
         */
        EValidationState mValidationState;

        /**
         * @brief Optional warning or error message.
         */
        std::string mValidationError;
    };
}
```

### vislab/core/include/vislab/core/vislab_type_traits.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <array>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <set>
#include <type_traits>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace vislab
{
    namespace traits
    {
#define SHORTCUTS(TraitName)                           \
    template <typename T>                              \
    using TraitName##_t = typename TraitName<T>::type; \
    template <typename T>                              \
    inline constexpr bool TraitName##_v = TraitName<T>::value;
        template <typename, typename _ = void>
        struct is_map_type : std::false_type
        {
        };

        template <typename Key, typename T, typename Compare, typename Allocator>
        struct is_map_type<std::map<Key, T, Compare, Allocator>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        SHORTCUTS(is_map_type)

        template <typename, typename _ = void>
        struct is_unordered_map_type : std::false_type
        {
        };
        template <typename Key, typename T, typename Compare, typename Allocator>
        struct is_unordered_map_type<std::unordered_map<Key, T, Compare, Allocator>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        SHORTCUTS(is_unordered_map_type)

        template <typename, typename _ = void>
        struct is_set_type : std::false_type
        {
        };

        template <typename Key, typename Compare, typename Allocator>
        struct is_set_type<std::set<Key, Compare, Allocator>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        SHORTCUTS(is_set_type)

        template <typename, typename _ = void>
        struct is_vector_type : std::false_type
        {
        };

        template <typename T, typename Allocator>
        struct is_vector_type<std::vector<T, Allocator>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        SHORTCUTS(is_vector_type)

        template <typename, typename _ = void>
        struct is_array_type : std::false_type
        {
        };

        template <typename T, std::size_t N>
        struct is_array_type<std::array<T, N>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        SHORTCUTS(is_array_type)

        template <typename, typename _ = void>
        struct is_container_type : std::false_type
        {
        };

        template <typename T, std::size_t N>
        struct is_container_type<std::array<T, N>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        template <typename... Args>
        struct is_container_type<std::vector<Args...>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        template <typename... Args>
        struct is_container_type<std::set<Args...>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        template <typename... Args>
        struct is_container_type<std::map<Args...>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        template <typename... Args>
        struct is_container_type<std::unordered_map<Args...>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        SHORTCUTS(is_container_type)

        template <typename, typename _ = void>
        struct is_shared_ptr : std::false_type
        {
        };

        template <typename T>
        struct is_shared_ptr<std::shared_ptr<T>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        SHORTCUTS(is_shared_ptr)

        template <typename, typename _ = void>
        struct is_unique_ptr : std::false_type
        {
        };

        template <typename T>
        struct is_unique_ptr<std::unique_ptr<T>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        SHORTCUTS(is_unique_ptr)

        template <typename, typename _ = void>
        struct is_weak_ptr : std::false_type
        {
        };

        template <typename T>
        struct is_weak_ptr<std::weak_ptr<T>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        SHORTCUTS(is_weak_ptr)

        template <typename, typename _ = void>
        struct is_smart_ptr : std::false_type
        {
        };

        template <typename T>
        struct is_smart_ptr<T, std::enable_if_t<is_shared_ptr_v<T> || is_unique_ptr_v<T> || is_weak_ptr_v<T>>> : std::true_type
        {
        };

        SHORTCUTS(is_smart_ptr)

#undef SHORTCUTS
    }
}
```

```
#pragma once

#include <wrl/client.h>

namespace vislab
```

### vislab/d3d11/include/vislab/d3d11/d3d11_command_list.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <d3d11.h>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <wrl/client.h>

namespace vislab
{
    class D3D11Device;
    class D3D11Texture;
    class D3D11RenderPipeline;
    class D3D11ComputePipeline;
    class D3D11Buffer;

    class D3D11CommandList : public Reflectable<D3D11CommandList, ICommandList>
    {
    public:
        D3D11CommandList(D3D11Device* device,
                         Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11DeviceContext> context,
                         ECommandListType commandListType)
            : mDevice(device)
            , mContext(std::move(context))
            , mCommandListType(commandListType)
        {
        }

        void begin() override
        {
            mCommands.clear();
        }

        void end() override
        {
        }

        // Recording methods just push Command variants:

        void beginRenderPass(IGpuRenderTargetView* renderTarget,
                             IGpuDepthStencilView* depthTarget = nullptr) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdBeginRenderPass{ renderTarget, depthTarget });
        }

        void endRenderPass() override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdEndRenderPass{});
        }

        void clearRenderTarget(IGpuRenderTargetView* target, const float color[4])
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdClearRenderTargetView{ target, { color[0], color[1], color[2], color[3] } });
        }

        void clearDepthStencil(IGpuDepthStencilView* target, float depth, uint8_t stencil)
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdClearDepthStencilView{ target, depth, stencil });
        }

        void clearUnorderedAccess(IGpuUnorderedAccessView* target, const uint32_t pattern)
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdClearUnorderedAccessView{ target, pattern });
        }

        void setRenderPipeline(IRenderPipeline* pipeline) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetRenderPipeline{ pipeline });
        }

        void setComputePipeline(IComputePipeline* pipeline) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetComputePipeline{ pipeline });
        }

        void setVertexBuffer(uint32_t slot, IGpuBuffer* buffer) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetVertexBuffer{ slot, buffer });
        }

        void setIndexBuffer(IGpuBuffer* buffer) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetIndexBuffer{ buffer });
        }

        void setViewport(float x, float y, float width, float height, float minDepth, float maxDepth) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetViewport{ x, y, width, height, minDepth, maxDepth });
        }

        void setScissorRect(int32_t x, int32_t y, uint32_t width, uint32_t height) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetScissorRect{ x, y, width, height });
        }

        void setStencilRef(uint32_t ref) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetStencilRef{ ref });
        }

        void setBlendFactor(const float factor[4]) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetBlendFactor{ { factor[0], factor[1], factor[2], factor[3] } });
        }

        void setSampleMask(uint32_t mask) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetSampleMask{ mask });
        }

        void setPrimitiveTopology(EPrimitiveTopology topology) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetPrimitiveTopology{ topology });
        }

        void bindUniformBuffer(EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot, IGpuBuffer* buffer) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdBindUniformBuffer{ stages, slot, buffer });
        }

        void bindShaderResourceView(EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot, IGpuShaderResourceView* view) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdBindShaderResourceView{ stages, slot, view });
        }

        void bindUnorderedAccessView(EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot, IGpuUnorderedAccessView* view) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdBindUnorderedAccessView{ stages, slot, view });
        }

        void bindSampler(EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot, IGpuSampler* sampler) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdBindSampler{ stages, slot, sampler });
        }

        void resolveTexture(IGpuTexture* src, IGpuTexture* dst) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdResolveTexture{ src, dst });
        }

        void updateBuffer(IGpuBuffer* buffer, const void* data, size_t size, size_t offset = 0) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdUpdateBuffer{ buffer, offset, size, data });
        }

        void updateTexture1d(IGpuTexture* texture, const void* data, size_t rowPitch, uint32_t mipLevel = 0) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdUpdateTexture1d{ texture, data, rowPitch, mipLevel });
        }

        void updateTexture2d(IGpuTexture* texture, const void* data, size_t rowPitch, uint32_t mipLevel = 0) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdUpdateTexture2d{ texture, data, rowPitch, mipLevel });
        }

        void updateTexture3d(IGpuTexture* texture, const void* data, size_t rowPitch, size_t slicePitch, uint32_t mipLevel = 0) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdUpdateTexture3d{ texture, data, rowPitch, slicePitch, mipLevel });
        }

        void draw(uint32_t vertexCount, uint32_t firstVertex = 0) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdDraw{ vertexCount, firstVertex });
        }

        void drawIndexed(uint32_t indexCount, uint32_t firstIndex = 0, int32_t vertexOffset = 0) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdDrawIndexed{ indexCount, firstIndex, vertexOffset });
        }

        void dispatch(uint32_t groupX, uint32_t groupY, uint32_t groupZ) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdDispatch{ groupX, groupY, groupZ });
        }

        void executeCommands(std::span<ICommandList* const> lists) override;

        ECommandListType getCommandListType() const override { return mCommandListType; }

        /**
         * @brief For primary command lists only.
         */
        void replay() override;

    private:
        void replayInto(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx);

        // replay overloads:
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdBeginRenderPass& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdEndRenderPass& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdClearRenderTargetView& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdClearDepthStencilView& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdClearUnorderedAccessView& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdSetRenderPipeline& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdSetComputePipeline& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdSetVertexBuffer& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdSetIndexBuffer& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdSetViewport& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdSetScissorRect& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdSetStencilRef& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdSetBlendFactor& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdSetSampleMask& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdSetPrimitiveTopology& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdBindUniformBuffer& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdBindShaderResourceView& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdBindUnorderedAccessView& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdBindSampler& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdResolveTexture& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdUpdateBuffer& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdUpdateTexture1d& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdUpdateTexture2d& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdUpdateTexture3d& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdDraw& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdDrawIndexed& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdDispatch& c);
        void replayOn(ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx, const CmdExecuteCommands& c);

    private:
        D3D11Device* mDevice = nullptr;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11DeviceContext> mContext;
        std::vector<Command> mCommands;
        ECommandListType mCommandListType;

        // Dynamic OM state
        uint32_t mCurrentStencilRef  = 0;
        float mCurrentBlendFactor[4] = { 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f };
        uint32_t mCurrentSampleMask  = 0xffffffff;

        // State objects from the currently bound pipeline
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11DepthStencilState> mCurrentDepthStencilState;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11BlendState> mCurrentBlendState;
    };

} // namespace vislab
```

```
#pragma once

#include <d3d11.h>
```

```
#include <wrl/client.h>

#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    class D3D11Buffer;
    class D3D11Texture;
    class D3D11Sampler;
    class D3D11RenderPipeline;
    class D3D11ComputePipeline;
    class D3D11CommandList;
    class D3D11Swapchain;

    class D3D11Device : public Reflectable<D3D11Device, IGraphicsDevice>
    {
    public:
        static std::unique_ptr<D3D11Device> create();

        D3D11Device(Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Device> device,
                    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11DeviceContext> context);

        std::unique_ptr<IGpuBuffer> createBuffer(const BufferDesc& desc) override;
        std::unique_ptr<IGpuTexture> createTexture(const TextureDesc& desc) override;
        std::unique_ptr<IGpuSampler> createSampler(const SamplerDesc& desc) override;

        std::unique_ptr<IGpuShaderResourceView> createShaderResourceView(IGpuBuffer* buffer, const BufferViewDesc& desc) override;
        std::unique_ptr<IGpuShaderResourceView> createShaderResourceView(IGpuTexture* texture, const TextureViewDesc& desc) override;

        std::unique_ptr<IGpuUnorderedAccessView> createUnorderedAccessView(IGpuBuffer* buffer, const BufferViewDesc& desc) override;
        std::unique_ptr<IGpuUnorderedAccessView> createUnorderedAccessView(IGpuTexture* texture, const TextureViewDesc& desc) override;

        std::unique_ptr<IGpuRenderTargetView> createRenderTargetView(IGpuTexture* texture, const TextureViewDesc& desc) override;
        std::unique_ptr<IGpuDepthStencilView> createDepthStencilView(IGpuTexture* texture, const TextureViewDesc& desc) override;

        std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> createRenderPipeline(const RenderPipelineDesc& desc) override;
        std::unique_ptr<IComputePipeline> createComputePipeline(const ComputePipelineDesc& desc) override;

        std::unique_ptr<ICommandList> createCommandList(ECommandListType commandListType) override;

        ShaderBinary compileShader(const ShaderDesc& desc) override;

        void readBuffer(IGpuBuffer* buffer, void* dst, size_t size, size_t offset) override;

        // Read back a 1D texture into CPU memory
        void readTexture1d(IGpuTexture* texture, void* dst, size_t size, uint32_t mipLevel = 0) override;

        // Read back a 2D texture into CPU memory
        void readTexture2d(IGpuTexture* texture, void* dst, size_t rowPitch, uint32_t mipLevel = 0) override;

        // Read back a 3D texture into CPU memory
        void readTexture3d(IGpuTexture* texture, void* dst, size_t rowPitch, size_t slicePitch, uint32_t mipLevel = 0) override;

        std::unique_ptr<ISwapchain> createSwapchain(void* windowHandle, const SwapchainDesc& desc) override;
        void setSwapCallback([[maybe_unused]] std::function<void(void*)> cb) override {}

        ShaderDialect getShaderDialect() const override;

        ID3D11Device* getDevice() const { return mDevice.Get(); }
        ID3D11DeviceContext* getContext() const { return mContext.Get(); }

    private:
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Device> mDevice;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11DeviceContext> mContext;
    };

} // namespace vislab
```

### vislab/d3d11/include/vislab/d3d11/d3d11_swapchain.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <d3d11.h>
#include <dxgi.h>
#include <wrl/client.h>

#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>

#include "d3d11_texture.hpp"

namespace vislab
{
    class D3D11Swapchain : public Reflectable<D3D11Swapchain, ISwapchain>
    {
    public:
        D3D11Swapchain(Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDXGISwapChain> swapchain,
                       std::unique_ptr<IGpuTexture> backbuffer,
                       std::unique_ptr<IGpuRenderTargetView> renderTarget,
                       const SwapchainDesc& desc)
            : mSwapchain(swapchain)
            , mBackbuffer(std::move(backbuffer))
            , mRenderTarget(std::move(renderTarget))
            , mDesc(desc)
        {
        }

        void* getNativeHandle() override
        {
            return mSwapchain.Get();
        }

        SwapchainImage acquireNextImage() override
        {
            return { mBackbuffer.get(), mRenderTarget.get() };
        }

        void present() override
        {
            UINT sync = mDesc.vsync ? 1u : 0u;
            mSwapchain->Present(sync, 0);
        }

        const SwapchainDesc& getDesc() const override { return mDesc; }

    private:
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDXGISwapChain> mSwapchain;
        std::unique_ptr<IGpuTexture> mBackbuffer;
        std::unique_ptr<IGpuRenderTargetView> mRenderTarget;
        SwapchainDesc mDesc;
    };
}
```

### vislab/d3d11/include/vislab/d3d11/d3d11_texture.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <d3d11.h>
#include <wrl/client.h>

#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    class D3D11Texture : public Reflectable<D3D11Texture, IGpuTexture>
    {
    public:
        D3D11Texture(Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Resource> resource,
                     const TextureDesc& desc)
            : mResource(resource)
            , mDesc(desc)
        {
            // Cache typed interface once based on dimension
            switch (mDesc.dimension)
            {
            case ETextureDimension::Tex2D:
            case ETextureDimension::Tex2DArray:
            case ETextureDimension::TexCube:
            case ETextureDimension::TexCubeArray:
            {
                ID3D11Texture2D* tex = nullptr;
                if (SUCCEEDED(mResource->QueryInterface(&tex)))
                    mTex2D.Attach(tex);
                break;
            }

            case ETextureDimension::Tex3D:
            {
                ID3D11Texture3D* tex = nullptr;
                if (SUCCEEDED(mResource->QueryInterface(&tex)))
                    mTex3D.Attach(tex);
                break;
            }

            default:
                // No Texture1D support
                break;
            }
        }

        void* getNativeHandle() override { return mResource.Get(); }

        ID3D11Resource* getResource() const { return mResource.Get(); }
        ID3D11Texture2D* getTexture2D() const { return mTex2D.Get(); }
        ID3D11Texture3D* getTexture3D() const { return mTex3D.Get(); }

        const TextureDesc& getDesc() const { return mDesc; }

    private:
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Resource> mResource;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> mTex2D;
        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture3D> mTex3D;
        TextureDesc mDesc;
    };
}
```

### vislab/field/include/vislab/field/iscalar_field_fwd.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <vislab/core/iparametric_function_fwd.hpp>

#include "partial.hpp"

#include <Eigen/Eigen>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Base class for 2D scalar fields.
     * @tparam TPartial Specifier for partial derivatives.
     */
    template <typename TPartial>
    using IScalarField2d = IParametricFunction<Eigen::Vector<double, TPartial::Dimensions>, Eigen::Vector<double, 1>, TPartial>;

    /**
     * @brief Base class for 3D scalar fields.
     * @tparam TPartial Specifier for partial derivatives.
     */
    template <typename TPartial>
    using IScalarField3d = IParametricFunction<Eigen::Vector<double, TPartial::Dimensions>, Eigen::Vector<double, 1>, TPartial>;

    /**
     * @brief Base class for 2D steady scalar fields.
     */
    using ISteadyScalarField2d = IScalarField2d<PartialSteady2d>;

    /**
     * @brief Base class for 3D steady scalar fields.
     */
    using ISteadyScalarField3d = IScalarField3d<PartialSteady3d>;

    /**
     * @brief Base class for 2D unsteady scalar fields.
     */
    using IUnsteadyScalarField2d = IScalarField2d<PartialUnsteady2d>;

    /**
     * @brief Base class for 3D unsteady scalar fields.
     */
    using IUnsteadyScalarField3d = IScalarField3d<PartialUnsteady3d>;
}
```

### vislab/field/include/vislab/field/ivector_field_fwd.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <vislab/core/iparametric_function_fwd.hpp>

#include "partial.hpp"

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Base class for 2D vector fields.
     * @tparam TPartial Specifier for partial derivatives.
     */
    template <typename TPartial>
    using IVectorField2d = IParametricFunction<Eigen::Vector<double, TPartial::Dimensions>, Eigen::Vector2d, TPartial>;

    /**
     * @brief Base class for 3D vector fields.
     * @tparam TPartial Specifier for partial derivatives.
     */
    template <typename TPartial>
    using IVectorField3d = IParametricFunction<Eigen::Vector<double, TPartial::Dimensions>, Eigen::Vector3d, TPartial>;

    /**
     * @brief Base class for 2D steady vector fields.
     */
    using ISteadyVectorField2d = IVectorField2d<PartialSteady2d>;

    /**
     * @brief Base class for 3D steady vector fields.
     */
    using ISteadyVectorField3d = IVectorField3d<PartialSteady3d>;

    /**
     * @brief Base class for 2D unsteady vector fields.
     */
    using IUnsteadyVectorField2d = IVectorField2d<PartialUnsteady2d>;

    /**
     * @brief Base class for 3D unsteady vector fields.
     */
    using IUnsteadyVectorField3d = IVectorField3d<PartialUnsteady3d>;
}
```

### vislab/field/include/vislab/field/partial.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <array>
#include <stdint.h>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Partial derivative specification for a steady 2D field.
     */
    struct PartialSteady2d
    {
        /**
         * @brief Number of spatial dimensions.
         */
        static const int SpatialDimensions = 2;

        /**
         * @brief Number of dimensions.
         */
        static const int Dimensions = 2;

        /**
         * @brief Flag that signals that this partial is for a steady field.
         */
        static const bool IsSteady = true;

        /**
         * @brief Constructor from hash.
         * @param hash Hash that specifies the derivative degree for all dimensions.
         */
        PartialSteady2d(uint64_t hash)
            : mHash(hash)
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Constructor from an array.
         * @param degree Array that specifies the derivative degree for all dimensions.
         */
        PartialSteady2d(std::array<uint8_t, Dimensions> degree)
            : mHash(0)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < Dimensions; ++i)
                mDegree[i] = degree[i];
        }

        /**
         * @brief Constructor with individual partial derivative degrees.
         * @param _dx Degree of the x-partial derivative.
         * @param _dy Degree of the y-partial derivative.
         */
        PartialSteady2d(uint8_t _dx, uint8_t _dy)
            : mHash(0)
        {
            mDegree[0] = _dx;
            mDegree[1] = _dy;
        }

        static constexpr uint64_t c    = 0;               /* Hash of the function (no partial). */
        static constexpr uint64_t dx   = 1 << 0;          /* Hash of the dx partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dy   = 1 << 8;          /* Hash of the dy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxx  = 2 << 0;          /* Hash of the dxx partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxy  = 1 << 0 | 1 << 8; /* Hash of the dxy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dyy  = 2 << 8;          /* Hash of the dyy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxxx = 3 << 0;          /* Hash of the dxxx partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxxy = 2 << 0 | 1 << 8; /* Hash of the dxxy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxyy = 1 << 0 | 2 << 8; /* Hash of the dxyy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dyyy = 3 << 8;          /* Hash of the dyyy partial derivative. */

        /**
         * @brief Gets the derivative degree for a given dimension.
         * @param dimension Dimension to get the derivative degree for.
         * @return Derivative degree of given dimension.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] uint8_t operator[](int dimension) const
        {
            return mDegree[dimension];
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the derivative degree for a given dimension.
         * @param dimension Dimension to get the derivative degree for.
         * @return Derivative degree of given dimension.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] uint8_t& operator[](int dimension)
        {
            return mDegree[dimension];
        }

        /* Gets the hash that can be used for comparison and switch cases. */
        [[nodiscard]] uint64_t getHash() const { return mHash; }
        /* Gets the degree of the x-partial derivative. */
        [[nodiscard]] uint8_t getDegreeDx() const { return mDegree[0]; }
        /* Gets the degree of the y-partial derivative. */
        [[nodiscard]] uint8_t getDegreeDy() const { return mDegree[1]; }
        /* Sets the degree of the x-partial derivative. */
        void setDegreeDx(uint8_t degree) { mDegree[0] = degree; }
        /* Sets the degree of the y-partial derivative. */
        void setDegreeDy(uint8_t degree) { mDegree[1] = degree; }

    private:
        union
        {
            uint64_t mHash; /* Hash that can be used for comparison and switch cases. */
            /**
             * @brief Array of derivative degrees for up to 8 dimensions.
             */
            uint8_t mDegree[8];
        };
    };

    /**
     * @brief Partial derivative specification for an unsteady 2D field.
     */
    union PartialUnsteady2d
    {
        /**
         * @brief Number of spatial dimensions.
         */
        static const int SpatialDimensions = 2;

        /**
         * @brief Number of dimensions.
         */
        static const int Dimensions = 3;

        /**
         * @brief Flag that signals that this partial is for an unsteady field.
         */
        static const bool IsSteady = false;

        /**
         * @brief Constructor from hash.
         * @param hash Hash that specifies the derivative degree for all dimensions.
         */
        PartialUnsteady2d(uint64_t hash)
            : mHash(hash)
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Constructor from an array.
         * @param degree Array that specifies the derivative degree for all dimensions.
         */
        PartialUnsteady2d(std::array<uint8_t, Dimensions> degree)
            : mHash(0)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < Dimensions; ++i)
                mDegree[i] = degree[i];
        }

        /**
         * @brief Constructor with individual partial derivative degrees.
         * @param _dx Degree of the x-partial derivative.
         * @param _dy Degree of the y-partial derivative.
         * @param _dt Degree of the t-partial derivative.
         */
        PartialUnsteady2d(uint8_t _dx, uint8_t _dy, uint8_t _dt)
            : mHash(0)
        {
            mDegree[0] = _dx;
            mDegree[1] = _dy;
            mDegree[2] = _dt;
        }

        static constexpr uint64_t c    = 0;                         /* Hash of the function (no partial). */
        static constexpr uint64_t dx   = 1 << 0;                    /* Hash of the dx partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dy   = 1 << 8;                    /* Hash of the dy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dt   = 1 << 16;                   /* Hash of the dt partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxx  = 2 << 0;                    /* Hash of the dxx partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxy  = 1 << 0 | 1 << 8;           /* Hash of the dxy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxt  = 1 << 0 | 1 << 16;          /* Hash of the dxt partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dyy  = 2 << 8;                    /* Hash of the dyy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dyt  = 1 << 8 | 1 << 16;          /* Hash of the dyt partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dtt  = 2 << 16;                   /* Hash of the dtt partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxxx = 3 << 0;                    /* Hash of the dxxx partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxxy = 2 << 0 | 1 << 8;           /* Hash of the dxxy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxxt = 2 << 0 | 1 << 16;          /* Hash of the dxxt partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxyy = 1 << 0 | 2 << 8;           /* Hash of the dxyy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxyt = 1 << 0 | 1 << 8 | 1 << 16; /* Hash of the dxyt partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxtt = 1 << 0 | 2 << 16;          /* Hash of the dxtt partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dyyy = 3 << 8;                    /* Hash of the dyyy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dyyt = 2 << 8 | 1 << 16;          /* Hash of the dyyt partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dytt = 1 << 8 | 2 << 16;          /* Hash of the dytt partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dttt = 3 << 16;                   /* Hash of the dttt partial derivative. */

        /**
         * @brief Gets the derivative degree for a given dimension.
         * @param dimension Dimension to get the derivative degree for.
         * @return Derivative degree of given dimension.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] uint8_t operator[](int dimension) const
        {
            return mDegree[dimension];
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the derivative degree for a given dimension.
         * @param dimension Dimension to get the derivative degree for.
         * @return Derivative degree of given dimension.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] uint8_t& operator[](int dimension)
        {
            return mDegree[dimension];
        }

        /* Gets the hash that can be used for comparison and switch cases. */
        [[nodiscard]] uint64_t getHash() const { return mHash; }
        /* Gets the degree of the x-partial derivative. */
        [[nodiscard]] uint8_t getDegreeDx() const { return mDegree[0]; }
        /* Gets the degree of the y-partial derivative. */
        [[nodiscard]] uint8_t getDegreeDy() const { return mDegree[1]; }
        /* Gets the degree of the t-partial derivative. */
        [[nodiscard]] uint8_t getDegreeDt() const { return mDegree[2]; }
        /* Sets the degree of the x-partial derivative. */
        void setDegreeDx(uint8_t degree) { mDegree[0] = degree; }
        /* Sets the degree of the y-partial derivative. */
        void setDegreeDy(uint8_t degree) { mDegree[1] = degree; }
        /* Sets the degree of the t-partial derivative. */
        void setDegreeDt(uint8_t degree) { mDegree[2] = degree; }

    private:
        union
        {
            uint64_t mHash; /* Hash that can be used for comparison and switch cases. */
            /**
             * @brief Array of derivative degrees for up to 8 dimensions.
             */
            uint8_t mDegree[8];
        };
    };

    /**
     * @brief Partial derivative specification for a steady 3D field.

    {

            : mHash(0)

            for (int i = 0; i < Dimensions; ++i)
                mDegree[i] = degree[i];

        /**
         * @brief Constructor with individual partial derivative degrees.

            : mHash(0)

            mDegree[0] = _dx;
            mDegree[1] = _dy;
            mDegree[2] = _dz;
        }

        static constexpr uint64_t c    = 0;                         /* Hash of the function (no partial). */
        static constexpr uint64_t dx   = 1 << 0;                    /* Hash of the dx partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dy   = 1 << 8;                    /* Hash of the dy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dz   = 1 << 16;                   /* Hash of the dz partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxx  = 2 << 0;                    /* Hash of the dxx partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxy  = 1 << 0 | 1 << 8;           /* Hash of the dxy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxz  = 1 << 0 | 1 << 16;          /* Hash of the dxz partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dyy  = 2 << 8;                    /* Hash of the dyy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dyz  = 1 << 8 | 1 << 16;          /* Hash of the dyz partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dzz  = 2 << 16;                   /* Hash of the dzz partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxxx = 3 << 0;                    /* Hash of the dxxx partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxxy = 2 << 0 | 1 << 8;           /* Hash of the dxxy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxxz = 2 << 0 | 1 << 16;          /* Hash of the dxxz partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxyy = 1 << 0 | 2 << 8;           /* Hash of the dxyy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxyz = 1 << 0 | 1 << 8 | 1 << 16; /* Hash of the dxyz partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dxzz = 1 << 0 | 2 << 16;          /* Hash of the dxzz partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dyyy = 3 << 8;                    /* Hash of the dyyy partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dyyz = 2 << 8 | 1 << 16;          /* Hash of the dyyz partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dyzz = 1 << 8 | 2 << 16;          /* Hash of the dyzz partial derivative. */
        static constexpr uint64_t dzzz = 3 << 16;                   /* Hash of the dzzz partial derivative. */

        /**
         * @brief Gets the derivative degree for a given dimension.

         */

            return mDegree[dimension];
        }

         * @return Derivative degree of given dimension.

        {
            return mDegree[dimension];

        /* Gets the degree of the x-partial derivative. */

        /* Gets the degree of the y-partial derivative. */

        /* Gets the degree of the z-partial derivative. */
        [[nodiscard]] uint8_t getDegreeDz() const { return mDegree[2]; }
        /* Sets the degree of the x-partial derivative. */
        void setDegreeDx(uint8_t degree) { mDegree[0] = degree; }
        /* Sets the degree of the y-partial derivative. */
        void setDegreeDy(uint8_t degree) { mDegree[1] = degree; }
        /* Sets the degree of the z-partial derivative. */
```
