### vislab/geometry/include/vislab/geometry/mesh.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "mesh_fwd.hpp"

#include "raw_mesh.hpp"

#include <span>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Strongly typed mesh with data structures aligning well to graphics APIs.
     *
     * This class is a typed convenience layer around RawMesh. It preserves the
     * implicit/explicit semantics of RawMesh:
     *
     * - Indices:
     *   - RawMesh::getIndexCollection() is the explicit untyped index buffer.
     *   - RawMesh::getIndices() is the logical read-only view (implicit or explicit).
     * - Submeshes:
     *   - RawMesh::getSubmeshCollection() is the explicit submesh list.
     *   - RawMesh::getSubmeshes() is the logical read-only view (implicit or explicit).
     *
     * TypedMesh mirrors this:
     *
     * - getIndexCollection(): typed explicit index container (Array<TIndexValue>).
     * - getIndices(): typed logical read-only index view.
     * - getSubmeshCollection(): explicit submesh container.
     * - getSubmeshes(): logical read-only submesh view.
     *
     * @tparam TPositionValue Eigen::Vector type of the position coordinates.
     * @tparam TNormalValue Eigen::Vector type of the normals.
     * @tparam TTexCoordValue Eigen::Vector type of the texture coordinates.
     * @tparam TIndexValue Eigen::Vector type of the index buffer.
     */
    template <typename TPositionValue,
              typename TNormalValue,
              typename TTexCoordValue,
              typename TIndexValue>
        requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TPositionValue> && detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TNormalValue> && detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TTexCoordValue> && detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TIndexValue>
    class TypedMesh
        : public Concrete<TypedMesh<TPositionValue, TNormalValue, TTexCoordValue, TIndexValue>, Data>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Type of position values.
         */
        using Position = TPositionValue;

        /**
         * @brief Type of normal vectors.
         */
        using Normal = TNormalValue;

        /**
         * @brief Type of texture coordinates.
         */
        using TexCoord = TTexCoordValue;

        /**
         * @brief Type of indices (Eigen::Vector with one scalar component).
         */
        using Index = TIndexValue;

        /**
         * @brief Bounding box type.
         */
        using BoundingBox = Eigen::AlignedBox<typename TPositionValue::Scalar, TPositionValue::RowsAtCompileTime>;

        /**
         * @brief Read-only typed logical view over the mesh's index sequence.
         *
         * This view mirrors RawIndexView but returns TIndexValue instead of raw integers.
         * It abstracts over implicit and explicit index buffers and provides:
         *
         *  - getSize() : number of logical indices
         *  - getValue() : typed index value
         *  - copyTo() : copy logical indices into a user buffer
         *  - Iterator<T> : typed forward iterator
         *
         * Mutation is not exposed. To modify explicit indices, use getIndexCollection().
         */
        class TypedIndexView
        {
        public:
            /**
             * @brief Constructs a TypedIndexView for a given mesh.
             * @param mesh Pointer to the underlying RawMesh.
             *
             * The mesh pointer must remain valid for the lifetime of the view.
             */
            explicit TypedIndexView(const RawMesh* mesh)
                : mMesh(mesh)
            {
            }

            /**
             * @brief Returns the number of logical indices.
             *
             * If explicit indices exist, this is the size of the explicit index buffer.
             * Otherwise, it equals the number of positions (implicit indexing).
             *
             * @return Number of logical indices.
             */
            [[nodiscard]] std::size_t getSize() const
            {
                return mMesh->getIndices().getSize();
            }

            /**
             * @brief Returns the index value at position i as TIndexValue.
             *
             * For explicit indices, the value is read from the index collection.
             * For implicit indices, this is equivalent to TIndexValue(i).
             *
             * @param i Logical index position.
             * @return Index value as TIndexValue.
             */
            [[nodiscard]] TIndexValue operator[](std::size_t i) const
            {
                return mMesh->getIndices().template getValue<TIndexValue>(i);
            }

            /**
             * @brief Returns the index value at position i as TIndexValue.
             *
             * For explicit indices, the value is read from the index collection.
             * For implicit indices, this is equivalent to TIndexValue(i).
             *
             * @param i Logical index position.
             * @return Index value as TIndexValue.
             */
            [[nodiscard]] TIndexValue getValue(std::size_t i) const
            {
                return mMesh->getIndices().template getValue<TIndexValue>(i);
            }

            /**
             * @brief Copies the logical index buffer into a destination array.
             *
             * For explicit indices, this performs a contiguous copy from the
             * index collection (converted to TIndexValue).
             * For implicit indices, this generates the sequence
             * [0, 1, 2, ..., size()-1] as TIndexValue.
             *
             * @param dst Pointer to a buffer with at least size() elements.
             */
            void copyTo(TIndexValue* dst) const
            {
                mMesh->getIndices().copyTo(dst);
            }

            /**
             * @brief Forward iterator over the logical index sequence.
             *
             * The iterator yields values of type TIndex, converted from the
             * underlying representation on demand.
             *
             * @tparam TIndex Integral value type of the iterator.
             */
            class iterator
            {
            public:
                using value_type        = TIndexValue;
                using difference_type   = std::ptrdiff_t;
                using iterator_category = std::forward_iterator_tag;
                using reference         = TIndexValue;
                using pointer           = void;

                /**
                 * @brief Constructs an iterator.
                 * @param mesh Pointer to the underlying RawMesh.
                 * @param i Current logical index position.
                 */
                iterator(const RawMesh* mesh, std::size_t i)
                    : mMesh(mesh)
                    , mIndex(i)
                {
                }

                /**
                 * @brief Dereferences the iterator.
                 * @return Current index value converted to TIndex.
                 */
                [[nodiscard]] TIndexValue operator*() const
                {
                    return mMesh->getIndices().template getValueAs<TIndexValue>(mIndex);
                }

                /**
                 * @brief Pre-increment operator.
                 *
                 * Advances the iterator to the next logical index position and returns
                 * a reference to the updated iterator. This operator is typically more
                 * efficient than the post-increment variant, as it avoids creating a
                 * temporary copy.
                 *
                 * @return Reference to the iterator after incrementing.
                 */
                iterator& operator++()
                {
                    ++mIndex;
                    return *this;
                }

                /**
                 * @brief Post-increment operator.
                 *
                 * Advances the iterator to the next logical index position, but returns
                 * a copy of the iterator as it was before the increment. This allows
                 * expressions such as @c it++ to behave according to standard iterator
                 * semantics.
                 *
                 * @return A copy of the iterator prior to incrementing.
                 */
                iterator operator++(int)
                {
                    iterator tmp = *this;
                    ++(*this);
                    return tmp;
                }

                /**
                 * @brief Inequality comparison.
                 * @param other Iterator to compare against.
                 * @return True if the iterators refer to different positions or meshes.
                 */
                [[nodiscard]] bool operator!=(const iterator& other) const
                {
                    return mIndex != other.mIndex || mMesh != other.mMesh;
                }

                /**
                 * @brief Equality comparison.
                 * @param other Iterator to compare against.
                 * @return True if the iterators refer to same positions and meshes.
                 */
                [[nodiscard]] bool operator==(const iterator& other) const
                {
                    return mIndex == other.mIndex && mMesh == other.mMesh;
                }

            private:
                const RawMesh* mMesh;
                std::size_t mIndex;
            };

            /**
             * @brief Const iterator for traversing the indices.
             */
            using const_iterator = iterator;

            /**
             * @brief Iterator to the beginning of the container.
             * @return Iterator to beginning.
             */
            [[nodiscard]] iterator begin() const { return iterator(mMesh, 0); }

            /**
             * @brief Iterator to the end of the container.
             * @return Iterator to end.
             */
            [[nodiscard]] iterator end() const { return iterator(mMesh, getSize()); }

            /**
             * @brief Const iterator to the beginning of the container.
             * @return Const iterator to beginning.
             */
            [[nodiscard]] const_iterator cbegin() const { return begin(); }

            /**
             * @brief Const iterator to the end of the container.
             * @return Const iterator to end.
             */
            [[nodiscard]] const_iterator cend() const { return end(); }

        private:
            const RawMesh* mMesh;
        };

        /**
         * @brief Empty constructor. Owns its own generic raw mesh.
         * @param meshTopology Mesh topology to use.
         */
        TypedMesh(EMeshTopology meshTopology = EMeshTopology::Undefined)
            : mMesh(std::make_shared<RawMesh>(meshTopology))
        {
            // Allocate canonical attributes.
            mMesh->getPositions().template allocate<TPositionValue>(0);
            mMesh->getNormals().template allocate<TNormalValue>(0);
            mMesh->getTexCoords().template allocate<TTexCoordValue>(0);

            // Allocate explicit index collection with correct type (empty means implicit until used).
            mMesh->getIndexCollection().template allocate<TIndexValue>(0);

            // Bind typed wrappers to explicit containers.
            mPositions.setRaw(mMesh->getPositionsShared());
            mNormals.setRaw(mMesh->getNormalsShared());
            mTexCoords.setRaw(mMesh->getTexCoordsShared());
            mIndexCollection.setRaw(mMesh->getIndexCollectionShared());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Constructor from a generic mesh.
         *
         * The given RawMesh must have positions of type TPositionValue. Normals,
         * texcoords, and the explicit index collection are allocated to the correct
         * type if they are undefined.
         *
         * @param mesh Mesh to encapsulate.
         */
        explicit TypedMesh(std::shared_ptr<RawMesh> mesh)
            : mMesh(std::move(mesh))
        {
            assert(mMesh != nullptr);
            assert(mMesh->getPositions().isValueType<TPositionValue>());

            if (mMesh->getNormals().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                mMesh->getNormals().template allocate<TNormalValue>(0);
            assert(mMesh->getNormals().isValueType<TNormalValue>());

            if (mMesh->getTexCoords().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                mMesh->getTexCoords().template allocate<TTexCoordValue>(0);
            assert(mMesh->getTexCoords().isValueType<TTexCoordValue>());

            if (mMesh->getIndexCollection().getFormat() == EFormat::Undefined)
                mMesh->getIndexCollection().template allocate<TIndexValue>(0);
            assert(mMesh->getIndexCollection().isValueType<TIndexValue>());

            mPositions.setRaw(mMesh->getPositionsShared());
            mNormals.setRaw(mMesh->getNormalsShared());
            mTexCoords.setRaw(mMesh->getTexCoordsShared());
            mIndexCollection.setRaw(mMesh->getIndexCollectionShared());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Copy constructor.
         * @param other Other typed mesh to copy.
         */
        explicit TypedMesh(const TypedMesh& other)
            : mMesh(other.mMesh->clone())
        {
            mPositions.setRaw(mMesh->getPositionsShared());
            mNormals.setRaw(mMesh->getNormalsShared());
            mTexCoords.setRaw(mMesh->getTexCoordsShared());
            mIndexCollection.setRaw(mMesh->getIndexCollectionShared());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the position buffer.
         * @return Position buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const Array<TPositionValue>& getPositions() const { return mPositions; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the position buffer.
         * @return Position buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Array<TPositionValue>& getPositions() { return mPositions; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the normal buffer.
         * @return Normal buffer
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const Array<TNormalValue>& getNormals() const { return mNormals; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the normal buffer.
         * @return Normal buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Array<TNormalValue>& getNormals() { return mNormals; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the texture coordinate buffer.
         * @return Texture coordinate buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const Array<TTexCoordValue>& getTexCoords() const { return mTexCoords; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the texture coordinate buffer.
         * @return Texture coordinate buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Array<TTexCoordValue>& getTexCoords() { return mTexCoords; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the typed explicit index collection.
         *
         * This maps directly to RawMesh::getIndexCollection(). If the collection
         * is empty, the mesh may still be using implicit indices; writing here
         * switches it to explicit indexing.
         *
         * @return Typed explicit index collection.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const Array<TIndexValue>& getIndexCollection() const { return mIndexCollection; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the typed explicit index collection.
         * @return Typed explicit index collection.
         */

        [[nodiscard]] Array<TIndexValue>& getIndexCollection() { return mIndexCollection; }

        /**
         * @brief Returns true if the mesh has an explicit index buffer (IndicesCollection is not empty).
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool hasExplicitIndices() const
        {
            return mMesh->hasExplicitIndices();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns true if the mesh uses implicit indices (IndicesCollection is empty).
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool hasImplicitIndices() const
        {
            return mMesh->hasImplicitIndices();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the typed logical index view (read-only).
         * This wraps RawMesh::getIndices() and respects implicit and explicit representations.
         * @return TypedIndexView over the logical indices.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] TypedIndexView getIndices() const
        {
            return TypedIndexView(mMesh.get());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the collection of attributes.
         * @return Attributes.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const Attributes& getAttributes() const { return mMesh->getAttributes(); }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the collection of attributes.
         * @return Attributes.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Attributes& getAttributes() { return mMesh->getAttributes(); }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the underlying mesh.
         * @return Underlying generic mesh.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const RawMesh& getRaw() const { return *mMesh; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the underlying mesh.
         * @return Underlying generic mesh.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] RawMesh& getRaw() { return *mMesh; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a shared pointer to the underlying mesh.
         * @return Underlying generic mesh.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<const RawMesh> getRawShared() const { return mMesh; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a shared pointer to the underlying mesh.
         * @return Underlying generic mesh.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<RawMesh> getRawShared() { return mMesh; }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the underlying mesh.
         * @param mesh Underlying mesh.
         */
        void setRaw(std::shared_ptr<RawMesh> mesh)
        {
            assert(mesh != nullptr);
            assert(mesh->getPositions().isValueType<TPositionValue>());
            assert(mesh->getNormals().isValueType<TNormalValue>());
            assert(mesh->getTexCoords().isValueType<TTexCoordValue>());
            assert(mesh->getIndexCollection().isValueType<TIndexValue>());

            mMesh = std::move(mesh);

            mPositions.setRaw(mMesh->getPositionsShared());
            mNormals.setRaw(mMesh->getNormalsShared());
            mTexCoords.setRaw(mMesh->getTexCoordsShared());
            mIndexCollection.setRaw(mMesh->getIndexCollectionShared());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Tests if the mesh object is fully initialized and ready for use.
         * @return True if the mesh object is in a valid state.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool isValid() const override
        {
            if (mMesh == nullptr || !mMesh->isValid())
                return false;
            if (!mPositions.isValid())
                return false;
            if (!mNormals.isValid())
                return false;
            if (!mTexCoords.isValid())
                return false;
            if (!mIndexCollection.isValid())
                return false;
            return true;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Serializes the object into/from an archive.
         * @param archive Archive to serialize into/from.
         */
        void serialize(IArchive& archive) override
        {
            archive("Mesh", mMesh);

            mPositions.setRaw(mMesh->getPositionsShared());
            mNormals.setRaw(mMesh->getNormalsShared());
            mTexCoords.setRaw(mMesh->getTexCoordsShared());
            mIndexCollection.setRaw(mMesh->getIndexCollectionShared());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Tests if the two meshes are equal.
         * @param other Other mesh to compare with.
         * @return True if equal.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool isEqual(const TypedMesh& other)
        {
            if (!mMesh->isEqual(*other.mMesh))
                return false;
            return true;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Appends another mesh at the end of this mesh. Note that the other mesh retains its submeshes, and that this mesh will be converted to an explicit mesh. If both meshes are implicit and you want to retain everything implicitly, then append the positions manually instead.
         * @param other Other mesh to append.
         */
        void append(const TypedMesh& other)
        {
            std::size_t baseOffset = mPositions.getSize();

            // 0) Make explicit
            if (hasImplicitIndices())
            {
                auto indices      = getIndices();
                size_t numIndices = indices.getSize();
                mIndexCollection.setSize(numIndices);
                for (size_t i = 0; i < numIndices; ++i)
                    mIndexCollection[i] = TIndexValue((typename TIndexValue::Scalar)i);
            }
            if (hasImplicitSubmeshes() && getIndices().getSize() > 0)
            {
                mMesh->getSubmeshCollection().push_back(
                    mMesh->getSubmeshes()[0]);
            }

            // 1) Copy canonical vertex arrays
            mPositions.insert(mPositions.end(), other.mPositions.begin(), other.mPositions.end());
            mNormals.insert(mNormals.end(), other.mNormals.begin(), other.mNormals.end());
            mTexCoords.insert(mTexCoords.end(), other.mTexCoords.begin(), other.mTexCoords.end());

            // 2) Copy extra attributes (if aligned)
            for (std::size_t ia = 0; ia < other.mMesh->getAttributes().getSize(); ++ia)
            {
                const auto& srcAttr = other.mMesh->getAttributes().getByIndex(ia);
                auto& dstAttr       = mMesh->getAttributes().getByIndex(ia);

                if (srcAttr.getSize() == other.mPositions.getSize())
                {
                    std::size_t dstSize = dstAttr.getSize();
                    dstAttr.insert(dstSize, 0, srcAttr.getSize(), srcAttr);
                }
            }

            // 3) Copy indices with offset (explicit indices)
            auto otherIndices     = other.getIndices();
            std::size_t indexBase = mIndexCollection.getSize();
            for (size_t idx = 0; idx < otherIndices.getSize(); ++idx)
                mIndexCollection.push_back(
                    otherIndices.getValue(idx) + TIndexValue((typename TIndexValue::Scalar)baseOffset));

            // 4) Copy submeshes with shifted offsets
            auto& dstSubs       = mMesh->getSubmeshCollection();
            const auto& srcSubs = other.mMesh->getSubmeshes();
            for (const auto& sm : srcSubs)
                dstSubs.emplace_back(Submesh{ sm.indexOffset + indexBase, sm.indexCount });
        }

        /**
         * @brief Prepends another mesh at the front of this mesh.
         *
         * Copies all vertex data (positions, normals, texcoords, and extra attributes)
         * from @p other into the front of this mesh. Existing indices are rebased by
         * the size of @p other�s vertex buffer to remain valid. Submeshes from @p other
         * are prepended with their index offsets unchanged, while existing submeshes
         * have their offsets shifted accordingly. The other mesh retains its own submeshes.
         *
         * @param other Other mesh to prepend.
         */
        void prepend(const TypedMesh& other)
        {
            std::size_t baseOffset = other.mPositions.getSize();

            // 0) Make explicit
            if (hasImplicitIndices())
            {
                auto indices      = getIndices();
                size_t numIndices = indices.getSize();
                mIndexCollection.setSize(numIndices);
                for (size_t i = 0; i < numIndices; ++i)
                    mIndexCollection[i] = TIndexValue((typename TIndexValue::Scalar)i);
            }
            if (hasImplicitSubmeshes() && getIndices().getSize() > 0)
            {
                mMesh->getSubmeshCollection().push_back(
                    mMesh->getSubmeshes()[0]);
            }

            // 1) Prepend canonical vertex arrays
            mPositions.insert(mPositions.begin(), other.mPositions.begin(), other.mPositions.end());
            mNormals.insert(mNormals.begin(), other.mNormals.begin(), other.mNormals.end());
            mTexCoords.insert(mTexCoords.begin(), other.mTexCoords.begin(), other.mTexCoords.end());

            // 2) Prepend extra attributes
            for (std::size_t ia = 0; ia < other.mMesh->getAttributes().getSize(); ++ia)
            {
                const auto& srcAttr = other.mMesh->getAttributes().getByIndex(ia);
                auto& dstAttr       = mMesh->getAttributes().getByIndex(ia);

                if (srcAttr.getSize() == other.mPositions.getSize())
                    dstAttr.insert(0, 0, srcAttr.getSize(), srcAttr);
            }

            // 3) Rebase existing indices
            for (auto& idx : mIndexCollection)
                idx.x() += (typename TIndexValue::Scalar)baseOffset;

            // 4) Prepend other indices
            auto& dstIndices            = mIndexCollection;
            const auto& srcIndices      = other.getIndices();
            std::size_t srcIndicesCount = srcIndices.getSize();
            std::size_t dstIndicesCount = dstIndices.getSize();
            dstIndices.setSize(dstIndicesCount + srcIndicesCount);
            for (int64_t idx = int64_t(dstIndicesCount) - 1; idx >= 0; --idx)
                dstIndices[idx + srcIndicesCount] = dstIndices[idx];
            for (size_t idx = 0; idx < srcIndicesCount; ++idx)
                dstIndices[idx] = srcIndices.getValue(idx);

            // 5) Adjust submeshes
            auto& dstSubs       = mMesh->getSubmeshCollection();
            const auto& srcSubs = other.mMesh->getSubmeshes();
            for (auto& sm : dstSubs)
                sm.indexOffset += srcIndicesCount;
            std::size_t srcSubsCount = srcSubs.getSize();
            std::size_t dstSubsCount = dstSubs.size();
            dstSubs.resize(dstSubsCount + srcSubsCount);
            for (int64_t idx = int64_t(dstSubsCount) - 1; idx >= 0; --idx)
                dstSubs[idx + srcSubsCount] = dstSubs[idx];
            for (size_t idx = 0; idx < srcSubsCount; ++idx)
                dstSubs[idx] = srcSubs[idx];
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns true if the mesh uses explicit submeshes (SubmeshCollection is not empty).
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool hasExplicitSubmeshes() const
        {
            return mMesh->hasExplicitSubmeshes();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns true if the mesh uses implicit submeshes (SubmeshCollection is empty).
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool hasImplicitSubmeshes() const
        {
            return mMesh->hasImplicitSubmeshes();
        }

        /** @brief Explicit submesh collection (mutable). */
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Submesh>& getSubmeshCollection()
        {
            return mMesh->getSubmeshCollection();
        }

        /** @brief Explicit submesh collection (const). */
        [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<Submesh>& getSubmeshCollection() const
        {
            return mMesh->getSubmeshCollection();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Logical submesh view (read-only, implicit or explicit).
         */
        [[nodiscard]] RawMesh::SubmeshView getSubmeshes() const
        {
            return mMesh->getSubmeshes();
        }

        /** @brief Gets the number of submeshes. */
        std::size_t getNumSubmeshes() const
        {
            return mMesh->getSubmeshes().getSize();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the mesh topology.

        void setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology meshTopology) { mMesh->setMeshTopology(meshTopology); }

        /**

        [[nodiscard]] EMeshTopology getMeshTopology() const { return mMesh->getMeshTopology(); }

        [[nodiscard]] size_t getVerticesPerPrimitive() const

        [[nodiscard]] size_t getNumPrimitives(size_t submeshIndex) const

        /**

        [[nodiscard]] IndexRange getPrimitive(std::size_t submeshIndex, std::size_t primitiveIndex) const
        {
            return mMesh->getPrimitive(submeshIndex, primitiveIndex);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Computes the bounding box of the position coordinates.
         */
        void recomputeBoundingBox()
        {
            mMesh->recomputeBoundingBox();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the bounding box of the position values. Note that recomputeBoundingBox has to be computed first.
         * @return Bounding box of the position coordinates.
         */
        const BoundingBox& getBoundingBox() const
        {
            return mMesh->template getBoundingBox<TPositionValue>();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Deletes vertices that are not referenced by indices.
         *
         * This function compacts the vertex buffer by removing any unreferenced vertices.
         * Positions, normals, texcoords, and all extra attributes are rewritten according
         * to a remap table built from the referenced indices. The index buffer is updated
         * to point to the new compacted vertex indices.
         */
        void compactVertices()
        {
            if (hasImplicitIndices())
                return;

            // 1) Mark referenced vertices
            std::vector<bool> used(mPositions.getSize(), false);
            for (const auto& idx : mIndexCollection)
            {
                std::size_t vi = idx.x();
                if (vi < used.size())
                    used[vi] = true;
            }

            // 2) Build remap table
            std::vector<std::size_t> remap(mPositions.getSize(), std::size_t(-1));
            std::size_t newIndex = 0;
            for (std::size_t oldIndex = 0; oldIndex < used.size(); ++oldIndex)
            {
                if (used[oldIndex])
                    remap[oldIndex] = newIndex++;
            }

            // 3) Rewrite positions
            std::vector<Position> newPositions(newIndex);
            for (std::size_t oldIndex = 0; oldIndex < used.size(); ++oldIndex)
            {
                if (remap[oldIndex] != std::size_t(-1))
                    newPositions[remap[oldIndex]] = mPositions[oldIndex];
            }
            mPositions.setValues(newPositions);

            // 4) Rewrite normals if aligned
            if (mNormals.getSize() == used.size())
            {
                std::vector<Normal> newNormals(newIndex);
                for (std::size_t oldIndex = 0; oldIndex < used.size(); ++oldIndex)
                {
                    if (remap[oldIndex] != std::size_t(-1))
                        newNormals[remap[oldIndex]] = mNormals[oldIndex];
                }
                mNormals.setValues(newNormals);
            }

            // 5) Rewrite texCoords if aligned
            if (mTexCoords.getSize() == used.size())
            {
                std::vector<TexCoord> newTexCoords(newIndex);
                for (std::size_t oldIndex = 0; oldIndex < used.size(); ++oldIndex)
                {
                    if (remap[oldIndex] != std::size_t(-1))
                        newTexCoords[remap[oldIndex]] = mTexCoords[oldIndex];
                }
                mTexCoords.setValues(newTexCoords);
            }

            // 6) Rewrite extra attributes if aligned
            for (std::size_t ia = 0; ia < mMesh->getAttributes().getSize(); ++ia)
            {
                auto& attr = mMesh->getAttributes().getByIndex(ia);
                if (attr.getSize() == used.size())
                {
                    RawArray newAttr;
                    newAttr.setNumComponents(attr.getNumComponents());
                    newAttr.setFormat(attr.getFormat());
                    newAttr.setSize(newIndex);

                    for (std::size_t oldIndex = 0; oldIndex < used.size(); ++oldIndex)
                    {
                        if (remap[oldIndex] != std::size_t(-1))
                            newAttr.assign(remap[oldIndex], oldIndex, attr);
                    }
                    attr = std::move(newAttr);
                }
            }

            // 7) Rewrite index buffer with remapped indices
            for (auto& idx : mIndexCollection)
                idx.x() = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(remap[idx.x()]);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Clears all buffers of this mesh.
         */
        void clear()
        {
            mMesh->clear();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Checks if a given RawMesh is compatible with this typed mesh.
         * @param rawMesh Raw mesh to test.
         * @return True if the RawMesh can be inserted into this TypedMesh.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] static bool isCompatible(const RawMesh& rawMesh)
        {
            bool positionCompatible = rawMesh.getPositions().isValueType<TPositionValue>();
            bool normalCompatible   = rawMesh.getNormals().isValueType<TNormalValue>();
            bool texCoordCompatible = rawMesh.getTexCoords().isValueType<TTexCoordValue>();
            bool indexCompatible    = rawMesh.getIndexCollection().isValueType<TIndexValue>();
            return positionCompatible && normalCompatible && texCoordCompatible && indexCompatible;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Casts from another typed mesh into this one. If the type is matching, then they share the data. If the types don't match, then each element is casted.
         * @tparam TOtherMesh The type of the other mesh.
         * @param otherMesh The other mesh to convert into this one.
         * @return The converted typed mesh.
         */
        template <typename TOtherMesh>
        static std::shared_ptr<TypedMesh> cast(std::shared_ptr<TOtherMesh> otherMesh)
        {
            if constexpr (std::is_same_v<TypedMesh, TOtherMesh>)
                return otherMesh;
            else
                return cast(*otherMesh);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Casts from another typed mesh into this one. If the type is matching, then they share the data. If the types don't match, then each element is casted.
         * @tparam TOtherMesh The type of the other mesh.
         * @param otherMesh The other mesh to convert into this one.
         * @return The converted typed mesh.
         */
        template <typename TOtherMesh>
        static std::shared_ptr<TypedMesh> cast(TOtherMesh& otherMesh)
        {
            return cast(otherMesh.getRawShared());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Casts from a general raw mesh into this type. If the type is matching, then they share the data, although this object is not receiving ownership. If the types don't match, then each element is casted and this object owns the casted data.
         * @param rawMesh Raw mesh to cast from.
         * @return The converted typed mesh.
         */
        static std::shared_ptr<TypedMesh> cast(std::shared_ptr<RawMesh> rawMesh)
        {
            if (TypedMesh::isCompatible(*rawMesh))
            {
                return std::make_shared<TypedMesh>(rawMesh);
            }
            else
            {
                auto mesh = std::make_shared<TypedMesh>();
                mesh->setMeshTopology(rawMesh->getMeshTopology());

                auto pos = Array<typename TypedMesh::Position>::cast(rawMesh->getPositionsShared());
                mesh->getPositions().setRaw(pos->getRawShared());
                mesh->getRaw().setPositionsShared(pos->getRawShared());

                auto normal = Array<typename TypedMesh::Normal>::cast(rawMesh->getNormalsShared());
                mesh->getNormals().setRaw(normal->getRawShared());
                mesh->getRaw().setNormalsShared(normal->getRawShared());

                auto texCoord = Array<typename TypedMesh::TexCoord>::cast(rawMesh->getTexCoordsShared());
                mesh->getTexCoords().setRaw(texCoord->getRawShared());
                mesh->getRaw().setTexCoordsShared(texCoord->getRawShared());

                auto indices = Array<typename TypedMesh::Index>::cast(rawMesh->getIndexCollectionShared());
                mesh->getIndexCollection().setRaw(indices->getRawShared());
                mesh->getRaw().setIndexCollectionShared(indices->getRawShared());

                mesh->getSubmeshCollection().assign(rawMesh->getSubmeshCollection().begin(), rawMesh->getSubmeshCollection().end());
                mesh->getRaw().setAttributesShared(rawMesh->getAttributesShared());

                typename TypedMesh::BoundingBox box = rawMesh->getBoundingBoxAs<typename TypedMesh::BoundingBox::VectorType>();
                mesh->getRaw().template setBoundingBox<typename TypedMesh::BoundingBox::VectorType>(box);

                return mesh;
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Casts this mesh into another type. If the type is matching, then they share the data, although this object is not receiving ownership. If the types don't match, then each element is casted and this object owns the casted data.
         * @tparam TOtherMesh The type of the other mesh.
         * @return The converted typed mesh.
         */
        template <typename TOtherMesh>
        std::shared_ptr<TOtherMesh> cast()
        {
            return TOtherMesh::cast(*this);
        }

    private:
        /**
         * @brief Underlying generic mesh.
         */
        std::shared_ptr<RawMesh> mMesh;

        /**
         * @brief Typed interface for accessing the positions of the underlying mesh.
         */
        Array<TPositionValue> mPositions;

        /**
         * @brief Typed interface for accessing the normals of the underlying mesh.
         */
        Array<TNormalValue> mNormals;

        /**
         * @brief Typed interface for accessing the texture coordinates of the underlying mesh.
         */
        Array<TTexCoordValue> mTexCoords;

        /**
         * @brief Typed interface for accessing the explicit index buffer of the underlying mesh.
         */
        Array<TIndexValue> mIndexCollection;
    };
}
```

### vislab/geometry/include/vislab/geometry/mesh_fwd.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "mesh_topology.hpp"

#include <vislab/core/traits.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/types.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Strongly typed mesh with data structures aligning well to graphics APIs.
     * @tparam TPositionValue Eigen::Vector type of the position coordinates.
     * @tparam TNormalValue Eigen::Vector type of the normals.
     * @tparam TTexCoordValue Eigen::Vector type of the texture coordinates.
     * @tparam TIndexValue Eigen::Vector type of the index buffer.
     */
    template <typename TPositionValue,
              typename TNormalValue,
              typename TTexCoordValue,
              typename TIndexValue>
        requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TPositionValue> && detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TNormalValue> && detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TTexCoordValue> && detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TIndexValue>
    class TypedMesh;

    /**
     * @brief One-dimensional mesh geometry with vertex positions in float precision.
     */
     using Mesh1f = TypedMesh<Eigen::Vector1f, Eigen::Vector1f, Eigen::Vector1f, Eigen::Vector1u>;

    /**
     * @brief Two-dimensional mesh geometry with vertex positions in float precision.
     */
     using Mesh2f = TypedMesh<Eigen::Vector2f, Eigen::Vector2f, Eigen::Vector2f, Eigen::Vector1u>;

    /**
     * @brief Three-dimensional mesh geometry with vertex positions in float precision.
     */
     using Mesh3f = TypedMesh<Eigen::Vector3f, Eigen::Vector3f, Eigen::Vector2f, Eigen::Vector1u>;

    /**
     * @brief Four-dimensional mesh geometry with vertex positions in float precision.
     */
     using Mesh4f = TypedMesh<Eigen::Vector4f, Eigen::Vector4f, Eigen::Vector2f, Eigen::Vector1u>;

    /**
     * @brief One-dimensional mesh geometry with vertex positions in double precision.
     */
     using Mesh1d = TypedMesh<Eigen::Vector1d, Eigen::Vector1d, Eigen::Vector1d, Eigen::Vector1u>;

    /**
     * @brief Two-dimensional mesh geometry with vertex positions in double precision.
     */
     using Mesh2d = TypedMesh<Eigen::Vector2d, Eigen::Vector2d, Eigen::Vector2d, Eigen::Vector1u>;

    /**
     * @brief Three-dimensional mesh geometry with vertex positions in double precision.
     */
     using Mesh3d = TypedMesh<Eigen::Vector3d, Eigen::Vector3d, Eigen::Vector2d, Eigen::Vector1u>;

    /**
     * @brief Four-dimensional mesh geometry with vertex positions in double precision.
     */
     using Mesh4d = TypedMesh<Eigen::Vector4d, Eigen::Vector4d, Eigen::Vector2d, Eigen::Vector1u>;
}
```

```
#pragma once

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Enumeration of mesh topologies.
     */
    enum class EMeshTopology
    {
        /**
         * @brief Undefined initial state.
         */
        Undefined,
        /**
         * @brief List of points.
         */
        PointList,
        /**
         * @brief List of line segments.
         */
        LineList,
        /**
         * @brief Strip of line segments. Use -1 in the index buffer to indicate the start of a new strip.
         */
        LineStrip,
        /**
         * @brief List of triangles.
         */
        TriangleList,
        /**
         * @brief Strip of triangles. Use -1 in the index buffer to indicate the start of a new strip.
         */
        TriangleStrip,
    };
}
```
