### vislab/geometry/include/vislab/geometry/raw_mesh.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "attributes.hpp"
#include "mesh_topology.hpp"
#include "submesh.hpp"

#include <vislab/core/array.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/raw_array_math.hpp>

#include <span>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Specifies a range of consecutive indices.
     */
    struct IndexRange
    {
        /**
         * @brief Offset (in terms of indices) from which the indices begin in the index buffer.
         */
        size_t indexOffset;
        /**
         * @brief Number of indices in the index buffer from the offset onwards.
         */
        size_t indexCount;
    };

    /**
     * @brief Generic mesh type with data structures aligning well to graphics APIs.
     *
     * RawMesh owns the raw attribute buffers (positions, normals, texcoords, indices, attributes)
     * and a list of submeshes. Each submesh describes a slice of the index buffer (or implicit indices).
     */
    class RawMesh : public Concrete<RawMesh, Data>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Read-only logical view over the mesh's index sequence.
         *
         * This view abstracts over implicit and explicit index buffers.
         * It provides typed access via getValueAs<T>().
         *
         * The view does not expose mutation; to modify explicit indices,
         * use getIndexCollection().
         */
        class RawIndexView
        {
        public:
            /**
             * @brief Constructs a RawIndexView for a given mesh.
             * @param mesh Pointer to the underlying RawMesh.
             *
             * The mesh pointer must remain valid for the lifetime of the view.
             */
            explicit RawIndexView(const RawMesh* mesh)
                : mMesh(mesh)
            {
            }

            /**
             * @brief Returns the number of logical indices.
             *
             * If an explicit index collection exists, this is the size of the
             * explicit index buffer. Otherwise, it equals the number of positions.
             *
             * @return Number of logical indices.
             */
            [[nodiscard]] std::size_t getSize() const
            {
                if (mMesh->hasExplicitIndices())
                    return mMesh->getIndexCollection().getSize();
                return mMesh->getPositions().getSize();
            }

            /**
             * @brief Returns the index value at position i converted to TIndex.
             *
             * For explicit indices, the value is read from the index collection
             * and converted to TIndex. For implicit indices, this is equivalent
             * to static_cast<TIndex>(i).
             *
             * @tparam TIndex Target integral type.
             * @param i Logical index position.
             * @return Index value converted to TIndex.
             */
            template <typename TIndex>
            [[nodiscard]] TIndex getValue(std::size_t i) const
            {
                if (mMesh->hasExplicitIndices())
                    return mMesh->getIndexCollection().getValue<TIndex>(i);
                else
                    return TIndex((typename TIndex::Scalar)i);
            }

            /**
             * @brief Returns the index value at position i converted to TIndex.
             *
             * For explicit indices, the value is read from the index collection
             * and converted to TIndex. For implicit indices, this is equivalent
             * to static_cast<TIndex>(i).
             *
             * @tparam TIndex Target integral type.
             * @param i Logical index position.
             * @return Index value converted to TIndex.
             */
            template <typename TIndex>
            [[nodiscard]] TIndex getValueAs(std::size_t i) const
            {
                if (mMesh->hasExplicitIndices())
                    return mMesh->getIndexCollection().getValueAs<TIndex>(i);
                else
                    return TIndex(typename TIndex::Scalar(i));
            }

            /**
             * @brief Copies the logical index buffer into a destination array.
             *
             * For explicit indices, this performs a contiguous copy from the
             * index collection, assuming it is compatible with TIndex.
             * For implicit indices, this generates the sequence
             * [0, 1, 2, ..., size()-1], converted to TIndex.
             *
             * @tparam TIndex Target integral type.
             * @param dst Pointer to a buffer with at least size() elements.
             */
            template <typename TIndex>
            void copyTo(TIndex* dst) const
            {
                const std::size_t count = getSize();

                if (mMesh->hasExplicitIndices())
                {
                    const RawArray& collection = mMesh->getIndexCollection();
                    const TIndex* src          = collection.getPtr<TIndex>();
                    std::memcpy(dst, src, count * sizeof(TIndex));
                }
                else
                {
                    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                        dst[i].x() = static_cast<typename TIndex::Scalar>(i);
                }
            }

        private:
            const RawMesh* mMesh;
        };

        /**
         * @brief Read-only logical view over the mesh's submeshes.
         *
         * This view abstracts over explicit and implicit submeshes:
         *
         * - If the submesh collection is non-empty, it exposes the explicit list.
         * - Otherwise, it behaves as if there were exactly one submesh covering
         *   the full logical index range.
         *
         * The view is read-only; to modify explicit submeshes, use
         * getSubmeshCollection().
         */
        class SubmeshView
        {
        public:
            /**
             * @brief Constructs a SubmeshView for a given mesh.
             * @param mesh Pointer to the underlying RawMesh.
             *
             * The mesh pointer must remain valid for the lifetime of the view.
             */
            explicit SubmeshView(const RawMesh* mesh)
                : mMesh(mesh)
            {
            }

            /**
             * @brief Returns the number of logical submeshes.
             *
             * If an explicit submesh collection exists, this is the size of that
             * collection. Otherwise, this is 1, representing the implicit full
             * range submesh.
             *
             * @return Number of logical submeshes.
             */
            [[nodiscard]] std::size_t getSize() const
            {
                return hasExplicit()
                           ? mMesh->mSubmeshCollection.size()
                           : 1;
            }

            /**
             * @brief Random access operator for submeshes.
             *
             * If explicit submeshes exist, this returns the i-th explicit
             * submesh by value.
             * Otherwise, this returns the implicit submesh
             * { offset = 0, indexCount = getIndices()->getSize() } for i == 0.
             * Access with i > 0 is undefined in the implicit case.
             *
             * @param i Submesh index.
             * @return Submesh value.
             */
            [[nodiscard]] Submesh operator[](std::size_t i) const
            {
                if (hasExplicit())
                {
                    return mMesh->mSubmeshCollection[i];
                }

                // Implicit: single submesh covering the full logical index range.
                assert(i == 0);
                return Submesh{ 0, mMesh->getIndices().getSize() };
            }

            /**
             * @brief Forward iterator over submeshes for range-based for loops.
             *
             * Iteration yields Submesh values by value. To modify explicit
             * submeshes, use getSubmeshCollection() on the mesh.
             */
            class Iterator
            {
            public:
                using value_type        = Submesh;
                using difference_type   = std::ptrdiff_t;
                using iterator_category = std::forward_iterator_tag;

                /**
                 * @brief Constructs an iterator.
                 * @param mesh Pointer to the underlying RawMesh.
                 * @param i Current submesh index.
                 */
                Iterator(const RawMesh* mesh, std::size_t i)
                    : mMesh(mesh)
                    , mIndex(i)
                {
                }

                /**
                 * @brief Dereferences the iterator.
                 * @return Current submesh value.
                 */
                [[nodiscard]] Submesh operator*() const
                {
                    if (!mMesh->mSubmeshCollection.empty())
                    {
                        return mMesh->mSubmeshCollection[mIndex];
                    }

                    // Implicit single submesh.
                    assert(mIndex == 0);
                    return Submesh{ 0, getSize() };
                }

                /**
                 * @brief Pre-increment operator.
                 * @return Reference to this iterator.
                 */
                Iterator& operator++()
                {
                    ++mIndex;
                    return *this;
                }

                /**
                 * @brief Inequality comparison.
                 * @param other Iterator to compare against.
                 * @return True if the iterators refer to different indices or meshes.
                 */
                [[nodiscard]] bool operator!=(const Iterator& other) const
                {
                    return mIndex != other.mIndex || mMesh != other.mMesh;
                }

            private:
                /**
                 * @brief Returns the number of logical indices.
                 *
                 * If an explicit index collection exists, this is the size of the
                 * explicit index buffer. Otherwise, it equals the number of indices.
                 *
                 * @return Number of logical indices.
                 */
                [[nodiscard]] std::size_t getSize() const
                {
                    if (mMesh->hasExplicitIndices())
                        return mMesh->getIndexCollection().getSize();
                    return mMesh->getIndices().getSize();
                }

                const RawMesh* mMesh;
                std::size_t mIndex;
            };

            /**
             * @brief Returns an iterator to the first logical submesh.
             * @return Iterator to the first submesh.
             */
            [[nodiscard]] Iterator begin() const
            {
                return Iterator(mMesh, 0);
            }

            /**
             * @brief Returns an iterator past the last logical submesh.
             * @return End iterator.
             */
            [[nodiscard]] Iterator end() const
            {
                return Iterator(mMesh, getSize());
            }

        private:
            /**
             * @brief Returns true if the mesh has explicit submeshes.
             * @return True if an explicit submesh collection exists and is non-empty.
             */
            [[nodiscard]] bool hasExplicit() const
            {
                return !mMesh->mSubmeshCollection.empty();
            }

            const RawMesh* mMesh;
        };

        /**
         * @brief Empty constructor.
         * @param meshTopology Mesh topology of the raw mesh.
         * @param insertDefaultSubmesh If true, then an empty default submesh is created that addVertex will append to.
         */
        RawMesh(EMeshTopology meshTopology = EMeshTopology::Undefined)
            : mMeshTopology(meshTopology)
            , mPositions(std::make_shared<RawArray>())
            , mNormals(std::make_shared<RawArray>())
            , mTexCoords(std::make_shared<RawArray>())
            , mIndexCollection(std::make_shared<RawArray>())
            , mAttributes(std::make_shared<Attributes>())
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Copy-constructor from another mesh.
         * @param other Other mesh to copy.
         */
        explicit RawMesh(const RawMesh& other)
            : mMeshTopology(other.mMeshTopology)
            , mPositions(other.mPositions->clone())
            , mNormals(other.mNormals->clone())
            , mTexCoords(other.mTexCoords->clone())
            , mIndexCollection(other.mIndexCollection->clone())
            , mAttributes(other.mAttributes->clone())
            , mSubmeshCollection(other.mSubmeshCollection)
            , mBoundingBox(other.mBoundingBox)
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Move constructor.
         * @param other Other mesh to construct from.
         */
        RawMesh(RawMesh&& other) noexcept
            : mMeshTopology(std::move(other.mMeshTopology))
            , mPositions(std::move(other.mPositions))
            , mNormals(std::move(other.mNormals))
            , mTexCoords(std::move(other.mTexCoords))
            , mIndexCollection(std::move(other.mIndexCollection))
            , mAttributes(std::move(other.mAttributes))
            , mSubmeshCollection(std::move(other.mSubmeshCollection))
            , mBoundingBox(std::move(other.mBoundingBox))
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Copy assignment
         * @param other Other mesh to copy from.
         * @return Reference to self.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] RawMesh& operator=(const RawMesh& other)
        {
            if (this != &other)
            {
                mMeshTopology      = other.mMeshTopology;
                *mPositions        = *other.mPositions;
                *mNormals          = *other.mNormals;
                *mTexCoords        = *other.mTexCoords;
                *mIndexCollection  = *other.mIndexCollection;
                *mAttributes       = *other.mAttributes;
                mSubmeshCollection = other.mSubmeshCollection;
            }
            return *this;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Move assignment.
         * @param other Other object to move.
         * @return Reference to self.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] RawMesh& operator=(RawMesh&& other) noexcept
        {
            if (this != &other)
            {
                mMeshTopology      = std::move(other.mMeshTopology);
                mPositions         = std::move(other.mPositions);
                mNormals           = std::move(other.mNormals);
                mTexCoords         = std::move(other.mTexCoords);
                mIndexCollection   = std::move(other.mIndexCollection);
                mAttributes        = std::move(other.mAttributes);
                mSubmeshCollection = std::move(other.mSubmeshCollection);
            }
            return *this;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the position buffer.
         * @return Position buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const RawArray& getPositions() const { return *mPositions; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the position buffer.
         * @return Position buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] RawArray& getPositions() { return *mPositions; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a shared pointer to the position buffer.
         * @return Position buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<const RawArray> getPositionsShared() const { return mPositions; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a shared pointer to the position buffer.
         * @return Position buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<RawArray> getPositionsShared() { return mPositions; }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the position buffer by copying from another buffer.
         * @param positions Position buffer.
         */
        void setPositions(const RawArray& positions)
        {
            *mPositions = positions;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Redirects the shared pointer to the position buffer. Be careful with this function! When changing the underlying resource, any view onto this object will still point at the old resource.
         * @param positions Position buffer.
         */
        void setPositionsShared(const std::shared_ptr<RawArray>& positions)
        {
            assert(positions != nullptr);
            mPositions = positions;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the normal buffer.
         * @return Normal buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const RawArray& getNormals() const { return *mNormals; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the normal buffer.
         * @return Normal buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] RawArray& getNormals() { return *mNormals; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a shared pointer to the normal buffer.
         * @return Normal buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<const RawArray> getNormalsShared() const { return mNormals; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a shared pointer to the normal buffer.
         * @return Normal buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<RawArray> getNormalsShared() { return mNormals; }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the normal buffer by copying from another buffer.
         * @param normals Normal buffer.
         */
        void setNormals(const RawArray& normals)
        {
            *mNormals = normals;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Redirects the shared pointer to the normal buffer. Be careful with this function! When changing the underlying resource, any view onto this object will still point at the old resource.
         * @param normals Normal buffer.
         */
        void setNormalsShared(const std::shared_ptr<RawArray>& normals)
        {
            assert(normals != nullptr);
            mNormals = normals;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the texture coordinate buffer.
         * @return Texture coordinate buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const RawArray& getTexCoords() const { return *mTexCoords; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the texture coordinate buffer.
         * @return Texture coordinate buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] RawArray& getTexCoords() { return *mTexCoords; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a shared pointer to the texture coordinate buffer.
         * @return Texture coordinator buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<const RawArray> getTexCoordsShared() const { return mTexCoords; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a shared pointer to the texture coordinate buffer.
         * @return Texture coordinator buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<RawArray> getTexCoordsShared() { return mTexCoords; }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the texture coordinate buffer by copying from another buffer.
         * @param texCoords Texture coordinate buffer.
         */
        void setTexCoords(const RawArray& texCoords)
        {
            *mTexCoords = texCoords;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Redirects the shared pointer to the texture coordinate buffer. Be careful with this function! When changing the underlying resource, any view onto this object will still point at the old resource.
         * @param texCoords Texture coordinate buffer.
         */
        void setTexCoordsShared(const std::shared_ptr<RawArray>& texCoords)
        {
            assert(texCoords != nullptr);
            mTexCoords = texCoords;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns true if the mesh has an explicit index buffer (IndicesCollection is not empty).
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool hasExplicitIndices() const
        {
            return mIndexCollection->getSize() > 0;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns true if the mesh uses implicit indices (IndicesCollection is empty).
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool hasImplicitIndices() const
        {
            return !hasExplicitIndices();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns a read-only logical view over the mesh's index buffer.
         *
         * The returned view abstracts over explicit and implicit indices.
         * For mutation of explicit indices, use getIndexCollection().
         *
         * @return RawIndexView representing the logical index sequence.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] RawIndexView getIndices() const
        {
            return RawIndexView(this);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns the explicit index collection.
         *
         * The returned RawArray stores the explicit index buffer.
         * If the collection is empty, the mesh uses implicit indices.
         *
         * @return Reference to the explicit index collection.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] RawArray& getIndexCollection()
        {
            assert(mIndexCollection && "Index collection pointer must be initialized.");
            return *mIndexCollection;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns the explicit index collection (const overload).
         *
         * The returned RawArray stores the explicit index buffer.
         * If the collection is empty, the mesh uses implicit indices.
         *
         * @return Const reference to the explicit index collection.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const RawArray& getIndexCollection() const
        {
            assert(mIndexCollection && "Index collection pointer must be initialized.");
            return *mIndexCollection;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns a shared pointer to the explicit index collection.
         *
         * The returned RawArray stores the explicit index buffer.
         * If the collection is empty, the mesh uses implicit indices.
         *
         * @return Shared pointer to the explicit index collection.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<const RawArray> getIndexCollectionShared() const { return mIndexCollection; }

        /**
         * @brief Returns a shared pointer to the explicit index collection.
         *
         * The returned RawArray stores the explicit index buffer.
         * If the collection is empty, the mesh uses implicit indices.
         *
         * @return Shared pointer to the explicit index collection.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<RawArray> getIndexCollectionShared() { return mIndexCollection; }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the explicit index collection by reference.
         *
         * After calling this function, the mesh will use explicit indices if @p indices is non-empty. If @p indices is empty, the mesh falls back to implicit indices.
         *
         * @param indices Reference to a RawArray that will be used as the index collection. The RawMesh does not take ownership.
         */
        void setIndexCollection(const RawArray& indices)
        {
            *mIndexCollection = indices;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Redirects the shared pointer to the explicit index buffer. Be careful with this function! When changing the underlying resource, any view onto this object will still point at the old resource.
         *
         * After calling this function, the mesh will use explicit indices if @p indices is non-empty. If @p indices is empty, the mesh falls back to implicit indices.
         *
         * @param indices Reference to a RawArray that will be used as the index collection.
         */
        void setIndexCollectionShared(const std::shared_ptr<RawArray>& indices)
        {
            assert(indices != nullptr);
            mIndexCollection = indices;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the attributes.
         * @return Attributes.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const Attributes& getAttributes() const { return *mAttributes; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the attributes.
         * @return Attributes.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Attributes& getAttributes() { return *mAttributes; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a shared pointer to the attributes.
         * @return Attributes.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<const Attributes> getAttributesShared() const { return mAttributes; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets a shared pointer to the attributes.
         * @return Attributes.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<Attributes> getAttributesShared() { return mAttributes; }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the attributes by copying from another attribute set.
         * @param attributes Attributes.
         */
        void setAttributes(const Attributes& attributes)
        {
            *mAttributes = attributes;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Redirects the shared pointer to the attributes.
         * @param attributes Attributes.
         */
        void setAttributesShared(const std::shared_ptr<Attributes>& attributes)
        {
            assert(attributes != nullptr);
            mAttributes = attributes;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the mesh topology.
         * @param meshTopology Mesh topology.
         */
        void setMeshTopology(EMeshTopology meshTopology) { mMeshTopology = meshTopology; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the mesh topology.
         * @return Mesh topology.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] EMeshTopology getMeshTopology() const { return mMeshTopology; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the number of vertices for the underlying primitive topology.
         * @return Number of vertices per primitive.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] size_t getVerticesPerPrimitive() const
        {
            switch (mMeshTopology)
            {
            case EMeshTopology::PointList:
                return 1;
            case EMeshTopology::LineList:
                return 2;
            case EMeshTopology::TriangleList:
                return 3;
            case EMeshTopology::LineStrip:
                return 2;
            case EMeshTopology::TriangleStrip:
                return 3;
            default:
                return 0;
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns true of the topology is sliding, i.e., whether it is a strip.
         * @return True of line strip or triangle strip.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool hasSlidingTopology() const
        {
            switch (mMeshTopology)
            {
            case EMeshTopology::LineStrip:
            case EMeshTopology::TriangleStrip:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the total number of primitives over all submeshes.
         * @return Number of primitives in total.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] size_t getNumPrimitives() const
        {
            size_t count        = 0;
            size_t numSubmeshes = getSubmeshes().getSize();
            for (int submeshIndex = 0; submeshIndex < numSubmeshes; ++submeshIndex)
                count += getNumPrimitives(submeshIndex);
            return count;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the number of primitives inside a specific submesh.
         * @param submeshIndex Index of the submesh.
         * @return Number of primitives in the submesh.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] size_t getNumPrimitives(size_t submeshIndex) const
        {
            auto subs = getSubmeshes(); // logical view
            assert(submeshIndex < subs.getSize());
            const auto sm       = subs[submeshIndex]; // by value
            const std::size_t N = getVerticesPerPrimitive();
            const bool sliding  = hasSlidingTopology(); // runtime query

            if (sliding)
            {
                // Sliding topologies (like line strips, triangle strips):
                // each new vertex adds one primitive
                if (sm.indexCount < N)
                    return 0;
                return sm.indexCount - (N - 1);
            }
            else
            {
                // Non-sliding topologies (like lines, triangles, quads):
                // each primitive consumes N vertices
                return sm.indexCount / N;
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Retrieves the index buffer range of a given primitive.
         * @param submeshIndex Index of the submesh that contains the primitive.
         * @param primitiveIndex Primitive index to find the index range for.
         * @return Range of indices in the index buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] IndexRange getPrimitive(std::size_t submeshIndex, std::size_t primitiveIndex) const
        {
            auto subs     = getSubmeshes();
            const auto sm = subs[submeshIndex];

            const std::size_t N = getVerticesPerPrimitive();
            const auto indices  = getIndices(); // logical view

            const std::size_t base = hasSlidingTopology()
                                         ? (sm.indexOffset + primitiveIndex)
                                         : (sm.indexOffset + primitiveIndex * N);
            return IndexRange({ base, N });
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns true if the mesh uses explicit submeshes (SubmeshCollection is not empty).
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool hasExplicitSubmeshes() const
        {
            return mSubmeshCollection.size() > 0;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns true if the mesh uses implicit submeshes (SubmeshCollection is empty).
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool hasImplicitSubmeshes() const
        {
            return !hasExplicitSubmeshes();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns a read-only logical view over the mesh's submeshes.
         *
         * If the submesh collection is non-empty, the view exposes the explicit submeshes. Otherwise, it behaves as if there were exactly one implicit submesh covering the full logical index range.
         * To modify explicit submeshes, use getSubmeshCollection().
         *
         * @return SubmeshView representing the logical submesh list.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] SubmeshView getSubmeshes() const
        {
            return SubmeshView(this);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns the explicit submesh collection.
         *
         * If the collection is empty, the mesh behaves as if it had a single implicit submesh covering the full logical index range. This implicit submesh is not stored in the collection.
         *
         * @return Reference to the explicit submesh collection.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Submesh>& getSubmeshCollection()
        {
            return mSubmeshCollection;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns the explicit submesh collection (const overload).
         *
         * If the collection is empty, the mesh behaves as if it had a single implicit submesh covering the full logical index range. This implicit submesh is not stored in the collection.
         *
         * @return Const reference to the explicit submesh collection.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<Submesh>& getSubmeshCollection() const
        {
            return mSubmeshCollection;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Replaces the explicit submesh collection.
         *
         * After calling this function, the mesh will use explicit submeshes if @p submeshes is non-empty. If @p submeshes is empty, the mesh falls back to a single implicit submesh covering the full index range.
         *
         * @param submeshes New explicit submesh collection (copied).
         */
        void setSubmeshCollection(const std::vector<Submesh>& submeshes)
        {
            mSubmeshCollection = submeshes;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Replaces the explicit submesh collection (move overload).
         *
         * After calling this function, the mesh will use explicit submeshes if @p submeshes is non-empty. If @p submeshes is empty, the mesh falls back to a single implicit submesh covering the full index range.
         *
         * @param submeshes New explicit submesh collection (moved from).
         */
        void setSubmeshCollection(std::vector<Submesh>&& submeshes)
        {
            mSubmeshCollection = std::move(submeshes);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Tests if the mesh object is fully initialized and ready for use.
         * @return True if the mesh object is in a valid state.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool isValid() const override
        {
            // if there is geometry, but the mesh topology is undefined -> not valid
            if (mMeshTopology == EMeshTopology::Undefined && mPositions->getSize() > 0)
                return false;
            if (!mPositions->isValid())
                return false;
            if (!mNormals->isValid())
                return false;
            if (!mTexCoords->isValid())
                return false;
            if (!mIndexCollection->isValid())
                return false;
            if (!mAttributes->isValid())
                return false;
            if (mPositions->getSize() > 0 && mBoundingBox.empty())
                return false;

            return validateTopology();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Recomputes the bounding box of the position coordinates.
         */
        void recomputeBoundingBox()
        {
            mBoundingBox.clear();
            if (mPositions->getSize() > 0)
            {
                auto minDomain = detail::computeMin(*mPositions);
                auto maxDomain = detail::computeMax(*mPositions);
                mBoundingBox.insert(mBoundingBox.end(), minDomain.begin(), minDomain.end());
                mBoundingBox.insert(mBoundingBox.end(), maxDomain.begin(), maxDomain.end());
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the bounding box by assuming a certain underlying TElement format. Note that recomputeBoundingBox has to be called beforehand.
         * @tparam TElement Assumed element type of the underlying data.
         * @return Bounding box of the positions.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        [[nodiscard]] const Eigen::AlignedBox<typename TElement::Scalar, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime * TElement::ColsAtCompileTime>& getBoundingBox() const
        {
            using BoxType = Eigen::AlignedBox<typename TElement::Scalar, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime * TElement::ColsAtCompileTime>;
            assert(!mBoundingBox.empty());
            assert(mBoundingBox.size() == sizeof(BoxType));
            return *reinterpret_cast<const BoxType*>(mBoundingBox.data());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the bounding box by assuming a certain underlying TElement format.
         * @tparam TElement Assumed element type of the underlying data.
         * @param boundingBox Bounding box of the positions to set.
         */
        template <typename TVector>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TVector> &&
                     (TVector::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TVector::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        void setBoundingBox(const Eigen::AlignedBox<typename TVector::Scalar,
                                                    TVector::RowsAtCompileTime * TVector::ColsAtCompileTime>& box)
        {
            using BoxType = Eigen::AlignedBox<typename TVector::Scalar, TVector::RowsAtCompileTime * TVector::ColsAtCompileTime>;
            mBoundingBox.resize(sizeof(BoxType));
            std::memcpy(mBoundingBox.data(), &box, sizeof(BoxType));
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the bounding box by converting it into a certain TElement format. Note that recomputeBoundingBox has to be called beforehand.
         * @tparam TElement Requested element type to convert into.
         * @return Bounding box of the positions.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> && (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
        [[nodiscard]] Eigen::AlignedBox<typename TElement::Scalar, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime * TElement::ColsAtCompileTime> getBoundingBoxAs() const
        {
            if (mBoundingBox.empty())
            {
                Eigen::AlignedBox<typename TElement::Scalar, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime * TElement::ColsAtCompileTime> box;
                box.setEmpty();
                return box;
            }
            switch (mPositions->getFormat())
            {
            case EFormat::Float32:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::AlignedBox<float, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mBoundingBox.data())->template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::Float64:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::AlignedBox<double, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mBoundingBox.data())->template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::Int16:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::AlignedBox<int16_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mBoundingBox.data())->template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::Int32:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::AlignedBox<int32_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mBoundingBox.data())->template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::Int64:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::AlignedBox<int64_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mBoundingBox.data())->template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::UInt16:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::AlignedBox<uint16_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mBoundingBox.data())->template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::UInt32:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::AlignedBox<uint32_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mBoundingBox.data())->template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            case EFormat::UInt64:
                return reinterpret_cast<const Eigen::AlignedBox<uint64_t, TElement::RowsAtCompileTime>*>(mBoundingBox.data())->template cast<typename TElement::Scalar>();
            default:
                throw std::runtime_error("Unknown format.");
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Serializes the object into/from an archive.
         * @param archive Archive to serialize into/from.
         */
        void serialize(IArchive& archive) override
        {
            archive("Positions", mPositions);
            archive("Normals", mNormals);
            archive("TexCoords", mTexCoords);
            archive("IndexCollection", mIndexCollection);
            archive("Attributes", mAttributes);
            archive("SubmeshCollection", mSubmeshCollection);
            int itopology = (int)mMeshTopology;
            archive("meshTopology", itopology);
            mMeshTopology = (EMeshTopology)itopology;
            archive("BoundingBox", mBoundingBox);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Tests if equal to the given mesh.
         * @param other Mesh to compare with.
         * @return True if equal.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool isEqual(const RawMesh& other) const
        {
            bool eqMeshTopology      = mMeshTopology == other.mMeshTopology;
            bool eqPositions         = mPositions->isEqual(*other.mPositions);
            bool eqNormals           = mNormals->isEqual(*other.mNormals);
            bool eqTexCoords         = mTexCoords->isEqual(*other.mTexCoords);
            bool eqIndexCollection   = mIndexCollection->isEqual(*other.mIndexCollection);
            bool eqAttributes        = mAttributes->isEqual(*other.mAttributes);
            bool eqSubmeshCollection = mSubmeshCollection == other.mSubmeshCollection;
            bool eqBoundingBox       = mBoundingBox == other.mBoundingBox;
            return eqMeshTopology && eqPositions && eqNormals && eqTexCoords && eqIndexCollection && eqAttributes && eqSubmeshCollection && eqBoundingBox;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Clears all buffers of this mesh.
         */
        void clear()
        {
            mPositions->clear();
            mNormals->clear();
            mTexCoords->clear();
            mIndexCollection->clear();
            mAttributes->clear();
            mSubmeshCollection.clear();
            mBoundingBox.clear();
        }

    private:
        /**
         * @brief Topology of the mesh.
         */
        EMeshTopology mMeshTopology;

        /**
         * @brief Position buffer.
         */
        std::shared_ptr<RawArray> mPositions;

        /**
         * @brief Normal buffer.
         */
        std::shared_ptr<RawArray> mNormals;

        /**
         * @brief Texture coordinate buffer.
         */
        std::shared_ptr<RawArray> mTexCoords;

        /**
         * @brief Explicit index collection; empty implies a implicit indices.
         */
        std::shared_ptr<RawArray> mIndexCollection;

        /**
         * @brief Collection of attributes.
         */
        std::shared_ptr<Attributes> mAttributes;

        /**
         * @brief Explicit submesh collection of indices for slicing into submeshes; empty implies a single implicit submesh.
         */
        std::vector<Submesh> mSubmeshCollection;

        /**
         * @brief Minimum and maximum bound of the positions in binary format.
         */
        std::vector<std::byte, Eigen::aligned_allocator<std::byte>> mBoundingBox;

        /**
         * @brief Validates if submesh indices are aligned with the mesh topology.
         * @return True if the mesh topology makes sense.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool validateTopology() const
        {
            for (auto sm : getSubmeshes())
            {
                switch (mMeshTopology)
                {
                case EMeshTopology::TriangleList:
                    if (sm.indexCount % 3 != 0)
                        return false;
                    break;
                case EMeshTopology::LineList:
                    if (sm.indexCount % 2 != 0)
                        return false;
                    break;
                default:
                    break; // PointList etc. have no constraints
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
    };
}
```

### vislab/geometry/include/vislab/geometry/submesh.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <vislab/core/data.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/iarchive.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Information for slicing into the data of a specific submesh.
     */
    class Submesh : public Concrete<Submesh, Data>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         */
        Submesh()
            : indexOffset(0)
            , indexCount(0)
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         * @param _indexOffset Starting index in the index buffer.
         * @param _indexCount Number of indices.
         */
        Submesh(size_t _indexOffset, size_t _indexCount)
            : indexOffset(_indexOffset)
            , indexCount(_indexCount)
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Starting index in the index buffer.
         */
        size_t indexOffset = 0;

        /**
         * @brief Number of indices.
         */
        size_t indexCount = 0;

        /**
         * @brief Serializes the object into/from an archive.
         * @param archive Archive to serialize into/from.
         */
        void serialize(IArchive& archive) override
        {
            archive("indexOffset", indexOffset);
            archive("indexCount", indexCount);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Equality operator.
         * @param other Other submesh to compare with.
         * @return True if equal.
         */
        bool operator==(const Submesh& other) const noexcept
        {
            return indexOffset == other.indexOffset &&
                   indexCount == other.indexCount;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Inequality operator.
         * @param other Other submesh to compare with.
         * @return True if unequal.
         */
        bool operator!=(const Submesh& other) const noexcept
        {
            return !(*this == other);
        }
    };
}
```

### vislab/geometry/include/vislab/geometry/vertex_normals.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "raw_mesh.hpp"

#include <vislab/core/algorithm.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    class RawArray;

    /**
     * @brief Algorithm that calculates vertex normals.
     */
    class VertexNormals : public ConcreteAlgorithm<VertexNormals>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         */
        VertexNormals() = default;

        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         * @param inMesh Mesh that the positions are read from.
         * @param outMesh Mesh that the vertex normals are written to.
         */
        VertexNormals(const std::shared_ptr<RawMesh>& inMesh, const std::shared_ptr<RawMesh>& outMesh)
        {
            inputMesh.setData(inMesh);
            outputMesh.setData(outMesh);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Mesh that the positions are read from.
         */
        InputPort<RawMesh> inputMesh;

        /**
         * @brief Mesh that the vertex normals are written to.
         */
        OutputPort<RawMesh> outputMesh;

        /**
         * @brief Computes vertex normals and adds them the given mesh. Assumes triangle list topology.
         * @param positions Vertex positions of the surface.
         * @param indices Index buffer of the surface.
         * @param normals Buffer that stores the resulting normals.
         */
        static void computeNormals(const RawArray& positions, const RawArray& indices, RawArray& normals);

        /**
         * @brief Computes vertex normals and adds them to the given mesh. Assumes triangle list topology.
         * @param mesh Mesh to compute the vertex normals for.
        */
        static void computeNormals(RawMesh& mesh);

    protected:
        /**
         * @brief Internal computation function
         * @param[in] progress Optional progress info.
         * @return Information about the completion of the computation, including a potential error message.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] UpdateInfo internalUpdate(ProgressInfo& progress) override;
    };
}
```

### vislab/gpu/include/vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <vislab/core/reflectable.hpp>

#include <filesystem>
#include <memory>
#include <span>

#include "types.hpp"

namespace vislab
{
    // Forward declarations
    class IGpuBuffer;
    class IGpuTexture;
    class IGpuSampler;
    class IRenderPipeline;
    class IComputePipeline;
    class IGpuShaderResourceView;
    class IGpuUnorderedAccessView;
    class IGpuRenderTargetView;
    class IGpuDepthStencilView;
    class ICommandList;
    class ISwapchain;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Resource Interfaces (pure, lightweight)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    class IGpuBuffer : public Reflectable<IGpuBuffer>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~IGpuBuffer()           = default;
        virtual void* getNativeHandle() = 0;
    };

    class IGpuTexture : public Reflectable<IGpuTexture>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~IGpuTexture()          = default;
        virtual void* getNativeHandle() = 0;
    };

    class IGpuSampler : public Reflectable<IGpuSampler>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~IGpuSampler()          = default;
        virtual void* getNativeHandle() = 0;
    };

    class IGpuShaderResourceView : public Reflectable<IGpuShaderResourceView>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~IGpuShaderResourceView() = default;
        virtual void* getNativeHandle()   = 0;
    };

    class IGpuUnorderedAccessView : public Reflectable<IGpuUnorderedAccessView>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~IGpuUnorderedAccessView() = default;
        virtual void* getNativeHandle()    = 0;
    };

    class IGpuRenderTargetView : public Reflectable<IGpuRenderTargetView>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~IGpuRenderTargetView() = default;
        virtual void* getNativeHandle() = 0;
    };

    class IGpuDepthStencilView : public Reflectable<IGpuDepthStencilView>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~IGpuDepthStencilView() = default;
        virtual void* getNativeHandle() = 0;
    };

    class IRenderPipeline : public Reflectable<IRenderPipeline>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~IRenderPipeline()      = default;
        virtual void* getNativeHandle() = 0;
    };

    class IComputePipeline : public Reflectable<IComputePipeline>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~IComputePipeline()     = default;
        virtual void* getNativeHandle() = 0;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Swapchain Interface
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    struct SwapchainImage
    {
        IGpuTexture* texture;               // backbuffer texture
        IGpuRenderTargetView* renderTarget; // RTV view for rendering
    };

    class ISwapchain : public Reflectable<ISwapchain>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~ISwapchain() = default;

        virtual SwapchainImage acquireNextImage() = 0;
        virtual void present()                    = 0;

        virtual const SwapchainDesc& getDesc() const = 0;
        virtual void* getNativeHandle()              = 0;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Command List Interface
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    class ICommandList : public Reflectable<ICommandList>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~ICommandList() = default;

        // Recording lifecycle
        virtual void begin() = 0;
        virtual void end()   = 0;

        // Render passes (views, not raw textures)
        virtual void beginRenderPass(IGpuRenderTargetView* renderTarget,
                                     IGpuDepthStencilView* depthTarget = nullptr) = 0;
        virtual void endRenderPass()                                              = 0;

        // Clear commands
        virtual void clearRenderTarget(IGpuRenderTargetView* target, const float color[4])                = 0;
        virtual void clearDepthStencil(IGpuDepthStencilView* target, float depth, uint8_t stencil = 0xFF) = 0;
        virtual void clearUnorderedAccess(IGpuUnorderedAccessView* target, const uint32_t pattern)        = 0;

        // Pipelines
        virtual void setRenderPipeline(IRenderPipeline* pipeline)   = 0;
        virtual void setComputePipeline(IComputePipeline* pipeline) = 0;

        // Vertex / index input
        virtual void setVertexBuffer(uint32_t slot, IGpuBuffer* buffer) = 0;
        virtual void setIndexBuffer(IGpuBuffer* buffer)                 = 0;

        // dynamic state
        virtual void setViewport(float x,
                                 float y,
                                 float width,
                                 float height,
                                 float minDepth = 0.0f,
                                 float maxDepth = 1.0f) = 0;

        virtual void setScissorRect(int32_t x,
                                    int32_t y,
                                    uint32_t width,
                                    uint32_t height) = 0;

        virtual void setStencilRef(uint32_t)                           = 0;
        virtual void setBlendFactor(const float[4])                    = 0;
        virtual void setSampleMask(uint32_t)                           = 0;
        virtual void setPrimitiveTopology(EPrimitiveTopology topology) = 0;

        // Uniform = constant/uniform buffer
        virtual void bindUniformBuffer(EShaderStage stages,
                                       uint32_t slot,
                                       IGpuBuffer* buffer) = 0;

        // Read-only buffer
        virtual void bindShaderResourceView(EShaderStage stages,
                                            uint32_t slot,
                                            IGpuShaderResourceView* view) = 0;

        // Read-write buffer
        virtual void bindUnorderedAccessView(EShaderStage stages,
                                             uint32_t slot,
                                             IGpuUnorderedAccessView* view) = 0;

        // Sampler bindings
        virtual void bindSampler(EShaderStage stages,
                                 uint32_t slot,
                                 IGpuSampler* sampler) = 0;

        // Resolve multi-sampled resource
        virtual void resolveTexture(IGpuTexture* src,
                                    IGpuTexture* dst) = 0;

        // Update buffer
        virtual void updateBuffer(IGpuBuffer* buffer,
                                  const void* data,
                                  size_t size,
                                  size_t offset = 0) = 0;

        virtual void updateTexture1d(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                     const void* data,
                                     size_t rowPitch,
                                     uint32_t mipLevel = 0) = 0;

        virtual void updateTexture2d(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                     const void* data,
                                     size_t rowPitch,
                                     uint32_t mipLevel = 0) = 0;

        virtual void updateTexture3d(IGpuTexture* texture,
                                     const void* data,
                                     size_t rowPitch,
                                     size_t slicePitch,
                                     uint32_t mipLevel = 0) = 0;

        // Draw / dispatch
        virtual void draw(uint32_t vertexCount,
                          uint32_t firstVertex = 0) = 0;

        virtual void drawIndexed(uint32_t indexCount,
                                 uint32_t firstIndex  = 0,
                                 int32_t vertexOffset = 0) = 0;

        virtual void dispatch(uint32_t groupX,
                              uint32_t groupY,
                              uint32_t groupZ) = 0;

        virtual void replay() = 0;

        /**
         * @brief Primary list executes secondary list.
         * @param lists Secondary command lists.
         */
        virtual void executeCommands(std::span<ICommandList* const> lists) = 0;

        void executeCommands(ICommandList* list)
        {
            ICommandList* const lists[] = { list };
            executeCommands(std::span<ICommandList* const>(lists, 1));
        }

        virtual ECommandListType getCommandListType() const = 0;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Device Interface
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    class IGraphicsDevice : public Reflectable<IGraphicsDevice>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~IGraphicsDevice() = default;

        virtual std::unique_ptr<IGpuBuffer> createBuffer(const BufferDesc& desc)    = 0;
        virtual std::unique_ptr<IGpuTexture> createTexture(const TextureDesc& desc) = 0;
        virtual std::unique_ptr<IGpuSampler> createSampler(const SamplerDesc& desc) = 0;

        virtual std::unique_ptr<IGpuShaderResourceView> createShaderResourceView(IGpuBuffer* buffer, const BufferViewDesc& desc)    = 0;
        virtual std::unique_ptr<IGpuShaderResourceView> createShaderResourceView(IGpuTexture* texture, const TextureViewDesc& desc) = 0;

        virtual std::unique_ptr<IGpuUnorderedAccessView> createUnorderedAccessView(IGpuBuffer* buffer, const BufferViewDesc& desc)    = 0;
        virtual std::unique_ptr<IGpuUnorderedAccessView> createUnorderedAccessView(IGpuTexture* texture, const TextureViewDesc& desc) = 0;

        virtual std::unique_ptr<IGpuRenderTargetView> createRenderTargetView(IGpuTexture* texture, const TextureViewDesc& desc) = 0;
        virtual std::unique_ptr<IGpuDepthStencilView> createDepthStencilView(IGpuTexture* texture, const TextureViewDesc& desc) = 0;

        virtual std::unique_ptr<IRenderPipeline> createRenderPipeline(const RenderPipelineDesc& desc)    = 0;
        virtual std::unique_ptr<IComputePipeline> createComputePipeline(const ComputePipelineDesc& desc) = 0;

        virtual std::unique_ptr<ICommandList> createCommandList(ECommandListType commandListType) = 0;

        virtual ShaderBinary compileShader(const ShaderDesc& desc) = 0;

        ShaderBinary loadShader(EShaderStage stage, const std::filesystem::path& filename, const std::string& debugName);

        virtual void readBuffer(IGpuBuffer* buffer, void* dst, size_t size, size_t offset = 0) = 0;

        // Read back a 1D texture into CPU memory
        virtual void readTexture1d(IGpuTexture* texture, void* dst, size_t size, uint32_t mipLevel = 0) = 0;

        // Read back a 2D texture into CPU memory
        virtual void readTexture2d(IGpuTexture* texture, void* dst, size_t rowPitch, uint32_t mipLevel = 0) = 0;

        // Read back a 3D texture into CPU memory
        virtual void readTexture3d(IGpuTexture* texture, void* dst, size_t rowPitch, size_t slicePitch, uint32_t mipLevel = 0) = 0;

        virtual std::unique_ptr<ISwapchain> createSwapchain(void* windowHandle, const SwapchainDesc& desc) = 0;
        virtual void setSwapCallback(std::function<void(void*)> cb)                                        = 0;

        virtual ShaderDialect getShaderDialect() const = 0;
    };

} // namespace vislab
```

### vislab/gpu/include/vislab/gpu/types.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <array>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string>
#include <variant>
#include <vector>
#include <limits>

namespace vislab
{
    class IGpuBuffer;
    class IGpuTexture;
    class IGpuSampler;
    class IRenderPipeline;
    class IComputePipeline;
    class IGpuShaderResourceView;
    class IGpuUnorderedAccessView;
    class IGpuRenderTargetView;
    class IGpuDepthStencilView;
    class ICommandList;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Swapchain
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    struct SwapchainDesc
    {
        uint32_t width  = 0;
        uint32_t height = 0;

        // Multisampling
        uint32_t sampleCount = 1; // 1 = no MSAA

        // Presentation
        bool vsync = true;

        // Future extensions:
        // ETextureFormat format = ETextureFormat::RGBA8;
        // bool allowTearing = false;
        // bool fullscreen = false;
        // uint32_t bufferCount = 2;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Buffer + Memory
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    enum class EBufferBindFlags : uint32_t
    {
        None            = 0,
        Vertex          = 1 << 0,
        Index           = 1 << 1,
        Uniform         = 1 << 2,
        ShaderResource  = 1 << 3,
        UnorderedAccess = 1 << 4,
    };

    inline EBufferBindFlags operator|(EBufferBindFlags a, EBufferBindFlags b)
    {
        return static_cast<EBufferBindFlags>(
            static_cast<uint32_t>(a) | static_cast<uint32_t>(b));
    }

    inline EBufferBindFlags operator&(EBufferBindFlags a, EBufferBindFlags b)
    {
        return static_cast<EBufferBindFlags>(
            static_cast<uint32_t>(a) & static_cast<uint32_t>(b));
    }

    inline bool hasFlag(EBufferBindFlags value, EBufferBindFlags flag)
    {
        return (static_cast<uint32_t>(value) & static_cast<uint32_t>(flag)) != 0;
    }

    enum class EMemoryType
    {
        DeviceLocal,  // GPU-only memory: fast, not CPU accessible
        HostVisible,  // CPU-visible memory (mapped or mappable)
        HostCoherent, // CPU-visible and coherent (no manual flush)
        HostCached,   // CPU-visible and cached (fast CPU reads)
        Staging       // CPU <-> GPU transfer memory (upload/download)
    };

    enum class EIndexFormat : uint8_t
    {
        Uint16 = 0, // 16-bit indices
        Uint32 = 1  // 32-bit indices
    };

    struct BufferDesc
    {
        size_t size                = 0;
        uint32_t stride            = 0;
        EIndexFormat indexFormat   = EIndexFormat::Uint16;
        EBufferBindFlags bindFlags = EBufferBindFlags::None;
        EMemoryType memoryType     = EMemoryType::DeviceLocal;
        bool raw                   = false;
        const void* initialData    = nullptr;

        std::string debugName;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Texture + Sampler
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    enum class ETextureBindFlags : uint32_t
    {
        None            = 0,
        ShaderResource  = 1 << 0, // read-only sampling in shaders
        UnorderedAccess = 1 << 1, // read/write image access
        RenderTarget    = 1 << 2, // color attachment
        DepthStencil    = 1 << 3  // depth/stencil attachment
    };

    inline ETextureBindFlags operator|(ETextureBindFlags a, ETextureBindFlags b)
    {
        return static_cast<ETextureBindFlags>(
            static_cast<uint32_t>(a) | static_cast<uint32_t>(b));
    }

    inline ETextureBindFlags operator&(ETextureBindFlags a, ETextureBindFlags b)
    {
        return static_cast<ETextureBindFlags>(
            static_cast<uint32_t>(a) & static_cast<uint32_t>(b));
    }

    inline bool hasFlag(ETextureBindFlags value, ETextureBindFlags flag)
    {
        return (static_cast<uint32_t>(value) & static_cast<uint32_t>(flag)) != 0;
    }

    enum class ETextureFormat
    {
        RGBA8,
        BGRA8,
        RGBA16F,
        RGBA32F,

        R8,
        R16,
        R16F,
        R32F,
        R32U,
        R32I,

        RG8,
        RG16F,
        RG32F,

        R10G10B10A2,
        RG11B10F,

        D16,
        D24S8,
        D32F,
        D32FS8
    };

    enum class ETextureDimension
    {
        Tex2D,
        Tex3D,
        TexCube,
        Tex2DArray,
        TexCubeArray
    };

    struct TextureDesc
    {
        uint32_t width     = 1;
        uint32_t height    = 1;
        uint32_t depth     = 1; // for Tex3D
        uint32_t arraySize = 1; // for arrays and cube maps
        uint32_t mipLevels = 1;

        ETextureDimension dimension = ETextureDimension::Tex2D;
        ETextureFormat format       = ETextureFormat::RGBA8;
        ETextureBindFlags bindFlags = ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource;
        EMemoryType memoryType      = EMemoryType::DeviceLocal;

        uint32_t sampleCount     = 1; // MSAA
        const void* initialData  = nullptr;
        size_t initialRowPitch   = 0;
        size_t initialSlicePitch = 0;

        std::string debugName;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Sampler
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    enum class EFilterMode
    {
        Nearest,
        Linear
    };

    enum class EMipFilterMode
    {
        Nearest,
        Linear
    };

    enum class EAddressMode
    {
        Repeat,
        ClampToEdge,
        ClampToBorder,
        MirrorRepeat
    };

    enum class ECompareFunc
    {
        Never,
        Less,
        Equal,
        LessEqual,
        Greater,
        NotEqual,
        GreaterEqual,
        Always
    };

    struct SamplerDesc
    {
        // Filtering
        EFilterMode minFilter    = EFilterMode::Linear;
        EFilterMode magFilter    = EFilterMode::Linear;
        EMipFilterMode mipFilter = EMipFilterMode::Linear;

        // Addressing
        EAddressMode addressU = EAddressMode::Repeat;
        EAddressMode addressV = EAddressMode::Repeat;
        EAddressMode addressW = EAddressMode::Repeat;

        // Anisotropy
        bool enableAnisotropy  = false;
        uint32_t maxAnisotropy = 1; // 1 = disabled

        // Comparison sampling
        bool enableComparison    = false;
        ECompareFunc compareFunc = ECompareFunc::LessEqual;

        // LOD control
        float mipLodBias = 0.0f;
        float minLod     = 0.0f;
        float maxLod     = std::numeric_limits<float>::max();

        // Border color
        float borderColor[4] = { 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f };

        std::string debugName;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // View Descriptors
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    enum class EBufferFormat
    {
        Unknown, // use this for Structured and ByteAddress buffers

        // 8-bit
        R8,      // ambiguous legacy (usually UNorm) � optional to keep
        R8U,     // uint8
        R8I,     // int8
        R8UNorm, // normalized uint8

        // 16-bit
        R16,      // ambiguous legacy (usually UNorm)
        R16U,     // uint16
        R16I,     // int16
        R16UNorm, // normalized uint16
        R16F,     // float16

        // 32-bit
        R32F,
        R32U,
        R32I,

        // 2-channel
        RG8,
        RG16F,
        RG32F,

        // 4-channel
        RGBA8,
        RGBA16F,
        RGBA32F
    };

    enum class EBufferViewType
    {
        Structured, // StructuredBuffer<T>
        Raw,        // ByteAddressBuffer
        Typed       // Buffer<T> (typed buffer)
    };

    struct BufferViewDesc
    {
        EBufferFormat format;
        size_t offset            = 0;
        size_t size              = 0;
        EBufferViewType viewType = EBufferViewType::Structured;
        std::string debugName;
    };

    struct TextureViewDesc
    {
        ETextureFormat format;
        uint32_t baseMip    = 0;
        uint32_t mipCount   = 1;
        uint32_t baseLayer  = 0;
        uint32_t layerCount = 1;
        std::string debugName;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Shaders
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    enum class EShaderStage : uint32_t
    {
        None     = 0,
        Vertex   = 1 << 0,
        Hull     = 1 << 1,
        Domain   = 1 << 2,
        Geometry = 1 << 3,
        Fragment = 1 << 4,
        Compute  = 1 << 5
    };

    inline EShaderStage operator|(EShaderStage a, EShaderStage b)
    {
        return static_cast<EShaderStage>(
            static_cast<uint32_t>(a) | static_cast<uint32_t>(b));
    }

    inline EShaderStage operator&(EShaderStage a, EShaderStage b)
    {
        return static_cast<EShaderStage>(
            static_cast<uint32_t>(a) & static_cast<uint32_t>(b));
    }

    inline bool hasStage(EShaderStage stages, EShaderStage stage)
    {
        return (static_cast<uint32_t>(stages) & static_cast<uint32_t>(stage)) != 0;
    }

    struct ShaderDesc
    {
        std::string filePath;
        std::string entryPoint;
        EShaderStage stage;
        std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> defines;
        std::string debugName;
    };

    struct ShaderBinary
    {
        EShaderStage stage;
        std::vector<uint8_t> code;
        std::string debugName;
    };

    struct ShaderDialect
    {
        std::string language;    // shading language, e.g., "glsl" or "hlsl"
        std::string vertexExt;   // file extension of vertex shader source files
        std::string hullExt;     // file extension of hull shader source files
        std::string domainExt;   // file extension of domain shader source files
        std::string geometryExt; // file extension of geometry shader source files
        std::string fragmentExt; // file extension of fragment shader source files
        std::string computeExt;  // file extension of compute shader source files
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Vertex Layout
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    enum class EVertexFormat
    {
        Float32,
        Float32x2,
        Float32x3,
        Float32x4,
        Uint32,
        Uint32x2,
        Uint32x3,
        Uint32x4
    };

    struct VertexAttributeDesc
    {
        uint32_t location    = 0;
        uint32_t bufferSlot  = 0;
        uint32_t offset      = 0;
        uint32_t stride      = 0;
        EVertexFormat format = EVertexFormat::Float32x3;
    };

    struct VertexLayoutDesc
    {
        std::vector<VertexAttributeDesc> attributes;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Pipeline States
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    enum class ECullMode
    {
        None,
        Front,
        Back
    };

    struct RasterState
    {
        ECullMode cullMode      = ECullMode::Back;
        bool wireframe          = false;
        bool depthClipEnable    = true;
        bool conservativeRaster = false;
    };

    struct DepthState
    {
        bool depthTest       = true;
        bool depthWrite      = true;
        ECompareFunc depthFunc = ECompareFunc ::LessEqual;
    };

    enum class EStencilOp
    {
        Keep,     // keep existing stencil value
        Zero,     // write 0
        Replace,  // write reference value
        IncrSat,  // increment, clamp to max
        DecrSat,  // decrement, clamp to 0
        Invert,   // bitwise invert
        IncrWrap, // increment, wrap on overflow
        DecrWrap  // decrement, wrap on underflow
    };

    struct StencilOpDesc
    {
        EStencilOp failOp;
        EStencilOp depthFailOp;
        EStencilOp passOp;
        ECompareFunc func;
    };

    struct StencilState
    {
        bool enable       = false;
        uint8_t readMask  = 0xFF;
        uint8_t writeMask = 0xFF;
        uint8_t reference = 0;

        StencilOpDesc front;
        StencilOpDesc back;
    };

    enum class EBlendFactor
    {
        Zero,
        One,
        SrcColor,
        OneMinusSrcColor,
        DstColor,
        OneMinusDstColor,
        SrcAlpha,
        OneMinusSrcAlpha,
        DstAlpha,
        OneMinusDstAlpha,
    };

    enum class EBlendOp
    {
        Add,
        Subtract,
        ReverseSubtract,
        Min,
        Max
    };

    struct RenderTargetBlend
    {
        bool enable = false;

        EBlendFactor srcColor = EBlendFactor::SrcAlpha;
        EBlendFactor dstColor = EBlendFactor::OneMinusSrcAlpha;
        EBlendOp colorOp      = EBlendOp::Add;

        EBlendFactor srcAlpha = EBlendFactor::One;
        EBlendFactor dstAlpha = EBlendFactor::Zero;
        EBlendOp alphaOp      = EBlendOp::Add;

        uint8_t writeMask = 0xF; // RGBA
    };

    struct BlendState
    {
        // Up to 8 render targets (D3D11 limit)
        std::array<RenderTargetBlend, 8> targets;

        // How many render targets are actually used
        uint32_t targetCount = 1;
    };

    struct MultisampleState
    {
        bool multisampleEnable = false;
        bool alphaToCoverage   = false;
        bool sampleShading     = false;
        float minSampleShading = 1.0f;
    };

    struct RenderPipelineDesc
    {
        ShaderBinary vertexShader;
        ShaderBinary hullShader;
        ShaderBinary domainShader;
        ShaderBinary geometryShader;
        ShaderBinary fragmentShader;

        VertexLayoutDesc vertexLayout;

        RasterState raster;
        DepthState depth;
        StencilState stencil;
        BlendState blend;
        MultisampleState multisample;

        std::string debugName;
    };

    struct ComputePipelineDesc
    {
        ShaderBinary computeShader;

        std::string debugName;
    };

    enum class ECommandListType
    {
        Primary,
        Secondary
    };

    /**
     * @brief Enumeration of primitive topologies.
     */
    enum class EPrimitiveTopology
    {
        /**
         * @brief Undefined initial state.
         */
        Undefined,
        /**
         * @brief List of points.
         */
        PointList,
        /**
         * @brief List of line segments.
         */
        LineList,
        /**
         * @brief Strip of line segments. Use -1 in the index buffer to indicate the start of a new strip.
         */
        LineStrip,
        /**
         * @brief List of triangles.
         */
        TriangleList,
        /**
         * @brief Strip of triangles. Use -1 in the index buffer to indicate the start of a new strip.
         */
        TriangleStrip,
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Commands
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    struct CmdBeginRenderPass
    {
        IGpuRenderTargetView* renderTarget = nullptr;
        IGpuDepthStencilView* depthTarget  = nullptr;
    };

    struct CmdEndRenderPass
    {
    };

    struct CmdClearRenderTargetView
    {
        IGpuRenderTargetView* target;
        float color[4];
    };

    struct CmdClearDepthStencilView
    {
        IGpuDepthStencilView* target;
        float depth;
        uint8_t stencil;
    };

    struct CmdClearUnorderedAccessView
    {
        IGpuUnorderedAccessView* target;
        uint32_t pattern;
    };

    struct CmdSetRenderPipeline
    {
        IRenderPipeline* pipeline = nullptr;
    };

    struct CmdSetComputePipeline
    {
        IComputePipeline* pipeline = nullptr;
    };

    struct CmdSetVertexBuffer
    {
        uint32_t slot      = 0;
        IGpuBuffer* buffer = nullptr;
    };

    struct CmdSetIndexBuffer
    {
        IGpuBuffer* buffer = nullptr;
    };

    struct CmdSetViewport
    {
        float x;
        float y;
        float width;
        float height;
        float minDepth;
        float maxDepth;
    };

    struct CmdSetScissorRect
    {
        int32_t x;
        int32_t y;
        uint32_t width;
        uint32_t height;
    };

    struct CmdSetStencilRef
    {
        uint32_t ref;
    };

    struct CmdSetBlendFactor
    {
        float factor[4];
    };

    struct CmdSetSampleMask
    {
        uint32_t mask;
    };

    struct CmdSetPrimitiveTopology
    {
        EPrimitiveTopology topology;
    };

    struct CmdBindUniformBuffer
    {
        EShaderStage stages;
        uint32_t slot;
        IGpuBuffer* buffer;
    };

    struct CmdBindShaderResourceView
    {
        EShaderStage stages;
        uint32_t slot;
        IGpuShaderResourceView* view;
    };

    struct CmdBindUnorderedAccessView
    {
        EShaderStage stages;
        uint32_t slot;
        IGpuUnorderedAccessView* view;
    };

    struct CmdBindSampler
    {
        EShaderStage stages;
        uint32_t slot;
        IGpuSampler* sampler;
    };

    struct CmdResolveTexture
    {
        IGpuTexture* src;
        IGpuTexture* dst;
    };

    struct CmdUpdateBuffer
    {
        IGpuBuffer* buffer = nullptr;
        size_t offset      = 0;
        size_t size        = 0;
        const void* data   = nullptr;
    };

    struct CmdUpdateTexture1d
    {
        IGpuTexture* texture;
        const void* data;
        size_t rowPitch;
        uint32_t mipLevel;
    };

    struct CmdUpdateTexture2d
    {
        IGpuTexture* texture;
        const void* data;
        size_t rowPitch;
        uint32_t mipLevel;
    };

    struct CmdUpdateTexture3d
    {
        IGpuTexture* texture;
        const void* data;
        size_t rowPitch;
        size_t slicePitch;
        uint32_t mipLevel;
    };

    struct CmdDraw
    {
        uint32_t vertexCount;
        uint32_t firstVertex;
    };

    struct CmdDrawIndexed
    {
        uint32_t indexCount;
        uint32_t firstIndex;
        int32_t vertexOffset;
    };

    struct CmdDispatch
    {
        uint32_t groupX;
        uint32_t groupY;
        uint32_t groupZ;
    };

    struct CmdExecuteCommands
    {
        std::vector<ICommandList*> lists;
    };

    using Command = std::variant<
        CmdBeginRenderPass,
        CmdEndRenderPass,

        CmdClearRenderTargetView,
        CmdClearDepthStencilView,
        CmdClearUnorderedAccessView,

        CmdSetRenderPipeline,
        CmdSetComputePipeline,

        CmdSetVertexBuffer,
        CmdSetIndexBuffer,

        CmdSetViewport,
        CmdSetScissorRect,
        CmdSetStencilRef,
        CmdSetBlendFactor,
        CmdSetSampleMask,
        CmdSetPrimitiveTopology,

        CmdBindUniformBuffer,

        CmdBindShaderResourceView,
        CmdBindUnorderedAccessView,

        CmdBindSampler,

        CmdResolveTexture,

        CmdUpdateBuffer,
        CmdUpdateTexture1d,
        CmdUpdateTexture2d,
        CmdUpdateTexture3d,

        CmdDraw,
        CmdDrawIndexed,
        CmdDispatch,

        CmdExecuteCommands>;

} // namespace vislab
```

### vislab/image/include/vislab/image/bmp_reader.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "image.hpp"

#include <vislab/core/algorithm.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/path_parameter.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Bitmap reader for RGB images.
     */
    class BmpReader : public ConcreteAlgorithm<BmpReader>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         * @param path Path to read from.
         */
        BmpReader(const std::string& path = "")
            : paramPath(PathParameter::EFile::In, "Bitmap (*.bmp)")
        {
            paramPath.setValue(path);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Constructor.
         * @param outImage Image to write to.
         * @param path Path to read from.
         */
        BmpReader(const std::shared_ptr<Image3d>& outImage, const std::string& path = "")
            : BmpReader(path)
        {
            outputImage.setData(outImage);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Image data that was read from file.
         */
        OutputPort<Image3d> outputImage;

        /**
         * @brief Path to read from.
         */
        PathParameter paramPath;

    protected:
        /**
         * @brief Internal computation function
         * @param progress Optional progress info.
         * @return Information about the completion of the computation, including a potential error message.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] UpdateInfo internalUpdate(ProgressInfo& progress) override;
    };
}
```
