### vislab/image/include/vislab/image/image.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "raw_image.hpp"
#include <vislab/core/array.hpp>

#include "image_fwd.hpp"

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Strongly typed 2D image with data structures aligning well to graphics APIs.
     *
     * TypedImage is a typed convenience layer around RawImage. It provides
     * strongly typed Value access using Eigen vector types (e.g., Eigen::Vector3f).
     *
     * The underlying RawImage stores Values in a RawArray whose element type
     * matches TElement. TypedImage binds an Array<TElement> wrapper to that
     * RawArray for convenient typed access.
     *
     * @tparam TElement Eigen::Vector type of the Value (e.g., Eigen::Vector3f).
     */
    template <typename TElement>
        requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> &&
                 (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
    class TypedImage
        : public Concrete<TypedImage<TElement>, Data>
    {
    public:
        using Element                 = TElement;
        using Scalar                  = typename TElement::Scalar;
        static constexpr int Channels = TElement::SizeAtCompileTime;

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Constructors
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        TypedImage()
            : mImage(std::make_shared<RawImage>())
        {
            allocateTypedStorage();
        }

        explicit TypedImage(const Eigen::Vector2i& resolution)
            : mImage(std::make_shared<RawImage>(
                  resolution,
                  Channels,
                  detail::EigenFormatTraits<TElement>::format))
        {
            allocateTypedStorage();
        }

        TypedImage(int width, int height)
            : mImage(std::make_shared<RawImage>(
                  Eigen::Vector2i(width, height),
                  Channels,
                  detail::EigenFormatTraits<TElement>::format))
        {
            allocateTypedStorage();
        }


        explicit TypedImage(std::shared_ptr<RawImage> image)
            : mImage(std::move(image))
        {
            assert(mImage != nullptr);
            assert(mImage->getNumChannels() == Channels);
            assert(mImage->getValues().isValueType<TElement>());

            mValues.setRaw(mImage->getValuesShared());
        }

        TypedImage(const TypedImage& other)
            : mImage(other.mImage->clone())
        {
            mValues.setRaw(mImage->getValuesShared());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the image resolution.
         *
         * Resizes the underlying pixel buffer to width * height elements.
         */
        void setResolution(const Eigen::Vector2i& resolution)
        {
            mImage->setResolution(resolution);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the image resolution.
         */
        void setResolution(int width, int height)
        {
            mImage->setResolution(Eigen::Vector2i(width, height));
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Raw access (mirrors TypedMesh)
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        [[nodiscard]] RawImage& getRaw() { return *mImage; }
        [[nodiscard]] const RawImage& getRaw() const { return *mImage; }

        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<RawImage> getRawShared() { return mImage; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<const RawImage> getRawShared() const { return mImage; }

        void setRaw(std::shared_ptr<RawImage> image)
        {
            assert(image != nullptr);
            assert(image->getNumChannels() == Channels);
            assert(image->getValues().isValueType<TElement>());

            mImage = std::move(image);
            mValues.setRaw(mImage->getValuesShared());
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Basic properties
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        [[nodiscard]] const Eigen::Vector2i& getResolution() const
        {
            return mImage->getResolution();
        }

        [[nodiscard]] Eigen::Index getNumPixels() const
        {
            return mImage->getNumPixels();
        }

        [[nodiscard]] bool isValid() const override
        {
            if (!mImage || !mImage->isValid())
                return false;
            if (!mValues.isValid())
                return false;
            return true;
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Value access
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        [[nodiscard]] const Element& getValue(size_t linearIndex) const
        {
            return mValues.getValue(linearIndex);
        }

        [[nodiscard]] Element& getValue(size_t linearIndex)
        {
            return mValues.getValue(linearIndex);
        }

        [[nodiscard]] const Element& getValue(size_t ix, size_t iy) const
        {
            const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(iy * getResolution().x() + ix);
            return mValues.getValue(idx);
        }

        [[nodiscard]] Element& getValue(size_t ix, size_t iy)
        {
            const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(iy * getResolution().x() + ix);
            return mValues.getValue(idx);
        }

        [[nodiscard]] const Element& getValue(const Eigen::Vector2i& ValueCoord) const
        {
            const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(ValueCoord.y() * getResolution().x() + ValueCoord.x());
            return mValues.getValue(idx);
        }

        [[nodiscard]] Element& getValue(const Eigen::Vector2i& ValueCoord)
        {
            const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(ValueCoord.y() * getResolution().x() + ValueCoord.x());
            return mValues.getValue(idx);
        }

        void setValue(size_t linearIndex, const Element& value)
        {
            mValues.setValue(linearIndex, value);
        }

        void setValue(size_t ix, size_t iy, const Element& value)
        {
            mValues.setValue(static_cast<size_t>(iy * getResolution().x() + ix), value);
        }

        void setValue(const Eigen::Vector2i& ValueCoord, const Element& value)
        {
            mValues.setValue(static_cast<size_t>(ValueCoord.y() * getResolution().x() + ValueCoord.x()), value);
        }

        void setZero()
        {
            mValues.setZero();
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Equality
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        [[nodiscard]] bool isEqual(const TypedImage& other) const
        {
            return mImage->isEqual(*other.mImage);
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Compatibility and casting (mirrors TypedMesh)
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        /**
         * @brief Checks if a RawImage is compatible with this TypedImage type.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] static bool isCompatible(const RawImage& raw)
        {
            return raw.getNumChannels() == Channels &&
                   raw.getValues().isValueType<TElement>();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Casts from another TypedImage type.
         */
        template <typename TOtherImage>
        static std::shared_ptr<TypedImage> cast(std::shared_ptr<TOtherImage> other)
        {
            if constexpr (std::is_same_v<TypedImage, TOtherImage>)
                return other;
            else
                return cast(other->getRawShared());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Casts from another TypedImage type.
         */
        template <typename TOtherImage>
        static std::shared_ptr<TypedImage> cast(TOtherImage& other)
        {
            return cast(other.getRawShared());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Casts from a RawImage.
         *
         * If compatible, shares the underlying RawImage.
         * If incompatible, converts Value-by-Value.
         */
        static std::shared_ptr<TypedImage> cast(std::shared_ptr<RawImage> raw)
        {
            if (TypedImage::isCompatible(*raw))
            {
                return std::make_shared<TypedImage>(raw);
            }
            else
            {
                auto img = std::make_shared<TypedImage>(raw->getResolution());

                for (Eigen::Index i = 0; i < raw->getNumPixels(); ++i)
                {
                    auto p = raw->getValueAs<TElement>(static_cast<size_t>(i));
                    img->setValue(static_cast<size_t>(i), p);
                }

                return img;
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Casts this image into another TypedImage type.
         */
        template <typename TOtherImage>
        std::shared_ptr<TOtherImage> cast()
        {
            return TOtherImage::cast(*this);
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Serialization
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        void serialize(IArchive& archive) override
        {
            archive("Image", mImage);
            mValues.setRaw(mImage->getValuesShared());
        }

    private:
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Internal helpers
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        void allocateTypedStorage()
        {
            assert(mImage != nullptr);

            // allocate<TElement>() is a templated member of RawArray
            mImage->getValues().template allocate<TElement>(mImage->getNumPixels());
            mImage->setNumChannels(TElement::RowsAtCompileTime);
            mValues.setRaw(mImage->getValuesShared());
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Members
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        std::shared_ptr<RawImage> mImage;
        Array<TElement> mValues;
    };
}
```

### vislab/image/include/vislab/image/image_fwd.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <vislab/core/types.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/traits.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Strongly typed 2D image.
     *
     * TypedImage is a typed view onto a RawImage, where the pixel type is an
     * Eigen vector (e.g., Eigen::Vector3f). The number of channels is given
     * by the compile-time size of TElement.
     *
     * @tparam TElement Eigen::Vector type of the pixel.
     */
    template <typename TElement>
        requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement> &&
                 (TElement::RowsAtCompileTime > 0 && TElement::ColsAtCompileTime > 0)
    class TypedImage;

    /**
     * @brief Two-dimensional image storing one float value per pixel.
     *
     * Each pixel is stored as Eigen::Vector1f.
     */
    using Image1f = TypedImage<Eigen::Vector1f>;

    /**
     * @brief Two-dimensional image storing two float values per pixel.
     *
     * Each pixel is stored as Eigen::Vector2f.
     */
    using Image2f = TypedImage<Eigen::Vector2f>;

    /**
     * @brief Two-dimensional image storing three float values per pixel.
     *
     * Each pixel is stored as Eigen::Vector3f.
     */
    using Image3f = TypedImage<Eigen::Vector3f>;

    /**
     * @brief Two-dimensional image storing four float values per pixel.
     *
     * Each pixel is stored as Eigen::Vector4f.
     */
    using Image4f = TypedImage<Eigen::Vector4f>;

    /**
     * @brief Two-dimensional image storing one double value per pixel.
     *
     * Each pixel is stored as Eigen::Vector1d.
     */
    using Image1d = TypedImage<Eigen::Vector1d>;

    /**
     * @brief Two-dimensional image storing two double values per pixel.
     *
     * Each pixel is stored as Eigen::Vector2d.
     */
    using Image2d = TypedImage<Eigen::Vector2d>;

    /**
     * @brief Two-dimensional image storing three double values per pixel.
     *
     * Each pixel is stored as Eigen::Vector3d.
     */
    using Image3d = TypedImage<Eigen::Vector3d>;

    /**
     * @brief Two-dimensional image storing four double values per pixel.
     *
     * Each pixel is stored as Eigen::Vector4d.
     */
    using Image4d = TypedImage<Eigen::Vector4d>;
}

### vislab/image/include/vislab/image/raw_image.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <vislab/core/array.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/iarchive.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/types.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Generic 2D image with data structures aligning well to graphics APIs.
     *
     * RawImage owns the raw pixel buffer as a RawArray. Each pixel is stored as an
     * Eigen vector element (e.g., Eigen::Vector1f, Eigen::Vector3f), consistent
     * with the Array / Image / Mesh design in vislab.
     *
     * RawImage is the untyped, low-level storage layer. TypedImage<T,Channels>
     * provides the strongly typed interface on top of this class.
     */
    class RawImage : public Concrete<RawImage, Data>
    {
    public:
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Constructors
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        /**
         * @brief Empty constructor.
         *
         * Creates an image with zero resolution and zero channels.
         */
        RawImage()
            : mResolution(0, 0)
            , mChannels(0)
            , mValues(std::make_shared<RawArray>())
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Constructor with resolution and channel count.
         * @param resolution Image resolution.
         * @param channels Number of channels per pixel.
         * @param format Internal scalar format.
         */
        RawImage(const Eigen::Vector2i& resolution, int channels, EFormat format)
            : mResolution(resolution)
            , mChannels(channels)
            , mValues(std::make_shared<RawArray>())
        {
            mValues->setFormat(format, false);
            resizeStorage();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Constructor with resolution and channel count.
         * @param width Image width.
         * @param height Image height.
         * @param channels Number of channels per pixel.
         * @param format Internal scalar format.
         */
        RawImage(int width, int height, int channels, EFormat format)
            : mResolution(width, height)
            , mChannels(channels)
            , mValues(std::make_shared<RawArray>())
        {
            mValues->setFormat(format, false);
            resizeStorage();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Copy constructor.
         */
        RawImage(const RawImage& other)
            : mResolution(other.mResolution)
            , mChannels(other.mChannels)
            , mValues(other.mValues->clone())
        {
        }

        /**
         * @brief Move constructor.
         */
        RawImage(RawImage&& other) noexcept
            : mResolution(std::move(other.mResolution))
            , mChannels(std::move(other.mChannels))
            , mValues(std::move(other.mValues))
        {
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Assignment operators
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        /**
         * @brief Copy assignment.
         */
        RawImage& operator=(const RawImage& other)
        {
            if (this != &other)
            {
                mResolution = other.mResolution;
                mChannels   = other.mChannels;
                *mValues    = *other.mValues;
            }
            return *this;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Move assignment.
         */
        RawImage& operator=(RawImage&& other) noexcept
        {
            if (this != &other)
            {
                mResolution = std::move(other.mResolution);
                mChannels   = std::move(other.mChannels);
                mValues     = std::move(other.mValues);
            }
            return *this;
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Basic properties
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        /**
         * @brief Gets the image resolution.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const Eigen::Vector2i& getResolution() const { return mResolution; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the number of channels per pixel.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] int getNumChannels() const { return mChannels; }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the image resolution.
         *
         * Resizes the underlying pixel buffer to width * height elements.
         */
        void setResolution(const Eigen::Vector2i& resolution)
        {
            mResolution = resolution;
            resizeStorage();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the image resolution.
         */
        void setResolution(int width, int height)
        {
            setResolution(Eigen::Vector2i(width, height));
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the number of channels per pixel.
         *
         * Does not change the underlying RawArray element type; only resizes storage.
         */
        void setNumChannels(int channels)
        {
            mChannels = channels;
            resizeStorage();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the total number of pixels.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Eigen::Index getNumPixels() const
        {
            return static_cast<Eigen::Index>(mResolution.x()) *
                   static_cast<Eigen::Index>(mResolution.y());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Returns generally true.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool isValid() const
        {
            return true;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Compares two RawImages for equality (resolution, channels, pixel data).
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool isEqual(const RawImage& other) const
        {
            if (mResolution != other.mResolution)
                return false;
            if (mChannels != other.mChannels)
                return false;
            return mValues->isEqual(*other.mValues);
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Value access
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        [[nodiscard]] RawArray& getValues() { return *mValues; }
        [[nodiscard]] const RawArray& getValues() const { return *mValues; }

        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<RawArray> getValuesShared() { return mValues; }
        [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<const RawArray> getValuesShared() const { return mValues; }

        void setValues(const RawArray& pixels)
        {
            *mValues = pixels;
        }

        void setValuesShared(const std::shared_ptr<RawArray>& pixels)
        {
            assert(pixels != nullptr);
            mValues = pixels;
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the pixel at a linear index.
         * @tparam TElement Eigen vector type matching the underlying pixel format.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement>
        [[nodiscard]] const TElement& getValue(size_t linearIndex) const
        {
            return mValues->getValue<TElement>(linearIndex);
        }

        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement>
        [[nodiscard]] TElement& getValue(size_t linearIndex)
        {
            return mValues->getValue<TElement>(linearIndex);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the pixel at (ix, iy).
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement>
        [[nodiscard]] const TElement& getValue(size_t ix, size_t iy) const
        {
            const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(iy * mResolution.x() + ix);
            return mValues->getValue<TElement>(idx);
        }

        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement>
        [[nodiscard]] TElement& getValue(size_t ix, size_t iy)
        {
            const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(iy * mResolution.x() + ix);
            return mValues->getValue<TElement>(idx);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the pixel at pixelCoord = (x, y).
         */
        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement>
        [[nodiscard]] const TElement& getValue(const Eigen::Vector2i& pixelCoord) const
        {
            const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(pixelCoord.y() * mResolution.x() + pixelCoord.x());
            return mValues->getValue<TElement>(idx);
        }

        template <typename TElement>
            requires detail::is_eigen_matrix_v<TElement>
        [[nodiscard]] TElement& getValue(const Eigen::Vector2i& pixelCoord)
        {
            const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(pixelCoord.y() * mResolution.x() + pixelCoord.x());
            return mValues->getValue<TElement>(idx);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the pixel converted to TElement.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
        [[nodiscard]] TElement getValueAs(size_t linearIndex) const
        {
            return mValues->getValueAs<TElement>(linearIndex);
        }

        template <typename TElement>
        [[nodiscard]] TElement getValueAs(size_t ix, size_t iy) const
        {
            return mValues->getValueAs<TElement>(static_cast<size_t>(iy * mResolution.x() + ix));
        }

        template <typename TElement>
        [[nodiscard]] TElement getValueAs(const Eigen::Vector2i& pixelCoord) const
        {
            return mValues->getValueAs<TElement>(static_cast<size_t>(pixelCoord.y() * mResolution.x() + pixelCoord.x()));
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets the pixel value.
         */
        template <typename TElement>
        void setValue(size_t linearIndex, const TElement& value)
        {
            mValues->setValue(linearIndex, value);
        }

        template <typename TElement>
        void setValue(size_t ix, size_t iy, const TElement& value)
        {
            mValues->setValue(static_cast<size_t>(iy * mResolution.x() + ix), value);
        }

        template <typename TElement>
        void setValue(const Eigen::Vector2i& pixelCoord, const TElement& value)
        {
            mValues->setValue(static_cast<size_t>(pixelCoord.y() * mResolution.x() + pixelCoord.x()), value);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Sets all pixel values to zero.
         */
        void setZero()
        {
            if (mValues)
                mValues->setZero();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the row pitch.
         * @return resolution.x() * elementSizeInBytes()
         */
        [[nodiscard]] size_t getRowPitch() const
        {
            return static_cast<size_t>(mResolution.x()) *
                   mValues->getElementSizeInBytes();
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Serialization
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        void serialize(IArchive& archive) override
        {
            archive("Resolution", mResolution);
            archive("Channels", mChannels);
            archive("Values", mValues);
        }

    private:
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Internal helpers
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        /**
         * @brief Resizes the underlying pixel storage to match resolution.
         *
         * The number of elements in the RawArray equals the number of pixels.
         * The element type (e.g., Eigen::Vector3f) is determined by the user
         * of RawImage via RawArray's element type.
         */
        void resizeStorage()
        {
            if (!mValues)
                mValues = std::make_shared<RawArray>();

            const Eigen::Index numValues = getNumPixels();
            if (numValues > 0)
                mValues->setSize(static_cast<size_t>(numValues));
            else
                mValues->setSize(0);
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Members
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        Eigen::Vector2i mResolution;
        int mChannels;
        std::shared_ptr<RawArray> mValues;
    };
}
```

### vislab/opengl/include/vislab/opengl/gl_buffer.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <GL/glew.h>

#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    class GlBuffer : public Reflectable<GlBuffer, IGpuBuffer>
    {
    public:
        GlBuffer(GLuint buffer, const BufferDesc& desc)
            : mBuffer(buffer)
            , mDesc(desc)
        {
        }

        ~GlBuffer()
        {
            if (mBuffer != 0)
                glDeleteBuffers(1, &mBuffer);
        }

        void* getNativeHandle() override
        {
            return reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(mBuffer));
        }

        GLuint getBuffer() const { return mBuffer; }
        const BufferDesc& getDesc() const { return mDesc; }

    private:
        GLuint mBuffer = 0;
        BufferDesc mDesc;
    };
}

### vislab/opengl/include/vislab/opengl/gl_command_list.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <GL/glew.h>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    class GlDevice;
    class GlTexture;
    class GlRenderPipeline;
    class GlComputePipeline;
    class GlBuffer;
    class GlSampler;
    class GlShaderResourceView;
    class GlUnorderedAccessView;
    class GlRenderTargetView;
    class GlDepthStencilView;

    class GlCommandList : public Reflectable<GlCommandList, ICommandList>
    {
    public:
        GlCommandList(GlDevice* device,
                      ECommandListType commandListType)
            : mDevice(device)
            , mCommandListType(commandListType)
        {
        }

        void begin() override
        {
            mCommands.clear();
        }

        void end() override
        {
        }

        // Recording methods just push Command variants:

        void beginRenderPass(IGpuRenderTargetView* renderTarget,
                             IGpuDepthStencilView* depthTarget = nullptr) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdBeginRenderPass{ renderTarget, depthTarget });
        }

        void endRenderPass() override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdEndRenderPass{});
        }

        void clearRenderTarget(IGpuRenderTargetView* target, const float color[4]) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdClearRenderTargetView{ target, { color[0], color[1], color[2], color[3] } });
        }

        void clearDepthStencil(IGpuDepthStencilView* target, float depth, uint8_t stencil) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdClearDepthStencilView{ target, depth, stencil });
        }

        void clearUnorderedAccess(IGpuUnorderedAccessView* target, uint32_t pattern) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdClearUnorderedAccessView{ target, pattern });
        }

        void setRenderPipeline(IRenderPipeline* pipeline) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetRenderPipeline{ pipeline });
        }

        void setComputePipeline(IComputePipeline* pipeline) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetComputePipeline{ pipeline });
        }

        void setVertexBuffer(uint32_t slot, IGpuBuffer* buffer) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetVertexBuffer{ slot, buffer });
        }

        void setIndexBuffer(IGpuBuffer* buffer) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetIndexBuffer{ buffer });
        }

        void setViewport(float x, float y, float width, float height,
                         float minDepth, float maxDepth) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetViewport{ x, y, width, height, minDepth, maxDepth });
        }

        void setScissorRect(int32_t x, int32_t y,
                            uint32_t width, uint32_t height) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetScissorRect{ x, y, width, height });
        }

        void setStencilRef(uint32_t ref) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetStencilRef{ ref });
        }

        void setBlendFactor(const float factor[4]) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetBlendFactor{ { factor[0], factor[1], factor[2], factor[3] } });
        }

        void setSampleMask(uint32_t mask) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetSampleMask{ mask });
        }

        void setPrimitiveTopology(EPrimitiveTopology topology) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdSetPrimitiveTopology{ topology });
        }

        void bindUniformBuffer(EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot, IGpuBuffer* buffer) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdBindUniformBuffer{ stages, slot, buffer });
        }

        void bindShaderResourceView(EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot, IGpuShaderResourceView* view) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdBindShaderResourceView{ stages, slot, view });
        }

        void bindUnorderedAccessView(EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot, IGpuUnorderedAccessView* view) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdBindUnorderedAccessView{ stages, slot, view });
        }

        void bindSampler(EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot, IGpuSampler* sampler) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdBindSampler{ stages, slot, sampler });
        }

        void resolveTexture(IGpuTexture* src, IGpuTexture* dst) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdResolveTexture{ src, dst });
        }

        void updateBuffer(IGpuBuffer* buffer, const void* data,
                          size_t size, size_t offset = 0) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdUpdateBuffer{ buffer, offset, size, data });
        }

        void updateTexture1d(IGpuTexture* texture, const void* data,
                             size_t rowPitch, uint32_t mipLevel = 0) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdUpdateTexture1d{ texture, data, rowPitch, mipLevel });
        }

        void updateTexture2d(IGpuTexture* texture, const void* data,
                             size_t rowPitch, uint32_t mipLevel = 0) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdUpdateTexture2d{ texture, data, rowPitch, mipLevel });
        }

        void updateTexture3d(IGpuTexture* texture, const void* data,
                             size_t rowPitch, size_t slicePitch,
                             uint32_t mipLevel = 0) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdUpdateTexture3d{ texture, data, rowPitch, slicePitch, mipLevel });
        }

        void draw(uint32_t vertexCount, uint32_t firstVertex = 0) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdDraw{ vertexCount, firstVertex });
        }

        void drawIndexed(uint32_t indexCount, uint32_t firstIndex = 0,
                         int32_t vertexOffset = 0) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdDrawIndexed{ indexCount, firstIndex, vertexOffset });
        }

        void dispatch(uint32_t groupX, uint32_t groupY, uint32_t groupZ) override
        {
            mCommands.emplace_back(CmdDispatch{ groupX, groupY, groupZ });
        }

        void executeCommands(std::span<ICommandList* const> lists) override;

        ECommandListType getCommandListType() const override
        {
            return mCommandListType;
        }

        // For primary command lists only.
        void replay() override;

    private:
        void replayInto();

        // replay overloads:
        void replayOn(const CmdBeginRenderPass& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdEndRenderPass& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdClearRenderTargetView& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdClearDepthStencilView& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdClearUnorderedAccessView& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdSetRenderPipeline& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdSetComputePipeline& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdSetVertexBuffer& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdSetIndexBuffer& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdSetViewport& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdSetScissorRect& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdSetStencilRef& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdSetBlendFactor& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdSetSampleMask& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdSetPrimitiveTopology& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdBindUniformBuffer& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdBindShaderResourceView& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdBindUnorderedAccessView& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdBindSampler& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdResolveTexture& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdUpdateBuffer& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdUpdateTexture1d& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdUpdateTexture2d& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdUpdateTexture3d& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdDraw& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdDrawIndexed& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdDispatch& c);
        void replayOn(const CmdExecuteCommands& c);

    private:
        void applyGraphicsState(bool indexed);

        GlDevice* mDevice = nullptr;
        std::vector<Command> mCommands;
        ECommandListType mCommandListType;

        struct GlVertexBinding
        {
            GLuint buffer   = 0;
            GLintptr offset = 0;
            GLsizei stride  = 0;
        };

        GlRenderPipeline* mCurrentPipeline = nullptr;
        GlVertexBinding mVertexBindings[8]{};
        GLuint mCurrentIndexBuffer       = 0;
        GLenum mCurrentPrimitiveTopology = GL_POINTS;
        GLenum mCurrentIndexType         = GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT;

        uint32_t mCurrentStencilRef  = 0;
        float mCurrentBlendFactor[4] = { 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f };
        uint32_t mCurrentSampleMask  = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    };

} // namespace vislab

### vislab/opengl/include/vislab/opengl/gl_depth_stencil_view.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <GL/glew.h>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    class GlDepthStencilView : public Reflectable<GlDepthStencilView, IGpuDepthStencilView>
    {
    public:
        GlDepthStencilView(GLuint texture,
                           GLenum target,
                           const TextureDesc& desc,
                           const TextureViewDesc& view)
            : mTexture(texture)
            , mTarget(target)
            , mDesc(desc)
            , mView(view)
        {
            glGenFramebuffers(1, &mFbo);
            glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, mFbo);

            GLenum attachment = 0;
            switch (mDesc.format)
            {
            case ETextureFormat::D16:
            case ETextureFormat::D32F:
                attachment = GL_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT;
                break;

            case ETextureFormat::D24S8:
            case ETextureFormat::D32FS8:
                attachment = GL_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT;
                break;

            default:
                attachment = GL_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT; // or assert
                break;
            }

            attach(attachment);

            GLenum none = GL_NONE;
            glDrawBuffer(none);
            glReadBuffer(none);

            assert(glCheckFramebufferStatus(GL_FRAMEBUFFER) == GL_FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE);
            glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);
        }

        ~GlDepthStencilView()
        {
            if (mFbo)
                glDeleteFramebuffers(1, &mFbo);
        }

        GLuint getFramebuffer() const { return mFbo; }
        GLuint getTexture() const { return mTexture; }
        GLenum getTarget() const { return mTarget; }

        const TextureDesc& getDesc() const { return mDesc; }
        const TextureViewDesc& getViewDesc() const { return mView; }

        void* getNativeHandle() override
        {
            return reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(mFbo));
        }

    private:
        void attach(GLenum attachment)
        {
            if (mTarget == GL_TEXTURE_2D || mTarget == GL_TEXTURE_2D_MULTISAMPLE)
            {
                glFramebufferTexture2D(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, attachment, mTarget,
                                       mTexture, mView.baseMip);
            }
            else
            {
                glFramebufferTextureLayer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, attachment,
                                          mTexture, mView.baseMip, mView.baseLayer);
            }
        }

        GLuint mTexture = 0;
        GLenum mTarget  = GL_TEXTURE_2D;
        GLuint mFbo     = 0;

        TextureDesc mDesc;
        TextureViewDesc mView;
    };
}
```

### vislab/opengl/include/vislab/opengl/gl_pipeline.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <GL/glew.h>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    struct GlRasterState
    {
        GLboolean cullEnable = GL_FALSE;
        GLenum cullFace      = GL_BACK;
        GLenum polygonMode   = GL_FILL;

        // depthClipEnable = true  -> depth clamp disabled
        // depthClipEnable = false -> depth clamp enabled
        GLboolean depthClampEnable = GL_FALSE;
    };

    struct GlDepthState
    {
        GLboolean depthTest  = GL_FALSE;
        GLboolean depthWrite = GL_TRUE;
        GLenum depthFunc     = GL_LEQUAL;
    };

    struct GlStencilOpDesc
    {
        GLenum failOp;
        GLenum depthFailOp;
        GLenum passOp;
        GLenum func;
    };

    struct GlStencilState
    {
        GLboolean enable = GL_FALSE;

        GLuint readMask  = 0xFF;
        GLuint writeMask = 0xFF;
        GLuint reference = 0;

        GlStencilOpDesc front;
        GlStencilOpDesc back;
    };

    struct GlBlendTargetState
    {
        GLboolean enable       = GL_FALSE;
        GLboolean colorMask[4] = { GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE, GL_TRUE };

        GLenum srcColor = GL_ONE;
        GLenum dstColor = GL_ZERO;
        GLenum colorOp  = GL_FUNC_ADD;

        GLenum srcAlpha = GL_ONE;
        GLenum dstAlpha = GL_ZERO;
        GLenum alphaOp  = GL_FUNC_ADD;
    };

    struct GlBlendState
    {
        GLboolean alphaToCoverage  = GL_FALSE;
        GLboolean independentBlend = GL_FALSE;
        uint32_t targetCount       = 0;

        GlBlendTargetState targets[8];
    };

    struct GlMultisampleState
    {
        GLboolean sampleShading  = GL_FALSE;
        GLfloat minSampleShading = 1.0f;
    };

    class GlRenderPipeline : public Reflectable<GlRenderPipeline, IRenderPipeline>
    {
    public:
        GlRenderPipeline(GLuint program,
                         const RenderPipelineDesc& desc,
                         const GlRasterState& raster,
                         const GlDepthState& depth,
                         const GlStencilState& stencil,
                         const GlBlendState& blend,
                         const GlMultisampleState& multisample)
            : mProgram(program)
            , mDesc(desc)
            , mRaster(raster)
            , mDepth(depth)
            , mStencil(stencil)
            , mBlend(blend)
            , mMultisample(multisample)
        {
            glGenVertexArrays(1, &mVao);
            glBindVertexArray(mVao);

            for (const auto& a : mDesc.vertexLayout.attributes)
            {
                GLint size     = 0;
                GLenum type    = GL_FLOAT;
                GLboolean norm = GL_FALSE;

                switch (a.format)
                {
                case EVertexFormat::Float32:
                    size = 1;
                    type = GL_FLOAT;
                    break;
                case EVertexFormat::Float32x2:
                    size = 2;
                    type = GL_FLOAT;
                    break;
                case EVertexFormat::Float32x3:
                    size = 3;
                    type = GL_FLOAT;
                    break;
                case EVertexFormat::Float32x4:
                    size = 4;
                    type = GL_FLOAT;
                    break;

                case EVertexFormat::Uint32:
                    size = 1;
                    type = GL_UNSIGNED_INT;
                    break;
                case EVertexFormat::Uint32x2:
                    size = 2;
                    type = GL_UNSIGNED_INT;
                    break;
                case EVertexFormat::Uint32x3:
                    size = 3;
                    type = GL_UNSIGNED_INT;
                    break;
                case EVertexFormat::Uint32x4:
                    size = 4;
                    type = GL_UNSIGNED_INT;
                    break;
                }

                glEnableVertexAttribArray(a.location);

                glVertexAttribFormat(
                    a.location,
                    size,
                    type,
                    norm,
                    a.offset);

                glVertexAttribBinding(a.location, a.bufferSlot);

                glBindVertexBuffer(a.bufferSlot, 0, 0, a.stride);
            }

            glBindVertexArray(0);
        }

        ~GlRenderPipeline()
        {
            if (mVao)
                glDeleteVertexArrays(1, &mVao);
            if (mProgram)
                glDeleteProgram(mProgram);
        }

        void* getNativeHandle() override { return nullptr; }

        GLuint getVao() const { return mVao; }
        GLuint getProgram() const { return mProgram; }

        const GlRasterState& getRasterState() const { return mRaster; }
        const GlDepthState& getDepthState() const { return mDepth; }
        const GlStencilState& getStencilState() const { return mStencil; }
        const GlBlendState& getBlendState() const { return mBlend; }
        const GlMultisampleState& getMultisampleState() const { return mMultisample; }

    private:
        GLuint mProgram = 0;
        GLuint mVao     = 0;

        RenderPipelineDesc mDesc;
        GlRasterState mRaster;
        GlDepthState mDepth;
        GlStencilState mStencil;
        GlBlendState mBlend;
        GlMultisampleState mMultisample;
    };

    class GlComputePipeline : public Reflectable<GlComputePipeline, IComputePipeline>
    {
    public:
        GlComputePipeline(GLuint program, const ComputePipelineDesc& desc)
            : mProgram(program)
            , mDesc(desc)
        {
        }

        ~GlComputePipeline()
        {
            if (mProgram != 0)
                glDeleteProgram(mProgram);
        }

        void* getNativeHandle() override
        {
            return reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(mProgram));
        }

        GLuint getProgram() const { return mProgram; }
        const ComputePipelineDesc& getDesc() const { return mDesc; }

    private:
        GLuint mProgram = 0;
        ComputePipelineDesc mDesc;
    };

}
```

### vislab/opengl/include/vislab/opengl/gl_render_target_view.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <GL/glew.h>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    class GlRenderTargetView : public Reflectable<GlRenderTargetView, IGpuRenderTargetView>
    {
    public:
        GlRenderTargetView(GLuint texture,
                           GLenum target,
                           const TextureDesc& desc,
                           const TextureViewDesc& view)
            : mTexture(texture)
            , mTarget(target)
            , mDesc(desc)
            , mView(view)
        {

            glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, mFbo);

            attach(GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0);

            GLenum buf = GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0;

            assert(glCheckFramebufferStatus(GL_FRAMEBUFFER) == GL_FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE);
            glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

        {
            if (mFbo)
                glDeleteFramebuffers(1, &mFbo);
        }

        GLuint getFramebuffer() const { return mFbo; }
        GLuint getTexture() const { return mTexture; }
        GLenum getTarget() const { return mTarget; }

        const TextureDesc& getDesc() const { return mDesc; }
        const TextureViewDesc& getViewDesc() const { return mView; }

        void* getNativeHandle() override
        {
            return reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(mFbo));
        }

    private:
        void attach(GLenum attachment)
        {
            if (mTarget == GL_TEXTURE_2D || mTarget == GL_TEXTURE_2D_MULTISAMPLE)
            {
                glFramebufferTexture2D(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, attachment, mTarget,
                                       mTexture, mView.baseMip);
            }
            else
            {
                glFramebufferTextureLayer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, attachment,
                                          mTexture, mView.baseMip, mView.baseLayer);
            }
        }

        GLuint mTexture = 0;
        GLenum mTarget  = GL_TEXTURE_2D;
        GLuint mFbo     = 0;

        TextureDesc mDesc;
        TextureViewDesc mView;
    };

}

### vislab/opengl/include/vislab/opengl/gl_swapchain.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <GL/glew.h>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>

#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    class GlSwapchain : public Reflectable<GlSwapchain, ISwapchain>
    {
    public:
        GlSwapchain(std::unique_ptr<IGpuTexture> backbuffer,
                    std::unique_ptr<IGpuRenderTargetView> renderTarget,
                    GLuint framebuffer,
                    void* windowHandle,
                    std::function<void(void*)> swapCallback,
                    const SwapchainDesc& desc)
            : mBackbuffer(std::move(backbuffer))
            , mRenderTarget(std::move(renderTarget))
            , mFramebuffer(framebuffer)
            , mWindowHandle(windowHandle)
            , mSwapCallback(std::move(swapCallback))
            , mDesc(desc)
        {
        }

        ~GlSwapchain()
        {
            if (mFramebuffer != 0)
                glDeleteFramebuffers(1, &mFramebuffer);
        }

        void* getNativeHandle() override
        {
            // Expose the FBO used as the "swapchain image"
            return reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(mFramebuffer));
        }

        SwapchainImage acquireNextImage() override
        {
            return { mBackbuffer.get(), mRenderTarget.get() };
        }

        void present() override
        {
            glBindFramebuffer(GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, mFramebuffer);
            glBindFramebuffer(GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

            glBlitFramebuffer(
                0, 0,
                static_cast<GLint>(mDesc.width),
                static_cast<GLint>(mDesc.height),
                0, 0,
                static_cast<GLint>(mDesc.width),
                static_cast<GLint>(mDesc.height),
                GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT,
                GL_NEAREST);

            glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);

            if (mSwapCallback)
                mSwapCallback(mWindowHandle);
        }


        const SwapchainDesc& getDesc() const override
        {
            return mDesc;
        }

    private:
        std::unique_ptr<IGpuTexture> mBackbuffer;
        std::unique_ptr<IGpuRenderTargetView> mRenderTarget;

        GLuint mFramebuffer = 0;

        void* mWindowHandle = nullptr;
        std::function<void(void*)> mSwapCallback;

        SwapchainDesc mDesc;
    };
}
```

### vislab/opengl/include/vislab/opengl/gl_unordered_access_view.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <GL/glew.h>
#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    class GlUnorderedAccessView
        : public Reflectable<GlUnorderedAccessView, IGpuUnorderedAccessView>
    {
    public:
        enum class GlViewKind
        {
            Buffer, // SSBO or TBO-as-buffer
            Texture // Texture image load/store
        };

        // Unified constructor for buffer UAVs (Structured, Raw, Typed)
        GlUnorderedAccessView(GlViewKind kind,
                              GLuint handle,
                              GLenum target,
                              GLintptr offset,
                              GLsizeiptr size,
                              GLenum internalFormat)
            : mKind(kind)
            , mHandle(handle)
            , mTarget(target)
            , mOffset(offset)
            , mSize(size)
            , mInternalFormat(internalFormat)
        {
        }

        // Texture UAV constructor (image load/store on textures)
        GlUnorderedAccessView(GlViewKind kind,
                              GLuint handle,
                              GLenum target,
                              GLenum internalFormat,
                              GLint mip,
                              GLint layer)
            : mKind(kind)
            , mHandle(handle)
            , mTarget(target)
            , mInternalFormat(internalFormat)
            , mMip(mip)
            , mLayer(layer)
        {
        }

        bool isBuffer() const { return mKind == GlViewKind::Buffer; }
        bool isTexture() const { return mKind == GlViewKind::Texture; }

        GLuint getHandle() const { return mHandle; }
        GLenum getTarget() const { return mTarget; }

        // Buffer UAV fields
        GLintptr getOffset() const { return mOffset; }
        GLsizeiptr getSize() const { return mSize; }

        // Typed buffer + texture UAV fields
        GLenum getInternalFormat() const { return mInternalFormat; }
        GLint getMip() const { return mMip; }
        GLint getLayer() const { return mLayer; }

        void* getNativeHandle() override
        {
            return reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(mHandle));
        }

    private:
        GlViewKind mKind;

        GLuint mHandle = 0;
        GLenum mTarget = 0;

        // Buffer UAV fields (SSBO or TBO)
        GLintptr mOffset = 0;
        GLsizeiptr mSize = 0;

        // Typed buffer UAV + texture UAV fields
        GLenum mInternalFormat = GL_R32UI;
        GLint mMip             = 0;
        GLint mLayer           = 0;
    };

### vislab/render/include/vislab/render/gpu_buffer.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "gpu_resource.hpp"

#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>

#include <memory>

namespace vislab
{
    class IGraphicsDevice;
    class ICommandList;

    /**
     * @brief Render-layer wrapper around a GPU buffer.
     *
     * This class owns an IGpuBuffer and provides convenient upload() and read()
     * methods that delegate to the IGraphicsDevice. It does not contain backend
     * logic and does not expose mapping.
     *
     * GpuBuffer is the lowest-level GPU buffer abstraction:
     *  - created from a BufferDesc
     *  - fixed size (no resizing)
     *  - no CPU-side identity
     *  - general upload/read functions
     *
     * Higher-level abstractions (GpuConstantBuffer, GpuArray) build on top.
     */
    class GpuBuffer : public Reflectable<GpuBuffer, GpuResource>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Construct a GPU buffer from a BufferDesc.
         *
         * The buffer is GPU-only: it has no CPU-side identity and does not
         * automatically update. Higher-level wrappers may store CPU data and
         * call upload() explicitly.
         */
        GpuBuffer(IGraphicsDevice* device, const BufferDesc& desc);

        /**
         * @brief Upload CPU data into the GPU buffer.
         *
         * @param cmd    Command list used for the upload.
         * @param data   Pointer to CPU memory.
         * @param size   Number of bytes to upload.
         * @param offset Byte offset into the GPU buffer.
         */
        void upload(ICommandList* cmd, const void* data, size_t size, size_t offset = 0);

        /**
         * @brief Read GPU data back into CPU memory.
         *
         * @param dst    Destination CPU memory.
         * @param size   Number of bytes to read.
         * @param offset Byte offset into the GPU buffer.
         */
        void read(void* dst, size_t size, size_t offset = 0) const;

        /**
         * @brief Access the underlying GPU buffer handle.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] IGpuBuffer* getHandle() const noexcept { return mBuffer.get(); }

        /**
         * @brief Returns the buffer description used to create this buffer.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const BufferDesc& getDesc() const noexcept { return mDesc; }

    private:
        IGraphicsDevice* mDevice = nullptr;
        BufferDesc mDesc;
        std::unique_ptr<IGpuBuffer> mBuffer;
    };
}
```

### vislab/render/include/vislab/render/gpu_camera.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "gpu_constant_buffer.hpp"
#include "gpu_resource.hpp"

#include <Eigen/Eigen>
#include <memory>

namespace vislab
{
    class Camera;
    class IGraphicsDevice;
    class ICommandList;

    /**
     * GpuCamera
     * ---------
     *
     * GPU-side representation of a CPU Camera.
     *
     * This class mirrors a CPU-side camera object into a GPU constant buffer.
     *
     *   - Derived classes store a non-owning pointer to a CPU camera
     *   - Derived classes override fillParams() to populate the CPU-side struct
     *   - allocate() creates the GPU constant buffer with initial data
     *   - update() refreshes the GPU buffer every frame
     *
     * GpuCamera does NOT own the CPU camera. The CPU camera must outlive the
     * GpuCamera instance.
     *
     */
    class GpuCamera : public Reflectable<GpuCamera, GpuResource>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~GpuCamera() = default;

        /**
         * @brief Uploads CPU-side camera parameters to the GPU constant buffer.
         *
         * Calls fillParams() to refresh the CPU-side struct, then updates the
         * GPU buffer with the new data.
         */
        void update(ICommandList* cmd);

        /// Bind the camera constant buffer to the given slot and shader stages.
        void bind(ICommandList* cmd,
                  EShaderStage stages,
                  uint32_t slot) const;

        /**
         * @brief Returns the underlying GPU constant buffer handle.
         *
         * This is the IGpuBuffer used for binding the camera parameters in
         * shader stages.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] IGpuBuffer* getUniformHandle() const noexcept
        {
            return mBuffer.getHandle();
        }

    protected:
        /**
         * @brief Constructs a GPU camera wrapper.
         *
         * The derived class must call allocate() after storing its CPU camera
         * pointer.
         */
        explicit GpuCamera(IGraphicsDevice* device);

        /**
         * @brief Allocates the GPU constant buffer and initializes it.
         *
         * Calls fillParams() to populate the CPU-side struct, then creates
         * a GpuConstantBuffer<Params> with the initial data.
         */
        void allocate();

        /**
         * @brief Populates the CPU-side parameter struct.
         *
         * Derived classes must override this to write view/proj matrices and
         * camera position into mBuffer.getData().
         */
        virtual void fillParams() {}

        /**
         * @brief Layout of the camera constant buffer.
         *
         * Matches the shader-side camera UBO layout.
         */
        struct Params
        {
            Eigen::Matrix4f view;
            Eigen::Matrix4f proj;
            Eigen::Vector3f cameraPosition;
            float _pad0; ///< Padding for 16-byte alignment
        };

        IGraphicsDevice* mDevice = nullptr;

        /// @brief GPU constant buffer storing camera parameters.
        GpuConstantBuffer<Params> mBuffer;
    };
}

### vislab/render/include/vislab/render/gpu_constant_buffer.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <memory>
#include <string>

#include <vislab/gpu/interfaces.hpp>
#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Strongly-typed constant/uniform buffer wrapper.
     *
     * This class represents the canonical pattern for GPU constant buffers:
     *
     *   - A CPU-side struct TData is stored *inside* the wrapper.
     *   - A GPU buffer of fixed size (aligned to 16 bytes) is created once.
     *   - The user modifies the CPU struct via getData() and calls update().
     *   - The buffer is bound to shader stages via bind().
     *
     * GpuConstantBuffer<TData> is intentionally *not* a general-purpose buffer:
     *
     *   - It does not resize (size is sizeof(TData)).
     *   - It does not track external CPU memory.
     *   - It does not use RawArray.
     *   - It is not cached (each material/camera/light owns its own instance).
     *
     */
    template <typename TData>
    class GpuConstantBuffer
    {
    public:
        GpuConstantBuffer() = default;

        /**
         * @brief Construct a constant buffer and initialize GPU memory with given data.
         *
         * @param device     Graphics device used to create the GPU buffer.
         * @param initialData CPU-side struct used to initialize both CPU and GPU copies.
         * @param debugName  Optional debug label for GPU resource tracking.
         */
        GpuConstantBuffer(IGraphicsDevice* device,
                          const TData& initialData,
                          const std::string& debugName = "")
            : mData(initialData)
        {
            create(device, &mData, debugName);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Construct a constant buffer with default-initialized CPU data.
         *
         * GPU memory is initialized with zeroes (or whatever the backend does
         * when initialData == nullptr).
         *
         * @param device     Graphics device used to create the GPU buffer.
         * @param debugName  Optional debug label for GPU resource tracking.
         */
        GpuConstantBuffer(IGraphicsDevice* device,
                          const std::string& debugName = "")
        {
            create(device, nullptr, debugName);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Upload the CPU-side struct to the GPU buffer.
         *
         * This must be called after modifying getData().
         *
         * @param cmd Command list used for the upload.
         */
        void update(ICommandList* cmd)
        {
            if (!mBuffer)
                return;

            cmd->updateBuffer(mBuffer.get(), &mData, sizeof(TData), 0);
        }

        /**
         * @brief Bind the constant buffer to one or more shader stages.
         *
         * @param cmd    Command list used for binding.
         * @param stages Shader stages to bind to (bitmask).
         * @param slot   Binding slot index.
         */
        void bind(ICommandList* cmd, EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot) const
        {
            cmd->bindUniformBuffer(stages, slot, mBuffer.get());
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Accessors
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        /// @brief Read-only access to the CPU-side struct.
        [[nodiscard]] const TData& getData() const { return mData; }

        /// @brief Mutable access to the CPU-side struct.
        [[nodiscard]] TData& getData() { return mData; }

        /// @brief Access the underlying GPU buffer handle.
        [[nodiscard]] IGpuBuffer* getHandle() const { return mBuffer.get(); }

    private:
        /**
         * @brief Internal helper to create the GPU buffer.
         *
         * @param device      Graphics device.
         * @param initialData Optional pointer to initial CPU data.
         * @param debugName   Debug label for the GPU resource.
         */
        void create(IGraphicsDevice* device,
                    const void* initialData,
                    const std::string& debugName = "")
        {
            uint32_t size        = sizeof(TData);
            uint32_t alignedSize = (size + 15) & ~15u; // 16-byte alignment

            BufferDesc desc{};
            desc.size        = alignedSize;
            desc.bindFlags   = EBufferBindFlags::Uniform;
            desc.memoryType  = EMemoryType::DeviceLocal;
            desc.debugName   = debugName;
            desc.initialData = initialData;

            mBuffer = device->createBuffer(desc);
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Members
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        TData mData{};                       ///< CPU-side copy of the constant buffer struct.
        std::unique_ptr<IGpuBuffer> mBuffer; ///< GPU-side uniform buffer.
    };
}
```

### vislab/render/include/vislab/render/gpu_image.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "gpu_depth_stencil_view.hpp"
#include "gpu_render_target_view.hpp"
#include "gpu_resource.hpp"
#include "gpu_sampler.hpp"
#include "gpu_shader_resource_view.hpp"
#include "gpu_texture2d.hpp"
#include "gpu_unordered_access_view.hpp"

#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>

#include <memory>
#include <string>

namespace vislab
{
    class IGraphicsDevice;
    class ICommandList;
    class RawImage;

    /**
     * GpuImage
     * --------
     *
     * GPU-side mirror of a CPU RawImage.
     *
     * This class mirrors a RawImage into a GPU 2D texture. It:
     *   - uploads CPU data to the GPU
     *   - recreates the GPU texture when the RawImage resizes
     *   - optionally creates views and a sampler based on bind flags
     *
     * Ownership Model
     * ---------------
     *
     * GpuImage always owns its GpuTexture2d, views, and sampler.
     * The CPU RawImage is non-owning and must outlive this object.
     */
    class GpuImage : public Reflectable<GpuImage, GpuResource>
    {
    public:
        GpuImage(IGraphicsDevice* device,
                 const RawImage* cpuImage,
                 ETextureBindFlags bindFlags  = ETextureBindFlags::ShaderResource,
                 EMemoryType memoryType       = EMemoryType::DeviceLocal,
                 const std::string& debugName = "");

        /// Upload CPU -> GPU, recreating the texture if needed.
        void update(ICommandList* cmd);

        /// Access underlying GPU texture.
        GpuTexture2d* getTexture() const noexcept { return mTexture.get(); }

        /// Optional views, depending on bind flags.
        GpuShaderResourceView* getSRV() const noexcept { return mSRV.get(); }
        GpuUnorderedAccessView* getUAV() const noexcept { return mUAV.get(); }
        GpuRenderTargetView* getRTV() const noexcept { return mRTV.get(); }
        GpuDepthStencilView* getDSV() const noexcept { return mDSV.get(); }

        /// Optional sampler, created when sampled usage is requested.
        GpuSampler* getSampler() const noexcept { return mSampler.get(); }

        /// CPU RawImage pointer (non-owning).
        const RawImage* getCpuImage() const noexcept { return mCpuImage; }

        /// Current texture description used to create the GPU texture.
        const TextureDesc& getDesc() const noexcept { return mDesc; }

        /// Bind sampler.
        void bindSampler(ICommandList* cmd, EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot) const;

        /// Bind shader resource view (read-only).
        void bindSRV(ICommandList* cmd, EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot) const;

        /// Bind unordered access view (read-write).
        void bindUAV(ICommandList* cmd, EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot) const;

        /// Unbind shader resource view (read-only).
        void unbindSRV(ICommandList* cmd, EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot) const;

        /// Unbind unordered access view (read-write).
        void unbindUAV(ICommandList* cmd, EShaderStage stages, uint32_t slot) const;

        // Resizes the texture to the resolution of the underlying RawImage.
        void resize();

    private:
        void recreateTextureIfNeeded();
        void createViewsIfNeeded();
        void createSamplerIfNeeded();
        void upload(ICommandList* cmd);

    private:
        IGraphicsDevice* mDevice = nullptr;

        const RawImage* mCpuImage = nullptr; // non-owning

        uint32_t mWidth  = 0;
        uint32_t mHeight = 0;

        TextureDesc mDesc{}; // derived from RawImage + ctor parameters

        std::unique_ptr<GpuTexture2d> mTexture;

        std::unique_ptr<GpuShaderResourceView> mSRV;
        std::unique_ptr<GpuUnorderedAccessView> mUAV;
        std::unique_ptr<GpuRenderTargetView> mRTV;
        std::unique_ptr<GpuDepthStencilView> mDSV;

        std::unique_ptr<GpuSampler> mSampler;

        ETextureBindFlags mBindFlags = ETextureBindFlags::None;
    };

} // namespace vislab

### vislab/render/include/vislab/render/gpu_mesh.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "gpu_array.hpp"
#include "gpu_resource.hpp"
#include "gpu_resource_cache.hpp"
#include "vertex_streams.hpp"

#include <vislab/geometry/mesh_fwd.hpp>

#include <Eigen/Core>
#include <Eigen/Geometry>

#include <memory>
#include <vector>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * GpuMesh
     * -------
     *
     * GPU-side representation of a Mesh3f.
     *
     * This class mirrors all vertex/index streams of a Mesh3f using GpuArray
     * objects. A GpuArray is a GPU buffer wrapper that automatically:
     *
     *   - uploads CPU data to the GPU
     *   - recreates the GPU buffer when the underlying RawArray resizes
     *
     * GpuMesh is intentionally a *thin* wrapper:
     *   - it does not own or modify the CPU mesh
     *   - it does not perform CPU-side mesh processing
     *   - it only binds GPU buffers and issues draw calls
     *
     * Ownership Model
     * ---------------
     *
     * GpuMesh supports two modes:
     *
     *   (1) With GpuResourceCache (normal engine use)
     *       - GpuArray instances are created and owned by the cache
     *       - GpuMesh receives raw pointers from the cache
     *       - GpuMesh must NOT delete these pointers
     *
     *   (2) Without cache (demo / teaching / standalone)
     *       - GpuMesh allocates its own GpuArray instances
     *       - GpuMesh must delete them on destruction
     *
     * To support both modes uniformly, GpuMesh stores all GpuArray pointers
     * inside a std::unique_ptr with a custom deleter that conditionally deletes
     * the pointer.
     *
     * Vertex Streams
     * --------------
     *
     * The following Mesh3f streams are mirrored:
     *   - positions   -> slot 0
     *   - normals     -> slot 1
     *   - texcoords   -> slot 2
     *   - attributes  -> slots 3+i
     *   - indices     -> index buffer
     *
     * The vertex layout is generated dynamically based on the CPU mesh.
     */
    class GpuMesh : public Reflectable<GpuMesh, GpuResource>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * Construct a GPU representation of a Mesh3f.
         *
         * @param device  Graphics device used to create GPU buffers.
         * @param mesh    CPU-side mesh to mirror. Must remain valid for the
         *                lifetime of this GpuMesh.
         * @param cache   Optional resource cache. If provided, GpuArray objects
         *                are retrieved from the cache and NOT owned by GpuMesh.
         *                If null, GpuMesh owns all GpuArray objects it creates.
         */
        GpuMesh(IGraphicsDevice* device,
                const Mesh3f* mesh,
                GpuResourceCache* cache = nullptr);

        /// Bind all enabled vertex/index streams.
        void bind(ICommandList* cmd, EVertexStream streams) const;

        /// Issue draw calls for all submeshes or the full mesh.
        void draw(ICommandList* cmd) const;

        /// Update all GPU buffers from the CPU mesh.
        void update(ICommandList* cmd);

        /// Access underlying CPU mesh.
        const Mesh3f* getMesh() const noexcept { return mMesh; }

        /// Axis-aligned bounding box computed from CPU positions.
        const Eigen::AlignedBox3f& getBounds() const noexcept { return mBounds; }

        /// Direct accessors for GPU arrays.
        GpuArray* getPositions() { return mPositions.get(); }
        GpuArray* getNormals() { return mNormals.get(); }
        GpuArray* getTexCoords() { return mTexCoords.get(); }
        GpuArray* getAttribute(int index) { return mAttributes[index].get(); }
        GpuArray* getIndices() { return mIndices.get(); }

        /// Build a vertex layout description for pipeline creation.
        VertexLayoutDesc getVertexLayout() const;

    private:
        /// Recompute bounding box from CPU positions.
        void computeBounds();

        /**
         * ArrayDeleter
         * ------------
         *
         * Custom deleter for std::unique_ptr<GpuArray>.
         *
         * The "owns" flag determines whether the GpuArray should be deleted:
         *   - owns = true  -> delete p
         *   - owns = false -> do nothing (cache owns the resource)
         *
         * This allows GpuMesh to store both cache-owned and self-owned GpuArray
         * instances uniformly inside std::unique_ptr.
         */
        struct ArrayDeleter
        {
            ArrayDeleter() = default;
            explicit ArrayDeleter(bool owns) : owns(owns) {}
            ~ArrayDeleter() = default;

            bool owns = false;

            void operator()(GpuArray* p) const noexcept
            {
                if (owns)
                    delete p;
            }
        };

        /// Convenience alias for a unique_ptr with conditional ownership.
        using ArrayPtr = std::unique_ptr<GpuArray, ArrayDeleter>;

        /// Wrap a cache-owned GpuArray pointer (non-owning).
        static ArrayPtr makeNonOwning(GpuArray* ptr);

        /// Wrap a newly allocated GpuArray pointer (owning).
        static ArrayPtr makeOwning(GpuArray* ptr);

    private:
        IGraphicsDevice* mDevice = nullptr;
        GpuResourceCache* mCache = nullptr;
        const Mesh3f* mMesh      = nullptr;

        // GPU buffers for each vertex/index stream.
        ArrayPtr mPositions;
        ArrayPtr mNormals;
        ArrayPtr mTexCoords;
        std::vector<ArrayPtr> mAttributes;
        ArrayPtr mIndices;

        // CPU-side bounding box.
        Eigen::AlignedBox3f mBounds;
    };

} // namespace vislab
```

### vislab/render/include/vislab/render/gpu_resource.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <vislab/core/reflectable.hpp>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Base class for all GPU-side resources created by the renderer.
     *
     * This class exists so that the GpuResourceCache can store heterogeneous
     * GPU resources in type-erased containers.
     */
    class GpuResource : public Reflectable<GpuResource>
    {
    public:
        virtual ~GpuResource() = default;

        // Non-copyable, non-movable (GPU resources have identity)
        GpuResource(const GpuResource&)            = delete;
        GpuResource& operator=(const GpuResource&) = delete;

    protected:
        GpuResource() = default;
    };
}

### vislab/render/include/vislab/render/gpu_resource_cache.hpp
```
// vislab/render/include/vislab/render/gpu_resource_cache.hpp
#pragma once

#include "gpu_resource.hpp"

#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <type_traits>
#include <typeindex>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace vislab
{
    class GpuResourceCache
    {
    public:
        GpuResourceCache()  = default;
        ~GpuResourceCache() = default;

        GpuResourceCache(const GpuResourceCache&)            = delete;
        GpuResourceCache& operator=(const GpuResourceCache&) = delete;

        template <typename TGpu, typename TCpu, typename CreateFn>
        TGpu* getOrCreate(const std::shared_ptr<const TCpu>& cpuShared,
                          CreateFn&& create)
        {
            static_assert(std::is_base_of<GpuResource, TGpu>::value,
                          "TGpu must derive from GpuResource");

            ResourceMap& typeMap = mResources[std::type_index(typeid(TGpu))];

            std::shared_ptr<const void> erased(cpuShared,
                                               static_cast<const void*>(cpuShared.get()));
            WeakKey key(erased);

            auto it = typeMap.find(key);
            if (it != typeMap.end())
            {
                std::unique_ptr<GpuResource>& stored = it->second;
                return static_cast<TGpu*>(stored.get());
            }

            std::unique_ptr<GpuResource> gpuBase = create();
            TGpu* gpuPtr                         = static_cast<TGpu*>(gpuBase.get());

            typeMap.emplace(key, std::move(gpuBase));
            return gpuPtr;
        }

        void collectGarbage()
        {
            auto typeIt = mResources.begin();
            while (typeIt != mResources.end())
            {
                ResourceMap& map = typeIt->second;

                auto it = map.begin();
                while (it != map.end())
                {
                    const WeakKey& key = it->first;
                    if (key.expired())
                    {
                        auto eraseIt = it;
                        ++it;
                        map.erase(eraseIt);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ++it;
                    }
                }

                if (map.empty())
                {
                    auto eraseTypeIt = typeIt;
                    ++typeIt;
                    mResources.erase(eraseTypeIt);
                }
                else
                {
                    ++typeIt;
                }
            }
        }

        void clear()
        {
            mResources.clear();
        }

    private:
        using WeakKey     = std::weak_ptr<const void>;
        using WeakLess    = std::owner_less<WeakKey>;
        using ResourceMap = std::map<WeakKey, std::unique_ptr<GpuResource>, WeakLess>;

        std::unordered_map<std::type_index, ResourceMap> mResources;
    };
}
```
