### vislab/render/include/vislab/render/gpu_texture2d.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "gpu_resource.hpp"

#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>

#include <memory>

namespace vislab
{
    class IGraphicsDevice;
    class ICommandList;
    class IGpuTexture;

    /**
     * GpuTexture2d
     * ------------
     *
     * Low-level GPU texture resource.
     *
     * This class represents a 2D GPU texture created strictly from a
     * TextureDesc. It has:
     *
     *   - no CPU-side image pointer
     *   - no resize logic
     *   - no format conversion
     *   - no stored SRV/RTV/UAV views
     *
     * It is the exact analogue of GpuBuffer: a pure GPU resource with
     * upload/read operations and a stable description.
     *
     * Higher-level CPU-backed wrappers (e.g. GpuImage2d) should own or
     * reference a GpuTexture2d and handle resize, format conversion,
     * and caching.
     */
    class GpuTexture2d : public GpuResource
    {
    public:
        /**
         * Construct a GPU texture from a description.
         *
         * The TextureDesc fully defines the texture's size, format,
         * mip levels, usage flags, and optional initialData.
         *
         * @param device  Graphics device used to create the GPU texture.
         * @param desc    Texture description. Must be fully initialized.
         */
        GpuTexture2d(IGraphicsDevice* device, const TextureDesc& desc);

        /**
         * Upload raw pixel data into the texture.
         *
         * The caller must ensure:
         *   - data matches the texture's format
         *   - rowPitch matches the layout of the source data
         *
         * @param cmd       Command list used for the upload.
         * @param data      Pointer to CPU pixel data.
         * @param rowPitch  Number of bytes per row in the source data.
         */
        void upload(ICommandList* cmd, const void* data, size_t rowPitch);

        /**
         * Read back texture data into CPU memory.
         *
         * @param cmd       Command list used for the readback.
         * @param dst       Destination CPU buffer.
         * @param rowPitch  Number of bytes per row in the destination buffer.
         */
        void read(ICommandList* cmd, void* dst, size_t rowPitch) const;

        /// @brief Returns the texture description used to create the resource.
        const TextureDesc& getDesc() const noexcept { return mDesc; }

        /// @brief Returns the underlying GPU texture handle.
        IGpuTexture* getHandle() const noexcept { return mTexture.get(); }

    private:
        IGraphicsDevice* mDevice = nullptr;    ///< Device used for creation.
        TextureDesc mDesc{};                   ///< Immutable texture description.
        std::unique_ptr<IGpuTexture> mTexture; ///< GPU texture object (owned).
    };

} // namespace vislab
```

### vislab/render/include/vislab/render/gpu_texture3d.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "gpu_resource.hpp"

#include <vislab/gpu/types.hpp>

#include <memory>

namespace vislab
{
    class IGraphicsDevice;
    class ICommandList;
    class IGpuTexture;

    /**
     * GpuTexture3d
     * ------------
     *
     * Low-level GPU 3D texture resource.
     *
     * This class represents a 3D GPU texture created strictly from a
     * TextureDesc. It has:
     *
     *   - no CPU-side field pointer
     *   - no resize logic
     *   - no format conversion
     *   - no stored SRV/RTV/UAV views
     *
     * Upload and readback semantics match the existing engine:
     *
     *   - Uploads are performed via ICommandList::updateTexture3d()
     *   - Readback is performed via IGraphicsDevice::readTexture3d()
     *
     * Higher-level wrappers (e.g. GpuVolume3d, GpuRegularSteadyScalarFieldGpu)
     * handle CPU-backed data, resize detection, and caching.
     */
    class GpuTexture3d : public GpuResource
    {
    public:
        /**
         * Construct a GPU 3D texture from a description.
         *
         * @param device  Graphics device used to create the GPU texture.
         * @param desc    Fully initialized texture description.
         */
        GpuTexture3d(IGraphicsDevice* device, const TextureDesc& desc);

        /**
         * Upload raw voxel data into the texture.
         *
         * Uses ICommandList::updateTexture3d() internally.
         *
         * @param cmd         Command list used for the upload.
         * @param data        Pointer to CPU voxel data.
         * @param rowPitch    Bytes per row in the source data.
         * @param slicePitch  Bytes per slice (rowPitch * height).
         */
        void upload(ICommandList* cmd,
                    const void* data,
                    size_t rowPitch,
                    size_t slicePitch);

        /**
         * Read back texture data into CPU memory.
         *
         * Uses IGraphicsDevice::readTexture3d() internally.
         *
         * @param cmd         (Unused) Command list parameter for symmetry.
         * @param dst         Destination CPU buffer.
         * @param rowPitch    Bytes per row in the destination buffer.
         * @param slicePitch  Bytes per slice in the destination buffer.
         */
        void read(ICommandList* cmd,
                  void* dst,
                  size_t rowPitch,
                  size_t slicePitch) const;

        /// @brief Returns the texture description used to create the resource.
        const TextureDesc& getDesc() const noexcept { return mDesc; }

        /// @brief Returns the underlying GPU texture handle.
        IGpuTexture* getHandle() const noexcept { return mTexture.get(); }

    private:
        IGraphicsDevice* mDevice = nullptr;    ///< Device used for creation.
        TextureDesc mDesc{};                   ///< Immutable texture description.
        std::unique_ptr<IGpuTexture> mTexture; ///< GPU texture object (owned).
    };

} // namespace vislab
```

### vislab/render/include/vislab/render/vertex_streams.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <stdint.h>

namespace vislab
{
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Vertex Stream Mask
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    enum class EVertexStream : uint32_t
    {
        None = 0,

        Position = 1 << 0,
        Normal   = 1 << 1,
        TexCoord = 1 << 2,

        Attribute0 = 1 << 3,
        Attribute1 = 1 << 4,
        Attribute2 = 1 << 5,
        Attribute3 = 1 << 6
    };

    inline EVertexStream operator|(EVertexStream a, EVertexStream b)
    {
        return static_cast<EVertexStream>(
            static_cast<uint32_t>(a) | static_cast<uint32_t>(b));
    }

    inline bool hasStream(EVertexStream mask, EVertexStream flag)
    {
        return (static_cast<uint32_t>(mask) & static_cast<uint32_t>(flag)) != 0;
    }
}

#pragma once

### vislab/scene/include/vislab/scene/component.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <vislab/core/iserializable.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/object.hpp>

#include "resource.hpp"
#include "tag.hpp"
#include "tags.hpp"

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Tag that can be added to a transform to indicate that the transform has changed.
     */
    class ComponentChangedTag : public Concrete<ComponentChangedTag, Tag>
    {
    };

    /**
     * @brief Base class for components.
     */
    class Component : public Interface<Component, Object, ISerializable, Resource>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Checks whether the component has changed.
         * @return True if the component has changed.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] bool hasChanged() const
        {
            return mTags.has<ComponentChangedTag>();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Marks that this component has changed. Derived systems such as renderers will use this information to update their internal state.
         */
        void markChanged()
        {
            mTags.add<ComponentChangedTag>();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Marks that this component has not changed.
         */
        void markUnchanged()
        {
            mTags.remove<ComponentChangedTag>();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the tags that are attached to this component. Tags are used to put flags onto an object, for example to inform different systems that a state has changed.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Tags& getTags() { return mTags; }

        /**
         * @brief Gets the tags that are attached to this component. Tags are used to put flags onto an object, for example to inform different systems that a state has changed.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const Tags& getTags() const { return mTags; }

    private:
        /**
         * @brief Tags that are attached to this component. Tags are used to put flags onto an object, for example to inform different systems that a state has changed.
         */
        Tags mTags;
    };
}

### vislab/scene/include/vislab/scene/tags.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <vislab/core/event.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/object.hpp>
#include <vislab/core/iserializable.hpp>

#include <set>

namespace vislab
{
    class Tag;

    /**
     * @brief Implements a basic collection of tags.
     */
    class Tags : public Concrete<Tags, Object, ISerializable>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Adds a tag.
         * @tparam TTag Type of the tag to add.
         * @param tag Tag to add.
         */
        template <typename TTag>
        void add()
        {
            if (!has<TTag>())
                mTags.insert(TTag::type().identifier());
        }

        /**
         * @brief Removes a tag.
         * @tparam TTag Type of the tag to remove.
         */
        template <typename TTag>
        void remove()
        {
            auto it = mTags.find(TTag::type().identifier());
            if (it != mTags.end())
            {
                mTags.erase(it);
            }
        }

        /**
         * @brief Tests if a tag is present.
         * @tparam TTag Type of tag to test.
         * @return True if the tag exists.
         */
        template <typename TTag>
        [[nodiscard]] inline bool has() const
        {
            return mTags.find(TTag::type().identifier()) != mTags.end();
        }

        /**
         * @brief Serializes the object into/from an archive.
         * @param archive Archive to serialize into/from.
         */
        void serialize(IArchive& archive) override;

    private:
        /**
         * @brief Collection of tags, indexed by their unique identifiers.
         */
        std::set<std::size_t> mTags;
    };
}
```

### vislab/scene/include/vislab/scene/transform.hpp
```
#pragma once

// #include "ray.hpp"

#include "component.hpp"

#include "tag.hpp"

#include <vislab/core/event.hpp>

#include <Eigen/Eigen>

namespace vislab
{
    /**
     * @brief Component that stores a transformation.
     */
    class Transform : public Concrete<Transform, Component>
    {
    public:
        /**
         * @brief Constructor with an identity transformation.
         */
        Transform();

        /**
         * @brief Constructor with a given initial matrix.
         * @param matrix Initial matrix.
         */
        Transform(const Eigen::Matrix4d& matrix);

        /**
         * @brief Constructs a transformation from a scale, rotation, and translation (in that order).
         * @param translation Translation vector.
         * @param rotation Rotation quaternion.
         * @param scale Scaling vector.
         */
        Transform(const Eigen::Vector3d& translation, const Eigen::Quaterniond& rotation = Eigen::Quaterniond::Identity(), const Eigen::Vector3d& scale = Eigen::Vector3d::Ones());

        /**
         * @brief Gets the transformation matrix.
         * @return Transformation matrix.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const Eigen::Matrix4d& getMatrix() const;

        /**
         * @brief Inverse of the transformation matrix.
         * @return Inverse matrix.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] const Eigen::Matrix4d& getMatrixInverse() const;

        /**
         * @brief Sets the world transformation matrix.
         * @param matrix Transformation matrix to set.
         */
        void setMatrix(const Eigen::Matrix4d& matrix);

        /**
         * @brief Serializes the object into/from an archive.
         * @param archive Archive to serialize into/from.
         */
        void serialize(IArchive& archive) override;

        /**
         * @brief Event that is raised when the matrix changed.
         */
        Event<const Eigen::Matrix4d&> onChanged;

        /**
         * @brief Affine transformation of a 3D coordinate.
         * @param point Point to transform.
         * @return Transformed point.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Eigen::Vector3d transformPoint(const Eigen::Vector3d& point) const;

        /**
         * @brief Transforms a direction vector.
         * @param direction Direction vector to transform.
         * @return Transformed direction vector.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Eigen::Vector3d transformVector(const Eigen::Vector3d& direction) const;

        /**
         * @brief Transforms a normal vector.
         * @param normal Normal vector to transform.
         * @return Transformed normal vector.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Eigen::Vector3d transformNormal(const Eigen::Vector3d& normal) const;

        /**
         * @brief Affine inverse transformation of a 3D coordinate.
         * @param point Point to transform.
         * @return Transformed point.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Eigen::Vector3d transformPointInverse(const Eigen::Vector3d& point) const;

        /**
         * @brief Inverse transform of a direction vector.
         * @param direction Direction vector to transform.
         * @return Transformed direction vector.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Eigen::Vector3d transformVectorInverse(const Eigen::Vector3d& direction) const;

        /**
         * @brief Transforms the corners of a bounding box and fits an axis aligned bounding box around them.
         * @param oob Object-oriented bounding box to transform.
         * @return Axis-aligned bounding box around the transformed corners of the object-oriented bounding box.
         */
        [[nodiscard]] Eigen::AlignedBox3d transformBox(const Eigen::AlignedBox3d& oob) const;

        Eigen::Vector3d getPosition() const
        {
            return mMatrix.block<3, 1>(0, 3);
        }

        Eigen::Vector3d getRight() const
        {
            return mMatrix.block<3, 1>(0, 0).normalized();
        }

        Eigen::Vector3d getUp() const
        {
            return mMatrix.block<3, 1>(0, 1).normalized();
        }

        Eigen::Vector3d getForward() const
        {
            return mMatrix.block<3, 1>(0, 2).normalized();
        }

    private:
        /**
         * @brief Transformation matrix.
         */
        Eigen::Matrix4d mMatrix;

        /**
         * @brief Inverse of transformation matrix.
         */
        Eigen::Matrix4d mMatrixInverse;
    };
}
```
